unlockedAbilities.name: I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH
unlockedAbilities.description: Allows the user to absorb kinetic energy from movements and impacts upon contact. This stored energy can then be redirected through touch to enhance strikes or manipulate the environment.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Python
unlockedAbilities.description: A technique that combines IFILWPP's kinetic redirection with redirecting footwork. Jostin feeds energy to the kusarigama's chain only at the turning points — the moment before each curve — letting the weapon's own momentum do the work. The weighted blade arcs left, right, and back in tightening bends, and the chain hunts a target across its escape angles before wrapping and pinning a limb (or limbs). Requires precise timing; overfeeding the chain kinks it and pulls the strike off-line, straining the wrist.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Launcher — Twin Volley
unlockedAbilities.description: An advanced variant of the Peach Launcher technique. Jostin crouches low and drives through his legs, flooding every joule of the squat into IFILWPP's reserves so the golden rings spin to a blur. He then launches a scattershot volley — twin hand-flicks sending glass shards, splintered wood, and loose debris tearing across the room in a wide, relentless barrage that is harder to fully block.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Gearshift
unlockedAbilities.description: IFILWPP has evolved beyond absorbing, stockpiling, and redirecting kinetic energy. Jostin can now convert potential energy into kinetic energy, and kinetic energy back into potential energy. The conversion works on his own body and on anything he or IFILWPP touches, including objects and other living beings. With Peach Gearshift, Jostin converts energy held in his body into motion and launches from a standstill with explosive speed and force. He can also halt something in motion, hold its energy in a potential state, then release it later. A person, a weapon, or even a falling object can go from stillness to violent acceleration in an instant. The strain on his body is insane. His muscles, joints, bones, and organs still have to endure the acceleration, sudden stops, and impacts. A full-power launch can tear muscle, fracture bone, or leave him unable to move afterward. He has gained a far greater way to access energy—not a body that can safely withstand all of it.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Assassination
unlockedAbilities.description: A high-speed combat sequence that combines kinetic pulses with precision strikes to non-lethal pressure points. This allows the user to rapidly neutralize multiple opponents with minimal effort by delivering concentrated impact at the exact moment of contact.

unlockedAbilities.name: Eagle Vision
unlockedAbilities.description: By synchronizing his heartbeat with his Stand's kinetic feedback, the user enters a state of heightened sensory perception. This allows them to perceive environmental highlights, identifying hostile threats in red, allies in blue, and key objects of interest in gold.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Limit Break
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin uses the bodily control learned through assassin training to accelerate his heartbeat and blood flow. IFILWPP captures the kinetic energy of his circulation and feeds it back through his body; each pulse amplifies his strength, speed, reflexes, and senses exponentially. He becomes sensitive to tiny movements and vibrations in the air. His star birthmark glows pink-gold, heat shimmers around him, and steam rises from his skin. The longer he maintains it, the greater the strain on his muscles, blood vessels, and heart.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Healing
unlockedAbilities.description: The user channels measured pulses of kinetic energy into another person, synchronizing with their heartbeat to stabilize their condition. This provides a restorative effect that eases physical trauma, steadies breathing, and accelerates the recovery of battered bodies.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Aftershock
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin touches a wall, floor, or object and leaves stored kinetic energy inside it. Peach holds that energy until Jostin chooses to release it, triggering a sudden shove or vibration. Charges can be planted and traps can be set and released at will.

unlockedAbilities.name: Phantom Waltz
unlockedAbilities.description: With Eagle Vision active, Jostin reads the whole battlefield at once. Footsteps, heartbeats, shifting weight, and hostile intent map themselves in his mind. He flows through the path of least resistance, moving from target to target in one continuous sequence, concertedly dodging and striking lethal or nonlethal strikes as the situation demands. It looks like a graceful dance because he never wastes a step.

unlockedAbilities.name: Shadow Step
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin conceals his entire presence: breath, footsteps, sound, intent, and aura. He moves undetected like a ghost, even near enemies. This is assassin training, with no Peach required.

unlockedAbilities.name: Blackstar Dominion
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin projects the force of his will in a wave he can direct. To allies and frightened civilians, it feels warm and steady, quieting panic and helping them hold their ground. To enemies, it becomes crushing pressure that can make seasoned fighters stagger and knock out the weak-willed. When unleashed at full strength, the ground trembles, streetlights burst, and birds fall from the sky. It exists independently of Peach.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Stillpoint: Redirect
unlockedAbilities.description: A defensive counter-technique that allows Jostin to catch an opponent's strike and guide their own momentum against them. This enables him to pin targets or redirect force into the environment to neutralize an attack without taking damage.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Killroom
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin drains the kinetic energy from the surrounding air to create a zone of absolute silence. This muffles all sound and vibrations in the immediate area, allowing for undetected movement and stealthy ambushes.

unlockedAbilities.name: Peach Flash Step
unlockedAbilities.description: Jostin uses the golden rings of his Stand to rapidly discharge stored kinetic energy into his footfalls. This allows for short, explosive bursts of acceleration that create faint afterimages, granting a significant mobility advantage in close-quarters combat.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Concealing truth, constructing believable lies, maintaining cover identities, disguising motives, manipulating impressions, and detecting when a conversation requires careful misdirection. Applies to investigations, undercover work, criminal negotiations, social conflict, secrets, and protecting allies. Deception does not guarantee that others believe the player and should be challenged by evidence, scrutiny, relationships, and consequences.

investigation.name: investigation
investigation.description: Enables careful examination and analysis of surroundings, helping the player uncover clues and secrets.

persuasion.name: persuasion
persuasion.description: Enhances the player's ability to influence others through dialogue.

survival.name: survival
survival.description: Improves the player's ability to endure harsh environments, find food and water, and build shelters.

intimidation.name: intimidation
intimidation.description: Allows the player to use fear as a tool, potentially allowing them to scare off enemies or influence confrontations.

athletics.name: athletics
athletics.description: Improves overall physical performance, enhancing running, jumping, climbing, and other physical feats.

Power Control.name: Power Control
Power Control.description: Mastery of precision, output regulation, timing, safety, and creative use of a personal power under pressure.

Weapon Proficiency.name: Weapon Proficiency
Weapon Proficiency.description: Mastery of safely handling, aiming, maintaining, and fighting with a chosen weapon category. Each character must specify the weapon category they actually trained with; proficiency does not grant access to weapons or invent training.

Close Quarters Combat.name: Close Quarters Combat
Close Quarters Combat.description: Mastery of unarmed fighting at close range, including punches, kicks, clinches, takedowns, holds, escapes, positioning, and nonlethal restraint.

acrobatics.name: acrobatics
acrobatics.description: Improves the player's agility and balance, enabling them to perform acrobatic maneuvers.

Public Communication.name: Public Communication
Public Communication.description: Mastery of interviews, crisis messaging, Pulse strategy, sponsorship judgment, and reputation management.

Strike Tactics.name: Strike Tactics
Strike Tactics.description: Mastery of combat positioning, pursuit, restraint, defensive formations, and controlled power use.

Flirting.name: Flirting
Flirting.description: Showing romantic or sexual interest through playful conversation, teasing, compliments, invitations, and reading reciprocal interest. Supports chemistry and attraction but never guarantees desire, consent, romance, or a particular response.

Relationship Building.name: Relationship Building
Relationship Building.description: Developing trust, familiarity, mutual support, repair after conflict, and durable connections through consistent attention and meaningful shared experiences. Applies to friendship, romance, rivalry, teamwork, clients, and faction ties.

performance.name: performance
performance.description: Enables the player to entertain others through acts such as dancing, singing, or acting.

traits.name: Custom Power
traits.description: Define an original power without selecting a preset category. Describe its name, effects, activation, visual expression, strengths, limitations, risks, starting mastery, and desired ultimate technique.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Treat the player's custom power description as authoritative. In Backstory, ask how the power was discovered, how it shaped the player's life, what early incident revealed its limits, and what goal or fear is connected to mastering it. Never invent the player's answers or decisions.

traits.name: Chaos Gremlin
traits.description: You are mischievous, unpredictable, and drawn to clever trouble, strange solutions, and entertaining disruption.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Chaos Gremlin energy can create surprise, improvisational openings, comic relief, and unconventional solutions. It can also derail plans, attract unwanted attention, provoke conflict, and make reliability harder to prove. The character chooses whether to act; this trait never forces reckless behavior or removes player agency.

traits.name: Legacy Family
traits.description: Your family is known for influence, achievement, wealth, or public tradition.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Connections provide access but expectations can complicate sincere relationships.

traits.name: Cruel Impulses
traits.description: Under pressure, you may feel urges toward harsh, humiliating, or punitive responses.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: This creates temptation, not forced behavior. Harmful choices have consequences.

traits.name: Impulsiveness
traits.description: You react before every consequence has been considered.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Impulsiveness supports fast action but undermines careful investigation.

traits.name: Power and Weapons
traits.description: Combine established powers with trained weapon use, tactical positioning, and practical combat judgment.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Using a weapon requires an established weapon category, access, training, and attention to legality, injury, concealment, and escalation. Applying a power to a weapon follows its authored costs, limits, resources, and cooldowns.

traits.name: Smoker
traits.description: A habitual tobacco user who gains familiar short-term stress relief from cigarettes but carries ongoing health and resource costs.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Cigarettes may provide slightly more reliable short-term Stress relief for this character, but smoking costs money, uses one cigarette from a pack, creates odor and social consequences, can reduce stamina, worsen coughs and colds, impair long-term health, and create habit pressure. Never force smoking, withdrawal, dependence, or use of cigarettes without player choice.

traits.name: Alcoholic
traits.description: You have an ongoing alcohol-use disorder or serious dependence that affects health, routines, finances, relationships, and recovery. This trait does not define your entire identity and does not force drinking, relapse, or a particular outcome.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Track cravings, withdrawal risk, access, support, consent, medical care, stress, and recovery goals without glamorizing alcohol or treating relapse as inevitable. Alcohol use can impair judgment, sleep, health, finances, work, school, relationships, combat readiness, and power control. The character may seek treatment, harm reduction, sobriety, controlled support, or another player-defined path; emergencies require medically plausible care.

traits.name: Power Research
traits.description: You studied power theory, testing, limits, and controlled application.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: You begin with less field experience and must adapt when situations become chaotic.

traits.name: Strike Class
traits.description: A dexterity-focused class built around precision, timing, and decisive attacks.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Favors accurate attacks, quick reactions, and exploiting openings at close or long range. It does not require violence when restraint is safer.

traits.name: Awakened
traits.description: The character's dormant potential activated through age, stress, ritual, crisis, or another major event.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Use this trait to shape memory, timing, fear, discovery, and NPC reactions only. It has no mechanical effects.

traits.name: Empathetic
traits.description: You notice emotional states and respond to them quickly.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Empathy supports social reading but can make emotional pressure distracting.

traits.name: Nonchalant
traits.description: You meet danger, pressure, and uncertainty with an outwardly casual attitude.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: A calm exterior can steady others and resist intimidation, but may cause people to underestimate your concern or make you overlook urgency.

traits.name: Trade Apprentice
traits.description: Hands-on training gave you practical knowledge of tools, materials, and repairs.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Practical training supports field improvisation but may not transfer to formal research.

iLuUKK_5.name: Convenience Meal
iLuUKK_5.description: A quick purchased meal that reduces a small amount of Power Strain but provides no attribute bonus.

Y4-Sy-hb.name: black wristband
Y4-Sy-hb.description: a standard-issue black wristband provided to registered ability users at the academy. it serves as a subtle identifier for those in the system and provides a minor layer of protection during physical activities.

yIqNIM8I.name: pulse signup slip
yIqNIM8I.description: an official registration document for pulse, the academy's communication and hero-management network. it contains the necessary instructions for a new student to activate their digital profile and access faction resources.

dwIpNX8z.name: tetsu iron palm gym card
dwIpNX8z.description: a grease-stained business card for tetsu 'iron palm' gym, a basement-level boxing gym on kannai lane that welcomes all comers with no judgment. it advertises a first week free and serves as a lead to the gym's location.

o2o0_gEQ.name: Gara's Backdoor Token
o2o0_gEQ.description: A stamped brass token proving Gara's trust. It grants access to selected Kobuncho contacts and can open future underworld favors.

6f2EWlWs.name: red-and-black jacket
6f2EWlWs.description: a matching red-and-black jacket worn by the crew, with joestar patches stitched at the shoulders and hand-painted marks along the shoulders. it serves as a uniform so people know who is answering for whom, and carries the crew's identity rather than any special protection.

YxAsJfVO.name: gloves
YxAsJfVO.description: a pair of gloves hana dropped off for jostin, staged with the rest of the crew's gear in the back office. they offer a snug, protective fit for handling the kusarigama and general fieldwork, though they carry no special enchantment or reinforcement beyond everyday durability.

QKmwRGkn.name: earpiece
QKmwRGkn.description: a charged and tested comms earpiece distributed by nobu from his canvas pouch. it lets the crew hear everything he hears, keeping the intercept and recon teams coordinated in the field.

14LJQv76.name: coded receipt
14LJQv76.description: a creased, coffee-stained receipt with a coded list of collection points and times, and a name penciled on its back. it marks which shops the teenage crew hits and when, serving as the thread to pull toward the man who runs the collection routes.

NTYdAbGD.name: water bottle
NTYdAbGD.description: a plastic bottle of water tossed to jostin during training, meant to rehydrate between drills. it is a simple everyday item with no special properties.

HHypcwaM.name: knife belt
HHypcwaM.description: a belt rigged to hold throwing knives for a smooth, one-pull draw, part of jostin's custom order from nobu and hana. it keeps the knives within easy reach for quick retrieval and re-sheathing during a fight.

wlP9tfLe.name: plain mask
wlP9tfLe.description: a plain, unadorned mask among hana's preparations, worn beneath a hood to conceal jostin's identity. it keeps his face out of sight and out of the public eye while he works in the alley.

4jbqGNB2.name: copied notebook
4jbqGNB2.description: a blank notebook jostin joestar filled by hand with a perfect, line-for-line copy of sonobe's original records, using his stand's stored energy to write at breakneck speed. it contains every name, date, and stamp from the original, verified by ayame against her photographs. it serves as bait or evidence while the original stays untouched in its drawer.

JEGo9wKW.name: annex floor plan
JEGo9wKW.description: a folded floor plan of the annex, showing its layout and access points. useful for navigating the building's corridors, stairwells, and rooms during an operation.

5AG9vj58.name: pager
5AG9vj58.description: a compact pager used for short, discreet text messages. it allows quiet, low-profile communication without the traceability of a modern phone.

RqmhXEMC.name: yen
RqmhXEMC.description: a wad of small japanese yen bills, the standard currency of chikara tokyo. useful for purchases, bribes, and everyday expenses.

QpZK27Gd.name: safe documents
QpZK27Gd.description: a stack of incriminating paperwork pulled from the wall safe: delivery logs, duplicate manifests, and a payout schedule with the captain's cut circled. together with the courier's falsified intake records, they form the evidentiary spine linking daigo's crew to the protection fees and give leverage to force hayashi to choose a side.

blTMi5L6.name: signed form
blTMi5L6.description: a signed and sealed licensing form snatched from the captain's jacket, confirming a forged document. it serves as evidence of the captain's wrongdoing and the crew's objective in the street confrontation.

QsP4mbN7.name: blue-and-white jacket
QsP4mbN7.description: a tailored cobalt-blue-and-white streetwear jacket, cut to fit each wearer and double-stitched for durability. it drapes comfortably over injuries without binding, preserves full range of motion for draws and footwork, and reads as neutral everyday wear that keeps the crew inconspicuous. its pockets are practical and balanced for carrying gear.

RbeYVeyb.name: padded kusarigama
RbeYVeyb.description: a training version of the chain-sickle with foam-wrapped weights and a blunted edge. designed for jostin to master the arc and momentum of the weapon without causing serious injury during drills.

TovO6Uv6.name: cash envelope
TovO6Uv6.description: a thick, plain envelope filled with yen bills, found mysteriously behind the amemiya shop counter. it lacks any writing or identification, serving as a silent, grim substitute for noa's presence.

-NS7Y6m2.name: charge discs
-NS7Y6m2.description: a bandolier of repurposed, older-model power regulators salvaged from hana's workshop. they provide a crude but effective way to stabilize energy output when things get heated.

jGJzac-s.name: extraction kit
jGJzac-s.description: a purpose-built kit from hana containing specialized tools for extracting and recovering supernatural or stand-related materials from a scene. it is a professional field kit, not something worn or equipped, meant to be carried and used during operations.

csdPsI05.name: concealed baton
csdPsI05.description: a collapsible steel baton that a suited man draws from under his jacket and swings across jostin's ribs before jostin wrenches it away. it is a compact, concealable impact weapon meant for close-quarters enforcement work.

availableCustomAbilities.name: I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH
availableCustomAbilities.description: Allows the user to summon his stand absorb kinetic energy from movements and impacts upon contact. This stored energy can then be redirected through touch to enhance strikes or manipulate the environment.

availableCustomAbilities.description: A precise striking technique where power is generated from a back-foot pivot and hip snap rather than the shoulder. This results in a faster, more deceptive jab that maintains a low center of gravity and silent footwork.

availableCustomAbilities.description: The user synchronizes their heartbeat with Peach's kinetic feedback loop, creating a state of extreme physiological acceleration. This grants superhuman reaction speeds and mental clarity, effectively slowing the perception of time and purging toxins or fatigue from the body.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Hoshino Requiem
availableCustomAbilities.description: The user removes all mental and physiological limiters on their body to reach the absolute edge of their physical strength. This grants a massive surge in speed and power by ignoring pain and self-preservation, though it places extreme strain on the user's body.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Eagle Vision: District Pulse
availableCustomAbilities.description: An advanced expansion of Eagle Vision that allows the user to momentarily sense life signatures and movement patterns across an entire city district. This provides high-level situational awareness of distant threats or targets, though the sensory overload causes significant physical strain and nasal bleeding.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Peach Aftershock
availableCustomAbilities.description: The user stores kinetic energy within a locking mechanism or structural joint to trigger a precise, internal vibration. This allows the user to force open locks or shatter internal mechanisms without damaging the external surface of the object.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Blackstar Dominion
availableCustomAbilities.description: Jostin projects the force of his will in a wave he can direct. To allies and frightened civilians, it feels warm and steady, quieting panic and helping them hold their ground. To enemies, it becomes crushing pressure that can make seasoned fighters stagger and knock out the weak-willed. When unleashed at full strength, the ground trembles, streetlights burst, and birds fall from the sky. It exists independently of Peach.

Jostin Joestar.customBackground:
Born into a clandestine branch of the prestigious Joestar lineage, Jostin was never raised for the public spotlight of heroism, but for the silent efficiency of state-sanctioned assassination. Jostin bear the Joestar family’s distinctive heart-shaped birthmark high on their upper backs. It is hereditary rather than a removable tattoo, though characters may casually call it a tattoo if they do not know the family history. The mark is a recognizable symbol of the Joestar lineage and may attract attention from anyone familiar with the family. His childhood was a grueling curriculum of surveillance, linguistics, and lethal combat, where the kusarigama and hidden blade were treated as extensions of his own limbs. The apex of this upbringing was the culling, a brutal tradition in which siblings and cousins were forced to hunt one another until only the strongest survived.

During the culling, Jostin’s Stand awakened: 「I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH」, or IFILWPP. It manifests as an ivory-armoured humanoid figure with pink and gold accents, a crooked crown, and golden rings spinning around its wrists when it holds stored energy. Through physical contact, it can absorb, store, and redirect kinetic energy from movement and impacts. Jostin turned his attackers’ momentum against them, combining the Stand’s power with the skills he had been taught since childhood to survive.

IFILWPP is powerful, but it cannot create force from nothing. It needs movement to build a reserve and contact to transfer energy to a person or object. Holding too much makes the Stand harder to control; releasing too much through Jostin’s own body can tear muscles, damage joints, and leave him shaking or unable to move. Redirecting an attack also demands precise timing. If he misjudges it, he still takes the hit. His kusarigama gives him many ways to build and release momentum, while his hidden blade serves him when an opponent closes the distance.

The culling left Jostin with a deep distrust of authority and a cruel, impulsive streak he fears in himself. He buries both beneath nonchalance, mischief, and an apparent refusal to take anything seriously. He remains empathetic, particularly toward anyone being controlled or treated as expendable, though his heavy drinking and smoking suggest how little peace he has found since escaping.
Jostin has not enrolled at Chikara Academy. He came there after hearing that Jovian Joestar, a distant relative from another branch of the family, was there. Jostin does not know whether Jovian can help him understand the family he fled, or whether approaching another Joestar is a terrible idea. For now, he keeps his connection to the assassin branch hidden and watches the academy from its edges.
He came looking for a relative. What he really wants is proof that being a Joestar does not mean spending the rest of his life as someone else’s weapon. He has also decided to adopt the last name Diojo to prevent others from knowing that he is a Joestar.
Jostin Joestar.visualDescription: A cinematic full-body anime portrait of Jostin Joestar, a lean athletic young man in his late teens with tousled dark auburn hair, sharp amber eyes, and a knowing smirk. He wears layered cobalt-blue and white streetwear: an oversized white hooded windbreaker with blue panels, a cobalt hoodie, tapered utility trousers, white high-top sneakers, blue fingerless gloves, silver chains, and a compact crossbody gear strap. His assassin-inspired hood and relaxed stance suggest a dangerous past being rewritten into a new street-level identity.

unlockedAbilities.name: Breaker's Soul
unlockedAbilities.description: Manifests a powerful humanoid upper body that fights alongside the user. It can intercept attacks, grab enemies, and unleash rapid barrages of physical strikes.

unlockedAbilities.name: Breaker Limit
unlockedAbilities.description: A one-two combo built from a compact half-step strike (planted heel, committed hip turn) followed by a roundhouse kick off the same pivot, with Breaker's Soul trailing the kick in a shimmering half-arc. The key is finishing the first strike's rotation before starting the next — if the hips split between the two, neither lands fully and the combo grazes off guards. Uses a stable heel and straight spine to keep the delivery clean.

unlockedAbilities.name: Breaker Limit Flush
unlockedAbilities.description: A continuous flurry of Breaker Limit one-two combos chained seamlessly together. Each finished combo — the compact half-step strike and roundhouse kick off the same planted-heel pivot — rolls directly into the windup of the next, so no connection is wasted and each finish becomes the next attack's set-up. Driven by pain and pressure, the surge of momentum keeps Breaker's Soul trailing every kick in a shimmering half-arc, hammering out one clean strike after another without pause.

unlockedAbilities.name: Road Hog
unlockedAbilities.description: The user channels Breaker's Soul into their legs to execute a high-velocity explosive dash. This creates a devastating impact upon contact that can drive opponents deep into the ground and shatter nearby surfaces.

unlockedAbilities.name: Desperation Impact
unlockedAbilities.description: The user converts accumulated physical pain and damage into raw kinetic power, triggering a high-velocity, erratic assault. This allows Jovian to ricochet off surfaces and deliver a series of explosive punches with increased force based on his current state of injury.

unlockedAbilities.name: First Form: Phantom Step
unlockedAbilities.description: Mobility. Breaker's Soul grabs the user and hurls them through the air, then instantly pulls them back in another direction. To an opponent, it looks like the user is teleporting between positions, leaving behind ghostly afterimages.

unlockedAbilities.name: Second Form: Heaven's Impact
unlockedAbilities.description: Offense. Breaker's Soul launches the user vertically before appearing above them. Both user and Stand descend together, fists first, creating a massive crater and radial shockwave on impact.

unlockedAbilities.name: Third Form: Phantom Strike
unlockedAbilities.description: Barrage. Breaker's Soul appears behind the user and unleashes a barrage so fast that its arms become a storm of spectral fists. Each impact produces a brief flash of energy. The final punch creates a concentrated shockwave instead of just another hit.

unlockedAbilities.name: Fourth Form: Soul Eclipse
unlockedAbilities.description: Defense / Counter. Breaker's Soul completely envelops the user's body for an instant, becoming a gigantic spectral version of the user. When an attack hits, the Stand catches it. Then CRACK — the Stand violently redirects the attacker's momentum and launches them away.

unlockedAbilities.name: Fifth Form: Falling Star Palm
unlockedAbilities.description: A deceptive strike where Jovian places his palm flat against a target with no initial force, followed by a sudden, explosive surge of power from Breaker's Soul. This creates a star-shaped shockwave that detonates outward from the point of contact, launching opponents backward.

unlockedAbilities.name: Eleventh Form: Soul Pierce
unlockedAbilities.description: A high-precision strike where Jovian synchronizes his punch with Breaker's Soul to bypass physical defenses. Instead of a blunt impact, the force is channeled through his fist as a spectral overlay that detonates behind the opponent's guard, causing internal damage.

unlockedAbilities.name: Zero Form: Sovereign's Will
unlockedAbilities.description: Jovian releases a massive, crushing aura of spiritual pressure that suppresses the will and physical stability of those around him. This creates a zone of intense gravitational or spiritual weight that can incapacitate weak opponents and force others into a state of submission.

athletics.description: Improves overall physical performance, enhancing running, jumping, climbing, and other physical feats.

investigation.description: Enables careful examination and analysis of surroundings, helping the player uncover clues and secrets.

intimidation.description: Allows the player to use fear as a tool, potentially allowing them to scare off enemies or influence confrontations.

persuasion.name: persuasion
persuasion.description: Enhances the player's ability to influence others through dialogue.

survival.name: survival
survival.description: Improves the player's ability to endure harsh environments, find food and water, and build shelters.

Power Control.name: Power Control
Power Control.description: Mastery of precision, output regulation, timing, safety, and creative use of a personal power under pressure.

Close Quarters Combat.name: Close Quarters Combat
Close Quarters Combat.description: Mastery of unarmed fighting at close range, including punches, kicks, clinches, takedowns, holds, escapes, positioning, and nonlethal restraint.

Weapon Proficiency.name: Weapon Proficiency
Weapon Proficiency.description: Mastery of safely handling, aiming, maintaining, and fighting with a chosen weapon category. Each character must specify the weapon category they actually trained with; proficiency does not grant access to weapons or invent training.

Strike Tactics.name: Strike Tactics
Strike Tactics.description: Mastery of combat positioning, pursuit, restraint, defensive formations, and controlled power use.

Public Communication.name: Public Communication
Public Communication.description: Mastery of interviews, crisis messaging, Pulse strategy, sponsorship judgment, and reputation management.

Relationship Building.name: Relationship Building
Relationship Building.description: Developing trust, familiarity, mutual support, repair after conflict, and durable connections through consistent attention and meaningful shared experiences. Applies to friendship, romance, rivalry, teamwork, clients, and faction ties.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Concealing truth, constructing believable lies, maintaining cover identities, disguising motives, manipulating impressions, and detecting when a conversation requires careful misdirection. Applies to investigations, undercover work, criminal negotiations, social conflict, secrets, and protecting allies. Deception does not guarantee that others believe the player and should be challenged by evidence, scrutiny, relationships, and consequences.

performance.name: performance
performance.description: Enables the player to entertain others through acts such as dancing, singing, or acting.

traits.name: Custom Power
traits.description: Define an original power without selecting a preset category. Describe its name, effects, activation, visual expression, strengths, limitations, risks, starting mastery, and desired ultimate technique.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Treat the player's custom power description as authoritative. In Backstory, ask how the power was discovered, how it shaped the player's life, what early incident revealed its limits, and what goal or fear is connected to mastering it. Never invent the player's answers or decisions.

traits.name: Ambitious
traits.description: You set demanding goals and push yourself to achieve them.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Ambition supports training, competition, and leadership, but failure and comparison may create pressure.

traits.name: Nonchalant
traits.description: You meet danger, pressure, and uncertainty with an outwardly casual attitude.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: A calm exterior can steady others and resist intimidation, but may cause people to underestimate your concern or make you overlook urgency.

traits.name: Prideful
traits.description: You protect your competence and reputation fiercely.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Pride supports confident confrontation but makes concession difficult.

traits.name: Delinquent
traits.description: A rebellious past gave you hard-earned street experience and a reputation that may precede you.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: You handle pressure and informal circles well but may face distrust in formal settings.

traits.name: Streetwise Self-Taught
traits.description: You learned outside institutions by observing people, improvising, and surviving mistakes.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Street experience supports reading situations but can leave formal gaps.

traits.name: Pride
traits.description: You protect your dignity and resist being made to look weak.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Pride supports intimidation but can make compromise difficult.

traits.name: Reckless Loyalty
traits.description: You take disproportionate risks for people or causes you have claimed as yours.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Loyalty supports rescue and endurance but can undermine planning.

traits.name: Overconfidence
traits.description: You assume your preparation or ability will carry you through uncertain situations.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Confidence supports intimidation but can undermine investigation.

traits.name: Power and Hand-to-Hand
traits.description: Combine established powers with punches, kicks, grappling, movement, and close-range tactics.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Mundane close combat does not cause Power Strain by itself; applying a power to an attack follows its authored costs, limits, resources, and cooldowns.

traits.name: Smoker
traits.description: A habitual tobacco user who gains familiar short-term stress relief from cigarettes but carries ongoing health and resource costs.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Cigarettes may provide slightly more reliable short-term Stress relief for this character, but smoking costs money, uses one cigarette from a pack, creates odor and social consequences, can reduce stamina, worsen coughs and colds, impair long-term health, and create habit pressure. Never force smoking, withdrawal, dependence, or use of cigarettes without player choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Seeker
traits.description: A strong attraction to high-intensity activity that can improve performance under pressure but makes calm recovery difficult.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: During danger, competition, or urgent action the character may resist hesitation or fatigue briefly, but reckless choices, poor rest, injury risk, and difficulty settling down can create consequences. Never override player decisions.

traits.name: Combat Academy
traits.description: You focused on practical combat training and controlled engagements.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Your direct approach brings higher collateral scrutiny and pressure to solve conflicts visibly.

traits.name: Bruiser Class
traits.description: A strength-focused class built around close-range pressure, physical force, and taking space.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Favors grappling, striking, lifting, breaking obstacles, and direct physical problem-solving. Strength does not guarantee success or require violence.

traits.name: Cursed
traits.description: The character's power was imposed or awakened through a curse, relic, ritual, or supernatural event.
traits.traitNarrativeEffects: Use this trait to shape stigma, fear, investigation, control, and NPC reactions only. It has no mechanical effects.

6dkJfndi.name: momonga-themed chiikawa backpack
6dkJfndi.description: a plush, oversized backpack featuring the mischievous momonga from chiikawa. it is surprisingly spacious and its adorable aesthetic earns jovian extra attention from passersby.

5gHcXz9F.name: black wristband
5gHcXz9F.description: a standard-issue black wristband provided to registered ability users at the academy. it serves as a subtle identifier for those in the system and provides a minor layer of protection during physical activities.

26DVY1Ns.name: pulse signup slip
26DVY1Ns.description: an official registration document for pulse, the academy's communication and hero-management network. it contains the necessary instructions for a new student to activate their digital profile and access faction resources.

3q0YYOsO.name: battle test poster
3q0YYOsO.description: a printed schedule and rules sheet for the chikara tokyo battle test, torn from the main-hall bulletin board. it lists the event's format, timing, and participant sign-up details, useful for organizing a crew or confirming the arena's schedule.

ZR8M1_IL.name: coded receipt
ZR8M1_IL.description: a creased, coffee-stained receipt with a coded list of collection points and times, and a name penciled on its back. it marks which shops the teenage crew hits and when, serving as the thread to pull toward the man who runs the collection routes.

MHq4J_PJ.name: red-and-black jacket
MHq4J_PJ.description: a matching red-and-black jacket worn by the crew, with joestar patches stitched at the shoulders and hand-painted marks along the shoulders. it serves as a uniform so people know who is answering for whom, and carries the crew's identity rather than any special protection.

VPvNxaUA.name: earpiece
VPvNxaUA.description: a charged and tested comms earpiece distributed by nobu from his canvas pouch. it lets the crew hear everything he hears, keeping the intercept and recon teams coordinated in the field.

5qrG5fD_.name: reinforced alloy knuckles
5qrG5fD_.description: a pair of heavy knuckle gloves forged from reinforced alloy, fitted with a shock-dampening grip to protect the wearer's wrists from the force of their own punches. a quick-release strap on the back allows for fast removal. hana built them as a vi-inspired upgrade for jovian's close-quarters fighting.

ASIPtbRx.name: drawer key
ASIPtbRx.description: a small metal key that unlocks the bottom drawer of the annex third-floor filing cabinet, where hayashi keeps the original manifests. it is the physical key to the evidence trail that exposes the enforcement captain's thursday pit deliveries.

uKYOpLsf.name: blue-and-white jacket
uKYOpLsf.description: a tailored cobalt-blue-and-white streetwear jacket, cut to fit each wearer and double-stitched for durability. it drapes comfortably over injuries without binding, preserves full range of motion for draws and footwork, and reads as neutral everyday wear that keeps the crew inconspicuous. its pockets are practical and balanced for carrying gear.

qV_M_j7w.name: bag gloves
qV_M_j7w.description: a pair of padded training gloves used for heavy bag work in the gym. they protect the hands and wrists during striking practice and are standard equipment for boxing and conditioning sessions.

C2WLAEcJ.name: manga volume
C2WLAEcJ.description: a crisp new volume of manga that jovian pulls from his jacket to read while the others work. it is a personal leisure item, useful for passing time and providing moral support rather than any mechanical effect.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Breaker's Soul
availableCustomAbilities.description: Manifests a powerful humanoid upper body that fights alongside the user. It can intercept attacks, grab enemies, and unleash rapid barrages of physical strikes.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Compact Strike
availableCustomAbilities.description: A refined combat technique that minimizes windup by utilizing a half-step and sharp hip rotation. This allows the user to deliver powerful strikes with significantly less telegraphing and a more stable base.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Breaker Limit Flush
availableCustomAbilities.description: A state of heightened focus triggered by physical pain and pressure. When active, Breaker's Soul becomes denser and more synchronized with the user, allowing for cleaner, more efficient striking rotations and increased impact force.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Road Hog
availableCustomAbilities.description: The user channels Breaker's Soul into their legs to execute a high-velocity explosive dash. This creates a devastating impact upon contact that can drive opponents deep into the ground and shatter nearby surfaces.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Desperation Impact
availableCustomAbilities.description: The user converts accumulated physical pain and damage into raw kinetic power, triggering a high-velocity, erratic assault. This allows Jovian to ricochet off surfaces and deliver a series of explosive punches with increased force based on his current state of injury.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Fifth Form: Falling Star Palm
availableCustomAbilities.description: A deceptive strike where Jovian places his palm flat against a target with no initial force, followed by a sudden, explosive surge of power from Breaker's Soul. This creates a star-shaped shockwave that detonates outward from the point of contact, launching opponents backward.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Eleventh Form: Soul Pierce
availableCustomAbilities.description: A high-precision strike where Jovian synchronizes his punch with Breaker's Soul to bypass physical defenses. Instead of a blunt impact, the force is channeled through his fist as a spectral overlay that detonates behind the opponent's guard, causing internal damage.

availableCustomAbilities.name: Zero Form: Sovereign's Will
availableCustomAbilities.description: Jovian releases a massive, crushing aura of spiritual pressure that suppresses the will and physical stability of those around him. This creates a zone of intense gravitational or spiritual weight that can incapacitate weak opponents and force others into a state of submission.

Jovian Joestar.customBackground:
Jovian Joestar did not grow up in a dojo or a prestigious household; he grew up in the friction of Tokyo's streets. As a youth he was a known delinquent, navigating informal power structures and learning to survive through improvisation and grit. Like every Joestar, he bears the family's distinctive heart-shaped birthmark high on his upper back. It is hereditary rather than a removable tattoo, though people who do not know the family history may casually call it one, and it can draw attention from anyone familiar with the lineage.

His awakening came not as a gift but as a violent rupture. During a moment of extreme crisis, his dormant potential surged, fractured the invisible limiters on his soul, and tore his Stand into the world: 「Breaker's Soul」. It manifests as a towering spectral upper body with no legs, rising from behind Jovian's shoulders like a fighter stepping out of his shadow. Its armour is cobalt blue with white plating across the chest and forearms, echoing the streetwear Jovian favours. Its fists are bound in glowing blue wraps like his own, silver chain links trail from its neck and wrists, and its face is a smooth white mask with a single slit of cold light for eyes. When it strains, crimson cracks split across its armour, and the same cracks spread faintly over Jovian's skin.

Breaker's Soul is pure physical force. It can intercept attacks, grab enemies, hurl Jovian through the air, and unleash barrages too fast to follow. It stays close to his body, acts only on his will, and has no power beyond its fists and grip. Every hit it absorbs and every limit it breaks is paid for by Jovian's body. The crimson cracks deepen under pressure, and pushing too far risks Soul Burn, a breakdown he fears more than any opponent. Through street fights and training, he has begun shaping his power into numbered Forms, trading raw instinct for repeatable technique.

The discovery earned him prestige in the underground and enough notoriety to open the doors of Chikara Academy's Combat Academy. Now a Bruiser-class student, Jovian hides intense ambition beneath a veneer of nonchalance. He is prideful and fiercely protective of his reputation, treating the academy's structure as a challenge to conquer. He is an adrenaline seeker who pushes his body to the brink, knowing his power grows most dangerous when he is under genuine pressure. His goal is to refine his clumsy, instinct-driven output into a precision tool, so that when he finally executes the Kingbreaker, it secures a victory that leaves no doubt about who is the strongest.
Jovian Joestar.visualDescription: A full-body cinematic portrait of Jovian Joestar, a handsome young Korean fighter with sharp features, tousled black hair, piercing dark eyes, and a lean muscular build. He wears bold cobalt-and-white streetwear: an oversized blue varsity jacket with white sleeves, a white heavyweight tee, wide blue denim, white combat sneakers, blue hand wraps, silver chains, and a cobalt beanie pushed back from his hair. Rising behind him is his Stand, Breaker's Soul, a towering spectral upper body with no legs, emerging from behind his shoulders. Its armour is cobalt blue with white plating across the chest and forearms, its massive fists are bound in glowing blue wraps, silver chain links trail from its neck and wrists, and its face is a smooth white mask with a single slit of cold light for eyes. Faint crimson cracks glow across its armour. His rebellious grin and relaxed fighter stance make the new life feel confident rather than polished.

remainingTips: Death is not always the end…
If there's something you want to do, go out and give it a try!
Try describing your actions in detail. They may not always work out the way you expect, but it will make things more interesting!
If you can't beat 'em, persuade 'em. Try convincing an enemy to come over to your side - or go over to theirs!
You can solve a problem any way you can think of: fight, bribe, trick, steal, befriend. The choice is yours.
You may spend a long time with your party members. Choose them wisely!
You can try to dodge, block and attack all in the same turn.
You can use items and take other actions in the same turn.
Skills are most likely to succeed when you use them as intended: in their natural domain.
Don't forget to stock up on items. Shops often have very powerful equipment for sale.
You can level up by taking almost any action, so feel free to play the game whatever way you want.
Don't forget to check in on your party members! Ask them how they're doing - and tell them how you feel!
Sometimes you can insta-kill enemies if you get creative with your inputs.
Party members can learn new skills and abilities as you progress through the story together.
Environmental conditions can add modifiers to your skill checks. Use the world to your advantage!
Tired of action and fighting? Look for a tavern or other gathering spot to socialize and start new relationships.
To prepare for a fight, try giving your party members orders to carry out in combat.
Social skills are very powerful. Persuasion can save a lot of lives.
Don't think you can win a fight? Try making a deal instead.
You don't have to do it all yourself, you know: hire people to do jobs for you!
Tired of traveling? Try learning how to fly or teleport or look for other forms of travel in the world.
There's nothing you can't do if you put your mind to it, from starting a revolution to founding your own country!
Turn order is determined by level and a random initiative value. Higher level characters tend to act first.
Characters without targets (like those that are buffing or healing) act before characters who are targeting enemies.
Multiple defensive effects stack multiplicatively. Layer your defenses!
Damage reduction scales with level difference, but has diminishing returns.
Different enemies can have different resistances, vulnerabilities, immunities or weaknesses, which will greatly affect the damage they take.
Try different damage types to discover enemies' weaknesses!
Healing actions use the same success level system as attacks - critical successes will heal for more.
Your equipment's damage bonus increases overall damage by 10% per point.
Equipped items with an armor stat reduce incoming damage linearly: 1000 armor grants 90% damage reduction.
Want a quest? Try asking an NPC about their problems!
Most places and characters you meet have secrets to uncover: get exploring!
Your Journal contains a wealth of information about the world's people, places and ideas.
Want to learn more about the world? Try reading books or watching television or other media!
Looking for cool gear? Don't forget to loot dead enemies and search areas where powerful items might be found!
Need some help fighting? Recruit NPCs to join your party! Anyone you meet can become an ally—if you can convince them to take your side.
Can't find the skill you want? Try asking NPCs about any new skill you can imagine. They just might be able to teach it to you.
You can unlock custom abilities when your character does new things in the game.
Need ideas about how to start your story off? Try feeding some basic concepts to the Background Generator and editing what you get back.
Don't forget to explore. Open up the map and try going to a new location.
Abilities give you bonuses to success and allow you to perform the actions they describe without ever needing any items.
The memory system remembers. Reference past events, people you've met, and places you've been - even from many turns ago!
Locations, NPCs, and quests generate dynamically based on your actions. Every playthrough creates unique content!
Don't quit after failure! Mistakes, setbacks and even death can lead to memorable stories.
Every action teaches you something. You gain XP from attempting things, not just succeeding at them.
If you don't know what to do, press the submit button to continue without an action.
There are no rules about what you type. Describe what you want to do in your own words - be as creative or detailed as you want.
Have a question about the world or the game? Use the 'Ask the Narrator' command!
Can't remember the name of a character or place? Try writing '@' followed by the first few letters.
Stuck with no idea what to do next? Use the 'Ask the Narrator' command to ask for suggestions.
Worried about convincing someone? Try taking the conversation one line at a time.
Be ambitious and creative: Voyage rewards those who dream big!
How you phrase things matters: the game rewards you for stylish, clever actions.
Coordinate with party members in combat for powerful combined effects.
The world is your oyster: find and claim a place to call home.
Family is worth fighting for. Having a family in the game can lead to great stories.
You can attack multiple times per turn, and so can your allies.
Tell people your hopes and goals: you never know who may share your dreams.

effects.instruction: If the player is enrolled and it is after 10:00 PM, present a clear choice: return to the player's assigned apartment or dormitory, or remain out. Do not move the player automatically. Explain that staying out is allowed but may create consequences if academy staff, family, security, or another credible observer catches or reports them. Smooth Criminal may attempt evasion or deception; Dropout characters are exempt from academy curfew.

conditions.query: A civilian rescue, accident, villain incident, disaster, suspicious activity, or public-safety emergency is plausible at the player's current location or along travel.

effects.instruction: Present the emergency with clear hazards, civilians, responders, time pressure, and incomplete information. Let the player intervene, call police or heroes, evacuate, investigate, negotiate, use powers, retreat, or ignore it. Reward restraint, teamwork, accountability, and civilian protection. Track injuries, Power Strain, collateral, Hero Reputation, media response, police attention, school consequences, and relevant memories.

Jostin Joestar.text: Jovian Joestar confronts the Minder about a koi sticker, prompting the man to shove the Carrier Girl aside and flee into an alley. Mikoto and Jovian pursue him, eventually cornering the Minder between themselves and two unidentified allies. Simultaneously, Jostin Joestar uses his stand, Peach Python, to snag the small boy and hoist him onto a rooftop. During the capture, the boy drops a note with pickup times and a drop address, which Reiko warns Jostin to protect from two nearby Kurokawa musclemen.

Jovian Joestar orders a debrief and instructs Reiko to secure the Minder and the rescued boy in a separate KTV room. Jostin Joestar uses his Stand and Eagle Vision to enter a heightened state of sensory awareness. Nobu identifies a counting spot at an old dry-goods store and proposes staking out the 4:30 pickup to identify the organizer. Haruto warns the crew that their public actions may expose them to Principal Anya and Kurokawa, while Hana and Mikoto argue for a plan that returns the stolen money and protects the child carriers.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Ayame Fujinami explained to Jostin Joestar that they were currently delayed by a stalled van and a confused elderly man on the waterfront road. She detailed their plan to intercept a courier named Genda at a loading ramp behind the ward's licensing annex, noting that today's Wednesday schedule provided a unique opportunity to strike. Ayame clarified the difference between Genda's routine and the captain's Thursday visits to Sonobe's office, urging Jostin to move forward so they would not miss their window.

Using his Stand, Jostin Joestar detects hostility from a stalled van and quickly moves an elderly resident to safety behind a concrete barrier. Ayame Fujinami films the encounter, noting that the driver watched Jostin's movements, while a traffic officer requests a plate check on the vehicle. Simultaneously, Jovian Joestar, Reiko Amagawa, and Mikoto Kurogane confront the driver, who recognizes Jovian as "the pit kid" and claims to be waiting for a pickup. Mikoto observes two more individuals carrying heavy crates toward the loading door.

In a laundromat, Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami spot an unidentified figure sneaking into the alley behind the ramp. Nearby, a traffic officer attends to the dazed driver and a confused elderly resident. In the loading bay, Jovian Joestar, Reiko Amagawa, and Mikoto Kurogane launch an assault, with Jovian and Mikoto combining attacks to incapacitate one guard. Warehouse Silhouette 3 manages to block the breach with a pallet, leaving three guards remaining.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Ayame Fujinami and Jostin Joestar observed a loud breach while waiting for Genda to arrive. Ayame explained that their objective was to record Genda and the courier to publicly expose the legitimacy branch and discredit the captain. She corrected Jostin's assumption about assassination, clarifying that their goal was public exposure rather than murder.

In the laundromat, Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to scan the area, identifying a hostile figure in the alley and a courier, identified by Ayame Fujinami as Genda Shuji, ascending the loading ramp. Ayame informs Jostin that the alley watcher is waiting for Genda's return, leaving Jostin to decide whether to intercept the courier or follow the watcher. Simultaneously, in the warehouse, Jovian Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, and Reiko Amagawa incapacitate the five guards. Following the fight, Mikoto questions the contents of the untouched crates.

Jostin Joestar ambushes and incapacitates the watcher in the alley, though the noise alerts Genda Shuji, who proceeds into the annex. Ayame Fujinami records Genda's entry and asks Jostin whether to pursue the courier or search the unconscious watcher. Meanwhile, Reiko Amagawa discovers ward paperwork and a route sheet inside the warehouse crates. After Mikoto Kurogane intimidates warehouse silhouette 5 into revealing the crates contain Kurokawa collection money, Reiko asks Jovian Joestar if they should seize the entire shipment.

At Club Lumière, Haruto briefs the crew on a plan to publicly expose a Kurokawa lieutenant during Thursday's licensing annex intake. Ayame provided forged records that will serve as a trap, requiring the captain's personal signature to trigger the takedown. Haruto assigns Nobu and Kaito to communications and street surveillance, while Jostin, Jovian, and Mikoto are tasked with neutralizing the captain's enforcers. Reiko will secure the courier's route and Hana will provide equipment backup, while Ayame handles the final public unmasking of the forgeries.

Conversation with Kaito Arashima: Jostin Joestar remarked that Kaito Arashima seemed knowledgeable about "jojos." Kaito acknowledged this and asked if Jostin was seeking a recommendation or had a grievance with one of them.

Jovian Joestar uses the suited handler as a human shield to force entry into Club Kagerō. Kaito Arashima uses his Stand, Horizon Breaker, to trip and pin two bouncers, securing the entrance. Using Eagle Vision, Jostin Joestar identifies guards at every exit and locates a target in a camera-monitored room on the second floor. Rikona Mibu warns the group to move quickly to avoid civilian casualties.

Jovian Joestar.text: Jostin Joestar steps onto the balcony to smoke. Inside, Jovian Joestar receives a notification from the academy. Jovian informs Jostin that all initiates must register for Pulse by tonight.

Jovian smokes a cigarette while Jostin tells the Curvy Hostess they beat up Renji's gang earlier that morning. Two men from the Kurokawa crew enter the club and confront the tattooed hostess near the service corridor regarding a delayed payment. The Sporty and Curvy Hostesses warn the brothers not to get involved, while the tattooed hostess claims she will have the money by next week.

Jostin smokes in the booth and watches the corridor in silence. Jovian mocks the lean man and broad man for their numbers and compliments Reiko's tattoos. The lean man orders Jovian to sit down while the broad man squares up to face the group. Reiko refuses to move, insisting the tattooed hostess will pay next week and challenging the men to go through her.

Jovian and Jostin promise promotions and a celebratory "spread" to the staff to put the Joestar name on the map. Natsumi mocks the ambition while cleaning the debris, and Chiho asks Jostin to move a broken chair leg. Kaede and Tomoe warn the brothers to consider the visibility and attention their loudness will attract before the night begins. Maki agrees to the feast, ordering them to sit while she prepares the curry.

Jovian Joestar forces the suited handler to act as a friend while escorting him upstairs. Kaito Arashima pins the bouncers and monitors the stair guards, while Rikona Mibu secures the street side with a barrier. Using Shadow Step, Jostin Joestar bypasses security and cameras to reach a man in a dark suit in the monitor room, who acknowledges Jostin's stealth and invites him to ask his question.

Jovian Joestar tasks Jostin Joestar with finding an infiltrator to exploit a blind spot in the Kurosaki shell company. Jostin assigns Ayame Fujinami to lead the "Lantern Network" for intelligence gathering, a role Ayame accepts provided she sets the editorial rules. Mirei Tachibana offers the support of her hostesses on the condition that the women remain safe, and Maki Hayashida offers Lumiere House for briefings. After Mikoto Kurogane requests a data feed for the Vanguard, Reiko Amagawa prompts the brothers to decide between targeting the Kurosaki lot or the captains.
Maki Hayashida - Maki witnesses Jostin name his uncontrolled assassin's will, Blackstar Dominion, and gives Jovian room to stabilize him while she helps secure Club Lumière.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Haruto Saionji informed Jostin Joestar that the theft of the folders and a phone was a planned decoy to lead their enemies astray. He explained that the genuine records were safely stored in Nobu's system. Haruto then instructed Jostin to bring the team back to the lounge for a debriefing.

Jostin Joestar declares the mission over and directs the crew to return to Club Lumiere. Rin and Jovian Joestar criticize Jostin's leadership for failing to retrieve Rin's phone, for which Hana Kisaragi provides a burner replacement. Nobu Takamine reports that the sedan's trail is cold until dusk. Upon returning to the club, Haruto Saionji proposes that the crew tail a cash collection van tonight and asks for their commitment.

Collectors seize Rin's phone and Haruto's folders, shoving Rin to the pavement and striking Haruto in the mouth. The collectors and an extra man flee in a sedan heading east on Neon Lantern Street. Nobu Takamine deploys a drone to track the vehicle, while Haruto notes the license plate for a report. Jostin and Jovian Joestar observe the pursuit from their positions, with Jovian deferring to Jostin as the lead.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Haruto Saionji informed Jostin Joestar that the theft of the folders and a phone was a planned decoy to lead their enemies astray. He explained that the genuine records were safely stored in Nobu's system. Haruto then instructed Jostin to bring the team back to the lounge for a debriefing.

Jostin Joestar declares the mission over and directs the crew to return to Club Lumiere. Rin and Jovian Joestar criticize Jostin's leadership for failing to retrieve Rin's phone, for which Hana Kisaragi provides a burner replacement. Nobu Takamine reports that the sedan's trail is cold until dusk. Upon returning to the club, Haruto Saionji proposes that the crew tail a cash collection van tonight and asks for their commitment.

Jovian Joestar orders a debrief and instructs Reiko to secure the Minder and the rescued boy in a separate KTV room. Jostin Joestar uses his Stand and Eagle Vision to enter a heightened state of sensory awareness. Nobu identifies a counting spot at an old dry-goods store and proposes staking out the 4:30 pickup to identify the organizer. Haruto warns the crew that their public actions may expose them to Principal Anya and Kurokawa, while Hana and Mikoto argue for a plan that returns the stolen money and protects the child carriers.
