chatLog.text:
Welcome! I'm your story assistant, here to help you understand your adventure.

Feel free to ask me anything:
• "What just happened?" — I'll help make sense of the story
• "Where am I?" — I'll tell you about your current surroundings
• "Who is nearby?" — I'll tell you about characters around you
• "Something seems wrong..." — I can help fix story or state issues you notice

Just type naturally—I'm here to help your story flow smoothly.

Basic Train Ticket.name: Basic Train Ticket
Basic Train Ticket.description: A purchased Tokyo rail ticket valid for the selected route and trip. The player must buy it at a station ticket counter or machine before boarding.

Academy Commuter Pass.name: Academy Commuter Pass
Academy Commuter Pass.description: A restricted student transit pass for approved Chikara Academy routes. It reduces or covers eligible academy-line fares but does not bypass school-hour permission or station security.

Signal Earclip.name: Signal Earclip
Signal Earclip.description: A compact support device worn on the ear that filters emergency frequencies and provides directional alerts. It is useful for rescue coordination but can overload in heavy interference.

Convenience Meal.name: Convenience Meal
Convenience Meal.description: A quick purchased meal that reduces a small amount of Power Strain but provides no attribute bonus.

Home-Cooked Recovery Meal.name: Home-Cooked Recovery Meal
Home-Cooked Recovery Meal.description: A carefully prepared meal that reduces moderate Power Strain and grants a temporary Constitution bonus. Quality depends on cooking skill, ingredients, recipe, and preparation.

Perfect Hero Bento.name: Perfect Hero Bento
Perfect Hero Bento.description: An exceptionally balanced homemade bento that substantially reduces Power Strain and grants temporary Constitution plus one recipe-appropriate attribute bonus. It is difficult to prepare consistently.

Reality Shears.name: Reality Shears
Reality Shears.description: A cursed two-hand weapon resembling claymore-sized shears. It deals serious slashing damage and can cut physical barriers or, with a clear seam, supernatural effects. Unclear cuts risk unstable rifts or unintended severing. It occupies the cursed-item slot while equipped and may also require both hands to use.

Debit Card.name: Debit Card
Debit Card.description: A payment card linked to an established bank account. It can spend available funds but does not create credit by itself.

Credit Card.name: Credit Card
Credit Card.description: A payment card linked to an approved revolving credit account with a defined limit, balance, fees, and repayment terms.

Banking App Access.name: Banking App Access
Banking App Access.description: Access credentials for an established banking application used to review balances, transfer yen, pay bills, manage cards, and receive account alerts.

Brokerage App Access.name: Brokerage App Access
Brokerage App Access.description: Access to an established investment application for viewing markets and buying or selling approved securities.

Cigarettes.name: Cigarettes
Cigarettes.description: A pack of cigarettes that can be used 20 times, one cigarette per use. Each use may provide brief subjective Stress relief while carrying odor, cost, stamina, sleep, and long-term health consequences. The pack is depleted after 20 uses.

Alcohol.name: Alcohol
Alcohol.description: A consumable serving of alcohol. Each use may provide brief subjective Stress relief while impairing judgment, coordination, sleep, and next-day Energy. Quantity determines how many servings are available; never assume intoxication level or repeated use without player choice.

Cold Medicine.name: Cold Medicine
Cold Medicine.description: Over-the-counter medicine for ordinary cold symptoms. It supports comfort but does not instantly cure illness or replace medical care for serious symptoms.

Service Pistol.name: Service Pistol
Service Pistol.description: A compact ranged weapon occupying the ranged slot. It requires compatible ammunition and deals serious piercing damage, with limited ammunition and meaningful legal, social, and safety consequences.

Compact Bow.name: Compact Bow
Compact Bow.description: A collapsible ranged weapon occupying the ranged slot. It requires compatible arrows in the ammunition slot and deals moderate-to-high piercing damage based on draw strength, arrow type, range, placement, and archery skill.

Utility Knife.name: Utility Knife
Utility Knife.description: A folding utility blade useful for field repairs, cutting restraints, and emergencies. Carrying it may have legal consequences in restricted areas.

Training Bat.name: Training Bat
Training Bat.description: A sturdy close-range weapon occupying the main-hand slot. It deals low-to-moderate bludgeoning damage and can be used nonlethally with appropriate intent and control.

Smoke Bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke Bomb.description: A small thrown canister that creates a temporary obscuring cloud. Use in enclosed spaces can endanger bystanders.

Standard Ammunition.name: Standard Ammunition
Standard Ammunition.description: A boxed supply of compatible ammunition for common firearms. Exact compatibility depends on the weapon.

Practice Arrows.name: Practice Arrows
Practice Arrows.description: A bundle of reusable practice arrows for training bows. Not suitable for every field situation.

Salvage Scrap.name: Salvage Scrap
Salvage Scrap.description: Mixed metal, wiring, fasteners, and damaged components recovered from a scene. Usually junk, but useful to a mechanic or seller.

Damaged Electronics.name: Damaged Electronics
Damaged Electronics.description: Broken phones, boards, sensors, and other electronics with uncertain resale or repair value.

Recovery Drink.name: Recovery Drink
Recovery Drink.description: A bottled electrolyte drink used after exertion. It is ordinary food and hydration, not a magical cure.

First Aid Kit.name: First Aid Kit
First Aid Kit.description: A compact kit containing bandages, antiseptic, gloves, and basic medical supplies.

Encrypted Data Drive.name: Encrypted Data Drive
Encrypted Data Drive.description: A small secured drive containing unknown files. It may be sold, decrypted, surrendered, or connected to a quest.

Unclaimed Valuables.name: Unclaimed Valuables
Unclaimed Valuables.description: Small valuables such as jewelry, watches, or collectibles with uncertain ownership. Selling them may create ethical or legal complications.

Azrael Agency Lighter.name: Azrael Agency Lighter
Azrael Agency Lighter.description: A plain metal lighter stamped with the Misfit Hero Agency mark. Azrael gives it to someone who stayed through an ugly closing shift.

Tess Recovery Tin.name: Tess Recovery Tin
Tess Recovery Tin.description: A neatly packed tin of practical recovery supplies and homemade snacks prepared by Tess. Accepting it is optional; it is care, not an obligation.

Luna Grounding Charm.name: Luna Grounding Charm
Luna Grounding Charm.description: A small bright charm selected for use during Luna's grounding routine. It is a reminder and sensory aid, not a restraint or cure.

Zee Star Chart Fragment.name: Zee Star Chart Fragment
Zee Star Chart Fragment.description: A damaged fragment of an extraterrestrial navigation chart recovered from Zee's ship. Its meaning is incomplete and may matter to her route.

Hana Evidence Seal.name: Hana Evidence Seal
Hana Evidence Seal.description: A properly logged evidence seal issued after a case is closed or transferred. It represents procedural trust and is not a license to access evidence without authorization.

Aiko Probability Bookmark.name: Aiko Probability Bookmark
Aiko Probability Bookmark.description: A carefully annotated bookmark Aiko uses to record uncertain predictions without treating them as commands.

Explosive Arrows.name: Explosive Arrows
Explosive Arrows.description: Arrows fitted with compact impact charges. Powerful but dangerous near civilians, fragile structures, or allies.

Smoke Arrows.name: Smoke Arrows
Smoke Arrows.description: Arrows that release an obscuring smoke cloud on impact. Wind, ventilation, and enclosed spaces affect their usefulness.

Flash Arrows.name: Flash Arrows
Flash Arrows.description: Arrows carrying a bright flash charge intended to disorient or signal. They can harm unprotected eyes at close range.

Electric Arrows.name: Electric Arrows
Electric Arrows.description: Arrows with a controlled electrical discharge for disabling equipment or stunning a target. Conductive surfaces create additional risk.

Restraint Arrows.name: Restraint Arrows
Restraint Arrows.description: Arrows that deploy a short-range binding line or net on impact. They are nonlethal tools, but poor aim can endanger bystanders.

Fire Ammunition.name: Fire Ammunition
Fire Ammunition.description: Specialized rounds designed to ignite on impact. They require careful handling and are restricted in many civilian areas.

Cold Ammunition.name: Cold Ammunition
Cold Ammunition.description: Specialized rounds that rapidly chill a small impact area. They can damage equipment or create dangerous surfaces.

Electric Ammunition.name: Electric Ammunition
Electric Ammunition.description: Conductive rounds that release a controlled electrical pulse. Their effect depends on armor, insulation, and nearby circuitry.

Impact Ammunition.name: Impact Ammunition
Impact Ammunition.description: Non-piercing rounds designed to transfer force and reduce penetration. They still cause injury and require responsible use.

Armor Piercing Ammunition.name: Armor Piercing Ammunition
Armor Piercing Ammunition.description: Restricted ammunition designed to penetrate protective materials. Possession and use may have serious legal consequences.

Tracer Ammunition.name: Tracer Ammunition
Tracer Ammunition.description: Rounds that leave a visible trail, useful for signaling and tracking fire but dangerous when concealment matters.

Incendiary Grenade.name: Incendiary Grenade
Incendiary Grenade.description: A thrown device that spreads intense heat and flame across a small area. Highly hazardous and restricted.

Flash Grenade.name: Flash Grenade
Flash Grenade.description: A thrown device producing a bright flash and concussive report to disrupt a group. Hearing and vision protection matter.

Adhesive Grenade.name: Adhesive Grenade
Adhesive Grenade.description: A thrown device that releases fast-setting restraint foam. It can trap objects, doors, or people and may cause panic if misused.

Throwing Disc.name: Throwing Disc
Throwing Disc.description: A balanced reusable throwing disc suited to training, distraction, or controlled nonlethal strikes.

Weighted Chain.name: Weighted Chain
Weighted Chain.description: A compact weighted chain used for restraint, climbing assistance, or close-range defense. Requires training to use safely.

Arcane Bolts.name: Arcane Bolts
Arcane Bolts.description: Bolts etched with a simple arcane pattern. Their effect depends on the magic that charged them and should not be assumed to bypass every defense.

Signal Flares.name: Signal Flares
Signal Flares.description: Bright emergency flares used to mark a location, call for help, or warn others. They can reveal the user's position.

Corrosive Rounds.name: Corrosive Rounds
Corrosive Rounds.description: Specialized rounds carrying a corrosive compound intended for equipment or barriers. They are hazardous to skin and unstable storage.

Water Rounds.name: Water Rounds
Water Rounds.description: Pressurized nonlethal rounds that release a concentrated burst of water. Useful for cleanup, distraction, or specific elemental hazards.

Wind Rounds.name: Wind Rounds
Wind Rounds.description: Experimental rounds that release a compressed air burst. Their performance is affected by enclosed spaces and unstable structures.

Gravity Tags.name: Gravity Tags
Gravity Tags.description: Adhesive technical tags that create a brief localized change in weight when activated. Their safe load and duration are limited.

Universal Arrowheads.name: Universal Arrowheads
Universal Arrowheads.description: Interchangeable arrowheads for field customization. They are components, not automatically elemental or explosive until fitted with a compatible payload.

Portable Quiver.name: Portable Quiver
Portable Quiver.description: A compact field quiver with protected slots for ordinary and specialized arrows.

Throwing Knives.name: Throwing Knives
Throwing Knives.description: A ranged or main-hand set of balanced knives for throwing or close-range use. They deal moderate piercing or slashing damage when used skillfully, require recovery or replacement, and are limited by distance, cover, and placement.

Healing Salve.name: Healing Salve
Healing Salve.description: A compact medical salve applied during combat to stabilize a minor injury and restore a small amount of Health. It does not replace professional treatment.

Trauma Bandage.name: Trauma Bandage
Trauma Bandage.description: A pressure bandage designed for emergency combat use. It restores a moderate amount of Health when applied and may be used only when the character can safely administer it.

Field Medkit.name: Field Medkit
Field Medkit.description: A reinforced emergency kit containing dressings, antiseptic, and stabilization supplies. It restores significant Health during battle but does not remove serious injuries.

Revitalizing Injection.name: Revitalizing Injection
Revitalizing Injection.description: A restricted emergency stimulant and recovery injection that restores Health and helps a badly injured character remain active. It has risks and should not be treated as a cure-all.

Power Recovery Capsule.name: Power Recovery Capsule
Power Recovery Capsule.description: A specialized recovery capsule that reduces Power Strain during battle by a small amount. It cannot erase overload, injury, or the consequences of reckless power use.

Combat Ration.name: Combat Ration
Combat Ration.description: A compact emergency food pack that can restore a small amount of Health or stamina during a battle when there is a safe moment to eat.

Concealable Body Armor.name: Concealable Body Armor
Concealable Body Armor.description: A lightweight body armor vest worn beneath ordinary clothing and occupying the body slot. It reduces some piercing and blunt-force damage while preserving mobility, but adds heat, weight, and possible legal restrictions.

Tactical Plate Carrier.name: Tactical Plate Carrier
Tactical Plate Carrier.description: A heavy body-slot carrier fitted with rigid plates. It substantially reduces serious piercing and blunt trauma but restricts movement, draws attention, and may be illegal or inappropriate in public spaces.

Impact-Resistant Jacket.name: Impact-Resistant Jacket
Impact-Resistant Jacket.description: A reinforced everyday jacket occupying the body slot. It softens blunt impacts, slashes, and limited hazards but cannot reliably stop firearms.

Rescue Armor Vest.name: Rescue Armor Vest
Rescue Armor Vest.description: A professional protective vest occupying the body slot. Flexible panels and high-visibility markings protect against debris, impacts, and limited cutting hazards while preserving mobility for rescue work.

Protective Bracers.name: Protective Bracers
Protective Bracers.description: Reinforced guards occupying the hands slot. They provide focused protection against strikes, blades, and debris rather than full-body armor and require training to use effectively.

Armored Combat Suit.name: Armored Combat Suit
Armored Combat Suit.description: A technological hero suit occupying the body slot, combining flexible armor panels, reinforced joints, and powered support interfaces. It offers broad protection at the cost of weight, fatigue, maintenance, visibility, and access requirements.

Vending Machine Coffee.name: Vending Machine Coffee
Vending Machine Coffee.description: A hot canned coffee bought from one of Tokyo's ubiquitous public vending machines. Restores a small amount of Energy and provides brief alertness; late or repeated use can worsen Stress or sleep.

Energy Drink.name: Energy Drink
Energy Drink.description: A canned caffeinated energy drink from a vending machine or convenience store. Restores a modest amount of Energy for a short time, but excessive or late use may increase Stress, jitters, or later fatigue.

Vending Machine Soda.name: Vending Machine Soda
Vending Machine Soda.description: A cold canned soft drink from a public vending machine. Provides a small Energy lift and refreshment without replacing sleep.

NitroBurst Energy Drink.name: NitroBurst Energy Drink
NitroBurst Energy Drink.description: A fictional neon-labeled caffeinated energy drink sold at vending machines and convenience stores. Temporarily restores a modest amount of Energy, but excessive or late use can worsen Stress, jitters, and later sleep.

VoltRush Energy Drink.name: VoltRush Energy Drink
VoltRush Energy Drink.description: A fictional canned energy drink marketed with an electric lightning logo. Provides a short Energy lift rather than true rest; repeated use may increase Stress or later fatigue.

Poppin Pop Soda.name: Poppin Pop Soda
Poppin Pop Soda.description: A fictional carbonated soft drink available from vending machines, convenience stores, and restaurants. Provides a small Energy lift and refreshment.

Zero-Zero Cola.name: Zero-Zero Cola
Zero-Zero Cola.description: A fictional cola sold chilled in vending machines and shops. Gives a small temporary Energy boost; it does not replace food, hydration, or sleep.

Stand Arrow.name: Stand Arrow
Stand Arrow.description: A strange metal arrow dropped by Deo Brando. Using it may awaken an original supernatural ability in the user, but the outcome is uncertain and may carry physical or narrative consequences. It is not guaranteed to work and does not reproduce any existing character's power.

Bizarre Cigarette.name: Bizarre Cigarette
Bizarre Cigarette.description: A black-and-gold cigarette with a faint clock-face pattern in the paper. To use it, the player must consciously choose to smoke it. Smoking it immediately triggers the normal ability-awakening process, which must create and attach an original time-stop ability to the player. Do not merely describe the effect. Resolve duration, cooldown, resource cost, limits, and possible risk through normal rules; do not copy a franchise power exactly. Never assume the player smokes it.

Bizarre Arrow.name: Bizarre Arrow
Bizarre Arrow.description: A strange arrow with an iridescent metalhead and warped feather pattern. To use it, the player must consciously choose to stab themselves with it. This painful, dangerous action consumes the arrow and triggers the normal ability-awakening process. For a player who chooses Spirit Manifestation, the arrow grants the Spirit Manifestation trait and one temporary level 1 manifestation ability. The player must establish the manifestation's name; manifestation names follow a song-title naming scheme, such as "Purple Rain," but do not copy a specific existing character or franchise. The manifestation remains silent and bound to the user. Do not merely describe an awakening: create and attach exactly one newly generated original ability selected to complement the player's current abilities, powers, skills, traits, and build. Do not replace or duplicate existing abilities, guarantee a franchise power, or grant more than one ability. Injury, risk, limits, costs, or imperfect control may result. Never assume the player uses it.

Combat Shotgun.name: Combat Shotgun
Combat Shotgun.description: A two-hand ranged weapon firing a close-range spread of shells. It delivers high bludgeoning and piercing impact at short range, loses effectiveness with distance and cover, has limited ammunition, and creates a loud report and serious bystander risk.

Precision Sniper Rifle.name: Precision Sniper Rifle
Precision Sniper Rifle.description: A two-hand ranged weapon built for deliberate long-range precision. It can deliver high piercing damage when the user has time, stability, visibility, and a clear line of sight, but is cumbersome at close range and requires compatible rifle ammunition.

Suppressor Attachment.name: Suppressor Attachment
Suppressor Attachment.description: A compatible firearm attachment that reduces muzzle report and attention without making a shot silent. It adds length, heat, maintenance needs, and compatibility restrictions.

Extended Magazine.name: Extended Magazine
Extended Magazine.description: A compatible detachable magazine that increases ammunition capacity and reduces reload frequency. Its added weight and bulk can slow handling or make concealment more difficult.

Variable Optic Scope.name: Variable Optic Scope
Variable Optic Scope.description: A compatible firearm optic that improves aimed range and shot placement when the user has time, visibility, and a stable position. It is slower and less convenient during close-range movement.

Assault Rifle.name: Assault Rifle
Assault Rifle.description: A two-hand ranged weapon for controllable automatic or burst fire at mid-to-long range. It deals serious piercing damage but requires training, ammunition, recoil management, and careful handling.

Submachine Gun.name: Submachine Gun
Submachine Gun.description: A compact two-hand ranged weapon for sustained short-to-mid-range automatic fire. It has moderate per-shot piercing damage, high ammunition use, recoil, and reduced precision during uncontrolled bursts.

Revolver.name: Revolver
Revolver.description: A reliable main-hand or ranged sidearm with serious piercing damage, limited cylinder capacity, deliberate reloads, and meaningful noise and legal consequences.

Compact Crossbow.name: Compact Crossbow
Compact Crossbow.description: A two-hand ranged weapon firing bolts with moderate-to-high piercing damage. It is quieter than firearms but has slow reloads, limited bolts, and reduced effectiveness when rushed.

Conductive Taser Device.name: Conductive Taser Device
Conductive Taser Device.description: A short-range technology weapon favoring lightning damage, disruption, and restraint over lethal force. It depends on connection, range, charge, and battery capacity.

Directed Energy Tool.name: Directed Energy Tool
Directed Energy Tool.description: A specialized technology weapon emitting calibrated light, fire, or lightning. Its output depends on battery, heat, calibration, range, and authorized access; it does not bypass defenses automatically.

Sonic Disruptor.name: Sonic Disruptor
Sonic Disruptor.description: A technology weapon projecting focused sound for bludgeoning impact, disorientation, or control. It requires charge and calibration and risks collateral effects in enclosed spaces.

Standard Sword.name: Standard Sword
Standard Sword.description: A two-hand melee weapon dealing serious slashing damage, with piercing potential on thrusts. It requires close range, training, and control; armor, reach, footing, and placement affect results.

Combat Knife.name: Combat Knife
Combat Knife.description: A main-hand close-range weapon dealing moderate slashing or piercing damage. It is concealable but short-ranged, and training, placement, armor, and intent strongly affect results.

Baseball Bat.name: Baseball Bat
Baseball Bat.description: A main-hand close-range weapon dealing moderate bludgeoning damage. It can be used nonlethally with control, but force, placement, armor, and intent affect injury severity.

Minato's Trust Charm.name: Minato's Trust Charm
Minato's Trust Charm.description: A small handmade charm that occupies an accessory slot. Minato gives it only after she genuinely trusts the recipient. It offers a modest composure or fatigue-resistance benefit when worn; its personal meaning is more important than its mechanical effect.

Gold Star Sticker.name: Gold Star Sticker
Gold Star Sticker.description: A small gold star sticker awarded for completing the Ability and Pulse tutorial.

momonga-themed chiikawa backpack.name: momonga-themed chiikawa backpack
momonga-themed chiikawa backpack.description: a plush, oversized backpack featuring the mischievous momonga from chiikawa. it is surprisingly spacious and its adorable aesthetic earns jovian extra attention from passersby.

strong zero.name: strong zero
strong zero.description: a potent, high-alcohol canned chu-hi from a local convenience store. it is a harsh but effective way to take the edge off a stressful day in tokyo.

black wristband.name: black wristband
black wristband.description: a standard-issue black wristband provided to registered ability users at the academy. it serves as a subtle identifier for those in the system and provides a minor layer of protection during physical activities.

pulse signup slip.name: pulse signup slip
pulse signup slip.description: an official registration document for pulse, the academy's communication and hero-management network. it contains the necessary instructions for a new student to activate their digital profile and access faction resources.

canned coffee.name: canned coffee
canned coffee.description: a chilled canned coffee from a konbini cooler, the kind of quick pick-me-up jostin grabs for himself and his brother. it offers a brief jolt of caffeine but no lasting mechanical benefit.

tetsu iron palm gym card.name: tetsu iron palm gym card
tetsu iron palm gym card.description: a grease-stained business card for tetsu 'iron palm' gym, a basement-level boxing gym on kannai lane that welcomes all comers with no judgment. it advertises a first week free and serves as a lead to the gym's location.

kusarigama.name: kusarigama
kusarigama.description: a chain-sickle weapon kept wrapped against the back, its weighted blade and chain pooling in the grip. it can be launched to strike, redirected mid-swing, and used to hook and pin a target by wrapping the chain around a limb.

battle test poster.name: battle test poster
battle test poster.description: a printed schedule and rules sheet for the chikara tokyo battle test, torn from the main-hall bulletin board. it lists the event's format, timing, and participant sign-up details, useful for organizing a crew or confirming the arena's schedule.

metal ball.name: metal ball
metal ball.description: a small, dense metal ball hurled by the lean student during the sparring match. it is a simple thrown object with no special properties, caught mid-air by jostin's ifilwpp and drained of its momentum.

coded receipt.name: coded receipt
coded receipt.description: a creased, coffee-stained receipt with a coded list of collection points and times, and a name penciled on its back. it marks which shops the teenage crew hits and when, serving as the thread to pull toward the man who runs the collection routes.

Gara's Backdoor Token.name: Gara's Backdoor Token
Gara's Backdoor Token.description: A stamped brass token proving Gara's trust. It grants access to selected Kobuncho contacts and can open future underworld favors.

red-and-black jacket.name: red-and-black jacket
red-and-black jacket.description: a matching red-and-black jacket worn by the crew, with joestar patches stitched at the shoulders and hand-painted marks along the shoulders. it serves as a uniform so people know who is answering for whom, and carries the crew's identity rather than any special protection.

custom kusarigama.name: custom kusarigama
custom kusarigama.description: a custom-built kusarigama tuned to jostin's exact specifications, with chain length matched to his draw and weight balanced to his preference. maintenance points are marked in blue along the frame, and the chain tension and blade balance were tested twice before delivery. it is field-ready and built to outlast the crew if kept sharp.

hidden blade.name: hidden blade
hidden blade.description: a concealed blade mounted along the forearm that springs out with a snap of the fingers, hana's finish work on jostin's custom order. it is a close-quarters weapon meant for quick, silent strikes and pairs naturally with the knife belt's draw.

knife belt.name: knife belt
knife belt.description: a belt rigged to hold throwing knives for a smooth, one-pull draw, part of jostin's custom order from nobu and hana. it keeps the knives within easy reach for quick retrieval and re-sheathing during a fight.

gloves.name: gloves
gloves.description: a pair of gloves hana dropped off for jostin, staged with the rest of the crew's gear in the back office. they offer a snug, protective fit for handling the kusarigama and general fieldwork, though they carry no special enchantment or reinforcement beyond everyday durability.

anti-hangover pills.name: anti-hangover pills
anti-hangover pills.description: a battered strip of over-the-counter pills from chiho's emergency stash, meant to blunt a hangover's worst effects. they go down dry and harsh but steady the head for the work ahead.

earpiece.name: earpiece
earpiece.description: a charged and tested comms earpiece distributed by nobu from his canvas pouch. it lets the crew hear everything he hears, keeping the intercept and recon teams coordinated in the field.

cash bag.name: cash bag
cash bag.description: a worn canvas or leather bag holding a substantial amount of yen in cash, carried by the crew's money carrier. it is the target of the brothers' heist and represents a significant sum of currency rather than any protective or combat value.

envelope.name: envelope
envelope.description: a sealed envelope containing a note that the small boy was carrying along his route. it is the object of the standoff, and reiko has declared it under her protection, suggesting it holds information worth fighting over.

reinforced alloy knuckles.name: reinforced alloy knuckles
reinforced alloy knuckles.description: a pair of heavy knuckle gloves forged from reinforced alloy, fitted with a shock-dampening grip to protect the wearer's wrists from the force of their own punches. a quick-release strap on the back allows for fast removal. hana built them as a vi-inspired upgrade for jovian's close-quarters fighting.

folded route sheet.name: folded route sheet
folded route sheet.description: a folded route sheet taken from sato's breast pocket, its creases worn from repeated handling. it appears to map a route or set of locations, likely useful for tracking sato's movements or contacts.

keyring.name: keyring
keyring.description: a keyring clipped inside sato's coat lining, holding a set of keys. it may grant access to locations or locks connected to sato's activities.

water blaster.name: water blaster
water blaster.description: a bright plastic toy water blaster jovian keeps in his momonga backpack. it fires a short, playful arc of water that evaporates against heat and smoke, making it useless for firefighting but good for a laugh.

water bottle.name: water bottle
water bottle.description: a plastic bottle of water tossed to jostin during training, meant to rehydrate between drills. it is a simple everyday item with no special properties.

plain mask.name: plain mask
plain mask.description: a plain, unadorned mask among hana's preparations, worn beneath a hood to conceal jostin's identity. it keeps his face out of sight and out of the public eye while he works in the alley.

copied notebook.name: copied notebook
copied notebook.description: a blank notebook jostin joestar filled by hand with a perfect, line-for-line copy of sonobe's original records, using his stand's stored energy to write at breakneck speed. it contains every name, date, and stamp from the original, verified by ayame against her photographs. it serves as bait or evidence while the original stays untouched in its drawer.

annex floor plan.name: annex floor plan
annex floor plan.description: a folded floor plan of the annex, showing its layout and access points. useful for navigating the building's corridors, stairwells, and rooms during an operation.

pager.name: pager
pager.description: a compact pager used for short, discreet text messages. it allows quiet, low-profile communication without the traceability of a modern phone.

yen.name: yen
yen.description: a wad of small japanese yen bills, the standard currency of chikara tokyo. useful for purchases, bribes, and everyday expenses.

safe documents.name: safe documents
safe documents.description: a stack of incriminating paperwork pulled from the wall safe: delivery logs, duplicate manifests, and a payout schedule with the captain's cut circled. together with the courier's falsified intake records, they form the evidentiary spine linking daigo's crew to the protection fees and give leverage to force hayashi to choose a side.

drawer key.name: drawer key
drawer key.description: a small metal key that unlocks the bottom drawer of the annex third-floor filing cabinet, where hayashi keeps the original manifests. it is the physical key to the evidence trail that exposes the enforcement captain's thursday pit deliveries.

takoyaki.name: takoyaki
takoyaki.description: a paper boat of steaming octopus-filled batter balls topped with takoyaki sauce, bonito flakes, and green onion. a beloved street-food snack that restores energy and morale after a long day of paperwork or park exploring.

red bean taiyaki.name: red bean taiyaki
red bean taiyaki.description: a warm, freshly griddled fish-shaped pastry filled with sweet red bean paste, the classic taiyaki flavor. it is a beloved street food treat from the festival stalls, eaten on the spot and enjoyed for its comforting sweetness.

custard taiyaki.name: custard taiyaki
custard taiyaki.description: a warm, freshly griddled fish-shaped pastry filled with smooth, sweet custard, a popular modern taiyaki flavor. it is a festival street food treat meant to be eaten right away, enjoyed for its rich, creamy filling.

signed form.name: signed form
signed form.description: a signed and sealed licensing form snatched from the captain's jacket, confirming a forged document. it serves as evidence of the captain's wrongdoing and the crew's objective in the street confrontation.

blue-and-white jacket.name: blue-and-white jacket
blue-and-white jacket.description: a tailored cobalt-blue-and-white streetwear jacket, cut to fit each wearer and double-stitched for durability. it drapes comfortably over injuries without binding, preserves full range of motion for draws and footwork, and reads as neutral everyday wear that keeps the crew inconspicuous. its pockets are practical and balanced for carrying gear.

padded kusarigama.name: padded kusarigama
padded kusarigama.description: a training version of the chain-sickle with foam-wrapped weights and a blunted edge. designed for jostin to master the arc and momentum of the weapon without causing serious injury during drills.

cash envelope.name: cash envelope
cash envelope.description: a thick, plain envelope filled with yen bills, found mysteriously behind the amemiya shop counter. it lacks any writing or identification, serving as a silent, grim substitute for noa's presence.

charge discs.name: charge discs
charge discs.description: a bandolier of repurposed, older-model power regulators salvaged from hana's workshop. they provide a crude but effective way to stabilize energy output when things get heated.

bag gloves.name: bag gloves
bag gloves.description: a pair of padded training gloves used for heavy bag work in the gym. they protect the hands and wrists during striking practice and are standard equipment for boxing and conditioning sessions.

extraction kit.name: extraction kit
extraction kit.description: a purpose-built kit from hana containing specialized tools for extracting and recovering supernatural or stand-related materials from a scene. it is a professional field kit, not something worn or equipped, meant to be carried and used during operations.

concealed baton.name: concealed baton
concealed baton.description: a collapsible steel baton that a suited man draws from under his jacket and swings across jostin's ribs before jostin wrenches it away. it is a compact, concealable impact weapon meant for close-quarters enforcement work.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: a buzzing smartphone plucked from matsumoto's pocket, its screen cracked and smeared with blood. it carries the last call from a calm, flat-voiced caller who warned that jostin's 'bill just grew,' marking it as a lead to whoever is behind the beaten men.

master ledger.name: master ledger
master ledger.description: a thick, leather-bound master ledger whose dense pages are filled with columns of figures, recording the accounts and transactions of okabe's operation. it is the kind of record that ties debts and dealings to ink rather than boxes, making it a valuable piece of evidence or leverage.

provisional club charter.name: provisional club charter
provisional club charter.description: a paper charter stamped with the heavy physical seal of principal anya, marked 'provisional' in fresh ink. it grants the club permission to conduct activities after school hours, though no formal budget is attached. the document represents official recognition of the club's standing with the school administration.

manga volume.name: manga volume
manga volume.description: a crisp new volume of manga that jovian pulls from his jacket to read while the others work. it is a personal leisure item, useful for passing time and providing moral support rather than any mechanical effect.

lab address slip.name: lab address slip
lab address slip.description: a crumpled slip of paper bearing the address of a print lab where a kurokawa records deputy is holed up tonight to collect developed stills. it is a lead to a location rather than a piece of equipment, useful for tracking down the deputy and the photos.

Chikara Tokyo.name: Chikara Tokyo
Chikara Tokyo.basicInfo: A unified Tokyo realm for Chikara Academy's superhero-anime world, connecting academy life, colorful districts, hero agencies, ordinary neighborhoods, criminal networks, apartments, workplaces, and waterfront operations.

Chikara Tokyo.name: Chikara Tokyo
Chikara Tokyo.basicInfo: The unified Tokyo region containing Chikara Academy, student neighborhoods, hero institutions, everyday businesses, criminal routes, apartments, and waterfront operations.
Chikara Tokyo.hiddenInfo: Walking and rail travel connect the city. Flight, swinging, portals, and teleportation provide alternate routes only when the character's abilities, range, anchors, and access permit them.

Orizuru Industrial Basin.name: Orizuru Industrial Basin
Orizuru Industrial Basin.basicInfo: The Orizuru Industrial Basin is a sprawling expanse of decommissioned factories, chemical runoff canals, and massive rusted storage silos. Once the heart of Tokyo's heavy manufacturing, it has become a lawless grey zone where corporate interests and underworld factions fight over abandoned technology and scrap metal. Thick smog frequently blankets the area, masking the movements of scavengers and rogue powered individuals who treat the skeletal remains of industry as their private battleground.

Goshiki High-Rises.name: Goshiki High-Rises
Goshiki High-Rises.basicInfo: The Goshiki High-Rises is a dense vertical landscape of interconnected residential towers, sky-bridges, and precarious maintenance scaffolds. Once an ambitious middle-class housing project, it has become a chaotic sprawl where low-income families, reclusive shut-ins, and street-level operatives coexist. The district is defined by its verticality, with high-speed elevators and exterior freight lifts serving as the primary veins of movement for both legal commerce and illicit smuggling.

Tidewater Ward.name: Tidewater Ward
Tidewater Ward.basicInfo: A reclaimed coastal ward built on landfill and old dock foundations, where the sea has slowly taken back the low streets. Saltwater seeps through cracked concrete, and the tide regularly floods the lower lanes, forcing residents to live on stilts and raised walkways. The ward runs on salvage, small-boat trade, and the uneasy cooperation between licensed hero patrols and the waterfront crews who know every hidden slipway. A recent storm surge has reopened an old flooded district, drawing scavengers, smugglers, and curious heroes into the drowned streets.

Chikara Academy.name: Chikara Academy
Chikara Academy.basicInfo: A prestigious superhero university in Tokyo combining rigorous academics, power training, rescue simulations, student life, supervised hero development, and coed dormitory living.

main-hall.description: Central hall with hero memorials, class rosters, schedules, Pulse kiosks, club notices, and Battle Test announcements.

student-courtyard.description: Open paved courtyard between academic wings, with benches, shade trees, noticeboards, and room for casual conversations.

west-service-alley.description: Visible service alley along the academy wall for deliveries, maintenance carts, and quieter travel. It is not hidden.
paths: secluded concrete yard behind the annex

north-rooftop-overlook.description: Accessible rooftop overlook with safety lighting, benches, and a wide view over Chikara District. Useful for late-night conversations, recovery, stargazing, and difficult decisions.

campus-footbridge.description: Raised pedestrian bridge connecting the academy to surrounding campus paths, with city lights and passing trains below. Suitable for brief meetings and farewells.

vending-machine-nook.description: Covered seating beside vending machines. Bright, public, and open late for casual meals, phone calls, awkward encounters, and nighttime scenes.

dormitories.description: Coed dormitory wing with amber-lit corridors and individual student rooms, where the brothers settle for the night.

Chikara Academy.hiddenInfo: A sealed sublevel beneath the academy contains records about early Ultra Force operations and may connect to the player's family history. This is hidden information and restricted access within the globally visible academy, not a hidden map location.
visitedAreas: secluded concrete yard behind the annex

Old Tokyo Shrine Road.name: Old Tokyo Shrine Road
Old Tokyo Shrine Road.basicInfo: Historic shrine district with traditional restaurants, tea houses, antiques, tunnels, shops, and a preserved station.

tea-house.description: Restaurant and tea house for dates and negotiations.

old-tokyo-station.description: Historic station connecting old and modern Tokyo.

heritage-store.description: Antique, charm, book, and traditional craft store.

lantern-restaurant.description: Traditional restaurant serving seasonal dishes near the shrine.

Ultra Force Headquarters.name: Ultra Force Headquarters
Ultra Force Headquarters.basicInfo: Secure hero complex with operations, archives, training, medicine, stores, dining, communal barracks facilities, and a credentialed station. The barracks are reserved for Blacklisted recruits and provisional operatives whose story explicitly assigns them there. Everyday Zero's civilian dispatch coordinator remains based at Apartment 68; visiting Ultra Force Headquarters for work does not change the player's home or residence. Resolve "go home" using the player's established residence, not the barracks, unless a story explicitly establishes otherwise.

operations-floor.description: Mission dispatch and monitoring floor where civilian calls, agency requests, police referrals, supernatural alerts, and hero availability are assessed. Dispatch staff triage each case, record details, choose an appropriate response, and route ordinary incidents to the faction or hero organization best suited to handle them.

dispatch-floor.description: The dedicated Ultra Force dispatch floor: a wall of live incident boards, call consoles, response maps, agency status panels, secure phone lines, staffed routing desks, and a posted Ultra Force Dispatch Reference Guide. Dispatch coordinators assess callers, verify locations, check hero availability, route small local threats and practical paid-service cases to Hero for Hire responders, send specialized cases to the appropriate faction, escalate emergencies, and record follow-up reports. The floor includes adult civilian operations staff, pro heroes, supervised Blacklisted personnel, and coworkers; it is a workplace, not a student area.

hero-supply-store.description: Authorized store for costumes, support gear, field supplies, and recovery products.

command-mess.description: Hero cafeteria and restaurant for staff meals and briefings.

barracks.description: Monitored shared sleeping quarters for Blacklisted recruits and provisional operatives. These quarters are not assigned to ordinary civilian dispatch staff or Everyday Zero players. Only a story that explicitly places the player in Blacklisted recruitment or provisional housing may make the barracks their home. The random roommate shares the sleeping space, while privacy is limited and movement is logged.

communal-bathroom.description: Shared barracks bathroom with communal showers, bath facilities, lockers, and strict schedules. Use only privacy-respecting, nonsexual comedy such as queue disputes, missing toiletries, plumbing problems, or harmless power accidents.

Old Tokyo Lantern Quarter.name: Old Tokyo Lantern Quarter
Old Tokyo Lantern Quarter.basicInfo: Preserved neighborhood of lantern-lit alleys, craft workshops, seasonal food, and cultural events.

lantern-alley.description: Historic alley lined with lanterns, galleries, and food stalls.

craft-row.description: Workshops selling ceramics, paper goods, charms, and crafts.

festival-court.description: Courtyard for performances, dances, and seasonal celebrations.

seasonal-restaurant.description: Traditional dining room serving regional dishes and tea.

Old Tokyo Tea Market Street.name: Old Tokyo Tea Market Street
Old Tokyo Tea Market Street.basicInfo: Historic shopping street with groceries, tea merchants, gifts, and traditional restaurants.

grocery-stalls.description: Produce, preserved foods, spices, and ingredients.

Central Tokyo Station.name: Central Tokyo Station
Central Tokyo Station.basicInfo: Major public rail interchange with ticket counters, express platforms, route boards, and connections across Tokyo. When the player enters, a station attendant approaches to offer route and ticket help.

concourse.description: Large central concourse with maps, ticket machines, staffed counters, and departure boards. You can buy a train ticket here before boarding.

ticket-counter.description: Ticket office and automated machines. The game should tell the player they can buy a ticket here, select a destination, and pay the listed fare.

platforms.description: Platforms for Academy District, Old Tokyo, Tokyo Bay, Shadow District, and Ultra Force Headquarters. Boarding requires a valid ticket or approved access.

station-retail.description: Shops, cafés, lockers, and passenger services.

Imperial Palace East Gardens.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
Imperial Palace East Gardens.basicInfo: Historic gardens and preserved palace grounds with stone walls, seasonal landscaping, paths, and civic landmarks.

public-gate.description: Public entrance with visitor information and security guidance.

garden-paths.description: Stone walls, lawns, seasonal trees, and historic foundations.

moat-walk.description: Scenic outer path beside water and fortified walls.

Chiyoda Civic Offices.name: Chiyoda Civic Offices
Chiyoda Civic Offices.basicInfo: Municipal offices handling permits, records, public services, neighborhood administration, and civic complaints.

public-counter.description: Public service counters for forms, permits, and resident questions.

waiting-hall.description: Seating and information boards for visitors.

Marunouchi Business Avenue.name: Marunouchi Business Avenue
Marunouchi Business Avenue.basicInfo: A polished office corridor of corporate towers, underground passages, restaurants, hotels, and weekday commuter traffic.

avenue.description: Wide office avenue with plazas, taxis, and business crowds.

tower-lobby.description: Corporate reception areas and visitor security desks.

underground-mall.description: Restaurants, cafés, shops, and connected pedestrian passages.

Tokyo Skytree Tower Complex.name: Tokyo Skytree Tower Complex
Tokyo Skytree Tower Complex.basicInfo: A landmark tower and commercial complex with observation decks, shops, restaurants, and broad views across Tokyo.

tower-plaza.description: Public plaza beneath the tower with shops and event spaces.

observation-deck.description: High viewing decks above the city.

Nakano Residential Arcade.name: Nakano Residential Arcade
Nakano Residential Arcade.basicInfo: A neighborhood shopping arcade serving apartment residents with groceries, bakeries, clinics, laundries, and family restaurants.

grocery-row.description: Markets, bakeries, pharmacies, and daily services.

Gearshift Support.name: Gearshift Support
Gearshift Support.basicInfo: Compact support-technology workshop where students help repair approved hero equipment, sort parts, and assist customers.

workshop-floor.description: Repair benches and supervised prototype stations.

parts-counter.description: Components, diagnostic tools, and customer intake.

staff-office.description: Schedules, job records, and safety approvals.

Page Turner Books.name: Page Turner Books
Page Turner Books.basicInfo: Independent bookstore with study tables, hero biographies, and a quiet inventory room.

stockroom.description: Inventory shelves and staff work area.

Game Start Arcade.name: Game Start Arcade
Game Start Arcade.basicInfo: Colorful student arcade with competitive games, prize machines, after-school shifts, and a lively social scene.

arcade-floor.description: Cabinets, rhythm games, and prize machines.

prize-counter.description: Prize redemption and customer service desk.

staff-room.description: Break area, supplies, and shift board.

Crepe Expectations.name: Crepe Expectations
Crepe Expectations.basicInfo: Friendly crepe café with a compact kitchen, counter service, and student shifts.

Rescue Volunteer Desk.name: Rescue Volunteer Desk
Rescue Volunteer Desk.basicInfo: Public service desk connecting volunteers with approved welfare checks, visitor assistance, and community support.

help-desk.description: Reception for requests, directions, and volunteer intake.

quiet-room.description: Calm waiting room for visitors needing support.

records-room.description: Schedules, supplies, and supervised case files.

Uniform & Co..name: Uniform & Co.
Uniform & Co..basicInfo: Academy District clothing shop selling school uniforms, casual clothes, costume alterations, and practical accessories for students.

sales-floor.description: Uniform racks, everyday clothing, bags, and approved accessories.

fitting-rooms.description: Private fitting stalls for uniforms and casual clothing.

alterations-counter.description: Tailoring desk for repairs, adjustments, and costume-safe alterations.

back-workroom.description: Staff workroom with sewing machines and fabric supplies.

Hero Hobby Shop.name: Hero Hobby Shop
Hero Hobby Shop.basicInfo: A hobby store filled with hero collectibles, model kits, training memorabilia, craft supplies, and novelty power-themed merchandise.

main-floor.description: Shelves of figures, model kits, cards, comics, and hero merchandise.

craft-corner.description: Tables for painting models, assembling kits, and sharing hobby advice.

display-gallery.description: Rotating displays of famous heroes, academy memorabilia, and local artists.

checkout.description: Register, preorder desk, and raffle display.

Neon Karaoke.name: Neon Karaoke
Neon Karaoke.basicInfo: A colorful karaoke venue with private rooms where students celebrate, vent, practice songs, and build friendships after dark.

reception.description: Front desk with room bookings, song catalogs, and time packages.

hallway.description: Neon-lit corridor leading to private karaoke rooms.

karaoke-room.description: Soundproof room for singing, conversations, challenges, and group scenes.

snack-bar.description: Counter serving drinks and quick food to guests.

Midnight Diner.name: Midnight Diner
Midnight Diner.basicInfo: An all-night American-style diner in Chikara Tokyo, serving affordable comfort food twenty-four hours a day to students, workers, travelers, night-shift staff, and anyone who needs a booth and a quiet place to talk. The menu combines familiar American diner staples with a few practical Tokyo touches.

dining-room.description: Warm all-night dining room with red vinyl booths, chrome-edged tables, counter seats, laminated menus, pie display, coffee refills, and large front windows showing the street outside.

counter.description: Long counter with swivel stools, a coffee station, napkin holders, condiment caddies, and a view of the open kitchen. Regulars and night-shift workers often sit here.

booths.description: Rows of private red-vinyl booths for families, dates, students, tired workers, and late-night conversations.

kitchen.description: Open diner kitchen preparing burgers, cheeseburgers, fries, pancakes, waffles, eggs, bacon, grilled cheese, chicken sandwiches, milkshakes, coffee, pie, and rotating specials. A few rice bowls or other Tokyo-friendly options are available without changing the restaurant's American-diner identity.

Pulse Printworks.name: Pulse Printworks
Pulse Printworks.basicInfo: A small print and copy shop producing flyers, posters, club materials, event banners, and local campaign notices for the academy district.

front-counter.description: Order desk for printing, copying, binding, and design requests.

print-floor.description: Printers, cutters, binding machines, paper stock, and finished orders.

design-booth.description: Computer station for layouts, posters, club flyers, and campaign materials.

supply-room.description: Paper, ink, packaging, and staff storage.

Power Practice Studio.name: Power Practice Studio
Power Practice Studio.basicInfo: A supervised neighborhood studio offering safe power-control lessons, civilian exercises, and beginner sessions for students and residents.

reception.description: Booking desk with lesson schedules, waivers, and instructor information.

practice-floor.description: Padded training space with adjustable barriers and safety monitors.

observation-room.description: Viewing area for guardians, instructors, and controlled demonstrations.

equipment-room.description: Storage for protective gear, targets, and calibration tools.

Student Clinic.name: Student Clinic
Student Clinic.basicInfo: A walk-in neighborhood clinic serving academy students, residents, and workers with routine care, minor injuries, and referrals.

reception.description: Check-in desk, seating, appointment board, and intake forms.

exam-room.description: Private room for routine examinations and minor injuries.

treatment-room.description: Treatment space for first aid, observation, and power-related precautions.

pharmacy-window.description: Dispensing window for approved prescriptions and care instructions.

Riverside Food Market.name: Riverside Food Market
Riverside Food Market.basicInfo: A lively market near the river with produce stalls, prepared food, household basics, and inexpensive groceries for students and residents.

market-hall.description: Covered market aisle with produce, pantry goods, and household supplies.

food-stalls.description: Quick meals, desserts, and rotating local vendors.

fresh-counter.description: Produce, prepared meals, and refrigerated goods.

market-exit.description: Street-facing exit beside delivery lanes and pedestrian paths.

Open-Air Performance Stage.name: Open-Air Performance Stage
Open-Air Performance Stage.basicInfo: A public stage for school events, local musicians, Pulse broadcasts, festivals, speeches, and spontaneous student performances.

audience-plaza.description: Open public space with benches, food carts, and room for crowds.

stage.description: Raised performance platform with lighting, sound equipment, and event access.

backstage.description: Restricted preparation area for performers, staff, and equipment.

park-walkway.description: Path connecting the stage to nearby park and market routes.

Tokyo Tower.name: Tokyo Tower
Tokyo Tower.basicInfo: Iconic red communications tower and Central Tokyo landmark with observation decks, public event spaces, broadcast infrastructure, and a commanding view over the city.

tower-foot.description: Landmark plaza with visitors, food stands, ticket booths, and public gatherings.

observation-lobby.description: Visitor lobby and elevator access for the public observation decks.

main-observation-deck.description: Panoramic observation deck overlooking Tokyo and the surrounding districts.

upper-deck.description: Higher observation level with exhibits, dramatic views, and special-event access.

service-access.description: Restricted maintenance and broadcast access used by authorized staff and emergency crews.

broadcast-level.description: Communications equipment and broadcast infrastructure hidden above the public spaces.

Hero Agency Row.name: Hero Agency Row
Hero Agency Row.basicInfo: A Central Tokyo avenue lined with professional hero agencies, licensing offices, public relations firms, and internship opportunities.

agency-street.description: Busy avenue of agency entrances, hero billboards, and professional support services.

reception-lobby.description: Shared lobby for agency appointments, deliveries, and internship inquiries.

public-relations-office.description: Media coordination and reputation-management offices serving hero agencies.

agency-cafe.description: Café where assistants, interns, reporters, and heroes meet between appointments.

Pulse Media Tower.name: Pulse Media Tower
Pulse Media Tower.basicInfo: Central Tokyo broadcasting and news tower where hero coverage, interviews, public statements, and Fame-shaping stories are produced.

broadcast-lobby.description: Public lobby with news screens, visitor passes, and rotating hero coverage.

newsroom.description: Editors and reporters track incidents, academy news, hero performances, and public reaction.

studio-floor.description: Television and streaming studios for interviews, debates, announcements, and live segments.

press-room.description: Press briefing room for agency statements and major public events.

Tokyo Hero Plaza.name: Tokyo Hero Plaza
Tokyo Hero Plaza.basicInfo: A large public square honoring professional heroes through memorials, statues, event stages, demonstrations, and civic gatherings.

memorial-walk.description: Path of hero statues, plaques, memorials, and historical displays.

event-square.description: Open plaza for ceremonies, festivals, demonstrations, protests, and public hero appearances.

food-kiosks.description: Public food stalls and souvenir stands serving visitors and office workers.

hero-gallery.description: Indoor exhibit space displaying equipment, records, and licensed hero history.

Professional Hero Hospital.name: Professional Hero Hospital
Professional Hero Hospital.basicInfo: Specialized Central Tokyo hospital treating professional heroes, power-related injuries, emergency responders, and civilians affected by incidents.

emergency-entrance.description: Protected emergency intake for urgent injuries and incident victims.

reception.description: Main desk handling appointments, visitors, records, and referrals.

trauma-ward.description: Secure treatment area for serious injuries and emergency observation.

outpatient-wing.description: Clinics for follow-up care, rehabilitation, and power-related assessments.

rehabilitation-gym.description: Supervised recovery space for mobility, conditioning, and safe power rehabilitation.

visitor-lounge.description: Waiting area for families, agency staff, students, and authorized visitors.

Hero Licensing Bureau.name: Hero Licensing Bureau
Hero Licensing Bureau.basicInfo: Official Central Tokyo office handling hero licenses, permits, examinations, records, and regulated professional activity.

public-lobby.description: Reception, information screens, forms, and visitor guidance.

examination-wing.description: Testing rooms for written, practical, and renewal examinations.

records-counter.description: Secure counter for licenses, permits, identity checks, and official records.

staff-office.description: Restricted offices where examiners and administrators review applications.

Tokyo Metropolitan Government Office.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Office
Tokyo Metropolitan Government Office.basicInfo: Major civic office complex where public policy, emergency coordination, permits, city planning, and official hero oversight are handled.

public-hall.description: Public service counters, notices, visitor screening, and city information.

council-wing.description: Meeting rooms and offices for metropolitan policy and public hearings.

emergency-coordination.description: Operations room coordinating city services during major incidents.

restricted-briefing.description: Secure briefing room for authorized emergency and hero officials.

Executive Dining Tower.name: Executive Dining Tower
Executive Dining Tower.basicInfo: Upscale Central Tokyo dining venue where agency leaders, executives, officials, and ambitious professionals hold private meals and negotiations.

lobby.description: Elegant reception with reservations, security, and skyline elevators.

main-dining-room.description: High-end restaurant floor for formal meals and public networking.

private-suites.description: Reserved rooms for confidential meetings, negotiations, and celebrations.

skyline-terrace.description: Outdoor terrace with a sweeping view of Central Tokyo.

Hero Equipment Exchange.name: Hero Equipment Exchange
Hero Equipment Exchange.basicInfo: Licensed Central Tokyo marketplace for approved support gear, refurbished equipment, protective clothing, and regulated trade-ins.

showroom.description: Displays of approved support tools, protective equipment, and refurbished gear.

fitting-bay.description: Supervised testing area for checking fit, mobility, and basic function.

service-counter.description: Appraisals, repairs, trade-ins, and purchase paperwork.

secured-storage.description: Restricted storage for regulated equipment and high-value orders.

Metropolitan Police Headquarters.name: Metropolitan Police Headquarters
Metropolitan Police Headquarters.basicInfo: Major police headquarters coordinating investigations, emergency response, public safety, and official cooperation with licensed heroes. The building includes public services, secure investigative spaces, command operations, training facilities, and staff areas that support officers through long shifts.

public-entrance.description: Visitor screening, public information, and report guidance.

investigations-wing.description: Case offices and interview rooms for authorized investigations.

operations-center.description: Command floor coordinating citywide incidents and emergency response.

evidence-room.description: Restricted evidence storage and forensic intake.

secure-briefing.description: Controlled room for police, officials, and licensed hero briefings.

locker-room.description: Officer lockers, changing benches, equipment checklists, and secure preparation space before or after a shift.

police-gym.description: A practical headquarters gym with mats, free weights, punching bags, cardio machines, and a small defensive-training area. Officers may work out, practice restraint techniques, recover after shifts, or observe one another's routines. Training is voluntary and does not assume the player participates.

staff-cafeteria.description: A bright, functional cafeteria serving shift meals, coffee, vending-machine snacks, and informal conversation between officers, dispatchers, investigators, and support staff.

Metropolitan Police Headquarters.hiddenInfo: The headquarters gym is available to officers but is not a mandatory conditioning program. Early mornings are quieter, while shift changes make the cafeteria and locker room busier. Hana reliably works out in the police gym early each morning when duty, injury, or an active emergency does not prevent it; she focuses on disciplined strength, cardio, firearms posture, and close-quarters fundamentals. She does not automatically invite the player, and the player is never required to join.

Tokyo Tower 7-Eleven.name: Tokyo Tower 7-Eleven
Tokyo Tower 7-Eleven.basicInfo: Tourist-heavy convenience store at Tokyo Tower's base, selling snacks, drinks, souvenirs, camera supplies, and essentials for visitors.

store-floor.description: Tourist shelves of snacks, drinks, souvenirs, and travel essentials.

checkout.description: Register with souvenir displays and visitor service.

storage-room.description: Compact employee storage and delivery access.

Tokyo Business Hotel.name: Tokyo Business Hotel
Tokyo Business Hotel.basicInfo: Professional hotel in Central Tokyo where agency staff, visiting officials, reporters, and out-of-town heroes stay between meetings and assignments.

lobby.description: Reception, business desks, lounges, and conference access.

executive-lounge.description: Private lounge for professionals and quiet networking.

guest-floors.description: Comfortable private rooms and corridors for lodgers.

hotel-room.description: Well-appointed room for resting, preparing, and private calls.

Jobs, matches, recruitment offers, drinks, rumors, and introductions may be useful, deceptive, exploitative, or traps. Preserve existing story references to oblivion-box and arena-floor while using the clearly named areas for new scenes. Fights in the fighting-ring and arena-floor must use context-appropriate opponents: powered villains, unlicensed vigilantes, mercenaries, criminal fighters, dangerous contractors, cursed or supernatural combatants, or other explicitly authored participants connected to the Crucible.
