(attack) Knee-Drive Kick: A punishing low kick that buckles legs and forces openings

Sera.name: Sera
Sera.visualDescription: A wiry second-year female student with close-cropped dark hair and tape-wrapped wrists, dressed in a Chikara Academy training uniform. She moves with quick, precise energy and has a lean, athletic build suited to her strike-class combat training.
Sera.basicInfo: A wiry second-year student with close-cropped dark hair and tape-wrapped wrists, dressed in a Chikara Academy training uniform. She moves with quick, precise energy and carries a lean, athletic build suited to her strike-class combat training.
personality: hides her own worries behind competence
secretly wants to be seen as more than a fixer
Sera.hiddenInfo: Sera is a second-year strike-class student who grew up in a working-class district where her older brother's gambling debts kept the family under constant pressure from collectors. She learned early that being useful and well-connected was the only real protection, so she built a reputation as the student who knows everyone and can get anyone introduced to anyone. She genuinely cares about the underdogs and troublemakers the academy overlooks, because she sees herself in them, and she's quietly hoping that backing the right crew will finally give her a way out of the ward's shadow.
abilities: (utility) Quick Footwork: Sidesteps and repositions to control spacing in close combat
(attack) Snap Combo: Fast two-strike burst that pressures an opponent's guard

Nobu.name: Nobu Takamine
Nobu.visualDescription: A tall, lean young man with messy black hair in sharp sections, shaved sides, taped rectangular glasses, and a defiant expression. He wears a cobalt-blue oversized hoodie beneath a cropped white utility vest, loose blue carpenter pants, white-and-blue skate shoes, fingerless gloves, and a modular crossbody tool harness. His gear case is repainted white with cobalt warning stripes, stickers, and hand-drawn crew marks.
Nobu.basicInfo: Nobu Takamine is the Joestar crew's rebellious support technician and field quartermaster. He designs, modifies, repairs, and deploys crew equipment, treating every repair as proof that support specialists belong in the field. Precise, defiant, and loyal, he keeps the crew supplied while insisting their gear be practical, durable, and accountable.
personality: loyal to the Joestar crew once trust is earned
Nobu.hiddenInfo: Nobu Takamine grew up in a workshop run by his father, a small-time gear tinkerer who never broke into the hero industry. He learned to make himself indispensable with his hands and resents combat students who treat support work as beneath them. He created the crew's equipment systems, maintains their comms and weapons, and quietly keeps emergency parts cached around Club Lumière.
abilities: (control) Drone Override: Nobu takes over one nearby device (a camera, door lock, or radio) for one beat. It does what he says, such as opening, looping, or transmitting, then returns to normal.
(control) Dead Air: He jams the local signal. For one exchange hostile radios and phones stop working, and Ayame's stream cuts out too.
(utility) Eyes Up: His drone flies ahead and he reports what it sees, which the narrator must describe truthfully.

Mikoto.name: Mikoto Kurogane
Mikoto.visualDescription: A compact, sharply muscular fighter with a short black wolf cut tipped electric blue, skeptical eyes, and a crooked grin. She wears a cropped white racing jacket with cobalt panels, a fitted blue sports top, loose white track pants with blue striping, blue high-top sneakers, mismatched gloves, and silver hardware. Her style is aggressive athletic streetwear, with blue Riot Pulse sparks cracking around her knuckles.
Mikoto.basicInfo: An elite second-year strike-class fighter and Joestar Gang Vanguard. Mikoto is a compact, disciplined close-range combatant who has reshaped her academy training into a rebellious street-fighter style. She fights with direct pressure, sharp observation, and explosive Riot Pulse techniques, protecting allies while proving herself through ability rather than status.
Mikoto.hiddenInfo: Mikoto is a second-year strike-class fighter whose power, Riot Pulse, converts her own movement and absorbed impacts into compact red shockwaves released through her fists, elbows, knees, or feet. The power needs motion or impact to charge, works best at close range, and weakens across distance; repeated pulses send painful feedback through her joints and can numb the limb she uses. At elite mastery, Mikoto can chain pulses through footwork, redirect impact into counters, and create brief shockwave bursts that break formations. She still needs momentum and close range, and overcharging risks joint damage and temporary numbness. She fights to prove herself on ability rather than inherited status and is fiercely loyal once trust is earned.
abilities: (attack) Riot Pulse: A shockwave from Mikoto's hands or body that hits everything in front of her at close range and throws targets back. She chooses a shove or a killing blow; big pulses leave her winded with her ribs flaring.
(control) Pulse Interrupt: A quick pulse that cancels one attack the enemy has telegraphed and staggers them.
(attack) Impact Charge: She rushes one target, breaks their guard, and drives them back.

Aurelia Voss.name: Aurelia Voss
Aurelia Voss.basicInfo: A young Speedwagon Foundation representative with long silky white hair that flows naturally down her back and a striking, polished K-pop idol-like appearance. She wears a sharply tailored black suit with a pale shirt and silver accents, carrying a tablet she consults with quiet, unshakeable focus.
personality: secretly rooting for the crew's redemption
Aurelia Voss.hiddenInfo: Aurelia is a mid-level Foundation liaison who clawed her way up from a clerical post by being ruthlessly reliable, not by charm or connections. A failed early assignment where a client's debts were cleared without proper authorization nearly ended her career, teaching her that every line item must be signed, confirmed, and accounted for before she commits a single yen. She genuinely believes the Joestar crew can be made legitimate, and she cares about proving that the Foundation's money and her own reputation can survive the process intact.
abilities: utility
arcane
arcane

Retired Hero.name: Retired Hero
Retired Hero.visualDescription: A grizzled man in his late fifties with a weathered, lined face and close-cropped gray hair, dressed in a plain civilian jacket and worn work trousers. He moves with the deliberate ease of someone who once trained for combat, and his sharp eyes still scan the waterfront with professional habit.
Retired Hero.basicInfo: A grizzled man in his late fifties with a weathered, lined face and close-cropped gray hair, dressed in a plain civilian jacket and worn work trousers. He moves with the deliberate ease of someone who once trained for combat, and his sharp eyes still scan the waterfront with professional habit.

Retired Hero.hiddenInfo: A former licensed hero who retired after a career spent mostly in rescue and crowd-control work, never quite reaching the fame of the headline acts. He lost his nerve on one bad call years ago when a crowd he was managing turned violent and someone got hurt on his watch, and he's carried the guilt ever since. He still patrols the waterfront out of habit, quietly watching for the kind of trouble he once stopped, because he believes that keeping people safe is the only thing he was ever truly good at.
abilities: (UTILITY) Waterfront Awareness: Reads crowds and threats with practiced, professional calm
(DEFENSE) Steady Stance: Holds his ground against intimidation and sudden violence
(CONTROL) Commanding Presence: Freezes aggressors with a flat, authoritative voice

Carrier Girl.name: Carrier Girl
Carrier Girl.visualDescription: A young woman in her late teens, dressed in plain street clothes meant to blend into midday foot traffic — a loose jacket over a simple top, jeans, and worn sneakers. She has a slim build and a nervous, watchful manner, with a cash bag slung over her shoulder.
Carrier Girl.basicInfo: A slim young woman in her late teens, dressed in a loose jacket over a simple top, jeans, and worn sneakers meant to pass as ordinary midday foot traffic. She has a nervous, watchful manner, with a cash bag slung over her shoulder and her eyes constantly scanning the crowd.

Carrier Girl.hiddenInfo: A teenage girl from Kobuncho who fell in with the noodle shop crew out of desperation, carrying money for a local operator who pays her a cut to keep the envelopes moving. She was caught once before and roughed up for losing a delivery, which taught her to watch everything and trust no one. She cares about keeping her younger brother out of the same work, and she is terrified that today's loss will bring the operator's enforcers down on her family.

Yuzuki Hoshino.name: Yuzuki Hoshino
Yuzuki Hoshino.visualDescription: A petite Japanese woman in her late twenties with a soft round face, warm hazel eyes, and chestnut-brown hair in a neat loose bun secured with a pale blue hairpin. Yuzuki wears a modern blue-and-white kimono streetwear ensemble: a crisp white kimono-style wrap top with cobalt-blue geometric panels, wide blue hakama-inspired trousers, a white obi belt with a compact healer pouch, white tabi-style sneakers, and pale blue wrist wraps. The silhouette is modest, practical, and contemporary, blending bathhouse tradition with Tokyo street fashion. Small silver charms decorate the obi. Her translucent green sylph Stand floats near her shoulder, its emerald wings and leaflike light contrasting with the blue-and-white outfit.
Yuzuki Hoshino.basicInfo: Yuzuki Hoshino runs a small old bathhouse in Kobuncho and has quietly become its unofficial first-aid provider. She is warm, polite, and eager to help people in genuine trouble, but panics around fighting, blood, raised voices, and the possibility that someone might exploit her gift. Her kindness is not weakness: when a patient is endangered, fear gives way to stubborn courage and careful, effective treatment.
personality: panics around violence and serious injuries
protective of her bathhouse and its guests
quietly stubborn when someone is being mistreated
observant of pain and emotional distress
trusting toward sincere people but cautious with promises

still learning the limits of her fused Stand
Yuzuki Hoshino.hiddenInfo: Yuzuki inherited the bathhouse from her grandmother and keeps it open as an inexpensive refuge for workers, students, and people with nowhere else to rest. Years ago, she accidentally healed a stray cat with a broken leg; since then, similar restorative effects have appeared whenever she comforts someone in pain. She believes the healing is an unusual talent and has never received formal training. Jostin's Eagle Vision first revealed a small green fairy-like Stand near her; Yuzuki has since become aware of it and fused with it, calling wind wings, wind blades, and storm bursts under her own control. The Stand is gentle and instinctively protective, appearing most clearly when someone nearby is frightened or injured. It resembles a translucent sylph with leaflike light and green wings, and its presence may be the true source or amplifier of Yuzuki's healing. Yuzuki fears that criminals, agencies, or institutions would turn her into a resource if they learned the truth, so she avoids attention and helps people anonymously. She has chosen that life herself and is now the Joestar crew's healer.
abilities: (Stand) Verdant Sylph: Yuzuki is fused with her Sylph. She calls wind wings for flight, wind blades for close attacks, or a storm burst that hits enemies around her. She controls it, and it lasts the exchange.
(spell) Golden Mend: She heals one wounded ally in a single beat.
(spell) Soothing Aura: Calms nearby frightened people and eases tension, but fades if she panics.

Kaito Arashima.name: Kaito Arashima
Kaito Arashima.basicInfo: A lean young man in a black-and-crimson Joestar Gang uniform with gold trim, a compact cable-bow slung across his back. When he gets serious, his Stand Horizon Breaker manifests beside him as an imposing long-range marksman, turning rooftops and cables into a controlled firing network. Kaito carries himself with quiet, watchful confidence, using precision and battlefield geometry rather than brute force.
Kaito Arashima.hiddenInfo: Kaito is a former rooftop troublemaker and illegal ambush specialist who was disciplined by Josuke Higashikata and later recruited as a supervised Speedwagon Foundation field contractor. Josuke taught him that a ranged fighter does not merely attack from far away: he controls the entire battlefield and protects everyone caught inside it. Kaito's Stand, Horizon Breaker, manifests as a tall black-steel and cobalt-blue humanoid marksman with gold targeting lines, bow-shaped energy limbs, long-range sight apertures, and luminous tether cables. It specializes in impossible firing angles, ricochets, tether shots, pinning targets, and overlapping firing lanes without requiring lethal force. Horizon Breaker is strongest when Kaito has time to establish elevated positions and anchor points; it is less effective at point-blank range, in cramped interiors, or when its cables are severed. Kaito is still being evaluated as a possible Joestar crew ranged specialist and wants to judge whether the crew's principles are worth committing to.
personality: secretly wants to belong to something good
abilities: (Stand) Horizon Breaker: A long-range marksman Stand. From height or a clear sightline, Kaito hits a target far away, with normal cover offering little protection at distance.
(attack) Trick Shot: One shot ricochets off a nearby surface and hits a target hiding behind cover.
(control) Overwatch: He holds one chosen enemy in his sights. If that enemy moves or attacks, Kaito shoots first.
Kaito Arashima.visualDescription: A lean young man in his early twenties with tousled dark hair, sharp features, and a dry grin. He wears a cobalt-blue oversized technical windbreaker over a white mesh tee, wide white cargo trousers, blue trail sneakers, a crossbody utility sling, and slim wraparound sunglasses. His compact cable-bow is disguised as a street-photography rig; blue-and-white Horizon Breaker targeting lines glow like urban light trails.

firefighter 2.name: firefighter 2
firefighter 2.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered male firefighter in his late thirties, wearing a soot-smudged yellow turnout coat and black helmet, his face streaked with grime and sweat as he works the jammed ladder against the burning izakaya wall.
firefighter 2.basicInfo: A broad-shouldered male firefighter in his late thirties, wearing a soot-smudged yellow turnout coat and black helmet, his face streaked with grime and sweat as he works the jammed ladder against the burning izakaya wall. His movements are heavy and deliberate, favoring his left shoulder as he hauls on the ladder's rungs.
personality: quietly haunted by a past loss
secretly fears being the one who hesitates again
firefighter 2.hiddenInfo: A career firefighter in his late thirties who has spent nearly two decades on Kobuncho's engine crews, he lost a close colleague to a flashover years ago when a rescue was delayed by a jammed door. That loss taught him that hesitation and equipment failure cost lives, so he now throws himself at any obstacle rather than wait for backup. He cares fiercely about the residents of his district, especially the elderly and the trapped, and will not leave a scene until every person is accounted for.
abilities: (utility) Breach Charge: Shoulder-rams and kicks open jammed doors and windows with explosive force
(utility) Thermal Sweep: Uses gloved hands and gear to locate heat sources and trapped victims in smoke
(defense) Turnout Guard: Braces his armored coat to shield himself and others from falling debris

Kaito Serizawa.name: Kaito Serizawa
Kaito Serizawa.visualDescription: A lean, wiry man in his early thirties with close-cropped dark hair, a scar cutting through his left eyebrow, and calloused knuckles. He wears a worn black tank top and loose training pants, his wrists freshly taped for sparring.
Kaito Serizawa.basicInfo: A lean, wiry man in his early thirties with close-cropped dark hair, a scar cutting through his left eyebrow, and calloused knuckles. He wears a worn black tank top and loose training pants, his wrists freshly taped for sparring.

Kaito Serizawa.hiddenInfo: Kaito Serizawa is a thick-armed regular of the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, a hardened local fighter who trains under the old master and backs up the gym's turf. Years ago he lost a close friend to a Kurokawa debt-collection beating, and he learned that the only way to protect the people he cares about is to be the one standing at the door when trouble comes. He cares deeply about the gym, its old master, and the neighborhood regulars, and he will throw hands without hesitation to keep them safe.
abilities: (attack) Iron Palm Strike: A palm-heel blow that cracks ribs and sends opponents staggering
(utility) Grapple Break: Shrugs off holds and locks with raw upper-body strength
(defense) Gym Rat Footwork: Sidesteps and slips blows with practiced, close-quarters agility

elderly proprietor.name: elderly proprietor
elderly proprietor.visualDescription: An elderly Japanese woman in her late seventies, small and wiry, with silver hair pulled into a neat bun and deep laugh lines around her eyes. She wears a simple indigo kimono with a faded apron over it, and moves with the unhurried steadiness of a lifetime spent behind a tea counter.
elderly proprietor.basicInfo: A small, wiry Japanese woman in her late seventies with silver hair in a neat bun and deep laugh lines around her eyes, dressed in a simple indigo kimono and faded apron. She moves with unhurried steadiness behind her tea counter, grinding leaves and serving customers with quiet, practiced ease.
personality: takes quiet pride in her craft
elderly proprietor.hiddenInfo: She has run this teahouse for over fifty years, inheriting it from her mother, and has watched Kobuncho's streets change around her while her own life stayed rooted in the same worn counter and hand-painted noren. The one thing she cares about above all is keeping her teahouse a place of calm and refuge, and she quietly keeps tabs on the neighborhood's comings and goings from her window seat, noticing far more than she lets on. She learned long ago that staying neutral and keeping her head down is the only way to survive the shifting powers of the ward, and she trusts no one who brings trouble through her curtain.

Maki Hayashida.name: Maki Hayashida
Maki Hayashida.visualDescription: Maki Hayashida is a young woman in her mid-twenties with a lean, energetic build and a bright, cheerful demeanor. She has shoulder-length dark hair tied back with a loose ribbon, and wears a fitted black apron over a simple white blouse and dark trousers, practical for moving through the kitchen and lounge. Her hands are quick and sure, and she carries herself with the easy confidence of someone used to working a busy floor.
Maki Hayashida.basicInfo: Maki witnesses Jostin name his uncontrolled assassin's will, Blackstar Dominion, and gives Jovian room to stabilize him while she helps secure Club Lumière.
Maki Hayashida.hiddenInfo: Maki is a daytime worker at Club Lumière who keeps the front step and entrance swept and presentable during opening hours, but she has quietly become the club's unofficial fixer for small disasters—spilled drinks, broken glass, tangled lights. She grew up helping her mother run a cramped izakaya, where she learned to keep a whole room running on instinct and charm, and she still carries the habit of solving problems before anyone asks. What she cares about most is that the club feels like a home for the crew, and she will quietly work herself ragged to keep that feeling alive, even when she pretends it's all just logistics.
abilities: (utility) Quick Hands: Maki can snatch, catch, or redirect small objects mid-flight with startling speed
(utility) Floor Sense: Maki reads a crowded room's movement and angles to slip through or brace herself
(defense) Pan Toss: Maki flings a heavy pan or tray to knock an attacker off balance at close range

Airi Kurosawa.name: Airi Kurosawa
Airi Kurosawa.basicInfo: A cabaret hostess with glossy black hair swept into a low chignon, a poised smile, and an elegant midnight-blue dress with subtle sequins catching the club light. She moves through the room with practiced ease, topping glasses and steering conversations with a warm, attentive touch.

hides a sharp wariness behind a soft smile
genuinely enjoys making people feel cared for
Airi Kurosawa.hiddenInfo: Airi is a twenty-six-year-old hostess who has worked the floor of Kobuncho nightlife for nearly a decade, learning to read a room the way others read a menu. Years of watching men trade threats and favors over champagne taught her that the safest seat in any club is the one where everyone thinks you're on their side. She cares deeply about the regulars who come in to forget their troubles, and she will quietly steer trouble away from them before it ever reaches their table.
abilities: (utility) Graceful Intercept: deftly redirects a shove or grab to keep a guest from falling
(utility) Calm Presence: steadies a panicking patron with a word and a steadying hand

Mirei Tachibana.name: Mirei Tachibana
Mirei Tachibana.basicInfo: A glamorous hostess with cascading chestnut hair, luminous makeup, and a sophisticated champagne-colored evening dress. Warm, witty, and effortlessly magnetic, she keeps conversations sparkling through any lull.
personality: careful not to get entangled in syndicate business
Mirei Tachibana.hiddenInfo: Mirei is a thirty-one-year-old hostess who has worked the cabaret circuit for over a decade, drifting between clubs in Kobuncho and Kurokawa. Years ago she watched a regular customer get dragged out back by debt collectors and beaten for falling behind on payments; she learned that charm only protects you if you know who to smile at and who to avoid. She genuinely cares about the other hostesses and the small shopkeepers on her street, quietly steering trouble away from them while keeping her own hands clean.
abilities: (utility) Graceful Evasion: Sidesteps grapples and grabs with practiced, fluid ease
(utility) Soothing Presence: Calms agitated patrons with a steady, disarming tone
Mirei Tachibana.visualDescription: A glamorous young Japanese hostess in her mid-twenties with cascading chestnut hair in soft waves, luminous polished makeup, sparkling warm eyes, and a magnetic witty smile. Sena Fujimori.name: Sena Amagawa
Sena Fujimori.basicInfo: A striking young woman with a sleek raven bob, dramatic eyeliner, and a fitted crimson cabaret gown. Tasteful black-and-red tattoos wind across one shoulder and down her upper arm, giving her polished glamour a rebellious edge.
Sena Fujimori.visualDescription: A striking young woman with a sleek raven bob, dramatic eyeliner, and a fitted crimson cabaret gown. She has tasteful black-and-red tattoos winding across one shoulder and down her upper arm, visible above the dress, giving her polished glamour a rebellious edge.
personality: protective of her sister and the hostesses
hides her own worries behind a bright smile
Sena Fujimori.hiddenInfo: Sena is Reiko Amagawa's younger sister, raised in the shadow of her older sibling's fierce reputation and always measured against it. A few years back she got tangled with the wrong crowd in Kurokawa and learned the hard way that charm only gets you so far when debts come due, which taught her to trust her instincts over her smile. She cares fiercely about protecting her sister's name and the people who work the floor with her, and she will quietly move heaven and earth to keep them out of harm's way.
abilities: (utility) Room Reader: Instantly gauges a room's mood and spots trouble before it escalates
(utility) Charm Offensive: Disarms tense situations with a disarming smile and easy banter
(defense) Quick Step: Sidesteps grabs and shoves with practiced, fluid footwork

Noa Amemiya.name: Noa Amemiya
Noa Amemiya.basicInfo: An elegant hostess with long honey-blonde hair, delicate features, and a shimmering silver dress. Soft-spoken and observant, she offers calm companionship and remembers every guest's favorite drink.
personality: quietly loyal to the other hostesses
Noa Amemiya.hiddenInfo: Noa is a twenty-six-year-old hostess who grew up in Kobuncho and watched her family's small shop get squeezed out by Daigo's protection racket. She learned early that charm and silence keep you safe, and that the people who smile loudest are often the ones you should watch closest. She genuinely cares about the other hostesses and the neighborhood regulars, and quietly hopes the new management at Lumière might actually mean something good for the block.
abilities: (utility) Calm Presence: Steadies a panicking guest with a reassuring word and touch
(utility) Sharp Eye: Spots a concealed weapon or hostile intent across a crowded room
Noa Amemiya.visualDescription: An elegant young Japanese hostess in her early twenties with long honey-blonde hair worn loose, delicate refined features, warm confident eyes, and a poised gracious smile. She wears a shimmering silver dress with subtle jewelry — polished upscale cabaret elegance.

Rika Saotome.name: Rika Saotome
Rika Saotome.basicInfo: A dazzling hostess with wavy dark-red hair, a confident posture, and a black dress accented with gold jewelry. Bold, charismatic, and quick with a laugh, she brings energy to the lounge without losing her professional polish.
personality: hides a wary edge behind her laugh
pragmatic about survival in the nightlife
Rika Saotome.hiddenInfo: Rika Saotome is a twenty-six-year-old hostess who has worked the cabaret circuit in Kobuncho for nearly a decade, trading on charm and a sharp eye for trouble to keep herself safe in a trade full of it. A few years back, a debt collector cornered her over a friend's unpaid tab, and she learned that the only way to survive the nightlife was to know who was dangerous before they knew her. She cares fiercely about the other hostesses on her rotation, treating them like family and quietly steering them away from the men who would use them, even when it costs her tips.

She once watched a promising self-taught healer get turned away for lack of credentials and has regretted the rigidness of that moment ever since, which is why she quietly advocates for people like Yuzuki. She genuinely cares about keeping the clinic staffed and functional, and she sees practical skill as more valuable than paperwork.
abilities: (utility) Triage Focus: Quickly stabilizes and prioritizes wounded allies in combat

He lost a close colleague to a villain attack that a faster, better-equipped response might have prevented, and he has carried that guilt ever since. He cares deeply about making sure young healers are properly trained and equipped, because he believes competence—not courage—is what truly saves lives.

(spell) Stabilizing Ward: A gentle field that halts bleeding and steadies vitals

Ayame Fujinami.name: Ayame Fujinami
Ayame Fujinami.basicInfo: A glamorous third-year Media-track influencer with long glossy dark hair, luminous makeup, and a fashion-forward blend of luxury streetwear and designer accessories. She carries a smartphone and compact filming rig, her smile camera-perfect while her eyes stay alert and assessing.
Ayame Fujinami.visualDescription: A glamorous young Japanese influencer with long glossy dark hair and luminous makeup. Ayame Fujinami.hiddenInfo: Ayame is a third-year Media-track student who built her two-hundred-thousand-follower channel through relentless hustle, filming everything from power demos to club features. café worker.hiddenInfo: A café worker in her early twenties who has worked the counter at a small shop near Crepe Expectations for a couple of years. She grew up helping her grandmother, who ran a tiny neighborhood eatery, and learned early that staying calm and useful in a crisis matters more than panicking. She cares deeply about the regulars on her street and quietly keeps an eye out for anyone in trouble, though she rarely speaks up about it.

gentleman near the bar.name: gentleman near the bar
gentleman near the bar.visualDescription: A man in his late thirties with a lean build, wearing a dark charcoal suit jacket over a plain white shirt with the top button undone. He has short, neatly combed black hair, a faint scar along his jawline, and keeps his hands loosely in his pockets as he watches the room from the bar.
gentleman near the bar.basicInfo: A lean man in his late thirties in a dark charcoal suit jacket over a plain white shirt, top button undone. He has short, neatly combed black hair, a faint scar along his jawline, and keeps his hands loosely in his pockets as he watches the room from the bar.
personality: harbors a private resentment toward his employers
gentleman near the bar.hiddenInfo: He is a mid-level debt collector and information broker working the fringes of Kurokawa's network, sent to Club Lumière to gauge the new owners' strength and report back on their security and guest list. A failed collection years ago cost him his standing and nearly his life, teaching him to stay patient, watchful, and never to act without knowing the exits. He cares deeply about his younger sister's safety and has quietly been skimming a small cut of his collections to keep her out of the life, which makes him more cautious than loyal.

Daigo Kurosawa.name: Ginta Kurosawa
Daigo Kurosawa.visualDescription: A lean, middle-aged Japanese man in his late forties with a weathered, unreadable face and short graying black hair. He wears a dark, well-tailored suit over a crisp white shirt, no tie, and carries himself with the unhurried patience of a man used to waiting out answers. His eyes are sharp and assessing, and he holds his drink with a calm, deliberate grip.
Daigo Kurosawa.basicInfo: A lean, middle-aged Japanese man in his late forties with a weathered, unreadable face and short graying black hair. He wears a dark, well-tailored suit over a crisp white shirt, no tie, and carries himself with the unhurried patience of a man used to waiting out answers, his sharp eyes assessing everything around him.
personality: secretly tired of the syndicate's grip on him
Daigo Kurosawa.hiddenInfo: Daigo Kurosawa is a local shop owner in Kobuncho who has quietly risen to become the neighborhood's unofficial enforcer, collecting dues and keeping the streets orderly for the men who run the district. Years ago he watched a rival who tried to go independent get crushed by the syndicate, and he learned that survival in Kobuncho means knowing exactly who owns what and never overreaching. He genuinely cares about keeping his street quiet and prosperous, and he is testing the Joestars to decide whether they are useful partners or a threat to be removed.
abilities: (attack) Cane Strike: A precise, punishing blow from his concealed cane that targets joints and pressure points.
(utility) Pressure Point Pin: A swift, disabling grip that locks a limb and forces compliance.
(defense) Unreadable Guard: A calm, measured stance that reads an opponent's intent and deflects their opening move.

courier.name: courier
courier.visualDescription: A wiry young man in his early twenties wearing a branded courier jacket over a plain t-shirt, with a messenger bag slung across his chest. He has short, slightly disheveled dark hair and a neutral, businesslike expression, moving with the brisk efficiency of someone who makes deliveries all day.
courier.basicInfo: A wiry young man in his early twenties wearing a branded courier jacket over a plain t-shirt, with a messenger bag slung across his chest. He has short, slightly disheveled dark hair and a neutral, businesslike expression, moving with the brisk efficiency of someone who makes deliveries all day.
personality: hopes to quit the courier work someday
relieved to be done with a drop
tired of being treated as furniture
wary of the club's new owners
hopeful the club means safer streets
ready to vanish at the first sign of trouble
courier.hiddenInfo: He is a low-level courier who runs sealed envelopes and packages for several nightlife operators in Kurokawa, paid per drop and told never to ask what he carries. A few months ago he was caught holding a package during a police raid and spent a night in a holding cell, which taught him to keep his head down, deliver fast, and never open anything. He cares about staying out of trouble and keeping his courier job, since it's the only steady work he's found, and he will answer questions only if it costs him nothing.

café owner.name: café owner
café owner.visualDescription: A woman in her early forties with a tired but kind face, dark hair pulled back in a loose ponytail, and faint lines around her eyes from long shifts. She wears a simple apron over a plain blouse and dark trousers, with calloused hands from years of barista work.
café owner.basicInfo: A woman in her early forties with a tired but kind face, dark hair pulled back in a loose ponytail, and faint lines around her eyes from long shifts. She wears a simple apron over a plain blouse and dark trousers, with calloused hands from years of barista work.
personality: secretly hopeful the street can change
café owner.hiddenInfo: A café proprietor in her early forties who has run the same small shop on the east row for over a decade, serving the same regulars through every shift. When her husband left years ago, she took on the shop alone and learned to keep her head down and her ledger honest, trusting that steady work would outlast any trouble. She cares deeply about her regulars and the street's daily rhythm, and she quietly resents the collection crews who make her neighbors flinch at the door — but she will not risk her shop to defy them openly.
abilities: (utility) Hot-Pot Pour: Splashes a scalding drink to break a grapple or clear space
(defense) Steady Hands: Braces herself to keep footing when shoved or rushed

baker.name: baker
baker.visualDescription: A middle-aged male baker in his forties, flour-dusted apron over a plain work shirt, with flour-pale forearms and a tight, tired smile. He keeps glancing toward the door, wary and watchful.
baker.basicInfo: A middle-aged man in his forties with flour-pale forearms and a dusting of white across his plain work shirt and apron. He carries a tight, tired smile and keeps stealing glances toward the door, watchful and wary even amid the party noise.
personality: pragmatic to the point of cynicism
secretly hopeful the street can change
baker.hiddenInfo: A neighborhood baker who has run the same shop for over twenty years, inheriting it from his father. When a collection crew roughed up his delivery boy last winter and he complained, nobody backed him and the dues doubled anyway, teaching him that the street's 'order' only listens to whoever holds the line. He cares most about keeping his bakery open and his staff safe, which is why he's quietly weighing whether the new club owners are worth trusting or just another crew wearing a friendlier face.

Daigo Renjiro.name: Daigo Renjiro
Daigo Renjiro.visualDescription: Daigo Renjiro is a broad-shouldered man in his late forties with a weathered, scarred face and close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair. He wears a dark, tailored suit with no tie, hands perpetually in his pockets, and moves with the unhurried, deliberate gait of a man who has never needed to rush. His cold, appraising eyes and the faint smirk on his lips mark him as someone who measures every opponent before he speaks.
Daigo Renjiro.basicInfo: A broad-shouldered man in his late forties with a weathered, scarred face and close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair. He wears a dark, tailored suit with no tie, hands perpetually in his pockets, and moves with the unhurried, deliberate gait of a man who has never needed to rush.
personality: commands through presence rather than violence
fiercely protective of his territory's order
loyal to his crew and expects loyalty in return
holds a quiet pride in never needing to rush
Daigo Renjiro.hiddenInfo: Daigo Renjiro is a hardened Kurokawa crew leader in his late forties who commands enforcers through presence and intimidation rather than overt violence. He built his standing the slow way, paying his dues in the ward's hidden commerce until he owned the ground he walks on, and he learned that patience and measured words break more men than fists ever will. He cares deeply about the order of his territory and the loyalty of his crew, and he will not tolerate anyone who treats his ground as theirs for the taking.
abilities: (attack) Iron Palm Strike: A measured, bone-jarring open-palm blow that staggers even armored opponents
(utility) Territorial Command: Barks a single order that briefly steadies his enforcers' footing and resolve
(defense) Unshakable Stance: Braces himself to absorb heavy blows without being knocked off his ground

elite enforcer 3.name: Toma "Anchor" Genda
elite enforcer 3.visualDescription: A lean Japanese man in his early thirties with shoulder-length dark hair, a narrow thoughtful face, and calm brown eyes. He wears a sleeveless navy combat hoodie over a loose white shirt, reinforced trousers, ankle wraps, and a faded judo belt over street clothes. His relaxed stance hides precise balance and formidable leverage.
elite enforcer 3.basicInfo: A grappler and Kurokawa elite enforcer sent by Daigo Renjiro to test the Joestar crew without killing them. Toma's power, Gravity Lock, briefly increases his effective weight or anchors anything he has a firm grip on, making throws and pins difficult to escape.
elite enforcer 3.hiddenInfo: Gravity Lock requires direct contact and concentration. Toma can anchor himself or one held target, but the effect lasts only briefly and makes him slower while active. He cannot anchor distant objects, immobilize an entire area, or ignore overwhelming force forever.
abilities: Gravity Lock: Anchors Toma or a gripped target through temporary weight manipulation.
Leverage Grappling: Uses balance, trips, throws, and pins against stronger opponents.
Trial Rules: Controls force carefully to avoid lethal injury.

vigilante.name: vigilante
vigilante.visualDescription: A lean man in his early thirties wearing a worn black tactical vest over a dark hoodie, with a bandana pulled up over the lower half of his face. He has short, dark hair, sharp watchful eyes, and a utility belt with improvised tools. His gear is patched and practical, clearly self-assembled rather than issued.
vigilante.basicInfo: A lean man in his early thirties wearing a worn black tactical vest over a dark hoodie, a bandana pulled up over the lower half of his face. Short dark hair, sharp watchful eyes, and a utility belt of improvised tools, his gear patched and practical rather than issued.
vigilante.hiddenInfo: A former pit runner who got out of the circuit after a bad debt nearly cost him his life, he now patrols the flooded and forgotten corners of the ward as an unlicensed protector. He learned that the people who cut pipes and shut down streets are the same ones who collect on debts, and that staying quiet is how neighborhoods get eaten alive. He cares deeply about the small shopkeepers and regulars who can't afford protection, and he'll risk his own safety to warn them before trouble lands.
abilities: (utility) Pipe-Cut Awareness: Reads sabotage and ambush signs in urban terrain
(attack) Improvised Tool Toss: Hurls patched gear and debris with sharp accuracy
(defense) Streetwise Evasion: Slips through crowds and cover to break pursuit

Old Man Koga.name: Old Man Koga
Old Man Koga.visualDescription: A squat, elderly Japanese man in his late sixties with a weathered, deeply lined face, gray stubble, and a cigarette habit. He wears a faded tracksuit and leans on the wall with the practiced ease of someone who has spent decades guarding doorways. His arms bear the old scars of a lifetime in the fight circuit.

Cable-Cutter 3.name: Cable-Cutter 3
Cable-Cutter 3.visualDescription: A wiry man in his late twenties wearing stained gray work coveralls over a dark t-shirt, with a scuffed hard hat tucked under one arm and a heavy pair of bolt cutters hanging from his belt. His face is lean and unshaven, with a faded scar across one eyebrow and a nervous, darting look that suggests he's more hired muscle than true enforcer.

A wiry man in his late twenties wearing stained gray work coveralls over a dark t-shirt, with a scuffed hard hat tucked under one arm and a heavy pair of bolt cutters hanging from his belt. His face is lean and unshaven, with a faded scar across one eyebrow and a nervous, darting look that suggests he's more hired muscle than true enforcer.

A low-tier cable-cutter hired by the day for jobs like this, he's a former utility-lines worker who lost his license after a botched job and drifted into the Kurokawa underworld for steady pay. He learned that staying alive means never committing fully — he'll do the work but keeps an eye on the exits and a foot ready to run. He cares most about getting through the night without a hospital bill or a police record, and he'll fold fast if the odds turn against him.

Sonobe.name: Sonobe
Sonobe.visualDescription: A stooped, elderly Japanese man in his late sixties with thinning gray hair and thick glasses, wearing a rumpled cardigan over a collared shirt. His hands tremble as he sorts papers, and his office is cluttered with stacked folders and a whimpering kettle.
Sonobe.basicInfo: A stooped, elderly Japanese man in his late sixties with thinning gray hair and thick glasses, wearing a rumpled cardigan over a collared shirt. His hands tremble as he sorts papers, and his office is cluttered with stacked folders and a whimpering kettle.
personality: secretly proud of his hidden copies
clings to small routines for comfort
desperate to be seen as useful enough to protect
Sonobe.hiddenInfo: Sonobe is a widowed licensing officer in his late sixties who has spent decades processing ward paperwork, quietly resentful of the captains who have used his office as a front for falsified records. Years ago he was caught skimming small fees to cover his late wife's medical bills, and the captain learned of it — holding that secret over him ever since. He has spent that time secretly copying every falsified record he was forced to process, hoarding duplicates in hidden stashes, because he wants to survive the captain's fall without being buried with him.

warehouse silhouette 1.name: warehouse silhouette 1
warehouse silhouette 1.visualDescription: A lean man in his late twenties wearing a dark work jacket over a stained tee, jeans, and scuffed boots. He has short, unkempt dark hair and a wary, hard-set jaw, and he crouches low among the warehouse shelving, one hand gripping a crowbar as he watches the burst doorway.
warehouse silhouette 1.basicInfo: A lean man in his late twenties with short, unkempt dark hair and a hard-set jaw, wearing a dark work jacket over a stained tee, jeans, and scuffed boots. He crouches low among the warehouse shelving, one hand gripping a crowbar as he watches the burst doorway.

warehouse silhouette 1.hiddenInfo: A hired warehouse hand who took the job moving crates for extra cash, never expecting a fight. He learned long ago that the first one to stand tall gets hit hardest, so he stays low and lets others take the brunt. He cares about getting home in one piece and will fold the moment the fight turns against him.
abilities: (attack) Crowbar Swing: A heavy, close-range swing aimed at the head or hands
(utility) Crate Shield: Grabs a crate to block incoming strikes and shove attackers

warehouse silhouette 3.name: warehouse silhouette 3
warehouse silhouette 3.visualDescription: A male warehouse worker in his thirties, dressed in a dark work shirt and cargo pants, crouched low behind a stack of crates in the dim loading bay. His face is half-shadowed, one hand braced on a shelving rail as he watches the breached door.
warehouse silhouette 3.basicInfo: A stocky warehouse worker in his mid-thirties, dressed in a dark work shirt and cargo pants, crouched low behind a stack of crates in the dim loading bay. His face is half-shadowed, one hand braced on a shelving rail as he watches the breached door, breathing hard through his teeth.
personality: pragmatic to the point of cowardice
loyal only to his own survival
resentful of being treated as expendable
secretly ashamed of how easily he backs down
protective of his paycheck and his family
warehouse silhouette 3.hiddenInfo: A hired loader who has worked the Kobuncho docks for years, taking cash jobs that never ask questions. He once watched a coworker get beaten for refusing to move a crate, and learned that staying quiet and staying useful keeps him whole. He cares about getting home to his family in one piece, which is why he'll fold the moment the fight turns truly hopeless.
abilities: (ATTACK) Pallet Slam: Heaves a heavy pallet to crush or pin an advancing foe
(UTILITY) Crate Cover: Uses stacked crates to block sightlines and shield himself
(DEFENSE) Shelving Brace: Braces against shelving to absorb a heavy blow and hold ground

warehouse silhouette 4.name: warehouse silhouette 4
warehouse silhouette 4.visualDescription: A lean, wiry man in his late twenties with a shaved head and a thin scar across his left brow, dressed in a dark work jacket and cargo pants. He moves with the coiled tension of a hired enforcer, one hand hovering near the small of his back.
warehouse silhouette 4.basicInfo: A lean, wiry man in his late twenties with a shaved head and a thin scar across his left brow, dressed in a dark work jacket and cargo pants. He moves with the coiled tension of a hired enforcer, one hand hovering near the small of his back.
personality: keeps his voice low and even
more loyal to his paycheck than to any crew
secretly tired of the violence but won't admit it
warehouse silhouette 4.hiddenInfo: A hired enforcer for the Kurokawa crew who started as a dock loader and worked his way up through quiet, reliable muscle. A bad beat in a card game years ago taught him that loud men get found out, so he learned to read a room and wait for the right moment instead. He cares about his pay and his reputation for never botching a job, and he'll fold fast if the fight stops being worth his skin.
abilities: (attack) Crate-Side Strike: A short, brutal hook aimed at the ribs or jaw
(utility) Loader's Feint: Fakes a crate toss to bait an opening
(defense) Bay Bracing: Uses shelving and pallets to shield and reposition

kid on a scooter.name: kid on a scooter
kid on a scooter.visualDescription: A young boy, around eight years old, with messy dark hair and a bright yellow t-shirt, riding a small blue kick scooter. He wears scuffed sneakers and has a cheerful, energetic look as he zips around the park paths.
kid on a scooter.basicInfo: An energetic boy of about eight with messy dark hair, a bright yellow t-shirt, and scuffed sneakers, zipping around the park on a small blue kick scooter. He moves with the loose, joyful confidence of a kid who knows every path and shortcut in the park.
personality: protective of the park and its regulars
easily distracted by snacks and games
secretly a bit lonely when the park empties out
kid on a scooter.hiddenInfo: A neighborhood kid who lives in one of the Goshiki High-Rises and spends most afternoons scooting around Chiikawa Park. He once got lost in the park's back paths and a kind stranger helped him find his way home, which taught him to keep an eye on newcomers and make sure they don't get turned around. He cares deeply about the park and its regulars, and he's always eager to show off his scooter tricks to anyone who'll watch.

taiyaki vendor.name: taiyaki vendor
taiyaki vendor.visualDescription: A middle-aged Japanese man in his fifties with a weathered, friendly face, graying hair tucked under a plain cloth cap, and a white apron stained with batter and bean paste over a simple short-sleeved shirt. He works behind a small wheeled cart with a hot griddle, deftly flipping fish-shaped molds with a practiced hand.
taiyaki vendor.basicInfo: A middle-aged Japanese man in his fifties with a weathered, friendly face, graying hair tucked under a plain cloth cap, and a white apron stained with batter and bean paste over a simple short-sleeved shirt. He works behind a small wheeled cart with a hot griddle, deftly flipping fish-shaped molds with a practiced hand.
personality: a bit superstitious about his recipe
sentimental about the park's old days
stubbornly traditional about red bean over custard
taiyaki vendor.hiddenInfo: A longtime street vendor who has run his taiyaki cart in the park for over twenty years, learning the trade from his own father. He lost his wife to illness a few years back and now works the cart alone, finding quiet comfort in the rhythm of the griddle and the regulars who stop by. He takes genuine pride in his red bean recipe, which he guards jealously, and he quietly keeps an eye on the park's regulars, remembering faces and their usual orders.

old man on the third balcony.name: old man on the third balcony
old man on the third balcony.properName: old man on the third balcony
old man on the third balcony.visualDescription: An elderly Japanese man in his late seventies, with a lined, weathered face and short silver hair. He wears a loose beige cardigan over a plain collared shirt and sits on a balcony chair, watching the park below with a quiet, judging expression.
old man on the third balcony.basicInfo: An elderly Japanese man in his late seventies, with a lined, weathered face and short silver hair. He wears a loose beige cardigan over a plain collared shirt and sits on a balcony chair, watching the park below with a quiet, judging expression.
personality: secretly enjoys watching young people's happiness
sharp memory for faces and routines
old man on the third balcony.hiddenInfo: A retired building superintendent who spent forty years maintaining the Goshiki High-Rises, he knows every tenant, every pipe, and every quiet scandal in the complex. He lost his wife three years ago and now spends his evenings on the balcony, keeping watch over the park the way he once kept watch over the building. He cares deeply about the neighborhood's peace and is quick to judge anyone he thinks is disturbing it, though he secretly enjoys watching the young people of the park find happiness.

takoyaki vendor.name: takoyaki vendor
takoyaki vendor.visualDescription: A middle-aged Japanese man in his late forties with a weathered, friendly face, wearing a white apron over a dark shirt and a cloth headband. His hands are quick and calloused from years at the griddle, and a small towel hangs from his belt.
takoyaki vendor.basicInfo: A middle-aged Japanese man in his late forties with a weathered, friendly face, wearing a white apron over a dark shirt and a cloth headband. His hands are quick and calloused from years at the griddle, and a small towel hangs from his belt.

holds a gentle grudge against anyone who calls it 'just street food'
always saves the last boat for a regular he's expecting
takoyaki vendor.hiddenInfo: A street-food vendor in his late forties who has worked the same portable takoyaki cart for over twenty years, first as a helper for his uncle and now as the owner. He learned early that a steady griddle and a warm word keep regulars coming back, and he quietly prides himself on remembering faces and orders. He cares deeply about keeping his little corner of the park lively and welcoming, and he keeps a worn photo of his late wife tucked behind the batter tin.

suited observer.name: suited observer
suited observer.visualDescription: A lean, middle-aged Japanese man in a plain dark suit and muted tie, seated alone at a long table. His face is unremarkable and expressionless, with short neat black hair and a faint shadow of stubble, and his hands rest motionless beside an untouched cup of coffee while his eyes track the crowd without interest.
suited observer.basicInfo: A lean, middle-aged Japanese man in a plain dark suit and muted tie, seated alone at a long table. His face is unremarkable and expressionless, with short neat black hair and a faint shadow of stubble, and his hands rest motionless beside an untouched cup of coffee while his eyes track the crowd without interest.
personality: loyal to his paycheck over any person
suited observer.hiddenInfo: A quiet surveillance asset for the Kurokawa Underworld, he has spent years as an anonymous pair of eyes in government offices and licensing halls, paid to watch faces and report anything that shifts. A failed job years ago cost him a comfortable position and taught him that the safest observer is the one nobody remembers seeing. He cares deeply about keeping his own name off every record, because he knows that once a watcher is identified, he becomes the next target.
abilities: (utility) Crowd Sweep: Reads a room's faces and tells in seconds
(utility) Signal Relay: Passes quiet intel to nearby handlers mid-operation

enforcer 1.name: enforcer 1
enforcer 1.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered man in his late twenties with a close-cropped haircut and a flat, watchful expression. He wears a dark jacket over a plain shirt, standing near the doors with his hands loose at his sides, scanning every new face that enters.
enforcer 1.basicInfo: A broad-shouldered man in his late twenties with a close-cropped haircut and a flat, watchful expression. He wears a dark jacket over a plain shirt, standing near the doors with his hands loose at his sides, scanning every new face that enters.
personality: slow to anger but quick to block
enforcer 1.hiddenInfo: A former amateur boxer who washed out of the circuit on a bad loss and drifted into Kurokawa muscle for steady pay. He learned that loyalty is bought with money and fear, not respect, so he keeps his head down and his eyes open. He cares about keeping his younger brother out of the same life, and quietly sets aside a cut of every job to pay for his brother's schooling.
abilities: (attack) Shoulder Charge: Drives a heavy shoulder into an opponent to knock them off balance
(utility) Crowd Scan: Picks out threats and exits in a crowded room at a glance
(defense) Blocking Stance: Plants his frame to physically bar a doorway or path

Legitimacy captain.name: Legitimacy captain
Legitimacy captain.visualDescription: A middle-aged Japanese man in a sharply pressed dark suit with a crisp white shirt and polished shoes, his graying hair neatly combed back. He carries himself with easy, practiced charm, smiling warmly as he greets people by name, though his eyes hold a calculating, watchful edge. He wears no visible weapon, projecting an air of legitimate authority.
Legitimacy captain.basicInfo: A middle-aged Japanese man in a sharply pressed dark suit with a crisp white shirt and polished shoes, his graying hair neatly combed back. He carries himself with easy, practiced charm, smiling warmly as he greets people by name, though his eyes hold a calculating, watchful edge.
personality: secretly fears exposure more than violence
Legitimacy captain.hiddenInfo: A hardened Kurokawa crew leader who commands enforcers through presence and intimidation rather than overt violence. He rose through the ranks by learning that a calm smile and a well-placed signature move more money than a raised fist, and he trusts paperwork over muscle. He cares deeply about the legitimacy front he has built, because it is the only thing standing between his crew and the scrutiny of Ultra Force.
abilities: (attack) Enforcer Signal: A single wordless gesture that summons his lead enforcer to his side within seconds
(utility) Paper Shield: Uses forged documents and bureaucratic cover to deflect suspicion and buy time
(control) Room Ownership: His calm, practiced presence makes nearby witnesses hesitate to act against him

enforcer 4.name: enforcer 4
enforcer 4.visualDescription: A lean, broad-shouldered man in his late twenties with a clean-shaven face and short-cropped black hair. He wears a plain dark suit with a white shirt and no tie, blending into the licensing hall crowd while keeping his hands loose at his sides near the side windows.
enforcer 4.basicInfo: A lean, broad-shouldered man in his late twenties with a clean-shaven face and short-cropped black hair. He wears a plain dark suit with a white shirt and no tie, blending into the licensing hall crowd while keeping his hands loose at his sides near the side windows.

uncomfortable with violence but good at it
