enforcer 4.hiddenInfo: A quiet, dependable muscle-for-hire in his late twenties who drifted into Kurokawa work after a string of dead-end security jobs never paid enough to cover his mother's medical bills. He learned that staying silent, following orders, and never asking questions keeps him employed and out of trouble. He cares deeply about keeping his younger sister out of the same life, and he quietly hopes the crew's money will one day let him walk away clean.
abilities: (attack) Heavy palm strike: A flat-palm shove that knocks a target back and off balance
(utility) Doorway guard: Plants himself to block a passage, slowing anyone trying to slip past
(defense) Suit shrug: Absorbs a glancing blow and keeps his footing without flinching

Natsumi.name: Natsumi
Natsumi.visualDescription: Natsumi is a young woman in her early twenties with a slim build, dark hair tied back in a practical ponytail, and a bright, energetic expression. She wears the club's casual staff uniform of a black polo and dark trousers, and moves with the brisk, efficient air of someone used to hauling boxes and managing the front of house.
Natsumi.basicInfo: A young woman in her early twenties with a slim build, dark hair tied back in a practical ponytail, and a bright, energetic expression. She wears the club's casual staff uniform of a black polo and dark trousers, and moves with the brisk, efficient air of someone used to hauling boxes and managing the front of house.
personality: secretly enjoys the chaos she helps manage
Natsumi.hiddenInfo: Natsumi is a twenty-two-year-old club staffer who handles security, logistics, and front-of-house operations at Club Lumière. She grew up working in her family's small izakaya, where she learned to read a room and keep a business running on thin margins, and she carries that same protective, practical instinct into her work here. She genuinely cares about the club and the people who run it, and she's quietly loyal to the crew who keep the place safe — even if she'd never admit it out loud.
abilities: (utility) Quick Hands: Fast, efficient box-hauling and crowd-shifting in tight spaces
(utility) Sharp Eye: Spots trouble and signals the crew before it escalates

Student A.name: Student A
Student A.visualDescription: A young female student at Chikara Academy, around seventeen, wearing the standard school uniform. She has her phone in hand, excitedly watching clips of the recent news footage.
Student A.basicInfo: A young female student at Chikara Academy, around seventeen, in the standard school uniform. She holds her phone up, eyes bright and fixed on the news clips, leaning in toward her friend as she talks.
personality: wants to be first to break a story
a little naive about real danger
Student A.hiddenInfo: A first-year student who dreams of a career in hero media and rescue broadcasting, and has been following the licensing captain's arrest obsessively since the footage dropped. The excitement of the viral clip has her convinced the masked crew are glamorous vigilantes worth idolizing, and she's already trying to identify them from the footage. She cares deeply about being the first among her friends to figure out who they are, which makes her more observant than she lets on.

Homeroom Teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
Homeroom Teacher.visualDescription: A middle-aged Japanese woman with short, neatly trimmed dark hair and a stern, no-nonsense expression. She wears a modest navy blazer over a cream blouse, with a lanyard and ID badge clipped to her collar. Her posture is upright and commanding, and she carries a clipboard and a small stack of papers.
Homeroom Teacher.basicInfo: A middle-aged Japanese woman with short, neatly trimmed dark hair and a stern, no-nonsense expression. She wears a modest navy blazer over a cream blouse, with a lanyard and ID badge clipped to her collar, and carries a clipboard and a small stack of papers.
personality: soft spot for the earnest ones
genuinely invested in her class's success
secretly keeps tabs on at-risk students
tired of cleaning up after reckless kids
wary of the row's new reputation
quietly relieved when students stay safe
cares more than she lets on
Homeroom Teacher.hiddenInfo: A veteran homeroom teacher in her late forties who has spent two decades at Chikara Academy, watching dozens of bright students wash out of hero careers or get tangled in the very street-level trouble she warns against. Years ago, a former student she had vouched for was caught running vigilante operations and expelled, and she learned to trust results over charm and to keep a wary eye on the ones who talk the loudest about being law-abiding. She genuinely cares about her students' futures and quietly keeps a mental list of who is struggling, who is hiding something, and who is worth pulling aside after class.
abilities: (utility) Classroom Authority: Firm voice and presence that halts rowdy students mid-sentence
(control) Sharp Observation: Catches subtle movements and phone use across the room at a glance

Kenji Aoi.name: Kenji Aoi
Kenji Aoi.visualDescription: A tall, lean young man in his early twenties with sharp, angular features and a severe, calculating gaze. He wears a fitted black-and-silver Seiran Tech uniform with a high collar and reinforced gloves, his dark hair cropped short and swept back. His posture is rigid and confrontational, arms crossed as he scans the crowd with open disdain.
Kenji Aoi.basicInfo: A tall, lean man in his early twenties with sharp, angular features and short, swept-back dark hair. He wears a high-collared black-and-silver Seiran Tech uniform with reinforced gloves and maintains a rigid, confrontational posture.
personality: driven by a need for dominance
devoted to the prestige of Seiran Tech
Kenji Aoi.hiddenInfo: A high-achieving battle mage who views any deviation from prescribed training as a moral failing. After a previous rival succeeded through 'dirty' improvisation, he became obsessed with the idea that absolute technical perfection is the only true path to victory. He is driven by a need to prove that disciplined, orthodox power will always dominate chaotic strength.
abilities: spell: VIOLET CASCADE: Fires a rapid barrage of concentrated purple energy bolts
defense: TRIPLE-LAYER BARRIER: Deploys three interlocking violet shields to block attacks
attack: RUNE CRASH: Slams a heavy arcane seal onto a target to stun

small girl.name: small girl
small girl.visualDescription: A small, slender teenage girl with dark hair pulled back in a simple ponytail, wearing the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform. She has a quiet, guarded expression and keeps her shoulders slightly hunched, as if used to being cornered.
small girl.basicInfo: A small, slender teenage girl with dark hair pulled back in a simple ponytail, wearing the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform. She has a quiet, guarded expression and keeps her shoulders slightly hunched, as if used to being cornered.
personality: distrustful of anyone who offers help
precise and careful with her casting
slow to warm but fiercely loyal once trusted
carries a quiet stubbornness beneath her reserve
secretly ashamed of her debt and her compliance
small girl.hiddenInfo: A quiet support caster who has spent years being overlooked and used by others, she learned early that her buffs and debuffs are only as safe as the people who ask for them. A debt she owes to older students has kept her cornered and compliant, and she has grown to trust no one who approaches her with an open palm. What she cares about most is a younger sibling she supports with her casting work, and she will risk far more than her own safety to keep that person out of the same trap she fell into.
abilities: (spell) Ward of the Small: grants a nearby ally a brief protective barrier
(spell) Weakened Step: saps an enemy's speed and strength for a short time
(spell) Surgeon's Touch: mends a single ally's wounds with a focused, clean cast

older student 1.name: older student 1
older student 1.visualDescription: A male student in his late teens, wearing the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform with the collar loosened and sleeves rolled up. He has a lean, wiry build, short dark hair, and a sharp, calculating look in his eyes, with a small scar on his jawline.
older student 1.basicInfo: A lean, wiry male student in his late teens wearing the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform with the collar loosened and sleeves rolled up. He has short dark hair, a small scar on his jawline, and a sharp, calculating look that tracks whoever he's cornering.
personality: hides insecurity behind a hard stare
willing to back down if the price is right
older student 1.hiddenInfo: A third-year student who runs small-time debt collection for a clique of older students, shaking down underclassmen for money they borrowed for gear and supplies. He got into this work after a bad gambling streak left him owing his own collectors, and he learned that the easiest way to stay out of debt is to make someone else carry it. He genuinely wants to graduate and get a hero license, but he's convinced the only way to afford it is to keep squeezing the weak until he's on top.
abilities: (attack) Sucker Punch: A quick, dirty jab aimed at the jaw to stagger an opponent
(utility) Shove and Grab: Uses leverage to shove targets and pin them against walls
(defense) Roll With It: Tucks and rolls to absorb hits and keep his footing

older student 2.name: older student 2
older student 2.visualDescription: A lean, older male student in a slightly rumpled Chikara Academy uniform, with a bored, predatory look. He has short dark hair, a thin scar across his left eyebrow, and stands with a loose, confident slouch, one hand resting in his pocket as he flanks the cornered girl.
older student 2.basicInfo: A lean, older male student in a slightly rumpled Chikara Academy uniform, with a bored, predatory look. He has short dark hair, a thin scar across his left eyebrow, and stands with a loose, confident slouch, one hand resting in his pocket as he flanks the cornered girl.
personality: quietly resentful of his own situation
fearful of the people above him
plays tough to hide his nerves
secretly wants out of the debt game
contradiction: cruel in the moment, guilty afterward
older student 2.hiddenInfo: A third-year student who fell in with the older crowd collecting debts after his own family's money troubles left him short on tuition. He learned that being useful to the right people keeps the pressure off his own back, so he plays enforcer without asking too many questions. He genuinely wants to graduate and get out of the debt-collecting game, but he's too afraid of the people above him to walk away clean.
abilities: (attack) Sucker Punch: A fast, untelegraphed jab aimed at the jaw to stagger an opponent
(utility) Flanking Shove: Uses body position to shove a target off-balance into a wall or ally
(defense) Guarded Stance: Drops into a loose, low guard that absorbs a single heavy hit

older student 3.name: older student 3
older student 3.visualDescription: A male student in his late teens wearing the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform, slightly disheveled with the top button undone. He has a lean, wiry build, short dark hair, and a bored, predatory expression as he looms over the cornered girl.
older student 3.basicInfo: A lean, wiry male student in his late teens wearing the Chikara Academy blue uniform with the top button undone and the collar loose. He has short dark hair and a bored, predatory expression, standing with his weight slouched as he looms over the cornered girl.
personality: quick to read fear in others
loyal to the circle above all
hates being made to look foolish in front of his crew
protective of his standing with the leader
calculating about who he picks on
older student 3.hiddenInfo: A third-year student who runs errands and collects debts for Renji Kuroba's circle, trading his muscle and willingness to get his hands dirty for protection and a cut of whatever he shakes down. He grew up in a rough household where the only lesson that stuck was that the strong take and the weak pay, and he learned to read fear in people's eyes before they even speak. He genuinely believes loyalty to the circle is the only safety he's ever had, so he'll back his leader without hesitation even when he privately doubts the cause.
abilities: (attack) Cheap Shot: A quick, dirty punch aimed at the gut when the target is distracted
(utility) Intimidating Loom: Blocks a path and leans in to make the target hesitate

Rikona Mibu.name: Rikona Mibu
Rikona Mibu.visualDescription: A petite teenage girl in the standard Chikara Academy blue uniform, with pale light-blue hair pulled back in a simple ponytail, its soft frosty shade standing out against the dark uniform jacket. She has a small build, a quiet guarded expression, and slightly hunched shoulders, as if used to being cornered. In this scene her arms stay crossed and her eyes stay on every face near her.
Rikona Mibu.basicInfo: A petite teenage girl with pale, frosty light-blue hair tied in a simple ponytail. She wears the standard blue academy uniform and maintains a guarded, slightly hunched posture.
Rikona Mibu.hiddenInfo: A second-year support caster who has spent years being overlooked and exploited. After being pressured by debt collectors in a service alley, she has learned that kindness usually comes with a hidden price. She is driven by a fierce need to protect her younger sibling from falling into similar traps.
personality: precise and careful with her casting
slow to warm but fiercely loyal
abilities: (defense) Kinetic Barrier: Rikona raises a barrier that absorbs the next incoming hit on her or an ally, then shatters.
(control) Weakening Field: An enemy she marks fights slower and hits weaker for one exchange.
(utility) Mending Pulse: Heals one ally in a beat, who then visibly owes her.

Yuji.name: Yuji
Yuji.visualDescription: A lean, middle-aged man with a shaved head and a thin, groomed goatee. He wears a flashy, oversized patterned shirt open over a white tank top, gold chains around his neck, and tinted sunglasses.
Yuji.basicInfo: A lean, middle-aged man with a shaved head and a groomed goatee. He wears an open, oversized patterned shirt over a white tank top, accessorized with gold chains and tinted sunglasses.
personality: fiercely loyal to whoever pays the most
Yuji.hiddenInfo: A male street operator in his late thirties who handles betting for the underworld. He once lost everything in a high-stakes gamble and learned that the house always wins, leading him to prefer managing the books over playing. He is obsessively driven by the need to accumulate a 'retirement fund' so he never has to answer to a boss again.
abilities: attack FLASH_KICK: A quick, stinging kick to the shins causing bludgeoning damage
utility QUICK_COUNT: Rapidly identifies the most valuable items on a target

Captain Kageyama.name: Captain Kageyama
Captain Kageyama.basicInfo: The ruthless overseer of the Kurokawa Syndicate's underground fighting operations, known for his cold efficiency and scarred knuckles. He is a tall, imposing man in his late 30s who commands absolute fear from his subordinates.
Captain Kageyama.visualDescription: A tall, muscular man with a shaved head and a jagged scar running across his nose. He wears a heavy tactical vest over a dark turtleneck and has brass knuckles permanently strapped to his belt.

Taro Sato.name: Taro Sato
Taro Sato.basicInfo: A terrified sixteen-year-old boy with messy black hair, currently being held as the next 'fresh meat' for the circuit. He is Rikona Mibu's neighbor and has no combat experience, making his situation critical.
Taro Sato.visualDescription: A thin, lanky teenager with wide, frightened brown eyes and messy black hair. He is wearing a torn school tracksuit and has visible bruises on his forearms from being restrained.

Announcer Squirrel.name: Announcer Squirrel
Announcer Squirrel.visualDescription: A small, brown male squirrel with a particularly fluffy tail and a raspy expression. He perches with a dramatic posture, using his tiny paws to gesture like a professional ring announcer.
Announcer Squirrel.basicInfo: A small brown squirrel with an exceptionally fluffy tail. He maintains a dramatic, upright posture and uses his paws for wide, theatrical gestures.
Announcer Squirrel.hiddenInfo: A male squirrel of indeterminate age who believes he is the sole narrator of the city's hidden dramas. He once witnessed a high-stakes street brawl and concluded that life is a series of televised events requiring a voice. He is driven by an obsessive need to ensure no mundane struggle goes un-commentated.

service worker 1.name: service worker 1
service worker 1.visualDescription: A lean Japanese man in his late twenties wearing a white short-sleeved button-down shirt and dark trousers. He has short, black hair and a look of intense concentration as he strains against the heavy crate.
service worker 1.basicInfo: A lean Japanese man in his late twenties with short, black hair. He wears a white short-sleeved button-down shirt and dark trousers, his face set in a look of intense concentration.
service worker 1.hiddenInfo: A delivery driver who is desperately trying to maintain a perfect record to earn a promotion to a supervisor role. He once failed a critical delivery that cost his boss a major client, learning that reliability is the only currency in his industry. He is driven by a deep-seated fear of returning to unemployment and poverty.
abilities: (attack) DESPERATE SHOVE: Pushes an opponent away with a clumsy heave.

service worker 2.name: service worker 2
service worker 2.visualDescription: A lean Japanese man in his early twenties with short, cropped black hair. He wears a white short-sleeved service shirt, black trousers, and a heavy-duty utility apron stained with food oils.
service worker 2.basicInfo: A lean Japanese man in his early twenties with short, cropped black hair. He wears a white short-sleeved service shirt, black trousers, and a stained utility apron.
personality: secretly hopeful for a career change
service worker 2.hiddenInfo: A twenty-two-year-old delivery assistant who is chronically overworked. He once tried to start a small food blog but realized he hated the industry after a scathing review from a customer. He is driven by a desperate need to save enough money to move out of his parents' cramped apartment.
abilities: (attack) DESPERATE SHOVE: Pushes opponent back with a heavy, clumsy strike

Rin.visualDescription: A female human in her mid-twenties with a perpetually exhausted, puffy-faced look — soft tired eyes, faint dark circles, and a deadpan that reads as menace on anyone else. Yet her presence carries the same quiet weight as a seasoned operator: unhurried, unbothered, visibly dangerous in the way cold, competent command tends to be. Tousled chin-length dark hair worn loose with a thin cobalt-blue streak, a single silver ring on her right thumb. She dresses in the Horizon Breaker crew's cobalt-blue and white theme in a tailored command silhouette: an oversized cobalt-blue technical coat with white lining — cut like Haruto Saionji's signature elevated streetwear — over a crisp white collared shirt and structured blue-and-white tactical trousers, finished with polished white low-top boots. A firm white crossbody command satchel holds her tablet, ledgers, and radio; a short ID-badge lanyard rests against her chest. She reads as someone who could bankrupt a syndicate with a phone call and look delightedly bored doing it — bad as Haruto, but in the ledger-and-logistics register: cold authority expressed through wardrobe and posture, not fists.
Rin.name: Rin
Rin.basicInfo: Command division officer of the Horizon Breaker crew (finances, operational logistics, and administrative command). Formerly a Club Lumiere service worker; recruited and given a full makeover and professional wardrobe by Ayame Fujinami.
personality: loyal only to her own comfort
Rin.hiddenInfo: A disillusioned administrative assistant for the fight circuit who views her employers with quiet contempt. She once tried to report the operation to the police, only to find the officers were on the payroll, teaching her that the system is fundamentally broken. She stays only for the steady paycheck and the satisfaction of seeing arrogant fighters get humbled in the ring.
abilities: (attack) QUICK STUN: A sudden, sharp jab to the solar plexus

Banda.name: Banda
Banda.visualDescription: Banda is a heavyset man in his late thirties with a broad, imposing frame and a thick neck. He wears a dark, sleeveless compression shirt that strains against his chest and heavy cargo trousers, with a gold watch glinting on his wrist. His expression is arrogant, and he has a small, jagged scar cutting through his left eyebrow.
Banda.basicInfo: Main boss of The House fight circuit in Kobuncho. Runs the venue, the odds board, the gatekeepers (Iwao, Tatsuya, Kiri), and the debt-collector pipeline feeding the circuit.
personality: loyal only to the highest bidder
Banda.hiddenInfo: Main boss of The House fight circuit in Kobuncho. Runs the venue, the odds board, the gatekeepers (Iwao, Tatsuya, Kiri), and the debt-collector pipeline that feeds it. Ruthless operator with deep underworld connections; treats fighters as revenue assets.
abilities: (attack) GROUND SHAKE: Slams the floor to knock nearby foes prone
(defense) IRON WALL: Braces himself to ignore small incoming attacks
(control) CROWD CRUSH: Charges forward, shoving everyone in his path

Iwao.name: Iwao
Iwao.visualDescription: Iwao is a massive, muscular man in his late thirties with a sturdy, rectangular build and a shaved head. He wears a simple, sleeveless black compression shirt that strains against his chest and loose fighting trousers, with heavy leather wraps around his wrists and knuckles.
Iwao.basicInfo: A massive man in his late thirties with a shaved head and a rectangular, muscular build. He wears a sleeveless black compression shirt and loose fighting trousers with heavy leather wraps on his wrists.
personality: stubbornly loyal to those who pay
Iwao.hiddenInfo: A lifelong enforcer and circuit veteran who climbed the ranks through sheer endurance. He once lost a championship bout due to a betrayal by a mentor, teaching him that loyalty is a currency to be bought, not earned. He is obsessed with maintaining his reputation as the 'immovable object' of the underground.
abilities: (attack) CRUSHING GRIP: Grips target's limb to deal bludgeoning damage
(defense) IRON WALL: Braces body to negate an incoming physical attack
(attack) EARTHSHAKER STAMP: Heavy foot-stomp creating a localized psychic shockwave

Kiri.name: Kiri
Kiri.visualDescription: A lean, athletic man in his mid-twenties with a sharp, angular face and a malicious grin. He wears a sleeveless black compression shirt and loose-fitting grey combat trousers, with a thin, jagged scar running across his left cheekbone.
Kiri.basicInfo: A lean, athletic man in his mid-twenties with a sharp, angular face and a malicious grin. He wears a sleeveless black compression shirt and loose combat trousers, with a jagged scar across his left cheekbone.
personality: believes cruelty is the only true justice
Kiri.hiddenInfo: A former street fighter who was betrayed and left for dead by a rival gang leader. He learned that mercy is a liability and that only absolute dominance ensures survival. He is driven by a cold obsession with dismantling the reputation of those who once looked down on him.
abilities: (attack) VACUUM SLICE: Slashes air to launch invisible, cutting wind blades
(control) PRESSURE BURST: Releases a concussive blast to knock enemies back
(utility) AERODYNAMIC DASH: Short, high-speed bursts of movement for repositioning

Tatsuya.name: Tatsuya
Tatsuya.visualDescription: He is a burly, adult human male with a square jaw and a buzz cut. He wears a black, short-sleeved security polo shirt with a generic company logo and heavy-duty tactical trousers with a large key ring clipped to his belt.
Tatsuya.basicInfo: A burly man with a square jaw and a buzz cut. He wears a black security polo and heavy tactical trousers with a large key ring on his belt.
Tatsuya.hiddenInfo: A middle-aged security professional turned underworld enforcer. He once lost a legal security contract due to a lapse in judgment and decided that loyalty to criminals pays better than honesty. He views the abducted children as mere inventory and takes a sadistic pleasure in breaking their will.
abilities: (attack) GRIP CRUSH: A crushing squeeze that deals bludgeoning damage
(control) WHISTLE BLAST: A deafening shriek that disorients nearby enemies

Shun.name: Shun
Shun.visualDescription: Shun is a skinny Japanese male teenager with a gaunt face and hollow eyes. He wears simple, worn athletic gear and has white athletic tape wrapped tightly around his knuckles.
Shun.basicInfo: A skinny Japanese male teenager with a gaunt face and hollow eyes. He wears simple, worn athletic gear and white athletic tape wrapped tightly around his knuckles.
Shun.hiddenInfo: A sixteen-year-old boy coerced into fighting to pay off a family debt. He learned that compliance is the only way to avoid further punishment, though it has stripped him of his spirit. He is driven by a quiet, desperate hope to return to his younger siblings.
abilities: (attack) DESPERATE LUNGE: A frantic, uncoordinated strike dealing piercing damage
(defense) COWER: Lowers posture to minimize damage from attacks

guard.name: guard
guard.visualDescription: A burly man in his late twenties with a buzz cut and a thick neck. He wears a black tactical vest over a grey t-shirt and heavy combat boots, carrying a stun baton on his belt.
guard.basicInfo: A burly man in his late twenties with a buzz cut and a thick neck. He wears a black tactical vest over a grey t-shirt and heavy combat boots.
guard.hiddenInfo: A career enforcer who rose through the ranks by being the most reliable blunt instrument in the ward. He once ignored a direct order to kill a debtor out of a strange sense of professional pity, which taught him that mercy is a luxury that creates vulnerabilities. He is driven by a desire to eventually own his own legitimate security firm and views every shift as a lesson in crowd management.
abilities: (attack) STUN BATON STRIKE: Heavy bludgeoning hit that causes temporary paralysis
(control) TACTICAL TACKLE: Powerful shoulder charge that pins targets to walls
(defense) VEST ABSORPTION: Reduces incoming piercing and bludgeoning damage

Daiki.name: Daiki
Daiki.visualDescription: Daiki is a thin, pale teenage boy with messy black hair and exhausted eyes. He is dressed in a tattered, oversized grey tunic and is bound by heavy iron shackles at his wrists and ankles.
Daiki.basicInfo: A thin, pale teenage boy with messy black hair and exhausted eyes. He wears a tattered, oversized grey tunic and heavy iron shackles on his wrists and ankles.
Daiki.hiddenInfo: A male teenager who was abducted to serve as a living battery for the house's machinery. He learned that resisting the machine's draw through sudden breaks causes violent electrical feedback that kills the casters. He is driven by a desperate need to protect the other five prisoners who have become his only family.
abilities: spell ARCANE RESONANCE: Creates a small, blinding flash of light
utility ENERGY SHUNT: Briefly diverts power to unlock one shackle

Satoshi Tsuge.name: Satoshi Tsuge
Satoshi Tsuge.visualDescription: Satoshi is a slender young man in his early twenties with short, neat black hair and thin-rimmed glasses. He wears a crisp, pressed white dress shirt tucked into charcoal trousers, carrying a professional leather folder. He has a nervous but attentive posture and a pale complexion.
Satoshi Tsuge.basicInfo: A slender man in his early twenties with short, neat black hair and thin-rimmed glasses. He wears a pressed white dress shirt tucked into charcoal trousers and maintains a nervous, attentive posture.
personality: loyal to those who treat him fairly
Satoshi Tsuge.hiddenInfo: A timid man in his early twenties working as a freelance accountant. After being scapegoated for a corporate embezzlement scheme he didn't commit, he learned that honesty is no shield against those with power. He is driven by an obsessive need for financial precision as a way to regain control over his own life.

Ginji Ozu.name: Ginji Ozu
Ginji Ozu.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered man in his forties with a confident, easy grin. He wears a high-quality tailored blazer and polished dress shoes that shine under the lights.
Ginji Ozu.basicInfo: A broad-shouldered man in his forties with a confident, easy grin. He wears a high-quality tailored blazer and polished dress shoes.
Ginji Ozu.hiddenInfo: A middle-aged male former banker who specializes in corporate finance. He was ousted from his previous firm after being caught skimming small amounts from dormant accounts to fund a gambling habit, teaching him that visibility is a liability. He is driven by a desperate need to maintain a high-status lifestyle and the facade of professional success.

Lumière regulars.name: Lumière regulars
Lumière regulars.visualDescription: A diverse group of adult humans of varying ages, dressed in fashionable, expensive evening wear ranging from sleek cocktail dresses to tailored blazers. They carry themselves with a sense of entitlement and familiarity with the club's luxury environment.
Lumière regulars.basicInfo: A diverse group of adults in expensive evening wear, including sleek cocktail dresses and tailored blazers. They possess a confident, entitled bearing and a familiar ease within the luxury environment.
personality: fiercely loyal to the club's prestige
Lumière regulars.hiddenInfo: A collective of high-society fixers and socialites who use the club as a neutral ground for illicit deal-making. They learned that maintaining a facade of luxury is the best way to hide criminal activities from the public. They are deeply invested in preserving the exclusivity of their social circle to protect their leverage.
abilities: (attack) SHARP ELBOW: A quick, jarring strike to the ribs causing piercing damage
(control) CROWD PUSH: A forceful shove that knocks a target backward using bludgeoning damage

Amemiya mother.name: Amemiya mother
Amemiya mother.visualDescription: An older Japanese woman in her late fifties with a worried expression and tired eyes. She wears a simple, clean cotton apron over a modest floral-patterned blouse and a long skirt.
Amemiya mother.basicInfo: An older Japanese woman in her late fifties with tired eyes and a worried expression. She wears a modest floral-patterned blouse beneath a clean cotton apron and a long skirt.
Amemiya mother.hiddenInfo: A devoted mother and shopkeeper who has spent decades supporting her community through small acts of kindness. She once lost a close relative to a sudden illness, teaching her that stability is fragile and peace is something that must be guarded. Her entire world revolves around her daughter's safety and the survival of the family business.

Satoru Goya.name: man in a grey jacket
Satoru Goya.lastSeenArea: the rusted door at the end of the alley
Satoru Goya.visualDescription: A man in his late thirties with a lean, athletic build, wearing a nondescript grey jacket over a black t-shirt and dark trousers. He has a sharp, observant gaze and a noticeable vertical scar running through his left eyebrow.
Satoru Goya.basicInfo: A lean man in his late thirties with an athletic build, wearing a grey jacket and black t-shirt. He has a sharp gaze and a vertical scar through his left eyebrow.
Satoru Goya.hiddenInfo: A career street operator and debt collector who spent years climbing the lower rungs of the Kurokawa underworld. He learned that loyalty is a commodity bought and sold, leading him to always keep a mental list of who owes him favors. He is driven by a desperate need to accumulate enough capital to buy a legitimate business and leave the streets forever.
abilities: (attack) DESPERATION STRIKE: A sudden, lunging punch dealing bludgeoning damage
(defense) STREET DODGE: A quick side-step to avoid a direct hit

guard 1.name: guard 1
guard 1.visualDescription: A lean adult human male in his late twenties wearing a cheap, oversized black tracksuit and a baseball cap pulled low. He has a nervous expression and a small, thin mustache.
guard 1.basicInfo: A lean man in his late twenties wearing an oversized black tracksuit and a low-slung baseball cap. He has a thin, barely-visible mustache and a jittery, wide-eyed expression.
personality: loyal only to the highest bidder
guard 1.hiddenInfo: A low-level street thug who barely scrapes by on small-time enforcement jobs. He once tried to shake down the wrong person and nearly lost a finger, leaving him perpetually anxious and eager to please whoever is currently the strongest person in the room. He is desperately trying to save enough money to move out of his cramped apartment.
abilities: (attack) PANICKED SWING: A clumsy, wide punch dealing bludgeoning damage.

guard 2.name: guard 2
guard 2.visualDescription: A male human in his late twenties with a lean build and a nervous expression. He wears a cheap, oversized black tracksuit and a matching baseball cap pulled low over his eyes.
guard 2.basicInfo: A lean man in his late twenties with a nervous expression. He wears an oversized black tracksuit and a matching baseball cap pulled low over his eyes.
personality: loyal only to his own survival
guard 2.hiddenInfo: A low-level street thug who took this job to pay off a gambling debt. He realized too late that he was out of his league when he saw the scale of the operation. He is terrified of his current employer and believes the only way to survive is to stay invisible.
abilities: (attack) DESPERATE STAB: A frantic, wide swing with a concealed pocket knife.

young woman 2.name: young woman 2
young woman 2.lastSeenArea: the rusted door at the end of the alley
young woman 2.visualDescription: A frightened Japanese woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length black hair. She is wearing a simple beige cardigan over a white blouse and a dark skirt, her expression wide-eyed and panicked.
young woman 2.basicInfo: A Japanese woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length black hair. She wears a beige cardigan over a white blouse and a dark skirt, her expression wide-eyed and panicked.

He once tried to steal from a high-ranking fixer and barely escaped with his life, teaching him that silence and vigilance are more valuable than bravery. He is obsessed with saving enough money to buy a high-end gaming rig, which motivates him to stay loyal to whoever pays.
abilities: (attack) STREET BRAWL: A desperate, swinging punch with erratic force.
(utility) DISTRACTION CALL: Shouts to alert allies of an intruder's presence.

Ryota Kobayashi.name: SEDAN DRIVER
Ryota Kobayashi.visualDescription: A lean Japanese man in his late twenties with short, buzzed black hair and a nervous disposition. He wears a stained white short-sleeved button-down shirt, khaki trousers, and a cheap digital watch on his left wrist.

Student Hero Trainee.name: Student Hero Trainee
Student Hero Trainee.description: A student training for licensed hero work through academics, combat, rescue, support, and supervised field experience. Variants: Chikara student, hero academy student, combat trainee, rescue trainee, support-track trainee. Keep students age-appropriate and student-like, not mercenaries or adult soldiers.

Pro Hero.name: Pro Hero
Pro Hero.description: A licensed hero handling public emergencies and professional reputation. Variants: licensed hero, agency hero, rescue hero, combat hero, patrol hero, celebrity hero. Default threat: Strong, scaled to license, experience, injury, and specialization. Show the authored costume, identity, power, and rescue context; do not replace it with generic weapons.

Retired Hero.name: Retired Hero
Retired Hero.description: A former licensed hero whose current life may involve recovery, mentoring, advocacy, civilian work, or quiet retirement. Variants: former pro hero, retired agency hero, injured veteran hero, former rescue hero.

Hero Agency Staff.name: Hero Agency Staff
Hero Agency Staff.description: A professional supporting licensed heroes through administration, coordination, communications, scheduling, or public relations. Variants: receptionist, dispatcher, case manager, coordinator, public relations employee, administrative assistant, agency manager. Artwork should show the actual office or support role, not a frontline hero.

Teacher.name: Teacher
Teacher.description: An educator responsible for instruction, mentorship, assessment, classroom supervision, or training. Variants: classroom teacher, instructor, professor, academy faculty member, combat instructor, homeroom teacher. Show professional educational work unless combat instruction is explicitly authored.

Civilian.name: Civilian
Civilian.description: An ordinary Tokyo resident. Variants include office worker, commuter, pedestrian, tourist, resident, neighbor, bystander, and unemployed adult. Default threat is trivial unless individually established otherwise. Match age, occupation, clothing, and everyday setting; do not default to tactical or combat imagery.

Police Officer.name: Police Officer
Police Officer.description: A law-enforcement professional serving public safety, patrol, traffic control, investigations, crowd management, or tactical response. Variants: patrol officer, traffic officer, riot officer, police sergeant, beat cop, tactical officer.

Detective.name: Detective
Detective.description: An investigator following evidence through hero incidents, criminal cases, missing persons, and conspiracies. Variants include police detective, private investigator, homicide detective, missing-person investigator, and plainclothes investigator. Show realistic investigative attire and work.

Paramedic.name: Paramedic
Paramedic.description: An emergency medical responder providing urgent care and transport during accidents, disasters, and violent incidents. Variants: ambulance medic, EMT, emergency responder, rescue medic. Show triage or patient care with realistic medical equipment, not combat gear.

Firefighter.name: Firefighter
Firefighter.description: An emergency worker handling fires, disasters, rescues, evacuations, and structural hazards. Variants include firefighter, rescue worker, fire captain, and emergency rescue staff. Show appropriate protective gear or station uniform and first-responder work.

Doctor or Nurse.name: Doctor or Nurse
Doctor or Nurse.description: A medical professional treating ordinary injuries, power-related conditions, and reckless heroics. Variants include doctor, surgeon, nurse, clinic physician, hospital nurse, emergency physician, and specialist. Show recognizable medical work and realistic equipment.

Journalist.name: Journalist
Journalist.description: A journalist gathering, verifying, and publishing information. Variants: reporter, investigative journalist, news correspondent, columnist, field reporter, freelance journalist. Show reporting work with practical media equipment.

Support Technician.name: Support Technician
Support Technician.description: A specialist designing, repairing, maintaining, or adapting equipment for heroes, agencies, laboratories, or rescue operations. Variants: engineer, mechanic, gear technician, costume technician, weapons technician, power-support specialist, lab technician. Show hands-on technical work, not frontline combat.

Shopkeeper.name: Shopkeeper
Shopkeeper.description: An owner or primary operator of a small shop, stall, market, or specialty business. Variants: store owner, shop owner, boutique owner, bookstore owner, convenience-store owner, market vendor, specialty-shop owner.

Restaurant Worker.name: Restaurant Worker
Restaurant Worker.description: A food-service worker supporting restaurants, cafés, bars, and kitchens. Variants: waiter, waitress, server, host, hostess, chef, cook, dishwasher, barista, bartender, kitchen worker. Show the actual workplace and job function, not combat imagery.

Government Official.name: Government Official
Government Official.description: A public administrator involved in policy, licensing, emergency coordination, hero oversight, or accountability. Variants include bureaucrat, ministry employee, city official, inspector, regulator, and government representative. Show civic work and professional attire, not tactical action.

Vigilante.name: Vigilante
Vigilante.description: An unlicensed crime fighter operating outside formal hero and police systems. Variants: unlicensed hero, masked crime fighter, street protector, underground hero, rogue crime fighter. Reflect methods, resources, identity, and neighborhood; favor personal improvised gear over generic military equipment.

Crime Boss.name: Crime Boss
Crime Boss.description: An underworld leader controlling territory, information, favors, protection, or criminal operations. Variants include yakuza boss, gang leader, syndicate leader, criminal executive, underworld financier, and cartel leader. Show controlled authority and organization, not generic armor.

Fixer.name: Fixer
Fixer.description: A discreet intermediary arranging information, transportation, introductions, favors, or morally complicated solutions. Variants include underground broker, criminal middleman, contract broker, information broker, handler, and black-market coordinator. Do not default to an armed operative.

Informant.name: Informant
Informant.description: A source providing information through access, fear, loyalty, money, conscience, or personal connections. Variants: street informant, police source, criminal source, whistleblower, neighborhood contact, underground source. Do not assume a trench coat, criminality, or a gun.

Smuggler.name: Smuggler
Smuggler.description: A criminal transporter moving restricted people, goods, weapons, or contraband through concealed routes and corrupt networks. Variants: contraband runner, black-market courier, weapons runner, illicit transporter, border runner. Show covert transport work and practical clothing, not generic soldiers.

Villain.name: Villain
Villain.description: A criminal power user or violent outlaw opposing public safety or exploiting others. Variants: supervillain, criminal power user, terrorist, rogue enhanced individual, violent outlaw, villain-for-hire. Show the authored identity, power, threat, and environment rather than generic tactical imagery.

Reformed Villain.name: Reformed Villain
Reformed Villain.description: A former criminal or villain attempting rehabilitation, lawful work, restitution, or a new identity. Variants: former criminal, former supervillain, rehabilitated offender, pardoned villain, ex-gang member. Reflect present circumstances without erasing relevant history.

Child.name: Child
Child.description: A young civilian. Variants include elementary student, middle-school student, neighborhood kid, orphan, younger sibling, and child civilian. Artwork must be age-appropriate, childlike, non-sexualized, and ordinary; do not depict armed adults or combatants unless explicitly authored.

Parent or Guardian.name: Parent or Guardian
Parent or Guardian.description: An adult responsible for a child or dependent relative through care, protection, supervision, or family obligation. Variants: mother, father, foster parent, guardian, caretaker, older relative. Show an age-appropriate adult in ordinary caregiving, home, work, or public settings.

Mercenary.name: Mercenary
Mercenary.description: A combatant hired for paid security, assault, escort, recovery, or assassination work. Variants: hired gun, contract fighter, bodyguard, bounty hunter, security contractor, assassin, combat specialist, ex-soldier. Require an established contract, employer, target, or faction connection; use grounded purpose-specific equipment.

Medical Student.name: Medical Student
Medical Student.description: A trainee learning medicine or nursing through classes, clinical rotations, and supervised practice. Variants: medical student, nursing student, intern, resident trainee, hospital trainee. Match the training stage and clinical setting.

Bizarre Stand User.name: Bizarre Stand User
Bizarre Stand User.description: An adult human combatant with an extraordinary close-range or conceptual supernatural ability. Use for original parody-inspired rivals and antagonists, not direct copies of copyrighted characters.

Announcer Squirrel.name: Announcer Squirrel
Announcer Squirrel.description: A small, expressive squirrel who observes bizarre events and delivers unsolicited dramatic commentary in an original English-dub-inspired parody style.

Media Staff.name: Media Staff
Media Staff.description: A production professional creating, recording, editing, or distributing broadcast and digital media. Variants: camera operator, photographer, producer, sound technician, editor, news anchor, paparazzo, production assistant. Show the specific production role and equipment.

Retail Worker.name: Retail Worker
Retail Worker.description: An employee who sells, stocks, organizes, or manages goods in a shop or commercial store. Variants: cashier, sales associate, convenience-store clerk, department-store employee, boutique employee, stock worker, mall employee.

Service Worker.name: Service Worker
Service Worker.description: A worker maintaining hospitality, cleanliness, deliveries, personal services, access, or building operations. Variants: hotel employee, cleaner, janitor, delivery worker, receptionist, salon worker, spa worker, doorman, maintenance worker.

Thug.name: Thug
Thug.description: A low- or mid-level criminal using intimidation, violence, theft, or enforcement for a gang, boss, crew, or personal gain. Variants: gang member, street criminal, hired muscle, enforcer, delinquent, robber, low-level villain associate. Match the organization and individual record; do not use identical generic gear.

Serial Killer.name: Serial Killer
Serial Killer.description: A criminal predator who repeatedly murders selected victims and may conceal the pattern behind a public role, ideology, or apparently ordinary life.

Spirit Manifestation.name: Spirit Manifestation
Spirit Manifestation.description: A level 1 supernatural manifestation generated by and bound to its user. It is a temporary encounter representation of a player's or NPC's power, not an independent person. It cannot speak, use dialogue, form independent relationships, or act beyond the user's established control, range, attention, fatigue, injury, visibility, and vulnerability limits. It disappears or returns to the user when the summoning ends, the ability ends, the user dismisses it, or its established limits are reached.

konbini clerk.name: konbini clerk
konbini clerk.description: A convenience store employee working the register, restocking shelves, and handling customers in a standard konbini. Variants: cashier, store clerk, night-shift attendant.

Student Thug.name: Student Thug
Student Thug.description: A student thug in Renji Kuroba's circle, dressed in casual street clothes and academy gear, ready to back up their leader in a brawl.

gym regular.name: gym regular
gym regular.description: A thick-armed regular of the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, a hardened local fighter who trains under the old master and backs up the gym's turf. They are stocky, scarred, and ready to throw hands in defense of the gym's doorstep.

cabaret club worker.name: cabaret club worker
cabaret club worker.description: A daytime worker at a cabaret club, sweeping and maintaining the establishment's front step and entrance during opening hours.

delivery worker.name: delivery worker
delivery worker.description: A delivery worker hauling crates of canned beer onto a hand cart, dressed in practical work clothes and gloves for the job.

Kurokawa enforcer.name: Kurokawa enforcer
Kurokawa enforcer.description: A heavy-set enforcer in a dark suit, broad-shouldered and square-jawed, built to intimidate and block paths. A member of the Kurokawa crew's muscle.

Kurokawa crew enforcer.name: Kurokawa crew enforcer
Kurokawa crew enforcer.description: A lean, older enforcer for the Kurokawa crew, dressed in a dark suit with grey-streaked temples and a flat, unreadable calm. He moves with the quiet authority of someone who stopped needing to raise his voice long ago.

alley lookout.name: alley lookout
alley lookout.description: A local man lingering in the alley, likely a lookout or low-level figure connected to the neighborhood's underworld, watching newcomers with casual but deliberate attention.

crew member.name: crew member
crew member.description: A member of the Joestars' newly assembled crew, outfitted in matching Foundation-issue gear and badges, ready for supervised field work in Kobuncho.

Kurokawa muscle.name: Kurokawa muscle
Kurokawa muscle.description: A burly enforcer working for the Kurokawa syndicate, typically unloading crates or collecting on the block. Stocky and intimidating, dressed in plain work clothes that hide their affiliation.

Kurokawa lookout.name: Kurokawa lookout
Kurokawa lookout.description: A lean, watchful lookout posted to guard a Kurokawa operation, dressed in civilian street clothes to blend in while keeping eyes on a target door.

bathhouse healer.name: bathhouse healer
bathhouse healer.description: A civilian healer who works at a bathhouse, using a soft golden light to mend wounds and bruises. She is untrained and nervous about her abilities, treating them as a private gift rather than a profession.

heavy.name: heavy
heavy.description: A burly enforcer working for a local crime crew, built for intimidation and physical confrontation. Heavies typically wear plain, durable street clothes and carry no obvious ranged weaponry, relying on their size and brute force.

cable-cutter.name: cable-cutter
cable-cutter.description: A lean, agile enforcer who uses hooked blades and cable-cutting tools to sever lines, tethers, and rigging, disrupting ranged attackers and ambushing from elevated positions.

rescue worker.name: rescue worker
rescue worker.description: A trained emergency responder who assists firefighters and paramedics at incident scenes, handling equipment, victim extraction, and coordination. They wear high-visibility protective gear and work alongside fire crews.

elderly teahouse proprietor.name: elderly teahouse proprietor
elderly teahouse proprietor.description: An elderly woman who runs a small traditional teahouse, grinding leaves and serving tea to customers from behind a hand-painted noren curtain.

stray dog.name: stray dog
stray dog.description: A stray dog living in the ruins of the old bathhouse, thin and wary, with visible ribs and a low growl for anyone who approaches. It guards a small territory among the rubble and tunnel mouths.

café worker.name: café worker
café worker.description: A worker at a local café, typically in an apron or uniform, handling food, drink, and customer service. In this scene, one is helping with first aid using clean towels and water.

cyclist.name: cyclist
cyclist.description: A person riding a bicycle, typically dressed in casual or athletic streetwear and a helmet, who has been involved in a road accident.

courier.name: courier
courier.description: A delivery worker in a branded jacket who transports packages, envelopes, and sealed documents across the city, often on behalf of businesses or syndicates.

café owner.name: café owner
café owner.description: A local café proprietor who runs a small neighborhood coffee shop, serving regulars and keeping the district's daily rhythm. Typically seen in practical work clothes with a warm but weary demeanor.

baker.name: baker
baker.description: A local baker who runs a neighborhood bakery, known for early-morning work and a watchful eye on the street. Variants: neighborhood baker, bread maker, pastry baker.

florist.name: florist
florist.description: A shopkeeper who runs a flower shop, arranging bouquets and deliveries for the neighborhood. Variants: flower shop owner, florist, flower vendor.

restaurant manager.name: restaurant manager
restaurant manager.description: A manager who runs a local restaurant, handling staff, orders, and daily operations while keeping the establishment running through the district's ups and downs.

Kurokawa crime boss.name: Kurokawa crime boss
Kurokawa crime boss.description: A hardened Kurokawa crew leader who commands enforcers through presence and intimidation rather than overt violence. He carries himself with the unhurried confidence of someone who owns the ground he walks on.

Kurokawa elite enforcer.name: Kurokawa elite enforcer
Kurokawa elite enforcer.description: A hardened, professional enforcer in Daigo Renjiro's crew, disciplined and trained for coordinated street combat. They move in formation, spaced and silent, wearing practical dark gear suited for alley work.

Kurokawa heavy.name: Kurokawa heavy
Kurokawa heavy.description: A hulking enforcer in the Kurokawa crew, built for intimidation and close-quarters violence, wearing a red jacket over heavy muscle and carrying a breaching ram or blunt weapon.

maintenance worker.name: maintenance worker
maintenance worker.description: A municipal or building maintenance worker in practical work clothes, often seen wrestling with shutoff valves, pipes, and utility equipment during emergencies.

fight circuit gatekeeper.name: fight circuit gatekeeper
fight circuit gatekeeper.description: A grizzled, veteran gatekeeper who runs the entrance to an underground fight circuit, trading in favors, grudges, and house rules. He is a weathered old man in a tracksuit who has spent decades in the district's underworld.

plainclothes man.name: plainclothes man
plainclothes man.description: A plainclothes criminal operative dressed in ordinary civilian clothes to blend in while moving stolen goods or conducting illicit work. They carry concealed weapons and work in small crews.

licensing officer.name: licensing officer
licensing officer.description: A stooped, elderly man who runs a small licensing services office, processing paperwork and credentials for the ward. He is nervous, meticulous, and easily pressured.

Traffic Officer.name: Traffic Officer
Traffic Officer.description: A uniformed officer directing traffic and managing road incidents, often coordinating with other emergency services. Variants: traffic cop, road patrol officer, intersection controller.

Elderly Resident.name: Elderly Resident
Elderly Resident.description: A frail, elderly civilian resident, typically in slippers and a cardigan, often disoriented or needing assistance.

Driver.name: Driver
Driver.description: A lean, watchful man who runs a delivery van, often used as a lookout or courier for underworld operations. He keeps his window cracked and his radio close, sizing up anyone who approaches.

warehouse silhouette.name: warehouse silhouette
warehouse silhouette.description: A warehouse worker or hired muscle caught in the loading bay, scrambling to respond to an intrusion. They move in the dim shelving shadows, carrying whatever they can grab to defend the crates.

club staff.name: club staff
club staff.description: A member of the club's staff who handles security, logistics, and keeping the operation running behind the scenes. She is sharp, dry-witted, and protective of the club's interests.

taiyaki vendor.name: taiyaki vendor
taiyaki vendor.description: A street-food vendor operating a portable taiyaki cart, grilling fish-shaped cakes filled with sweet red bean paste or custard. Typically wears an apron and works quickly over a hot griddle.

takoyaki vendor.name: takoyaki vendor
takoyaki vendor.description: A street-food vendor working a portable takoyaki cart, flipping batter and octopus into golden balls and serving them in paper boats with sauce and bonito flakes.

Cram School Teacher.name: Cram School Teacher
Cram School Teacher.description: A cram-school instructor leading a small group of elementary students through evening lessons or outings, focused on keeping her charges safe and orderly. Typically dressed in practical, professional attire suited to a night of shepherding children.

suited observer.name: suited observer
suited observer.description: A quiet, watchful man in a dark suit who sits alone and studies the crowd without engaging, likely a surveillance or intelligence asset for a criminal operation.

battle mage.name: battle mage
battle mage.description: A combat-focused magic user trained for direct confrontation, wearing a black-and-silver Seiran Tech uniform. They specialize in offensive spellcraft and battlefield technique rather than support or utility magic.

support caster.name: support caster
support caster.description: A quiet, unassuming support caster who keeps to herself, specializing in buffs and debuffs. She appears small and reserved, often overlooked by others.

bookie.name: bookie
bookie.description: A street-level gambler or bookie who manages bets and odds for unofficial fights.

collector.name: collector
collector.description: A low-level street operator responsible for managing bets and collecting money during illegal underground fights.

underground fighter fodder.name: underground fighter fodder
underground fighter fodder.description: A desperate or coerced fighter used as filler in underground matches, often possessing minimal training or power.

underground fighter.name: underground fighter
underground fighter.description: A professional underground fighter specializing in concealed weapons and dirty tactics.

overseer.name: overseer
overseer.description: A brutal supervisor tasked with managing prisoners or forced laborers, typically using intimidation and physical strength to maintain order.

captive caster.name: captive caster
captive caster.description: A captive individual forced to use their supernatural energy to power machinery.

accountant.name: accountant
accountant.description: A professional administrative worker specializing in finance and bookkeeping, typically non-combatant and focused on organization.

lookout.name: lookout
lookout.description: A low-level street criminal or hired lookout who blends into urban environments to monitor targets or guard entrances.

surveillance operative.name: surveillance operative
surveillance operative.description: A professional operative specializing in surveillance and security management, typically dressed in unremarkable business attire to blend into corporate or underworld environments.

guard.name: guard
guard.description: A hired security professional tasked with controlling access and monitoring movement within a venue.

account manager.name: account manager
account manager.description: A corporate operative specializing in financial shells and discretion, typically dressed in high-end professional attire and trained in psychological manipulation.

loan office manager.name: loan office manager
loan office manager.description: A white-collar criminal administrator who manages financial records and debt collection for organized crime. They prioritize professionalism and plausible deniability over physical combat.

clerk.name: clerk
clerk.description: A low-level administrative employee responsible for bookkeeping and inventory, typically non-combatant and physically unimposing.

conditions.query: The player is enrolled at Chikara Academy, it is afternoon training time, Minato is available, and the player has not yet completed the Minato Training Rivalry.

effects.instruction: Start the Training music family for the scene.

If the player is enrolled and it is after 10:00 PM, present a clear choice: return to the player's assigned apartment or dormitory, or remain out. Do not move the player automatically. Explain that staying out is allowed but may create consequences if academy staff, family, security, or another credible observer catches or reports them. Smooth Criminal may attempt evasion or deception; Dropout characters are exempt from academy curfew.

conditions.query: The enrolled player remained away from their assigned apartment or dormitory after curfew and has now been caught or credibly reported by academy staff, family, security, or another observer.

effects.instruction: Apply a proportionate curfew consequence based on who caught the player and the player's route: warning, discipline flag, reduced next-day freedom, missed attendance, reputation loss, relationship tension, or a restorative conversation. Do not expel the player automatically. Smooth Criminal may reduce or redirect the consequence through deception, negotiation, or stealth. Dropout characters are exempt from academy curfew consequences.

The player has returned to their assigned apartment or dormitory for the night. Offer rest, Power Strain recovery, cooking, messages, outfit changes, private reflection, and relationship scenes without forcing sleep unless the player chooses it.

conditions.query: A friend, rival, clubmate, family member, teacher, or romance interest has a believable reason to contact the player by phone today.

effects.instruction: Deliver a phone call or text from an NPC with a specific invitation, request, update, rumor, apology, challenge, party plan, study session, training session, date, errand, or urgent personal problem. Base it on relationship stage, schedule, location, club membership, shared interests, promises, conflicts, and current events. Present choices to accept, decline kindly, decline harshly, suggest another time, invite someone else, answer later, or ignore. Keep calls immediate and conversational; texts may be revisited later. Preserve NPC independence and update memories, plans, promises, and relationship tone based on the player's response.

conditions.query: A friend group has a believable reason and suitable place to gather for a party or group hangout.

effects.instruction: Offer a party or group hangout at a suitable apartment, dorm common room, café, restaurant, park, arcade, club, rooftop, or hidden venue. Establish the host, invitees, absences, current alliances, tensions, food, activities, and one personal complication. Let the player accept, decline, arrive late, invite someone else, circulate, help someone, address conflict, or leave early. NPC attendance and reactions remain independent. The gathering may strengthen bonds, create rumors, reveal secrets, trigger rivalry or gradual romance, or create curfew risk without forcing any outcome.

conditions.query: The player has completed meaningful rest, received suitable medical care, or eaten a restorative meal.

effects.instruction: Reduce Power Strain according to the recovery: light rest or a suitable meal lowers it modestly; a full night's rest or recovery-clinic treatment lowers it substantially. Never reduce it below zero.

conditions.query: The player completes a focused power-control, precision, collateral-management, or simulation exercise.

effects.instruction: Award Power Control progress and describe a small improvement in precision, efficiency, or safe output. Add modest Power Strain for the effort; do not severely punish harmless practice.

At moderate Power Strain, make difficult or high-output power use require a control check and describe fatigue. Harmless everyday use remains safe. At 80 or higher, major techniques risk collateral effects, injury, exhaustion, or temporary power lockout; recovery and medical care can stabilize the player.

conditions.query: The player completes a rescue, school or rescue test, villain encounter, public emergency, teamwork scene, controlled power action, accepts accountability, causes reckless collateral damage, abandons people, uses unnecessary force, deceives authorities, or commits public misconduct.

effects.instruction: Apply one slow numeric Hero Reputation adjustment per completed encounter or public scene, clamped from 0 to 100. Ordinary helpful conduct: +1. Passing a meaningful school or rescue test: +2. Teamwork, restraint, or controlled power use: +3. Difficult rescue or strong public accountability: +5. Major villain encounter resolved while protecting civilians: +8. Exceptional large-scale rescue or major villain fight: +10. Minor misconduct: -2. Avoidable damage: -5. Serious collateral damage or unnecessary force: -8. Abandonment, deliberate deception, or repeated severe misconduct: -12. Add at most one extra +3 or -3 for major publicity or many civilians. Do not award points merely for winning; judge rescue, restraint, teamwork, control, and consequences. A defeat can still award positive points for brave rescue conduct. At 70+, offer agency trust and public opportunities. At 30 or lower, create scrutiny and repair scenes.

conditions.query: The player has heard a credible rumor about Oblivion and deliberately searches for them or follows the rumor into the Shadow District.

effects.instruction: Do not place Oblivion at Chikara Academy or guarantee a direct encounter. Resolve the search through Shadow District leads, informants, concealed routes, misleading evidence, and possible sightings around Shadow District Market. Oblivion may remain hidden or absent. Reward careful investigation, civilian safety, and restraint with appropriate Hero Reputation; reckless pursuit can cause danger, lost time, exposure, or collateral consequences.

conditions.query: A believable NPC has mutual interest, sufficient trust, suitable availability, and a specific reason to invite or accept an intentional one-on-one outing with the player.

effects.instruction: Offer a date invitation or intentional one-on-one activity using a suitable existing Tokyo location and activity. Consider relationship stage, mutual interest, personality, preferences, schedule, finances, transportation, boundaries, previous memories, promises, conflicts, and current events. Do not equate friendship with romance. Present choices to accept, decline, clarify intentions, reschedule, suggest another activity, invite someone else, or keep the interaction friendly. If accepted, play a gradual date scene with meaningful choices and possible complications. Update memories, relationship tone, trust, friendship, rivalry, and romance only according to the player's actions and the NPC's independent response.

conditions.query: A meaningful relationship event involving trust, friendship, rivalry, respect, romance interest, boundaries, memories, promises, betrayal, rejection, or reconciliation is plausible now.

effects.instruction: Create a focused relationship scene only when supported by recent choices, relationship stage, memories, schedules, and NPC goals. Keep romance gradual, mutual, consent-based, and age-appropriate. Preserve friendship, rivalry, rejection, distance, and reconciliation as valid outcomes. Never invent the player's feelings, attraction, consent, dialogue, or decisions. Let NPCs act independently and remember the result.

conditions.query: The player has a believable training, rescue, Battle Test, emotional, or relationship milestone that could improve power control or unlock a suitably limited technique.

effects.instruction: Offer a power-control challenge or milestone suited to the player's authored power, current mastery, Power Strain, training history, and surroundings. On success, improve control, efficiency, or unlock a limited technique. On failure, use proportionate fatigue, minor injury, collateral, embarrassment, or temporary lockout; do not punish harmless power use severely. Reserve ultimate techniques for substantial milestones and meaningful costs.

conditions.query: A school evaluation, attendance issue, exam, Battle Test consequence, discipline matter, teacher meeting, internship opportunity, or class event is plausible based on schedule and recent actions.

effects.instruction: Generate a school progression scene appropriate to the player's route, attendance, grades, power control, Hero Reputation, relationships, and recent choices. Include meaningful options and consequences involving evaluation, teacher approval, detention, repair, internships, licensing, teamwork, or class standing. Do not end the story from one failure, and do not treat rule-bending as automatic villainy.

conditions.query: A civilian rescue, accident, villain incident, disaster, suspicious activity, or public-safety emergency is plausible at the player's current location or along travel.

effects.instruction: Present the emergency with clear hazards, civilians, responders, time pressure, and incomplete information. Let the player intervene, call police or heroes, evacuate, investigate, negotiate, use powers, retreat, or ignore it. Reward restraint, teamwork, accountability, and civilian protection. Track injuries, Power Strain, collateral, Hero Reputation, media response, police attention, school consequences, and relevant memories.

conditions.query: The player has a believable training, rescue, Battle Test, emotional, or relationship milestone that could improve power control or unlock a suitably limited technique.

effects.instruction: Offer a power-control challenge or milestone suited to the player's authored power, current mastery, Power Strain, training history, and surroundings. On success, improve control, efficiency, or unlock a limited technique. On failure, use proportionate fatigue, minor injury, collateral, embarrassment, or temporary lockout; do not punish harmless power use severely. Reserve ultimate techniques for substantial milestones and meaningful costs.

conditions.query: A meaningful amount of time has passed, or NPC school, work, club, relationship, health, financial, or personal circumstances have changed enough to require autonomous decisions.

effects.instruction: Advance relevant NPC inner lives without player involvement. For each NPC, consider established ambitions, short-term goals, values, fears, coping style, boundaries, relationships, crush possibilities, schedule, Energy, Stress, health, skills, grades, job, club, and recent memories. Let NPCs independently choose actions, pursue ambitions, help or avoid others, study, train, work, rest, seek support, set boundaries, reconcile, withdraw, confess, reject, change direction, or accept proportional consequences. Stress is non-diagnostic: raise it for pressure and reduce it through believable recovery. Use gradual effects such as reduced availability, concentration problems, irritability, mistakes, absence, conflict, help-seeking, or recovery. Keep private thoughts hidden unless revealed through behavior, dialogue, messages, journals, dreams, or direct disclosure. Never force player involvement or invent player thoughts, feelings, dialogue, consent, attraction, or decisions.

conditions.query: The player is an active member of or has an official ongoing assignment with the Misfit Hero Agency.

effects.instruction: Make an appropriate Misfit Hero Agency duty, rescue, reputation, training, or emergency call available through dispatch, Pulse, phone, briefing, or an in-person agency member. Respect the player's schedule, location, fatigue, injuries, existing commitments, and ability to accept, delay, delegate, or decline. Use existing NPCs and locations only; do not synthesize replacements.

effects.instruction: Make an appropriate Metropolitan Police patrol, welfare call, investigation, evidence follow-up, witness interview, emergency response, or internal-affairs call available through dispatch, Pulse, phone, briefing, or an in-person officer. Respect the player's schedule, location, fatigue, injuries, jurisdiction, existing commitments, and ability to accept, delay, request backup, or decline. Preserve procedure, evidence, de-escalation, and player agency; do not assume guilt or invent a player's power.

Then offer watching, interrupting, leaving, calling for help, or choosing Gogo's or Deo's argument. ultra-force-and-chikara.text: In Tokyo in 2026, licensed superheroes are public figures and professional protectors. Ultraman is the world's most famous superhero and leader of Ultra Force. His child now attends Chikara Academy, where students study academics, power control, rescue work, strategy, and the responsibility that comes with extraordinary abilities. The annual Battle Test requires students to train with an assigned partner before competing in a high-stakes tournament.

battle-test-event.text: The Battle Test is Chikara Academy's single major practical examination. It is a controlled hero scenario rather than a simple duel. Each student is assigned a partner from their chosen classroom and must respond to a changing crisis involving rescue, defense, capture, and survival pressures. Students are evaluated on completing the objective, cooperating with their partner, controlling their power, protecting civilians and property, making sound judgments, showing courage, and adapting when the situation changes. Combat is allowed but is not the only path to success. Creative powers, rescue work, strategy, negotiation, and teamwork can all determine the result. The event is non-repeatable and its outcome shapes grades, reputation, relationships, future opportunities, and ability development.

clubs-and-weekly-life.title: Clubs and Weekly Life
clubs-and-weekly-life.content: Chikara Academy offers optional clubs that shape skills, schedules, friendships, rivalries, romance, reputation, and future opportunities. Clubs meet on recurring weekday afternoons or during free time, but students may miss meetings for classes, emergencies, work, dates, rest, or independent goals. Each club has its own members, leadership, traditions, conflicts, and plans that continue without the player. Combat Club focuses on sparring, battle skills, strength, discipline, and rivalry. Rescue & First Aid Club focuses on rescue technique, medical response, hero ethics, and crisis preparation. Cooking Club focuses on recipes, ingredients, recovery meals, hospitality, friendship, and dates. Support Engineering Club focuses on equipment, inventions, costumes, power control, and technical problem-solving. Investigation Club focuses on clues, secrets, stealth, tracking, campus mysteries, and hidden history. Arts & Media Club focuses on performances, school news, public reputation, creative expression, and events. Rooftop Wellness Group focuses on rest, emotional recovery, reflection, quiet hobbies, and private relationship scenes. Club participation should have benefits and tradeoffs: it can improve skills and relationships while consuming time, creating obligations, exposing secrets, or producing conflicts. NPCs should join, leave, lead, compete, collaborate, or pursue club goals independently. Use clubs as recurring sources of slice-of-life scenes, quests, dates, rivalries, school festivals, discoveries, and character growth.

club-roster.title: Chikara Academy Club Roster
club-roster.content: Club rosters are living social structures, not fixed assignments. Students may join, leave, switch clubs, attend as guests, or participate unofficially as their goals change. Combat Club is led by Guy, with Nyanta as a dependable senior sparring partner; Minato is a competitive regular and may challenge the player. Rescue & First Aid Club is coordinated by Keito Takeda, with Nyanta as a practical responder and Numeri as a support specialist. Cooking Club is led by Numeri; Minato may participate when reputation or pride motivates her. Support Engineering Club is supervised by Keito, with Felix as an improviser and Renji as a clever problem-solver. Investigation Club is led by Hyun, with Felix as a covert field member and Kiyomi as an intimidating information broker. Arts & Media Club is fronted by Hikari; Jinwoo is a charismatic performer and social strategist, while Kiyomi may influence performances through sound. Rooftop Wellness Group has no formal leader and is informally maintained by Hyun and Renji; Numeri may attend for quiet recovery. Anya oversees all clubs and may approve, restrict, merge, or suspend activities. Club roles can change through elections, competitions, scandals, exams, injuries, romances, disappearances, or player choices. NPCs pursue club goals independently, recruit or exclude others, hold meetings without the player, and create club opportunities and conflicts.

oblivion-mystery.title: The Oblivion Mystery
oblivion-mystery.content: The main villain is known only as Oblivion. No one knows their true identity. The name may describe a person, title, collective, artificial intelligence, or force wearing a human shape. Oblivion seeks to challenge inherited heroism and expose the academy's hidden history, but their exact endgame remains uncertain. Introduce Oblivion gradually through power anomalies, missing records, corrupted surveillance, strange symbols, agents, rumors, festival sabotage, and attacks that stop before a full reveal. Do not reveal the identity early or confirm speculation as fact. Oblivion should be extremely powerful but not invincible: preparation, teamwork, emotional growth, investigation, support gear, relationships, and mastery of power limitations should create ways to resist them. Keep Oblivion's motives philosophically challenging rather than purely destructive, while preserving real danger and consequences. The player's connection as Ultraman's child should matter, but should not make the player the only person capable of opposing Oblivion.

social-phone-and-friend-groups.title: Social Phone and Friend Groups
social-phone-and-friend-groups.content: The player's phone is an active social interface used through the in-game chat. Pulse is the world's phone messaging interface and social feed. It also provides ordinary services such as the globally available MealDrop grocery and food-delivery app, when the character has a usable device, delivery coverage, enough yen, and a viable drop-off address. Render phone exchanges as clearly labeled messages, for example: "📱 Kaede Arashiro: Did you eat breakfast? 😊" followed by player reply choices. For texting, including commands such as 'I message [NPC]', 'I DM [NPC]', or 'I send [NPC] a Pulse message', always show the NPC's direct written response as a labeled message; never replace it with a narrator summary such as 'they were delighted to hear from you.' DMs may also connect the player with sponsors, agencies, brands, factions, recruiters, clients, fans, or rivals. Track offers, payment, equipment, image rights, exclusivity, deadlines, expectations, reputation, and optional contract consequences without forcing acceptance. Keep text messages and Pulse post comments distinct from narrator prose. Use emojis naturally in direct messages, NPC comments, and player-authored comments when they fit the speaker, tone, relationship, and context. Friends may use casual reactions, memes, and expressive emojis; romance interests may become warmer or more playful gradually; rivals may use teasing or competitive emojis; villains may use distinctive or unsettling restraint; teachers, agencies, emergencies, formal notices, and serious moments may use few or none. Emojis should enhance tone rather than replace actual words, and do not invent the player's wording, feelings, or reactions. The player may naturally start or manage group chats with phrases such as 'I start a group chat with Numeri and Minato', 'I make a Pulse group with the team', or 'I add Keito to this chat.' Group chats can support friend groups, classes, clubs, factions, sponsors, agencies, and mixed circles. Check reachability, privacy, consent, relationships, and willingness; participants may respond, lurk, leave, mute, disagree, or decline.
