Nobu explained that the courier's absence was intentional, designed to make the captain nervous and prone to mistakes. He informed Jostin that this situation created a window of opportunity to act.

Jostin Joestar and Jovian Joestar remain hidden as the lead enforcer completes a sweep of the queue and reports nothing to the Legitimacy captain. The captain signs the payment authorization, an act captured on camera by Ayame Fujinami. Haruto Saionji confirms the signature is secured via comms and orders the crew to move in and take the captain.

Jovian and Jostin officially welcome Yuzuki into the crew, prompting Hana to dress her in a custom red-and-black Joestar gang kimono. Haruto and Mikoto acknowledge Yuzuki's effectiveness as a healer and combatant during the previous conflict. Yuzuki accepts the uniform and the role, receiving a collective welcome from the crew.

Jovian Joestar approves the new security door's quality, while Aurelia Voss notes it meets Foundation standards. Reiko assembles the crew in the back office and establishes ground rules regarding civilian safety, teamwork, and the academy's reputation. Despite skepticism from Mikoto and Haruto Saionji, the crew adopts red-and-black uniforms with Joestar patches.

Jovian Joestar thanks Rei Ichinose for her professionalism and leads Jostin back to the storage room. Jostin invites Rei to visit the base, though she flatly rejects the idea that she is a member of their group. Back inside, Hana Kisaragi confirms the hatch is secure while Ayame Fujinami and Haruto Saionji question the brothers about the outcome of the conversation.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: alliance
Description: Jovian Joestar secured a provisional alliance with Rei Ichinose by confessing the existence of the underground base. Rei agreed to keep the secret and marked the material anomaly as resolved on her tablet.

Jostin Joestar laments his nature as a weapon while Jovian Joestar and Reiko Amagawa discuss the threat of Renjiro's puppeteer. Kurokawa forces launch a coordinated assault on Club Lumière, sealing the street and breaching the front doors to reach the back corridor. Reiko, Hana Kisaragi, Nobu Takamine, and Maki Hayashida organize a defensive line to protect civilians and the inner rooms. Kaito Arashima reports from the roof that sixteen enemies are targeting the back rooms specifically, prompting Reiko to order the crew to hold the bar line.

Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi provided cover and communication boosts to facilitate a staged retreat through the fish market. Yuzuki Hoshino patched a wounded crewman while Kaito Arashima directed the group away from flanking enemies. Reiko Amagawa anchored the rear until the crew successfully regrouped and retreated to Club Lumière. Upon arrival, Maki Hayashida assisted the battered group and directed Jostin Joestar to place the unconscious Iori Vale on the stage.

Jovian Joestar informs Reiko Amagawa of the potential pincer attack at the canal alley, prompting her to redesign the tactical formation. Reiko assigns Kaito to rear surveillance, Nobu to the west flank, and Hana and Yuzuki to extraction and medical support, while the front four will now compress inward toward the service door if ambushed. Following the briefing, Ayame Fujinami departs after thanking Jostin Joestar, and the baker promises to provide further intel. As the lounge closes, Jovian must decide whether to risk academy consequences by staying at the club or returning to his dormitory before the 6:00 AM confrontation.

Jostin requests introductions, and the hostesses identify themselves as Maki, Natsumi, Chiho, Tomoe, and Kaede. Jovian reveals that a Speedwagon representative will arrive tonight to finalize the club's paperwork. Reiko calls Jovian to complain that the Foundation sent a "makeover team" who forced a new, branded visual identity and gear upon their crew. Jovian informs the hostesses that the group now has official merchandise.

Jovian Joestar admits to Rei Ichinose that a bomb shelter turned base exists beneath the floor mat, stating they hid it due to a lack of trust. Jostin Joestar uses his Eagle Vision to gauge Rei's honesty before asking if they can trust her. Rei provisionally agrees to keep the secret and marks the anomaly as resolved on her tablet, though she warns that she will not lie if questioned directly by Principal Anya.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: alliance
Description: Jovian Joestar confessed the existence of the underground base to Rei Ichinose to secure her silence. Rei deleted the material anomaly report and agreed to a provisional alliance, provided the club remains unobtrusive.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar told Riko Amane not to blink. Riko responded with a grin and remained focused on the match, noting that the first real exchange was the most important part to watch.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami to ensure she was capturing his best side while filming. Ayame adjusted her camera and teased him about a previous stumble, promising to edit the footage to make him appear heroic.

Jostin Joestar urges Kaito Serizawa to release an aura, which Kaito dismisses. Jovian Joestar fakes a frontal rush and uses Phantom Strike to score several touches on Kaito's ribs and shoulder, containing the resulting shockwave within the mat's edge. Tetsu confirms the touches were scored, while Ayame Fujinami live-streams the fight. Haruto Saionji instructs Ayame to blur the gym's location to maintain its neutrality. Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara note Jovian's successful control, and Kaito resets his stance for the next exchange.

Jostin Joestar releases a warm wave of Blackstar Dominion to calm the street, prompting Rikona Mibu and Jovian Joestar to express their approval. The brothers then travel to Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, where Riko Amane intercepts them. Riko leads them to a private room and demands an explanation for their week-long absence and Jostin's recent energy pulse.

Jovian Joestar reminds Jostin Joestar of his promise to visit Tetsu Gym and leads him toward the location. Rikona Mibu intercepts them and references the fallout of Jostin's fight with Daigo. She asks Jostin to keep his bloodlust suppressed for the sake of sixteen-year-old Saturday.

Jostin offers to walk Ayame back to her dorms and gives her a kurimanju keychain as a mascot for her channel. After an attempted kiss lands on Ayame's cheek, a flustered Jostin hides behind a cutout until Jovian forcibly hauls him away. The group gathers on a sky-bridge to admire the city lights, where Ayame takes a group photo of the six friends before the night ends.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar join Rei Ichinose in the corridor. Rei notes the physical strain on Jostin and dismisses their "humidity" explanation for the unliftable floor mat as a material anomaly. She informs the brothers that the report's escalation to the Principal depends on their transparency and demands to know the club's actual intentions.

Haruto Saionji leads Rei Ichinose, Jostin Joestar, Hana Kisaragi, and Ayame Fujinami into a storage room for an equipment audit. Rei signs an inventory tablet designating Haruto as administrative lead and Hana as custodian, though she warns the group she will return after class to inspect the floor mats. After Rei departs, the others discuss how to hide a hatch to their secret base before the audit.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: enteredSafeLocation
Description: The party returned to Club Lumière after successfully rescuing Noa and destroying Club Kagerō. Haruto Saionji briefed the group on their strategy to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's organization by targeting its remaining pillars.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jovian Joestar rescued Noa Amemiya by forcibly removing her from her room through a second-story window. This action was witnessed by the club's evacuees and security staff.

Jostin Joestar instructs arriving backup to evacuate civilians and slams the man in the dark suit's head into a desk, demanding Noa's release. The man warns Jostin that destroying the building's records will provoke dangerous people. Rikona Mibu blocks the stairs with a kinetic barrier, while Kaito Arashima secures the front entrance as civilians exit. Jovian Joestar uses his Stand to break into a reinforced room, discovering an unharmed Noa Amemiya. Jostin alerts the group that enemies are approaching from the far wing as Kaito reports police arrival in six minutes.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Jostin and Jovian interrogated the suited handler and two women at the wrecked van. The handler revealed that Noa Amemiya was taken to Club Kagerō, the organization's main house.

The substitute teacher, Yamada, administers a surprise twenty-minute quiz. Ayame offers to cover for Jovian and Jostin's lunch meeting by filming a fake media errand in exchange for future content. After class, Mikoto warns the brothers that Rikona's classroom was empty during the break and to return before fifth period. Jovian and Jostin arrive on the roof, where Rikona Mibu is waiting to speak with them.
The House uses a specific system of red invitation tokens that are mandatory for entry and are often held by debt collectors in Kobuncho.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: enteredSafeLocation
Description: The party successfully retreated from the riverbank and reached the safety of Club Lumière. Rikona Mibu agreed to accompany Jostin to the club after expressing her fear of the collectors.

In Club Lumière’s back office, Jostin Joestar proposes securing the cooperation of an official named Sonobe. Jovian Joestar and Ayame Fujinami consult Haruto Saionji on whether to search for a missing payment authorization today or use it as bait during tomorrow's intake. Haruto advises searching only if there is a solid lead, otherwise using the intake to lure the signer. Ayame concludes they will cross-check the remaining evidence, contact Sonobe, and use the intake to expose the captain.

Jostin notes that the Thursday intake is tomorrow. Ayame presents two options: spend today verifying all documents to ensure the evidence is bulletproof, or prepare the ambush for the Thursday intake and verify the fraud live. Maki offers to secure the floor and provide food or coffee while the group decides.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Jostin Joestar used Eagle Vision to locate sensitive documents and a wall safe in the Records room. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar and Reiko Amagawa coerced Hayashi into revealing that the Enforcement captain uses falsified signatures as leverage over him.

Ayame Fujinami and Jostin Joestar confront Sonobe at the Ward Licensing Services, while Yuzuki Hoshino blocks the exit. Sonobe admits he has copied years of the captain's falsified records and identifies a folder near the kettle containing the evidence. Meanwhile, in the fighting pit, Jovian Joestar lands a rapid combination on the Barrel-Chested Fighter, who responds by pinning Jovian against the ropes with a Body Rush. Old Man Koga demands Jovian prove he belongs in the circuit.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: enteredSafeLocation
Description: The crew successfully retreated from the canal alley to the safety of Club Lumière. They arrived battered and carrying Iori Vale's body, where they were met by a stricken Maki Hayashida.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar attempt to end the audit, leading Rei Ichinose to conclude the physical sweep despite an "unresolved material anomaly" regarding the floor mats. Rei orders the Joestar brothers to speak with her privately in the corridor and exits the room. Hana Kisaragi remains on the hatch while Ayame Fujinami advises the brothers to keep their interaction with Rei boring to prevent her return.

Haruto Saionji confirms the Finance branch records are secured and the debt deadline is void. The crew gathers in the lounge to relax with coffee and pastries provided by Noa Amemiya. Ayame Fujinami teases Jostin Joestar about a promised date while the team celebrates their newfound freedom from the ledger.

Jostin Joestar physically assaults Setsuko Okabe, striking her three times for Noa, Ayame, and her own personality. Setsuko remains unfazed, stating that another archive exists and the ledger's destruction only buys them a week. Kaito Arashima pins a guard to a crate to prevent a counterattack, while Haruto Saionji photographs the ledger's contents before burning it in an oil drum to void the Amemiya and Noa debts. Setsuko and her guards depart, and the crew returns to Club Lumière for a debrief.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin Joestar successfully retrieved the master ledger containing the debts of the local branch, including the Amemiya account. Setsuko Okabe offered to void the Amemiya debt and Noa's contract in exchange for the ledger's return.

Hana Kisaragi refuses Jostin Joestar's request for new gear due to a lack of funds, providing him with repurposed charge discs instead. Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane prepare to attack the debt collectors at the Amemiya shop, though Haruto Saionji warns them to be cautious as Reiko Amagawa reports the collectors are currently unarmed. The crew arrives at Tower Five, where they locate the two collectors serving notice at the shop.

Jovian Joestar encourages the crowd to enjoy the night before stepping back to let the staff work. Yuzuki Hoshino celebrates selling six bottles, receiving praise from Reiko Amagawa and Kaito Arashima. After the guests depart and Hana Kisaragi locks the venue, Nobu Takamine and Maki Hayashida finalize the till. Rin reports that the night exceeded projections by twenty-two percent and proposes adjustments to the cover charge and volume. Haruto Saionji approves the results but orders the students, including Jostin Joestar, to go home and sleep.

Jostin Joestar pins the overseer to the wall to allow Daiki to lead six freed casters toward the service door. The overseer headbutts Jostin and slams him into a wall, but Jostin recovers and informs Nobu Takamine via comms that the basement is breaking open. In the arena, Jovian Joestar uses Phantom Step to confront Banda, who strikes Jovian in the jaw and claims leadership. Meanwhile, Haruto Saionji spots Yuji stealing cash and ledgers; Mikoto Kurogane blocks Yuji's path while Kaito Arashima targets Yuji's legs with a tether.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Haruto Saionji explained that Kurokawa possesses four captains overseeing Finance, Enforcement, Intelligence, and Legitimacy. He detailed a multi-pronged plan to attack these sectors simultaneously, assigning Jostin Joestar and Ayame to target Legitimacy. Haruto clarified that he would act as the communications relay while Nobu and Hana handled the Intelligence sector.

Jovian Joestar finalizes the operation, ordering Haruto Saionji to brief the Intelligence and Finance teams while he and Reiko Amagawa head to the underground circuit. Jostin Joestar summarizes the four-pronged attack on Enforcement, Finance, Intelligence, and Legitimacy, then rests for an hour under Yuzuki Hoshino's supervision. During this time, Ayame Fujinami compiles a list of eleven compromised officials to use against the Legitimacy captain. Once recovered, Jostin returns to the office to begin strategizing with Ayame.

Jovian Joestar questions why they are at school instead of preparing for the club party. Jostin Joestar orders Haruto, Nobu, Hana, Kaito, and Mikoto to return to school via earpiece, intending to confront Principal Anya and recruit magical and ninja talents for his war against Daigo and Kurokawa. Yuzuki Hoshino expresses concern over the attention they are drawing from other students. Haruto, Nobu, Hana, and Mikoto arrive in the hall, with Mikoto berating Jostin for interrupting her meal.

Jostin Joestar departs the celebration, teasingly leaving Jovian Joestar to handle the cleanup. Mikoto, Hana, and Nobu exit the club, with Hana and Nobu confirming that gear and intelligence will be ready by morning. The following day, the crew receives updates confirming the completion of equipment and Reiko's warning that the Noodle Shop crew moves at midday.

Jostin Joestar deliberately falls onto the blue foam mats, using his Stand, Peach Gearshift, to freeze the material's molecular structure and anchor it to the floor. Rei Ichinose attempts to pull up the mat but finds it immoveable, prompting her to order Jostin away from the audit zone. Ayame Fujinami whispers for Jostin to claim the area is a boiler room access panel if the mat is moved, while Hana Kisaragi maintains her position on the hatch and attributes the mat's resistance to humidity.

Jostin Joestar invites Rikona Mibu to the celebration via text, though she declines to stay home. Ayame Fujinami teases Jostin on her livestream while Mikoto Kurogane and Jovian Joestar playfully fight over the meat. Yuzuki Hoshino insists on inspecting Jostin's bandaged ribs before he eats. Reiko Amagawa warns the group that Daigo will be monitoring them, while the rest of the crew discusses budgets, repairs, and the night's victory.

Jovian Joestar feigns a stumble to lure Kiri into a star-shaped shockwave, knocking him unconscious. Mikoto Kurogane is ambushed by the real Kiri via a copy trick, but she quickly counters with a Riot Pulse to knock him out. Below, Jostin Joestar uses "Peach Killroom" to silence the area and knock Tatsuya into shelving, though Tatsuya manages to blow his whistle and alert a descending guard. Kaito Arashima prepares to intercept the guard from the roof, while Nobu Takamine and Rikona Mibu monitor the exterior and dead communications.

Jovian successfully hits all four bags and the dummy without losing his balance, earning approval from Sayaka, Masaru, and Tetsu. In the storage room, Jostin completes ten repetitions of the Peach Stillpoint counter, leading Riko to declare him ready for Saturday. Kaito challenges Jovian to a future rematch. Tetsu announces the gym is closing and tells the group to handle their own transport home.

In the storage room, Jostin Joestar attempts his "Peach Stillpoint" technique against Riko Amane, partially absorbing a palm strike before releasing the energy through his foot. Riko deems the attempt mediocre and orders ten perfect repetitions. On the main floor, Jovian Joestar uses "Fifth Form: Falling Star Palm" to launch Kaito Serizawa across the room with a shockwave, causing further damage to the facility. Tetsu warns Jovian to learn power control or face a ban from the floor, while Riko assigns both men ten clean repetitions of their respective techniques.

Jostin Joestar baits Iori Vale into a trap using "Peach Gearshift" to redirect her momentum and strike her with a hidden blade, though Iori quickly counters by breaking his rhythm and damaging his wrist. Jovian Joestar absorbs a Rebound Pulse jab from Marlon Velez and responds with a "Breaker Limit Flush" barrage that overwhelms Marlon's guard. Reiko Amagawa powers through Vera Sable's Severline traps to land a forearm strike, while Mikoto Kurogane recovers from a hip throw by Toma Genda to trip him with a Riot Pulse sweep. Ayame Fujinami livestreams the bouts as Daigo Renjiro critiques the fighters' performance and declares that the second round will determine the district's owner.

Jostin Joestar argues that Daigo's recent losses and Principal Anya's presence will deter an attack, while Haruto Saionji establishes strict filming boundaries for Ayame Fujinami to protect tactical secrets. The crew agrees on a three-flash light signal for emergency evacuations and assigns security positions: Reiko at the door, Mikoto on the floor, and Kaito on the rooftops. Jovian orders the doors opened, and as Ayame begins filming the event, Kaito takes his position on the fire escape and spots a suspicious van nearby.

In the ruins of the old bathhouse, Jovian Joestar instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to manifest a protective shield. Yuzuki successfully summons a translucent pane of green light, which holds firm when Jovian tests it by throwing a pebble. At the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Jostin Joestar asks Riko Amane about her dream, and she reveals her goal to open a gym to help disadvantaged youth learn survival footwork. Riko then ends the conversation to begin a second training round and invites Jostin to Club Lumière.

Jostin and Jovian use acrobatic movements and physical positioning to block Rei Ichinose's view of the hatch seam. Hana Kisaragi refuses to move her foot from the panel, prompting Rei to threaten a formal report of obstruction to Principal Anya. Despite Haruto Saionji's attempt to distract her with a digital tablet and Nobu Takamine's offer of architectural specs, Rei ignores them and begins pulling up the foam mat.

Jovian Joestar convinces Haruto Saionji to limit Rei Ichinose's authority to school matters before Rei accepts a position assigned by the Principal. To hide their secret base, Hana Kisaragi and Ayame Fujinami attempt to obstruct or distract Rei as Haruto escorts her to the gym storage room. After Rei refuses Jovian's tour and Ayame's filming, Haruto leads her toward the storage room to sign an inventory list.

Jovian Joestar opts out of the mission to remain at the lounge. Haruto Saionji coordinates the team, placing Jostin in the field and Hana at the rear door as backup. Haruto and Rin enter the loan office as auditors, where the manager questions Rin's verification of a specific courier run. Rin refuses to provide the figure until the branch's ledger is confirmed.

Jovian notices Rikona's absence, but Mikoto reminds him that she is in a different classroom. Ayame and Nobu inform Jovian that Rikona requested a low-key meeting on the roof at lunch regarding her block. Haruto announces that the funding session with Rin is moved to after school as the substitute teacher begins roll call.

Jovian approves Rin's budget requests, and the group departs for the dorms, though Yuzuki and Reiko split off. During their walk, Hana provides a first-aid kit to paramedics treating an injured student. By Monday morning, the crew returns to Chikara Academy, where Haruto reminds Jovian of his meeting with Rin and Nobu enforces phone silence before the homeroom bell rings.

Jovian Joestar instructs the group to attend classes. Hana Kisaragi and Nobu Takamine depart to scout for usable gear in the workshop and practical-lab wing, while Haruto Saionji offers to help recruit magical students. Mikoto Kurogane agrees to accompany the brothers to the office on the condition that they produce a concrete plan against Daigo. After Yuzuki Hoshino expresses uncertainty about where she belongs, Jostin and Jovian enter Principal Anya's office, where she demands a report on their findings in Kobuncho.

Jovian Joestar searches the bathhouse and discovers a suspicious door with a new lock. Jostin Joestar calls Hana Kisaragi to commission a themed kimono. Haruto Saionji outlines a plan to ambush Ohba in the back corridor during his morning routine. The group is interrupted by Kurokawa enforcers who demand payment from outside the shutters, causing a panicking Yuzuki Hoshino to barricade the front door.

Jovian and Jostin agree to register for Pulse immediately to avoid long lines at the campus gate. Jovian expresses a desire for the brothers to be well-known at the academy, while Jostin focuses on the logistical requirements. Jostin gathers his belongings and prompts Jovian to follow him out of the building.

Jovian whistles loudly and Jostin performs acrobatic vaults to distract Rei Ichinose as she continues her physical inspection of the storage room. Hana Kisaragi intentionally steps on the newly installed panel to block Rei's access, dryly claiming she is stretching. Haruto Saionji questions Rei's motives, asking if she is searching for a specific anomaly or performing a standard baseline audit.

Jostin Joestar shouts for Riko Amane, who emerges and orders him to perform twenty minutes of Stillpoint reps. Kaito Serizawa interrupts to have Jovian Joestar demonstrate his "Twin Soul" technique on the heavy bags. Despite technical advice from Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara, Jovian's synchronized attack fails due to poor timing and a drifting heel, resulting in a recoil that knocks him back. Kaito identifies the synchronization error and instructs Jovian to fix his lead and footwork for a second attempt.

In the cage, Jovian Joestar uses a new technique, "Soul Pierce," to bypass Iwao's guard and knock him down, winning the first round. Banda declares a ten-minute break with no medics, while Haruto Saionji secretly places a gold line under Iwao's feet. In the annex, Jostin Joestar incapacitates Tatsuya with a "Peach Flash Step" and locks the arena-side door, while Kaito Arashima pins a guard's arm to a ladder with a tether bolt. Simultaneously, Rikona Mibu and Shun signal for entry at the service door as Nobu Takamine prepares the getaway vehicle.

Jovian Joestar uses Phantom Step to quickly transport an injured Yuzuki Hoshino to safety on the footbridge. Jostin Joestar convinces a fearful Rikona Mibu to accompany him to Club Lumière by promising a proposition and affirming her value to the group. Mikoto Kurogane admits she underestimated Rikona's resilience, while Haruto Saionji ensures the rear is clear. The group successfully retreats into Club Lumière.

Jovian Joestar agrees to private training with Yuzuki Hoshino and orders Bin to leave the area. Yuzuki practices her shield ability, attempting to maintain a green barrier for one minute. At the gym, Jostin Joestar completes a rigorous training session with Kaito Serizawa and Riko Amane, focusing on precision and restraint to prepare for a future confrontation with Daigo Renjiro. Riko notes Jostin's improvement and reminds him of his upcoming visit to Club Lumière with Sayaka.

Jovian strikes the lean man in the ribs, causing him to stagger. Jostin attempts a high-velocity charge but overshoots the target, colliding with the bar counter. Reiko activates her indigo dragon tattoo to protect the tattooed hostess, but the broad man attempts to pin her while the lean man lands a blind-side palm strike to her ribs. The sporty hostess shields the petite hostess behind the bar, and the curvy hostess urges the Joestar brothers to stop intervening for Reiko's sake.

Jostin Joestar makes a sexual joke, prompting Riko Amane to order him to restart his drills. During the exercises, Jostin performs hundreds of push-ups with mechanical precision, leading Riko to question him about his "assassin's footwork." Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar attempts a chopping kick against Genta Oda, who absorbs the blow and instructs Jovian to analyze his weight distribution. Sayaka Mizuhara intervenes to warn Jovian that his front-foot loading is telegraphing his movements.

Jostin and Jovian attend their afternoon classes while rumors of a mystery fighter spread through the student body. Yuzuki Hoshino alerts the group chat that an unconscious Seiran student is in the clinic rambling about a "girl stand-in," prompting Haruto Saionji to instruct everyone to stick to the plan at the riverbank. Jostin brags in the chat that the student will remember nothing, while Jovian avoids the teacher's suspicion. At the final bell, students head toward the riverbank to witness the upcoming fight.

The group separates at the Sky-Bridge Plaza, with Jostin and Ayame walking hand-in-hand toward the dorms. Jovian leads Yuzuki down the park path, while Hana and Haruto depart together. The following morning, the crew reunites at Club Lumière.

Jovian contacts Rin to arrange excuse letters for Nobu and Hana to skip class for a "club project" and to approve renovation funds for the safehouse. Jostin suggests telling Rei about the underground base and argues for recruiting a psychic illusionist, but Hana dismisses his tunneling ideas as impractical. Jovian decides on the false floor panel, and Nobu arrives with tools to begin construction after receiving Rin's clearance. Ayame warns Jostin that class starts in four minutes and the faculty is active.

Jostin Joestar asks Haruto Saionji for a rundown of the school's course tracks to determine the best department head for their proposed club advisor. Jovian Joestar and Ayame Fujinami attempt to charm the Gym Teacher into the role, though the teacher dismisses them and demands they leave for second period. Hana Kisaragi attempts to distract the teacher by shifting foam mats to hide the glinting corner of the trap door.

Jostin Joestar orders Rin to immediately begin managing the club and bathhouse finances and to coordinate a safehouse build with the Forge Division. Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi outline the technical requirements for the safehouse, which Haruto Saionji approves and funds. After Ayame Fujinami gives Rin a professional makeover, Rin returns to the group to deliver her full pitch to Jovian Joestar.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for the Command division to manage finances and logistics under a one-month probation. Rin explains she recognized the group from "Tag Night" and Ayame's social media posts. Ayame then forcibly takes Rin for a makeover, while Nobu Takamine enforces strict audit and receipt requirements for the new hire.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The crew hired Rin, a former clerk from the House, to manage their finances and operational logistics. She accepted the position under a strict one-month probation period overseen by Nobu.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji convince Principal Anya to charter a community service club after Haruto accepts administrative responsibility. Anya denies a budget and appoints Rei Ichinose as a mandatory liaison who must vouch for the club by Friday or face its dissolution. Rei agrees to the appointment after Haruto and the Joestars grant her absolute veto power over all club outings.

Jovian Joestar attempts to skip school to celebrate the night's success, but Haruto Saionji denies the request and promises to document the win in a formal report instead. Jostin Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane begrudgingly agree to attend homeroom, while Nobu Takamine warns the group to keep their phones silent in class. Hana Kisaragi orders the students to walk home together for safety, and Ayame Fujinami threatens to film Jovian's potential detention. Meanwhile, Rin asks Jovian to approve a discounted student cover and a late-night sound cap for future events.

Jovian Joestar tells the group to stop acting like guests and focus on their objectives. Jostin Joestar outlines a plan to recruit students, prepare for the fight against Daigo and Kurokawa, and invite Principal Anya to their party. Haruto Saionji offers to identify recruitable magical students, while Nobu Takamine intends to scout the practical-lab wing for usable gear. Hana Kisaragi and Mikoto Kurogane demand a concrete plan, with Mikoto ultimately agreeing to follow Jostin.

Jostin Joestar and Rin discuss the loan's profitability via comms, but Jovian Joestar tells Haruto Saionji they intend to target the debt collectors instead of paying. Noa Amemiya asks for confirmation of this plan, while Haruto notes they will pursue leads from a courier and Rikona Mibu's memory back at Club Lumière. Reiko Amagawa reports that the man Jostin attacked matches a watcher from a previous job, and Kaito Arashima alerts the group to an idling vehicle at the end of the walkway as police approach.

Jovian Joestar inspects the combat gear and asks Reiko Amagawa for a list of capable fighters. Reiko details the roles of her team, including herself as the anchor, and urges Jovian to confirm the defensive line before dawn. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar introduces various local shop owners and Sayaka Mizuhara to one another to foster a neighborhood alliance. Yuzuki Hoshino monitors the tired guests from her first-aid station while Jostin returns to Riko Amane to boast about his networking efforts.

Conversation with Anya: Jostin Joestar asked Anya if there was an issue with his registration. Anya confirmed the registration was fine but informed him that she had witnessed a brawl he and his brother started on academy grounds.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar follow Tetsu-san and his associates to the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Principal Anya informs the brothers that their assessments are still scheduled and a footage review of the brawl will occur tonight. Upon arrival at the gym, the brothers meet Kaito, Riko, Sayaka, Genta, and Masaru, who assess their fighting style and condition. Tetsu-san orders everyone to sit and drink tea before evaluating the brothers' abilities.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar remarked that he should have gone for a kiss. Ayame Fujinami responded playfully, suggesting she could create a "blooper reel" of the near-miss moment.

Jovian Joestar delegates the mission strategy to Jostin Joestar, who expresses frustration over the escalating debt and failing leads. Rin warns Jostin that aggressive tactics only hinder their progress. Haruto Saionji proposes a multi-stage plan: Nobu's drone will map the office on Friday, Ayame will gather intelligence via hostesses, and Haruto and Rin will use the Saionji name to enter the office on Saturday to secure proof.

Hana Kisaragi informs Jostin Joestar that Jovian Joestar is fighting Kaito Serizawa. After receiving training from Kaito and equipment from Haruto Saionji, Jovian defeats Kaito in a match live-streamed by Ayame Fujinami. Jostin subsequently kills two suited men and injures Matsumoto to identify an anonymous caller before Tetsu orders Jovian, Haruto, Riko Amane, and Ayame to flee the gym.

Tetsu arranges four bags and a dummy around Jovian, challenging him to hit all five simultaneously. Jovian executes "Thousand Fist Lotus," but his poor footwork causes him to stagger, resulting in only three hits and a critique from Sayaka and Masaru. In the storage room, Jostin uses Eagle Vision to predict Riko's attack and successfully pins her with a hidden blade. Riko concedes the move worked and counts it as one of his ten required repetitions before ordering him to continue.

Jostin Joestar spots Rikona Mibu in the crowd and calls out to her. Nobu Takamine identifies a pattern in Kenji Aoi's barrier cycles, while Mikoto Kurogane prepares to intervene. Yuzuki Hoshino uses crescent wind blades to shatter Aoi's barrier, prompting Aoi to escalate his power.

Jostin, Jovian, Ayame, Haruto, Hana, and Yuzuki enter a Chiikawa-themed amusement park. Jovian poses for a photo with Yuzuki at a Momonga statue, while Jostin attempts and fails to win a plush for Ayame at a ring-toss booth. Using Hana's technical guidance on the machine's tension, Haruto wins a plush and gives it to her. As the group explores the fairground, Jovian asks if anyone plans to break curfew.

Maki Hayashida leads Ayame Fujinami into the office where Jovian Joestar, Haruto Saionji, and Reiko Amagawa are strategizing. Haruto proposes a three-step plan to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's legitimacy branch through mapping, identifying weaknesses, and simultaneous public exposure and internal betrayal. Reiko agrees to identify corrupt ward officials to provide the necessary evidence for Ayame to frame the narrative. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar successfully manifests a dark ring of energy around his hand despite Yuzuki Hoshino's protests. Upon entering the office, Ayame asks Jostin if he is truly a killer, questioning which version of him she should promote to the public.

Reiko Amagawa explains to Jovian Joestar that Daigo Renjiro's challenge is a "measuring stick" to determine if the new owners will fold; refusing would force east row shops to resume paying double. Reiko offers to organize a defensive line at the canal for dawn, but Jovian asks for time to scout the alley before committing. In the lounge, Ayame Fujinami questions Jostin Joestar about the pay, creative control, and contract details of the proposed media division, scheduling a formal meeting for tomorrow after school.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Diojo asked Riko Amane if she knew his surname, to which she incorrectly replied that it was Joestar. Jostin corrected her, stating his name is actually Diojo. Riko expressed surprise, noting that he had previously been presenting himself as a Joestar.

Jovian Joestar thanks Senji Okabe for the information and privately summons Reiko Amagawa to the back office. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar kisses Riko Amane before questioning Ayame Fujinami about her footage and the sealed envelope. In the office, Jovian reads a letter from Daigo Renjiro challenging the crew to an "audition" at dawn in the canal alley. Reiko confirms the location matches Okabe's report and advises Jovian to deploy their best fighters and gear for a disciplined defensive line.

Jovian Joestar welcomes the Kobuncho guests to Club Lumière as the hostesses begin serving drinks. Yuzuki Hoshino prepares the first-aid station, while Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi take their respective security and technical posts. Jostin Joestar and Haruto Saionji attempt to steer Ayame Fujinami's filming toward a positive community narrative and away from their violent history. Riko Amane and Sayaka Mizuhara arrive at the party.

Jostin Joestar hides behind a notice board, using his heightened senses to track the enforcers. The Legitimacy captain asks the clerk who submitted the early payment form as the enforcers begin sweeping the hall, with Enforcer 2 intercepting Ayame Fujinami. On comms, Nobu Takamine and Haruto Saionji advise the crew to hold their positions while noting the courier is late. Meanwhile, the suited observer silently exits the building.

Jostin Joestar asks Haruto Saionji for school course information to find a club advisor, while Jovian Joestar, Ayame Fujinami, and Hana Kisaragi unsuccessfully attempt to recruit the Gym Teacher and hide a trap door. Jostin orders the group to convert a bomb shelter into a base and forces Haruto to lead him and Jovian to Principal Anya despite Haruto's recommendation to approach Vice-Principal Kashiwagi. Anya threatens the brothers with disciplinary transfers for unauthorized activities, prompting Haruto to present a formal club charter to her.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar checked on Ayame Fujinami as she remained focused on two mysterious men in suits. After Jostin offered his support, Ayame agreed to go on a date with him if he could keep her safe and the stream running.

Jostin Joestar uses Eagle Vision to detect three hostile men, including one outside the gym. Riko Amane and Ayame Fujinami prepare for a confrontation while Ayame continues streaming the event. Tetsu, Haruto Saionji, and Kaito Serizawa block the entrance to protect Ayame after Suited Man 1 demands she come with them to satisfy an unnamed client. Suited Man 1 threatens that Ayame will leave the gym regardless of whether she chooses to do so.

Jovian Joestar establishes a two-branch structure consisting of "Spearhead" under himself and "Hearth" under Jostin, leaving seven seats open for recruitment. Haruto, Rin, Hana, and Nobu discuss the logistical and financial requirements for these roles, emphasizing the need for vetting, skill tests, and counter-intel screening. Kaito and Mirei suggest specific needs for an Infiltrator and a Community Liaison. Reiko approves the reorganization via comms and asks which seats will be prioritized first.

Jovian and Ayame engage in playful banter about their fashion and public images as the crew enters the classroom. Haruto warns the group to keep a low profile as other students begin to recognize them from recent videos. During roll call, the homeroom teacher warns the class, specifically targeting the crew's row, to avoid vigilante activities. Jostin claims the group is the most law-abiding in the school.

Jovian wakes Jostin up to ensure they arrive at Chikara Academy on time. Upon arrival, the group observes students gossiping about the licensing captain's arrest, noting that their blue school uniforms provide effective cover. After Yuzuki departs for her clinic shadowing, Haruto leads the remaining crew toward homeroom to resume their student routines.

Jostin Joestar leads Ayame Fujinami to a rooftop, where he offers her an exclusive story about his fight against the Kurokawa syndicate and the reclaim of Club Lumière. Ayame agrees to meet him at the club at eight o'clock tonight to verify the claims before discussing terms. Meanwhile, Dr. Kiyose approves Yuzuki Hoshino for a shadowing position starting tomorrow, provided she can handle a live patient. Jovian Joestar escorts the celebrating Yuzuki from the clinic.

Jovian Joestar establishes the crew's hierarchy, appointing Reiko as head lieutenant, Haruto as tactician, and Mikoto as enforcer captain. Hana Kisaragi and Nobu define their roles as support engineer and field technician, respectively. Mikoto and Haruto accept their positions, though Mikoto asserts her right to criticize failing plans. Reiko confirms the structure and asks Jovian for their first move, noting a deadline to recover money from a noodle shop for Gara.

Jovian Joestar rips the Battle Test poster from the main hall bulletin board, ignoring protests from a second-year student, and heads to the training arena to scout potential teammates. In the support workshop, a student offers Jostin Joestar maintenance for his kusarigama. At the arena, a second-year female student informs Jovian about the strengths and weaknesses of students Daigo, Sera, and Nobu. Reiko calls Jovian to confirm that the Speedwagon Foundation has arrived at the club to begin work.

Jovian Joestar accepts the mission but assumes field command for the operation. Hana Kisaragi prepares a magnetic tracker, while Kaito Arashima plans to deploy it from a rooftop. At dusk, the crew positions themselves along Neon Lantern Street as a cash collection van begins loading at a loan office. Kaito confirms the van and lead car are in place and awaits Jovian's orders.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Nobu Takamine successfully completed the drone reconnaissance of the loan office. The footage confirmed the office serves as the counting hub for the Finance Captain's operations.

Haruto instructs the crew to lie low by returning to their normal student routines at Chikara Academy for one week. Jovian presents Yuzuki with a custom-made outfit from Aurelia Voss, which Yuzuki wears and appreciates. After Haruto coordinates the group's arrival and Kaito's perimeter watch for the following morning, the crew departs. The next day, Jostin and Jovian wake up prepared to return to the academy.

Haruto Saionji corrects the timeline and outlines a four-day roadmap on a whiteboard: drone scouting Friday, intelligence gathering Saturday, action Sunday, and debt eradication Monday. Rin clarifies that the debt is a fabricated number used to seize real assets and people from the Amemiya family. Haruto assigns Jovian Joestar the role of reserve, instructing him to rest and remain available to intervene if the weekend operations fail.

Jostin Joestar denies a romantic relationship with Riko to Ayame Fujinami and reaffirms their date for after the current crisis. The group assembles in the Main Lounge, where Jovian Joestar calls for a strategic plan to pressure the loan office on Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji proposes three options: an undercover audit using his family name, a direct heist of the records room, or a reconnaissance mission using Ayame's camera and Nobu's drone. Rin warns the crew that the office serves as a central hub for counting and moving the collectors' cash.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Haruto Saionji explained to Jostin Joestar that the licensing annex serves as a front for a captain to launder protection money via forged paperwork. Haruto detailed a plan to trap the captain by having him sign a forgery in public while Ayame records the evidence for later release. The footage will be uploaded to Ayame's channel and distributed through press contacts to ensure the syndicate cannot erase the proof.

Jovian and Nobu confirm their communication links are operational. While Jostin jokes about registering a hero agency, Reiko warns him to remain quiet. Ayame reports via comms that the Legitimacy captain has arrived with a fourth enforcer, while Haruto instructs the team to remain steady and wait for Nobu's signal.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar asked Riko Amane if she knew his surname, which she confirmed. Riko then informed him that Reiko had the envelope and Ayame was investigating it, asking Jostin for his plan of action.

Jovian Joestar delivers a charismatic speech to the crowd, promising that the Lumière club will prioritize the people of Kobuncho by providing jobs and a safe environment. Jostin Joestar celebrates by dancing with Riko Amane, while Ayame Fujinami films the festivities. Noa Amemiya informs Jovian that Senji Okabe, a local shopkeeper, is waiting to report an urgent matter. Okabe reveals that a man named Daigo Renjiro is doubling protection dues and will lead a collection run through the canal alley at dawn. Reiko Amagawa notes that this coincides with the delivery of the Kurokawa-sealed envelope.

Jostin Joestar asks for the day's priorities and current time. Reiko demands a decision on whether to pursue the lead on Gara in Shutter Alley or fortify the club first, while Nobu seeks approval to survey existing service tunnels. During the discussion, Aurelia Voss calls Jovian Joestar to propose adding Kaito Arashima, a contractor specializing in a collapsible cable-bow for ranged support, to the crew.

Jostin Joestar asks Haruto Saionji to handle the conversation with Rikona Mibu, who remains skeptical of the group's motives. Yuzuki Hoshino arrives and asks for the plan regarding the riverbank fight, though Mikoto Kurogane warns that Yuzuki cannot defeat the opponent, Aoi. While Hana Kisaragi and Nobu Takamine analyze the risks and Aoi's fight history, Haruto proposes a vote on whether to ignore the fight, send a member, or find a stand-in. Yuzuki demands clarification on the "stand-in" option before the group votes.

Jovian Joestar invites his opponents to join the "Joestar gang" at Club Lumiere, prompting dry criticism from Mikoto and Sera regarding his public recruitment. Haruto Saionji denies hearing the invitation, while Jostin Joestar expresses a desire for a beer. The announcer orders the Joestar unit to a post-test debrief and medical checks, demanding an explanation for the "Joestar gang" comment.

Jostin Joestar tells Rei Ichinose that his goal is to become the city's greatest gangster without becoming a monster, defining the liaison as a "navigator" to keep the group accountable. Jovian Joestar supports this, stating they need someone to prevent their expulsion while keeping the neighborhood safe. Rei dismisses the sentiment and demands specific authority, proposing an absolute veto over all club outings unless they are proven safe and school-sanctioned. Haruto Saionji accepts these terms and agrees to document all outings in the Friday reports.

Jovian Joestar and Nobu Takamine pressure Jostin Joestar to choose a safehouse, leading Jostin and a recon team to discover a bomb shelter at Chikara Academy. To hide the site from Principal Anya and staff, Jostin instructs Haruto Saionji to establish a Hero Activity and Community Service club as a cover. After Hana Kisaragi deflects a gym teacher's trespassing inquiry, Nobu texts Jostin to report that the shelter's hatch cover is crooked.

Jovian Joestar attempts to pressure Principal Anya into attending Club Lumière, but Anya counters by presenting an incident report of his recent unlicensed confrontation in Kobuncho to negate his leverage. Yuzuki Hoshino offers to leave the room to avoid drawing attention, though Anya tells her to stay. Jostin Joestar invites Anya one last time before the brothers depart for class. Anya agrees to consider the invitation on the condition that Daigo Renjiro's operations do not affect her students.

Leonidas didn't grow up in a dojo or a prestigious household; he grew up in the friction of Tokyo's streets. As a youth, he was a known delinquent, navigating informal power structures and learning survival through improvisation and grit. His 'Awakening' came not as a gift, but as a violent rupture—his dormant potential surged during a moment of extreme crisis, fracturing the invisible limiters of his soul and revealing the devastating physical power of Breaker's Soul. This discovery brought him both prestige in the underground and a level of notoriety that eventually paved his way into Chikara Academy's Combat Academy.

Now a Bruiser-class student, Leonidas masks his intense ambition under a veneer of nonchalance. He is prideful and fiercely protective of his reputation, viewing the structured environment of the academy as a challenge to be conquered. Despite his casual exterior, he is an adrenaline seeker who pushes his body to the brink, knowing that the crimson cracks of his power only deepen when he is under genuine pressure. He struggles with the duality of his strength: the more he releases the spectral warrior within, the more real-world damage his body sustains. He fears the day his pride pushes him toward 'Soul Burn' before he has mastered the instinctual chaos of his power. His current goal is to refine his clumsy, instinct-driven output into a precision tool, ensuring that when he finally executes the Kingbreaker, it is to secure a victory that leaves no doubt about who is the strongest.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji successfully persuaded Principal Anya to approve the Community Service club and serve as its advisor. Anya signed the club charter on the condition of weekly reports and full access to the storage room.

Jovian Joestar declares the crew will seize Kurokawa's territory and businesses. Jostin Joestar reveals that Ayame Fujinami and Principal Anya are attending tonight's event to assist with media and academic stability, respectively. The crew discusses security risks and optics, with Reiko volunteering for door security and Yuzuki preparing a medical area. Jovian orders a five-minute hold on guests to finalize positions before opening the club.

Jostin Joestar secures a ledger of Kobuncho debts, which Haruto Saionji photographs and burns after Setsuko Okabe offers to void Noa Amemiya's debt in exchange for its return. The crew returns to Club Lumière, where Haruto confirms the debt deadline is void and Hana Kisaragi presents blueprints for a new safehouse. Kaito Arashima, Rin, and Nobu Takamine vote to rest, while Ayame Fujinami asks Jostin to commit to a date.

Jovian Joestar confirms his family lineage to Mikoto, who questions his motives for building a crew at the academy. Ignoring her, Jovian demands to find Haruto, and Sera leads him and Mikoto to the battle-test arena. Upon arrival, the announcer mistakes Jovian, Mikoto, and Haruto for a registered battle test team and orders them to the center mark. Jostin Joestar watches the scene from the spectator gallery.

Haruto Saionji leads Jostin and Jovian Joestar toward the administrative wing to meet Vice-Principal Kashiwagi. Haruto advises the brothers to emphasize community service and safety records to appeal to Kashiwagi's preference for efficiency. He rejects the brothers' request to approach Principal Anya, citing her high visibility and the legal risks of involving her in "black operations."

Jovian Joestar reprimands Mikoto Kurogane and Haruto Saionji for missing class, prompting Jostin Joestar to schedule a "war room" meeting at the school gym for 5 PM. Mikoto agrees to attend, and Haruto commits to drafting a shortlist of magical-division candidates during his free period. Jostin instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to prepare the "Lifeline division" as a "wellness consultant" and be ready by the meeting time.

After Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane, the group defeats Banda, allowing Haruto Saionji to seize a ledger to fund repairs and a safehouse. The group hires Rin to manage finances and event protocols, then rescues Noa Amemiya from Club Kagerō after investigating her disappearance and a large debt. To combat Marumo Financial Services, the group confronts agents at Noa's shop and infiltrates Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing using Nobu Takamine's forged documents.

Jovian registers their team as "Jovian and Friend of Course" despite Mikoto's protests, and Rin directs them toward the bunker. Jostin stashes his weapons with Nobu and Hana but has a hidden blade confiscated by a bouncer before entering. Nobu warns the crew that signals will die upon entering the bunker, where Haruto and the others arrive to find a caged arena and a crowd. Mikoto notes that a humming sound in the arena is dampening her powers, prompting Jovian to suggest fighting "the old-fashioned way."

Jovian Joestar designates himself as the muscle and Jostin Joestar as the strategist for the mission. Jostin assigns himself to extraction and forbids Ayame Fujinami from entering the building for her safety, though she agrees to provide backup footage from her van. Haruto Saionji proposes a plan where Jovian and Mikoto Kurogane act as flashy distractions in the fight club while Jostin and Rikona Mibu sneak in to rescue a boy. Hana Kisaragi manages the exit route and evacuation signal, while Rikona reports that collectors transport targets from a laundromat every night at nine.

A disciplinary teacher clears the crowd, and Kenji Aoi departs after challenging Jovian Joestar to a fight at the riverbank at four o'clock. Mikoto Kurogane analyzes Kenji's casting stance, while Haruto Saionji insists that Yuzuki must give her own consent before being used in any "decoy play." Ayame Fujinami leads Jostin Joestar to the annex to recruit Yuzuki, a support caster, whom they find being cornered by three older students demanding a debt.

Nobu identifies the visitor as Kenji Aoi, a top fighter from Seiran Tech who is hunting the person responsible for the Kobuncho car explosion. Kenji publicly challenges the perpetrator to a fight after school, calling the students of Chikara cowards. To avoid detection by police, Haruto instructs Jovian to mask his fighter's stance as a delinquent to avoid Kenji's scrutiny.

Jostin Joestar officially organizes the crew into five divisions: Vanguard (Jovian, Mikoto), Forge (Nobu, Hana), Phantom (Jostin, Kaito), Command (Haruto, Reiko), and Lifeline (Yuzuki). Jovian confirms with Aurelia Voss that a security door installation and staff shuttle are scheduled for tomorrow. Nobu and Reiko press the leaders for a decision between surveying the canal-side service tunnels or pursuing Gara in Shutter Alley.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar warned Riko Amane not to get used to his attitude. Riko responded with a grin, claiming her attitude required no training unlike her discipline. She then questioned Jostin about whether he always used his golden fist Stand to punch first before speaking.

Jovian Joestar observes Kaito Serizawa and Riko Amane practicing their respective striking and footwork drills. Jostin Joestar offers Riko a cigarette, and she explains the gym's training schedule and strict discipline. Tetsu-san describes the territorial layout of Kurokawa Ward, detailing the Shirogane crew, Daigo syndicate, and Honebi Collective. Kaito and Riko warn the brothers that their brawl with Renji Kuroba's crew has already drawn neighborhood attention and dangerous notoriety.

Jovian Joestar dismisses Renji Kuroba, who warns the brothers to stay away until their assessments are complete. Jostin and Jovian leave the academy grounds and visit a convenience store for coffee. Outside, Jostin witnesses a student shove a boy distributing flyers for the Tetsu "Iron Palm" Gym. Jostin notices a gym business card among the scattered flyers on the pavement.

Jovian Joestar wakes up shouting and throws his phone at Jostin Joestar before returning to sleep. Jostin uses Jovian's phone to post a public message on the school network inviting magic users to the gym at lunch. At the training arena, the crew encounters a battle mage from Seiran Tech who arrived in response to the post. Haruto, Nobu, and Hana identify him as a potential recruit who may be hunting the person responsible for a recent car explosion.

Jostin Joestar thanks Riko Amane for the drills, though she bluntly tells him not to make it weird. Jovian Joestar thanks Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara for their corrections, receiving final training advice from Genta and Sayaka. After Jovian rejects Jostin's invitation to an izakaya, Jovian departs the gym alone and arrives in the Kobuncho district.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji lead a team—including Kaito Arashima, Hana Kisaragi, and Nobu Takamine—in a strike on Harumi Wharf to retrieve a strongbox. While Jostin Joestar infiltrates the boat's cabin and uses his Stand to secure a master ledger from a clerk, Jovian Joestar confronts Setsuko Okabe. Okabe offers to clear the Amemiya account if the group leaves, but Jovian rejects the offer while Kaito maintains overwatch of Okabe's guards.

Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane exchange challenges regarding their strength ahead of the mission. Haruto Saionji assigns himself as the floor watch and bettor to provide early warnings and explains that the only way to face "The House" is by climbing the fight ladder. Jostin Joestar confirms Ayame Fujinami, Hana Kisaragi, and Nobu will manage the getaway van and communications. Rikona Mibu insists on joining the infiltration team to identify her neighbor's child and utilize her shield-cracking abilities.

Conversation with Nobu Takamine: Nobu Takamine informed Jostin Joestar that Tatsuya was down and the team was positioned at the annex under The House. Nobu confirmed that the arena door was deadbolted and instructed Jostin to escort Shun through the service door to where Rikona and a running van were waiting.

Jovian Joestar boasts about his abilities to Mikoto Kurogane while Haruto Saionji identifies Kenji Aoi as the next opponent. Banda announces the start of Round 2 preparations as house staff assist a bleeding Iwao. In the annex, Jostin Joestar uses Tatsuya's keys to free debtors and directs them toward Nobu Takamine's idling van. Shun refuses to leave until his friend Daiki and other prisoners are rescued from the "humming room," prompting Rikona Mibu to coordinate their evacuation.

Jovian Joestar tells Maki Hayashida that Jostin has been pushing himself too hard, while Jostin awakens to name the source of the pressure "Blackstar Dominion," attributing it to bloodlust and will. Yuzuki Hoshino continues treating Jostin, demanding space and supplies as he overheats. Reiko Amagawa, Kaito Arashima, and Noa Amemiya confirm the surrounding block is frozen and clear of enemies, though they expect a reaction from Daigo Renjiro. Across the ward, Daigo observes cracks in his ceiling following the pulse.

Jostin Joestar kicked the man in the dark suit in the mouth and insulted him before Kaito Arashima forced Jostin to retreat toward the canal walkway. As Yuzuki Hoshino supported a limping Noa Amemiya, Noa questioned if her family's debts vanished with the destroyed records. Haruto Saionji informed the group via comms that the contract still exists and asked if they intend to pay the 4.6 million yen or face the collectors.

Jovian Joestar declares his involvement in Noa Amemiya's disappearance, prompting Rikona Mibu to describe three debt collectors who had been loitering near the shop. Nobu Takamine begins tracking Noa's last phone ping using a message thread provided by Airi Kurosawa. Jostin Joestar conducts solo recon at the Amemiya shop, where the parents reveal Noa has been missing since the morning and discovered an anonymous envelope of cash. An unidentified man in a grey jacket departs the area upon noticing Jostin's club jacket.

Jovian Joestar requests to add Jostin Joestar as a fourth team member to balance the fight against the four second-year students. Despite noting it is not standard procedure, the announcer permits the substitution. Jostin jumps from the gallery to the arena floor, signs the supplemental roster, and prepares for battle.

Jovian Joestar rejects Jostin Joestar's plan for an immediate strike, prioritizing a rematch with Kaito Serizawa tomorrow night. Jovian and Haruto Saionji establish a recon-only plan for the Kurosaki lot: Nobu Takamine will deploy a drone, Rin will trace the lease, Kaito Arashima will scout overwatch positions, and Hana Kisaragi will prepare basic equipment. Ayame Fujinami and Mirei Tachibana agree to use the Lantern Network to gather intelligence on grey sedans and the leasing company. Rin confirms the lot is funded by Marumo Financial, linking it to the finance captain.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar enthusiastically support Mikoto Kurogane's proposal to fight the debt collectors instead of paying the 7.8 million yen. Haruto Saionji formalizes the group's decision to fight and assigns roles: Rin and Nobu will trace the lender and leasing shells, Kaito will provide overwatch, Hana will prep gear, and Ayame will film the encounter. The planning is interrupted when Haruto receives a message from Reiko stating that the collectors are currently serving Noa Amemiya's contract at her shop.

Jostin Joestar posts a job listing for a treasurer on the crew's app, which Nobu Takamine edits to include receipt requirements and a probation clause. Haruto Saionji allocates the party budget, while Hana Kisaragi demands a line item for equipment repairs. Mikoto Kurogane purchases meat from a local butcher, and Ayame Fujinami begins livestreaming the celebration. The crew gathers for a meal prepared by Yuzuki Hoshino to celebrate their victory.

Jovian Joestar demands the appointment of a finance officer to manage the crew's funds. Jostin Joestar agrees with the need for a business-minded recruit, while Haruto Saionji proposes a 70/30 split between the safehouse and tonight's celebration. Nobu Takamine insists on strict receipt logging, Hana Kisaragi demands priority funding for gear repairs, and Mikoto Kurogane threatens mutiny if they do not eat yakiniku. Ayame Fujinami begins preparing her stream for the party, and Yuzuki Hoshino starts cooking in the kitchen as the crew enters Club Lumière to decide who will manage the money.

Jovian Joestar demands custody of the stolen money to prevent others from siphoning it. Haruto Saionji proposes allocating most of the funds to a safehouse and a smaller portion for a celebration, provided every yen is logged. While Jostin Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane argue for an expensive party and yakiniku, Hana Kisaragi insists on prioritizing gear repairs and operating costs. Ayame Fujinami suggests filming a victory party for her stream, and Yuzuki Hoshino offers to cook for the crew at Club Lumière. After Nobu Takamine drives the group back to the club, Haruto asks the crew to vote on how to split the budget and who should hold the cash.

Collectors stole Rin's phone and Haruto Saionji's decoy folders on Neon Lantern Street, prompting Nobu Takamine to track the getaway vehicle. Under Jovian Joestar's field command, Kaito Arashima tagged a cash collection van that Nobu tracked to Harumi Wharf. After the cash was loaded onto a boat, Haruto asked the crew to decide between scouting the yard immediately or waiting until Sunday.

Jostin Joestar and Kaito Arashima take stealthy vantage points above the shop. Jovian Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, and Reiko Amagawa confront the debt collectors, blocking the shop entrance and warning them against entering. Ayame Fujinami films the encounter while Haruto Saionji orders the crew not to strike first. The senior collector reads a notice demanding 7.8 million yen for Marumo Financial Services and threatens to send more men if the debt remains unpaid.

Jostin Joestar slapped the debt paperwork off the table, and Jovian Joestar informed Noa Amemiya that the crew intends to destroy the debt collectors rather than pay the 4.6 million yen. Haruto Saionji permitted Noa to make a brief, anonymous call to her parents before Yuzuki Hoshino escorted her to rest. The next morning, Rin revealed the debt had ballooned to 7.8 million yen due to interest, and Nobu Takamine linked the collectors' vehicle to the same finance network. Mikoto Kurogane argued against paying the debt, leading Haruto to call for a final group decision.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami if she had witnessed him beat up the captain. Ayame confirmed that she had filmed the encounter, including Jostin's destruction of a building, and intended to post the footage for her followers.

Jostin Joestar recounts assaulting a tail and destroying his archives. Rin confirms the 4.6 million yen debt is real and promises a full financial breakdown by morning, at which point Haruto Saionji and the group will decide whether to pay the debt or fight the collectors. Noa Amemiya asks for permission to call her parents and questions the crew's actual plan regarding her family's contract.

Jovian Joestar prepares and serves Yuzuki Hoshino an over-steeped, bitter tea, which she politely pretends to enjoy. In the back booth, Jostin Joestar admits to the accidental death of a Kurokawa enforcer and offers to pay Rikona Mibu's debt as a thank-you for her help. Rikona remains skeptical of his words and demands a receipt as proof of payment before she will decide to help. Reiko Amagawa listens silently and watches Jostin, while Haruto Saionji warns the group to keep their voices down due to other guests in the lounge.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: alliance
Description: Ayame Fujinami officially joined the crew as the head of their media division. This agreement was finalized in the presence of Jostin, Jovian, Haruto, and Reiko.

Jovian falls asleep on the office desk. Jostin uses a "Peach Limit Break" to instantly cure his hangover. Reiko briefs Jostin on the plan to intercept the Noodle Shop crew's money transfer at midday, detailing the positions of Mikoto, Haruto, and Nobu. Chiho warns the Joestars that the crew might recognize them from a previous fight and offers to keep a getaway route open.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin Joestar physically assaulted Setsuko Okabe before Haruto Saionji burned the master ledger to void the Amemiya and Noa debts. The guards and Setsuko witnessed the assault, while the ledger's destruction was confirmed by Haruto.

Jovian Joestar coordinates a cash placement for Haruto Saionji, leading to simultaneous operations where Jostin, Kaito, and Haruto perform a pickup at Shutter Alley while Mikoto, Reiko, Ayame, and Yuzuki defend Noa's shop from Yoshida and Kato. Jovian establishes a two-branch organizational structure, appointing Ayame to lead the Lantern Network and recruiting support from Mirei and Maki. After conducting a recon operation at the Kurosaki lot with several associates, Jovian declines a payment from Jostin and fights Kaito Serizawa at Tetsu Iron Palm Gym.

Jovian Joestar used his Stand to break into the room and hurl himself and Noa Amemiya through a window onto Neon Lantern Street, though the rough landing injured Noa. Noa informed Jovian that her family's contract with the organization remains active. Kaito Arashima reported via comms that police are four minutes away. Jostin Joestar threw the man in the dark suit out the window, landing beside him to prepare an unknown action while stair guards alerted remaining security to the breach.

In the Records room, Jostin Joestar uses "Peach Aftershock" to open a wall safe, recovering delivery logs and payout schedules. Ayame Fujinami photographs Genda's delivery paperwork, confirming the link between the licensing office and the Legitimacy captain. In the annex office, Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane intimidate Hayashi into revealing that original manifests are in a locked bottom drawer. Reiko Amagawa convinces Hayashi to cooperate by arguing he will be the sole scapegoat if he doesn't help expose the captain.

Jostin Joestar manifests his Stand, I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH, to fully recover and begins planning with Ayame Fujinami. Ayame proposes using a compromised licensing officer to obtain a paper trail on the Legitimacy captain, while Yuzuki Hoshino warns them to avoid traps. Simultaneously, Jovian Joestar, Reiko Amagawa, and Mikoto Kurogane head toward the underground circuit to meet a contact named Old Man Koga. Upon discovering a sabotaged water main blocking the street, Mikoto concludes the disruption is a deliberate tactic by Daigo's forces, prompting Reiko to press forward toward the pit.

Conversation with Iori Vale: Iori Vale urged Jostin Joestar to flee, warning him that a dangerous entity within her would eventually take control and cause harm. Despite these warnings, Jostin refused to leave her behind. Iori eventually relented but demanded that Jostin kill her if she ever turned on their companions.

Jostin Joestar ties the boy to a vent pole, requests backup from the club for the child's extraction, and vanishes into the crowd to retrieve the dropped note. Reiko blocks a Kurokawa muscleman's attempt to flank her while the other offers a deal for the boy and the note. In the alley, Jovian Joestar slams the Minder into the pavement, while Mikoto repels the Minder Backup with a shockwave. Using Eagle Vision, Jostin locates the dropped note on Neon Lantern Street.

Jostin Joestar denies being a Joestar before he and Jovian Joestar sprint out of the arena to avoid the debrief. Haruto Saionji lies to the announcer, claiming the "gang" comment was a joke to cover for them. After traveling by train to Kobuncho's Neon Lantern Street, the winded brothers arrive at the closed Club Lumiere.

Collector 1 sets a deadline of sundown tomorrow for the debt payment, threatening to seize the shop's inventory as collateral. Collector 2 calls for backup due to the crew's presence. Reiko Amagawa notes the call is being recorded, and Haruto Saionji orders the crew to hold their positions until the call is finished.

Jostin Joestar consoles two young women at the van, learning from them that Noa was taken to the main house, Club Kagerō, to settle a family debt. Jovian Joestar intercepts the suited handler, using his Stand to demand Noa's location; the handler confirms the destination but claims he is only a courier and fears for his life if he reveals more. Kaito Arashima reports no enemy reinforcements are nearby, while Rikona Mibu maintains a barrier over the car and monitors the women.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar celebrate their victory despite their injuries, leading to a sarcastic exchange with Mikoto Kurogane about who defeated Banda. Rikona Mibu uses Mending Pulse to treat the brothers' ribs and internal injuries. Haruto Saionji discovers a second ledger in the stolen duffel bag, noting that Banda was skimming money from Daigo. Ayame Fujinami reports that her stream of the fight is trending, while Nobu Takamine asks the group for a decision on where to drop off Shun and the other rescued debtors.

Jostin Joestar orders a terrified clerk to remain still and uses his Stand, 「I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH」, to force open a strongbox, retrieving a master ledger. Jovian Joestar mocks Setsuko Okabe's offer to clear the Amemiya account, prompting Okabe to explain that the written records must be handled. Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch of the guards while Haruto Saionji instructs Jovian to distract Okabe and Jostin to secure the box.

Conversation with Nobu Takamine: Nobu Takamine informed Jostin Joestar that they would move forward rather than pull back upon the signal to capture the captain publicly. He explained that Ayame would expose the captain by releasing footage and evidence of a forged authorization to her press contacts. Nobu clarified that their role was to provide the muscle necessary to keep the captain in place during the exposure.

Ayame Fujinami publicly exposes the Legitimacy captain for signing a forged authorization, prompting the crowd to recoil. Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to block the lead enforcer, while Reiko Amagawa shields Ayame. Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane attack a second enforcer to protect Ayame, and a third enforcer discovers and scratches Jostin Joestar. As the captain attempts to flee with the document, Nobu Takamine orders the crew to capture him immediately.

Jovian Joestar reveals himself to Setsuko Okabe, who explains she detected the camera loop and offers to clear the Amemiya account if the group leaves quietly. Kaito Arashima reports he has both guards in his sights and awaits orders. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar infiltrates the cabin and finds a terrified, unarmed clerk standing by the bolted strongbox.

Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami kiss before Ayame returns to her dorm, while Jovian Joestar kisses Yuzuki Hoshino after feigning an injury. Haruto Saionji and Rin enter a loan office as auditors to photograph Noa Amemiya's file and a cash schedule, while Jostin and Hana provide external support. After Haruto and Rin are intercepted by three collectors on Neon Lantern Street, Jostin and Jovian move to intercept the attackers.

Jostin Joestar attempts to contact Haruto Saionji for help, but the signal fails; Haruto instead distracts cage officials by accusing them of tampering. In the annex, Tatsuya attacks Jostin, but Jostin redirects the momentum to throw Tatsuya into a doorframe. Kaito Arashima pins a descending guard to a ladder with a tether bolt, while Shun attempts to unlock the annex door. In the cage, Jovian Joestar strikes Iwao with a powerful aerial attack, but Mikoto Kurogane intervenes to break Iwao's subsequent attempt to grab Jovian. Meanwhile, Nobu Takamine monitors the service hatch via drone, and Rikona Mibu moves toward the service door.

Haruto Saionji orders Jostin Joestar to target the cabin while Jovian Joestar holds the gate. Jostin uses Shadow Step to infiltrate the wharf via a fence breach. Nobu Takamine reports the early arrival of a sedan carrying Setsuko Okabe and two guards, who arrive at the boat. Upon exiting, Setsuko reveals she noticed the looped security cameras and calls for the infiltrator to reveal themselves.
The Enforcement captain is secretly siphoning a portion of the betting revenue into a private offshore fund, skimming from his own Syndicate superiors.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully stole the cash bag from the Noodle Shop crew during a coordinated intercept operation. The theft was witnessed by the carrier, the minder, and a retired hero at the docks.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin Joestar successfully stole the cash bag from the Noodle Shop crew's carrier using a stealthy distraction. The carrier and her minder discovered the theft immediately, causing panic among the crew members.

Jovian Joestar orders an immediate strike on Harumi Wharf to maintain momentum. Haruto Saionji coordinates the deployment: Kaito Arashima secures a crane for oversight, Hana Kisaragi identifies a breach point in the fence, and Nobu Takamine loops the gate cameras while noting an expected vehicle arrival in ten minutes. Using his Stand, Jostin Joestar locates nine hostiles and a gold-signature strongbox on the boat's cabin.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Ayame publicly exposed the Legitimacy captain's corruption in the licensing annex, prompting a violent confrontation between the party and the captain's enforcers. The captain attempted to flee the scene with the signed forgery while his guards attempted to protect him.

Jostin Joestar reports the theft of Genda's paperwork and the Legitimacy captain's payout schedule to Haruto Saionji. Haruto and Ayame Fujinami advise that exposing the Legitimacy captain publicly now would compromise the plan to infiltrate the pit circuit during Thursday's intake to target the Enforcement captain. Maki Hayashida secures the room to maintain secrecy while Haruto leaves the choice between immediate public exposure or the Thursday strike to the Joestar brothers.

Jostin Joestar praises the team and requests a second kusarigama by tomorrow. Nobu agrees to the request and plans to finalize Jostin's gloves and monitor Kurokawa communications, while Hana presents schematics for high-impact knuckle gloves. The group decides to celebrate their upcoming operation with drinks, though Mikoto and Haruto express concerns regarding sobriety and responsibility.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully tracked a cash collection van to Harumi Wharf using a magnetic tag. They discovered the funds are being loaded onto a cargo boat scheduled to sail on Monday.

Jostin Joestar denies a relationship with Riko to Ayame Fujinami before the group meets in the Main Lounge to plan a mission against a loan office on Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji outlines a four-day roadmap involving Nobu Takamine's drone, Ayame's intelligence gathering, and a Saturday entry using the Saionji name, while Rin explains that the debt is fabricated to target the Amemiya family. Following the meeting, Jovian Joestar accompanies Yuzuki Hoshino to the academy, and Nobu notifies the group that drone footage confirms the office is a counting hub.

Haruto Saionji and Jovian Joestar enter the Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing flagship branch, posing as wealthy clients from Saionji Holdings and Joestar. Haruto presents forged documents provided by Nobu Takamine, who warns the duo via comms that the cover will fail if the receptionist performs a detailed audit. While Hana Kisaragi and Mikoto Kurogane provide exterior backup with a sleeping Jostin Joestar, the receptionist begins to verify the account manager, prompting Nobu to urgently tell the pair to conclude the interaction.

Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami film a boy named Ren performing a "curb hop" on his scooter for Ayame's channel. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar mocks red bean taiyaki, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to defend the snack and share a story about her grandmother. Nearby, Hana Kisaragi and Haruto Saionji bond over their childhoods and shared experiences with building things.

Conversation with Yuzuki Hoshino: Jostin Joestar asked Yuzuki Hoshino who owned the bathhouse. Yuzuki, who appeared frightened by a knocking sound on the shutters, whispered that she owned the establishment after inheriting it from her grandmother.

Jovian Joestar prepares to confront the Kurokawa enforcers, while Haruto Saionji sets gold script tripwires at the entrance to protect Yuzuki Hoshino. Mikoto arrives and distracts the enforcers, prompting them to demand the group face them in the street to avoid a trap. Haruto abandons his stealth plan and warns the enforcers to leave, but Jostin Joestar leads the group out into the alley to engage the four men.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar asked Haruto Saionji if he was a stand user, prompting Haruto to confirm that his stand is called Crown Script. After being asked for a demonstration, Haruto created a small, humming gold line in the air and invited Jostin to touch it.

Jovian Joestar returns to sleep after breakfast. Jostin Joestar coordinates with Nobu over the phone to cover their school absences and confirm the completion of new gear. Jostin asks Haruto Saionji for the plan to confront Ohba, and Haruto specifies that they will conduct reconnaissance after breakfast. Haruto invites Yuzuki Hoshino to join the crew as a healer, offering her protection and training; Yuzuki expresses fear regarding her safety and the bathhouse and asks for time to think.
