Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar discuss Kaito Arashima's recruitment with Aurelia Voss, agreeing to accept him because he was vouched for by Josuke Higashikata. Jostin establishes a five-division organizational structure, assigning the crew into Vanguard, Forge, Phantom, Command, and Lifeline roles. The crew accepts these assignments, and the group now awaits a decision on whether to survey the tunnels or pursue Gara in Shutter Alley.

Jovian and Jostin leave their residence, drinking Strong Zero as they head toward campus. Upon exiting, they observe numerous students wearing identical black wristbands. Jostin discovers a new flyer requiring an ability declaration form for Pulse registration. Jovian notes that the gates close at 8 PM and asks Jostin if they should proceed to the line or investigate the wristbands first.

After a violent incident, Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji cancel a mission so the group can recover at Club Lumière. While Yuzuki Hoshino treats Jostin Joestar's injuries, Nobu Takamine traces a call from an unidentified person who mentioned the Amemiya account to Neon Lantern Street. Haruto reports a 5.9 million yen demand on the Amemiya shop, leading Jovian to identify the Finance Captain as the responsible party, while Jostin apologizes to Ayame Fujinami for lying about their relationship and secures a date with her.

Jovian Joestar interrupts the receptionist's verification process by demanding to see a manager, prompting her to summon a senior account manager. The manager offers Haruto Saionji a trial placement involving a modest sum to be collected by a courier tomorrow night at a designated address. Kaito Arashima notes via comms that this courier window coincides with Marumo's planned visit to Noa's shop.

Jovian Joestar leads the group in a celebratory toast to the Joestar Gang's second victory over Daigo's captains. Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami play to Ayame's livestream, while Kaito, Hana, Haruto, Nobu, Mikoto, and Reiko each offer a toast reflecting their personal priorities. Yuzuki Hoshino encourages Jostin to eat more protein for his rib recovery as the crew celebrates together.

Jostin Joestar retrieves Rin's coffee from the Vault and delivers it to Hana Kisaragi, who promises the cord spools will be finished by evening. After teasing Ayame Fujinami and Rin, Jostin travels to the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar and Kaito Serizawa warm up on the heavy bags, with Kaito providing form corrections. Jostin arrives at the gym in the late afternoon to offer Jovian moral support before the match.

Jovian Joestar proposes infiltrating Marumo's operation by posing as wealthy clients, leveraging the historical ties between the Saionji and Joestar families. Haruto Saionji agrees, provided the cover is airtight to avoid detection. Rin identifies Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing's flagship branch as the target, while Nobu Takamine offers to forge the necessary business documentation and Ayame Fujinami prepares a hidden camera for Jovian's jacket. Mikoto Kurogane and Hana Kisaragi agree to provide exterior backup and transportation once the paperwork is ready.

Riko Amane departs after reminding Jostin Joestar of their 5:00 AM drills. Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji brief the crew on a "front diamond" formation for the upcoming confrontation: Reiko Amagawa, Mikoto Kurogane, Jovian, and Jostin will hold the perimeter while the remaining crew provides support and extraction from the center. After conducting spacing drills and resting overnight, the crew takes their positions at the canal alley at dawn. Kaito Arashima alerts the team via comms that Daigo Renjiro has arrived, accompanied by four elite enforcers: Marlon Velez, Vera Sable, Toma Genda, and Iori Vale.

Yuzuki Hoshino and Jovian Joestar leave the ruins for Kobuncho after Yuzuki feeds Bin. Upon arriving at Club Lumière, Nobu Takamine, Hana Kisaragi, and Reiko Amagawa greet them and discuss Sato's route sheet and the halted transfer schedule. Haruto Saionji notes that Jostin is organizing a party with Riko and Sayaka, but warns that someone was piloting Sato's corpse. Maki Hayashida assigns Nobu and Hana to fix the stage lights by eight, while Reiko warns that Daigo Renjiro will likely retaliate once his money flow is cut.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully executed the first trial event night at Club Lumière, integrating a hostess showcase and gathering direct feedback from regulars. The event concluded with the hostesses entering the floor and Jostin exiting the bar top.

Conversation with curious students: Jostin Joestar asked a group of students about the size of the crowd. Nanami, one of the students, mistakenly claimed it was Thursday, but Jostin corrected her that it was Sunday. Nanami admitted she had lost track of the week due to finals and noted that the "mystery takeover" was successfully attracting people.

Conversation with Lumière regulars: Jostin Joestar offered to buy a round of drinks for the Lumière regulars. A silver-haired man declined the gesture, advising Jostin to save his money for the business's float instead.

Jostin Joestar invites Rikona Mibu to the club via text, but she declines to stay home with her brother. Jovian Joestar dismisses Rin's concerns about attendance projections and instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to prioritize selling expensive bottles over tea. Yuzuki attempts a nervous sales pitch to regulars who mock her delivery, though one guest eventually asks to see the bottle list. Nobu Takamine logs the champagne pricing, while Hana Kisaragi notes Yuzuki's lack of sales skills.

Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami shared a brief kiss and a promise of safety before Ayame returned to her dorm. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar feigned an injury to get Yuzuki Hoshino's attention, leading to a kiss that left Yuzuki flustered. On Saturday morning, the crew gathered at Club Lumière where Haruto Saionji and Rin confirmed the loan office as the counting hub. Haruto outlined the mission plan: he and Rin will enter through the front door using the Saionji name, while Jostin leads the field team outside.

Conversation with Rikona Mibu: Jostin Joestar pointed out that Rikona Mibu was holding onto his sleeve. Rikona quickly let go and blushed, claiming she was only ensuring she did not lose him in the crowd.

Jovian Joestar settles an injured Yuzuki Hoshino into a booth, and she requests tea. In a separate booth, Jostin Joestar admits his crew's responsibility for attacking Kurokawa and offers to clear Rikona Mibu's debt in exchange for her potential aid. Rikona expresses skepticism regarding the "no pressure" nature of the deal and asks if the crew killed a Kurokawa collector recently. Reiko Amagawa demands a truthful answer to Rikona's question.

Jovian Joestar calls Yuzuki Hoshino to recruit her for a "mission," but Yuzuki demands details before agreeing to sneak away from her clinic internship. Nearby, Ayame Fujinami observes a small girl using a precise green healing cast and tells Jostin Joestar she is the ideal caster. Meanwhile, three older students corner the girl, demanding she buff fighters in an underground match to pay off a debt.

In the bathhouse ruins, Jovian Joestar praises Yuzuki Hoshino, though Bin interrupts their close moment. Yuzuki asks Jovian if they can continue training together in private. At the gym, Jostin Joestar offers to help Riko Amane achieve her dream, and Riko agrees to visit Club Lumière tonight with Sayaka. Kaito Serizawa prepares to oversee Jostin's second round of training.

Jovian Joestar promises to help Yuzuki Hoshino find a private location to practice her combat abilities after they finish their tea. At the gym, Jostin Joestar uses a precise immobilization technique to defeat Kaito Serizawa in a sparring match. Riko Amane notes the move's lethality and reminds Jostin of a scheduled visit to Club Lumière.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar complimented Riko Amane on her welcoming nature. Riko dismissed the compliment, noting that Jostin appeared as though he had been through a war. She told him to sit down to avoid being forced to scrub by Sayaka.

At the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Jostin Joestar invites Riko Amane to a party at Club Lumière; she agrees to consider it provided Sayaka approves, then forces him into grueling footwork drills. Kaito Serizawa prepares to spar with Jostin following the drills. Simultaneously, Jovian Joestar and Yuzuki Hoshino go to a teahouse on Neon Lantern Street. Over tea, Yuzuki expresses gratitude for her time with the Joestars and discusses how her Stand, Verdant Sylph, no longer feels like a source of fear.

Jovian Joestar asks Yuzuki Hoshino on a date; she flusteredly agrees to get tea after she finishes treating the group's wounds. Gara acknowledges the team's success and orders them to rest. Jostin Joestar departs for the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, where he is greeted by Kaito Serizawa and Riko Amane.

Conversation with Yuzuki Hoshino: Jostin Joestar complimented Yuzuki Hoshino on her crest. Yuzuki admitted she felt strange wearing it but expressed her determination to live up to it to protect those who had been kind to her.

Jovian requests his promised power knuckles, which Hana provides for fitting. Jostin returns from a break and collects a modified second kusarigama from Nobu for balance testing. Reiko warns that Ohba is aware of Yuzuki and the club, urging the crew to choose between securing Shutter Alley or fortifying the club.

Jostin Joestar pins three men to the pavement, killing Suited Man 2 and Kazuya Oka while severely injuring Matsumoto. After answering a call from an anonymous person on Matsumoto's phone, Jostin beats him until Matsumoto reveals the caller's number is in the log. Tetsu orders the group, including Jovian Joestar, Haruto Saionji, Riko Amane, and Ayame Fujinami, to flee the gym.

Reiko Amagawa warns Jostin Joestar that their conversation is not over and tells him to get proper sleep before departing. In the ops room, Haruto Saionji confirms that gear and comms are ready for the following day, prompting the crew to leave. Jostin and Jovian Joestar walk back to the Chikara Academy dorms together after Jostin sends a goodnight message to Ayame.

Jovian Joestar teases Dr. Kiyose before the doctor leads Yuzuki Hoshino into a treatment room to demonstrate her healing abilities on a dummy. Dr. Kiyose notes Yuzuki's uneven pacing but steady hands, while the reception nurse informs Jovian that Yuzuki will shadow the doctor starting tomorrow if she passes. Elsewhere, Jostin Joestar tells Nobu Takamine he is choosing Agency Operations to handle marketing and asks for the school's top influencer. Nobu identifies Ayame Fujinami, who immediately arrives at the lab seeking footage of a damaged equipment log and introduces herself to Jostin.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The Legitimacy captain signed the forged payment authorization in public, unaware that Ayame Fujinami captured the act on camera. The party has secured the necessary evidence to expose the captain's corruption.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin and his team coerced Sonobe into revealing the existence of a secret ledger containing falsified licensing permits. The licensing officer admitted to copying the Legitimacy captain's illegal records after being confronted with evidence.

Jovian Joestar demands Noa's room number and key, threatening the man in the dark suit. The man, identifying himself as the manager of records, claims Noa Amemiya is upstairs and will be released once her family's debt is paid. He shows the Joestars recorded footage of their breach and warns that any further violence will automatically alert the police and Hero Agency. Despite Jovian manifesting Breaker's Soul, the manager remains calm and offers to discuss terms.

Jovian thanks the group for the training and promises Tetsu to be more careful next time. Riko flusteredly agrees to a date with Jostin after Saturday, provided he is not "weird" about it. Kaito holds the door for the brothers and reminds Jovian to bring Jostin for a rematch on Thursday. The Joestar brothers return to the Chikara Academy dormitory, where Jovian tells Jostin to sleep before their meeting at the House tomorrow night.

Jovian Joestar suggests creating a plan to deal with the Kurokawa syndicate, while an exhausted Jostin Joestar proposes using the club as a base of operations. The Sporty Hostess mocks the request given the wreckage, and Reiko checks her sister for injuries before demanding that future debt payments go through the club to prevent further harassment of the staff. The lean man agrees to relay Reiko's terms to his boss.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar help Noa Amemiya escape Club Kagerō, after which Haruto Saionji informs the group that Noa's family debt has increased to 7.8 million yen. Following a decision to fight the collectors, the group confronts Marumo Financial Services agents at Noa's shop in Tower Five. Haruto and Jovian then infiltrate Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing using Nobu Takamine's forged documents to locate the lenders' cash runs.

Nobu Takamine narrows the unidentified caller's location to two blocks on Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji reads a final notice demanding 5.9 million yen by Monday, leading Jovian Joestar to conclude the Finance Captain is responsible. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar apologizes to Ayame Fujinami for lying about their relationship and asks her on a date, which she accepts.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar apologized for briefly losing control. Riko Amane held onto his shoulder and cautioned him against acting alone.

Riko Amane comforts Jostin Joestar after his failed attempt, informing him that she will spot him in the future but not tonight. Jovian Joestar meditates for an hour to refine his timing and synchronize his movements. Haruto Saionji arrives to deliver equipment from Hana, including an extraction kit for Jostin, and announces he will be cornering Jovian. Ayame Fujinami proposes live-streaming a sanctioned rematch, which Kaito Serizawa agrees to provided his corner is not filmed.

Jostin Joestar reunites with Ayame Fujinami and dismisses his injuries. Jovian Joestar questions Yuzuki's absence, which Hana Kisaragi attributes to her shadowing at Dr. Kiyose's clinic. Haruto Saionji advises the crew to avoid Kobuncho for now while they evaluate the Suited Observer's behavior.

Nobu Takamine attempted to trace a call from a dead man's phone while Jostin Joestar dialed the most recent contact. An unidentified caller claimed the Amemiya account increased by the cost of three men before hanging up, leaving Nobu unable to pinpoint a location until morning. Haruto Saionji ordered the group to wait for the results. Jovian Joestar slept in a booth at Club Lumière after receiving tea from Maki Hayashida, waking the next morning to find Nobu and Haruto already working.

Jovian Joestar defeated Kaito Serizawa in a fight, winning the bout after using "Falling Star Palm" to blast Kaito across the mat. Following the match, three suited men arrived at the gym and demanded that Ayame Fujinami accompany them to satisfy a client. Jostin Joestar used Blackstar Dominion to defeat the men and pinned them to the street, where he questioned them about their employer.

Jovian Joestar guides Noa Amemiya into a getaway car driven by Hana Kisaragi, followed by Jostin Joestar and Kaito Arashima as police arrive. Jostin identifies the attacked man as one of Daigo's men, leading Haruto Saionji to instruct the group to systematically target Daigo Renjiro's subordinates. Reiko Amagawa promises to protect Noa's family shop, and Hana drives the group toward Club Lumière.

Jovian Joestar drops the suited handler and demands to know the location of his backups. Jostin Joestar strikes the man in the dark suit, who insists that Noa will not be freed until 4.6 million yen is paid. Nobu Takamine broadcasts a fake earthquake warning over the intercoms to evacuate the club, while Kaito Arashima reports that backup is arriving in two minutes and a guard has radioed for help. Jovian locates a room with a fresh paper tag as the man in the dark suit remains silent.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar asked Riko Amane how she was doing. Riko responded with a flat look, criticizing his priorities given that two bodies were on the pavement and sirens were approaching.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami if she was alright while she packed up her streaming equipment. Ayame responded with a smile and noted that she was doing better than the security guards outside. She then questioned Jostin's well-being after noticing blood on his knuckles.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji cancel tonight's mission so the group can recover. After Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara agree to maintain silence about the incident, Riko Amane reports the injuries to an unknown party via burner phone. Back at Club Lumière, Yuzuki Hoshino treats Jostin Joestar's injuries while Nobu Takamine and Haruto Saionji begin tracing the caller's prepaid phone. Nobu believes he can pinpoint the caller's district by morning due to a routing error in the final hop.

Jostin Joestar rested at the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym to recover from strain before heading to Kobuncho. At Club Lumière, Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine reviewed the club's budget, cover charges, and vendor quotes. Rikona Mibu arrived at the club and sat apart from the group as previously agreed.

Jovian Joestar feigns sleep to avoid decision-making, prompting Haruto Saionji to order that debtors be dropped home via staggered, untraceable routes. Haruto suggests using the stolen funds to establish a permanent safehouse, a plan Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi begin coordinating via secure routing. Yuzuki Hoshino provides food and water to the debtors, while Rikona Mibu insists on personally escorting Shun home to ensure his safety. Shun remains distressed at the mention of his home but begins to eat as Nobu starts the drop-off sequence.

Jostin Joestar releases a wave of raw black pressure that knocks out weak-willed civilians and staggers strong fighters like Reiko, Kaito, and Haruto. Jovian Joestar catches the collapsing Jostin and carries him into Club Lumière for medical attention. Yuzuki Hoshino immediately begins treating Jostin's injuries, while Maki Hayashida questions the cause of the blackout.

Jostin Joestar attributes his bloodlust to family instincts before falling unconscious. Jovian Joestar slaps his brother and reprimands him for acting like a weapon. Haruto Saionji comforts a panicked Yuzuki Hoshino and admits that stopping Jostin exhausted his abilities, leaving him unfit for the frontline. Mikoto confirms Jostin is unconscious and directs the group to move him into the bathhouse to avoid public attention.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: crime
Description: Jostin Joestar killed Kazuya Oka and brutally assaulted Matsumoto before answering a call from their mysterious employer. The violent act was witnessed by Jovian Joestar, Genta Oda, and Sayaka Mizuhara.

Jostin Joestar retreats to the van, but Nobu Takamine refuses to leave until Mikoto and Haruto are safe. In the basement, Yuzuki Hoshino uses the last of her healing energy to mend Jovian Joestar's injuries. Banda pins Mikoto to the ground, prompting Kenji Aoi to intervene by striking Banda with a violet energy bolt. Topside, Haruto Saionji maintains his restraint on Yuji and coordinates with Kaito Arashima to provide cover for Jovian's final assault.

Conversation with Daiki: Jostin Joestar questioned why they were waiting to attack. Daiki explained that he was slowly bleeding off an electrical current to avoid a lethal feedback loop. He warned Jostin not to strike until he gave the signal, as an early attack would cause a surge to kill everyone.

Jovian Joestar uses his Stand's Third Form to knock Goro unconscious, leading Kenji Aoi to forfeit the win in disgust over Goro's cheating. Mikoto Kurogane warns the group of incoming guards as Banda orders subordinates to the arena and the annex. Jostin Joestar ambushes the overseer with Peach Aftershocks, though the overseer remains standing after the attack. Daiki frees one wrist and scrambles for the overseer's dropped keys, urging the others to hold hands.

Jostin Joestar used Peach False Step to snatch the signed document from the Legitimacy captain. As Nobu Takamine warned of approaching police, the captain attacked Kaito Arashima, but was intercepted by Mikoto Kurogane and a Starfall Fist shockwave from Jovian Joestar. The captain survived the blast, while the remaining enforcers formed a human wall to protect him and the idling car. Haruto Saionji traced a Crown Script line to block the car's escape as Ayame Fujinami filmed the brawl and a dark-suited man watched from the doorway.

Jostin Joestar leaps into the lane, using his chain to wound the shelf-guard, pipe-carrier, Lean Watcher, leather-jacketed man, and wiry man. Jovian Joestar delivers an explosive punch to the heavyset woman, hurling her into a stack of crates. Haruto Saionji deploys a massive command seal that heals the Joestar brothers and freezes all enemies in place. Haruto warns that the immobilization is temporary and urges the brothers to attack.

Conversation with Reiko: Reiko informed Jostin Joestar that she was holding the alley mouth against two Kurokawa thugs to protect the rooftop. Jostin confirmed the boy was secure and stated he was retrieving a note. Reiko agreed to hold the line but urged Jostin to move quickly.

Jovian Joestar pins the Minder to the pavement while Mikoto repels the Minder Backup with a shockwave and zip-ties the Minder's wrists. Jostin Joestar retrieves the dropped note and rescues the boy from the vent pole, retreating from the rooftop. Reiko fends off two Kurokawa musclemen, with one warning her that her actions have created a "Kurokawa problem." The group secures the prisoner and returns to Club Lumière's back office to meet Maki Hayashida.

Jovian Joestar frees himself from his captors, while Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to knock back a gang member and demands that no one interfere. Following a phone call, Renji Kuroba orders his gang to stand down and retreat, though he threatens the brothers before leaving. Principal Anya informs the departing students that the academy will review footage of the brawl. Tetsu-san escorts the gang off the street and invites the Joestar brothers to visit his gym.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar asked Riko Amane if she was alright. Riko replied that she was fine but questioned the well-being of others after Jostin had violently attacked them.

Jovian Joestar mocks the defeated attackers while Sayaka Mizuhara warns that further killing will endanger the gym. Ignoring her, Jostin Joestar kills Kazuya Oka with a neck jab and slams Matsumoto's head into the pavement, injuring his own calf in the process. Jostin seizes Matsumoto's ringing phone and answers it, only for an anonymous caller to state that the "bill" has increased before hanging up.

Jovian Joestar taunts Goro into attacking, then uses his Stand, Breaker's Soul, to counter the strike and slam Goro into the fence, exposing Goro's hidden knuckle spike to the crowd. Kenji Aoi expresses disgust at the cheating, but Mikoto Kurogane interrupts him with a Riot Pulse strike. A runner informs Banda that the Handler is down in the annex, prompting the overseer to investigate. Meanwhile, Daiki uses Energy Shunt to weaken his shackles, and Jostin Joestar sets several weak Peach Aftershock charges to ambush the overseer. Haruto Saionji continues to distract the officials, while Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch of the service corridor.

Jovian Joestar bypassed Enforcer 4 using Stardust Dash but failed to stop the Legitimacy captain, who escaped through a side door after Mikoto Kurogane struck him. The captain reached the street, where Kaito Arashima blocked his path to a waiting car while the captain shouted for police to arrest the group for murder. Ayame Fujinami filmed the scene to prove the captain still possessed the signed document, while Reiko Amagawa held back the crowd. Jostin Joestar deployed a Peach Aftershock charge to protect Ayame and wounded Enforcer 1 with a hidden blade. Meanwhile, Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi coordinated via comms to secure the document before an observant, dark-suited man reached the exit.

Jostin Joestar launched a glass volley at Sato, but Sato countered by redirecting debris to wound Jostin and the others. The cable-cutter injured Kaito with an awning cable, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to heal Kaito and Mikoto. After Sato dodged Jostin's blade and absorbed Jovian's charge, Mikoto detonated a Riot Pulse at Sato's knee, allowing Kaito to shoot him with a ricochet bolt. Following Sato's death, the cable-cutter surrendered.

Jovian Joestar charges through the lane, slamming the heavyset woman into a wall. Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to deflect a blade attack and immobilize the wiry man. From the rooftop, Jostin Joestar launches a volley of knives, but the Lean Watcher warns the group, and the wiry man uses crates for cover.

In the ensuing melee, a worker throws a box at Jovian, leaving him open to strikes from the pipe-carrier and the Lean Watcher. The heavyset woman attacks Haruto’s chest to break his focus while the shelf-guard and the man in the leather jacket seal the exits. Haruto orders Jovian to handle the woman and Jostin to pin the workers.

Conversation with suited man 2: Jostin Joestar asked a wounded man in a suit if he had finished bleeding on the pavement. The man responded by spitting blood and claiming that he would be paid regardless of the situation.

Jostin Joestar masks his face and kills Suited Man 2 by stomping his head into the pavement. Jostin then brutally beats Kazuya Oka for threatening his gym and girlfriend, leaving Oka severely injured and barely conscious. Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara attempt to shield Jovian Joestar from the violence, though Jovian watches and mocks the attackers. Matsumoto attempts to surrender, but his phone begins to ring.

Riko Amane cautions Jostin Joestar after his failed attempt while Jovian Joestar meditates and receives equipment from Haruto Saionji. Ayame Fujinami live-streams a sanctioned match between Jovian and Kaito Serizawa, which Tetsu scores by touch. Jovian uses Phantom Strike and Soul Eclipse to score points and throw Kaito, winning the first round.

Jovian Joestar launches a final assault, breaking the broad man's guard and forcing him to his knee. Exhausted, Jostin Joestar collapses behind the bar, though he mentally imprints the pattern of his twin volley attack. The lean man presents a debt ledger for the Tattooed Hostess, who agrees to pay by next week to ensure Reiko's safety. Reiko stands down and warns the lean man she will destroy the boss's operations if the Tattooed Hostess is harassed. The Curvy Hostess takes the ledger, vouching for the payment and ordering the lean man to clean his face.

Jovian confronts the lean man and declares the club under Joestar protection, throwing a glass that cuts the broad man's cheek. Jostin supports this claim and strikes the broad man in the chest with a kinetic-charged cigarette, staggering him. Reiko threatens the men to protect the tattooed hostess, but the lean man warns that her interference will increase the hostess's debt. The broad man blocks Reiko's path and tells her to walk away, while the tattooed hostess begs her sister not to fight.

Jovian Joestar reduces the defensive line to four members to face elites head-on, and Reiko Amagawa coordinates their specific positions and fallback rules for the 6:00 AM confrontation at the canal alley. Jostin Joestar invites Ayame Fujinami to witness the fight and interview shop owners; she agrees to attend as a journalist provided she remains in a safe vantage point. Ayame posts a clip of the night's events to her 200,000 followers, framing the Joestars' arrival as a neighborhood project. The baker warns Jostin that Daigo’s men have a second crew waiting in ambush behind the canal mouth, prompting Rika Saotome to note that the team is preparing for the wrong fight.

Jovian Joestar, exhausted, asks Jostin to handle the situation alone. Jostin uses Blackstar Dominion to knock down two suited men, then hauls them into the street and pins them to the pavement. While Haruto Saionji evacuates the gym's students and Ayame Fujinami streams the event, Jostin demands to know who sent the men. Suited Man 1 refuses to give a name, citing a client, while a third man watches silently from a nearby car.

Hana Kisaragi tells Jostin Joestar that Jovian Joestar is fighting Kaito Serizawa after retrieving Rin's coffee from the Vault. At the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Kaito helps Jovian correct his footwork to successfully execute the "Twin Soul" technique. Riko Amane orders Jostin to perform Stillpoint reps, but Kaito and Genta Oda must pin him to the mat after he lunges violently during a limiter lift attempt.

Jovian Joestar eats takoyaki and taunts Kenji Aoi as Round 2 begins. Banda encourages the crowd to bet against the newcomers, while Haruto Saionji loudly accuses the officials of rigging the ring to distract them from the service corridor. Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch from the roof as Kenji's rune attack is neutralized by the arena's hum. Goro stabs Jovian in the ribs with a hidden knuckle spike, and Mikoto Kurogane strikes Kenji with a Riot Pulse. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar uses Shadow Step to infiltrate the humming room, where he discovers six chained prisoners powering a machine; one prisoner, Daiki, silently warns him not to cut the power too quickly.

Riko Amane orders Jostin and Jovian Joestar to sit and rejects Jostin's claim that he is unsafe around others. Kaito Arashima briefly appears to tell Jovian to warm up on a heavy bag before their rematch. Riko notes the difference between Jostin's destructive energy at Daigo and his controlled pulse tonight, asserting that Jostin is capable of steering his power. She offers to train his control at the gym and insists he participate in Saturday's event.

Jostin Joestar summons his Stand, IFILWPP, and demonstrates its kinetic abilities by using a kusarigama and launching bolts to show Nobu and Hana the specific technical requirements for his equipment. Impressed by the power, Nobu agrees to modify the chain to prevent wrist strain, and Hana agrees to craft reinforced throwing knives. Jostin hires both students and tells them to meet him at Club Lumière after school. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar changes his mind and asks Sera to introduce him to Mikoto and Haruto immediately.

Jovian requests a drink from the petite hostess, who demonstrates her skill by pouring a perfect glass. Jostin asks both the sporty and tattooed hostesses to show him a good time. The sporty hostess claims she is the better choice, while the tattooed hostess offers a strong drink on the condition that Jostin keeps his hands on the table.

Jovian Joestar landed a heavy "Road Hog" strike to Marlon Velez's solar plexus, though a recovered Marlon warned that he still holds a stored charge. Jostin Joestar used "Peach Limit Break" and "Gearshift" to bypass Iori Vale's predictions and stab her shoulder, but Iori quickly recalculated and knocked Jostin down with a shoulder check. At the canal, Reiko Amagawa took a shallow cut from Vera Sable before countering with a "Dragon's Coil" strike that shoved Vera back. In the center, Mikoto Kurogane used a Riot Pulse to break Toma Genda's "Gravity Lock" pin and strike his jaw. Ayame Fujinami livestreams the fights while Daigo Renjiro observes, declaring that the next exchange will decide the district's ownership.

At the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Jostin Joestar completes footwork drills and admits to Riko Amane that he nearly lost control to violent instincts during a recent encounter. Riko warns him that he must build habits to counteract these urges, questioning his views on gangsters to ensure he is not a danger to others before he begins sparring with Kaito Serizawa. Simultaneously, Jovian Joestar encourages Yuzuki Hoshino to explore using her Stand, Verdant Sylph, for defense and combat rather than just healing. Yuzuki expresses tentative excitement at the idea of secret training, though the teahouse proprietor reminds them to keep their "hero talk" quiet.

Jovian Joestar summons Breaker's Soul to defend against a gang assault, while Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to launch pavement debris at the attackers. Several gang members restrain the brothers to ensure the fight is filmed, with Renji Kuroba ordering them to make it look like the brothers started the fight. Principal Anya arrives to observe the brawl, followed by Tetsu-san and his regulars, who intervene to protect the brothers. Tetsu-san challenges Renji's gang to fight the gym crew instead.

Kaito Serizawa attacked with palm-heel strikes, scoring a shallow hit on Jovian Joestar's cheek. Jovian responded with "Fifth Form: Falling Star Palm," blasting Kaito across the mat and causing deep "Soul Burn" cracks on his own arm. Tetsu ended the bout and declared Jovian the winner after Kaito conceded. As Ayame Fujinami streamed the victory, Riko Amane spotted two unknown men in suits entering the gym and demanding to see the broadcaster.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jovian Joestar defeated Kaito Serizawa in their rematch using Falling Star Palm without damaging the gym floor. The victory was witnessed by Tetsu, gym staff, and a live-stream audience.

Jostin Joestar challenged Jovian Joestar to fight without using his Stand. After Tetsu signaled the start of round two, Kaito Serizawa landed a measured strike, which Jovian ignored to drink and pour water over his head. Jovian then used Breaker's Soul's "Heaven's Impact" to slam Kaito into the mat, leaving him winded but conscious. Tetsu and Masaru Hachiya praised Jovian's precision for avoiding collateral damage, while Haruto Saionji noted that Jovian is nearing his physical limit for the night.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jovian Joestar successfully executed Heaven's Impact, driving Kaito Serizawa into the mat with a contained shockwave. Tetsu and several observers confirmed the technique was delivered with precise control over the environment.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jovian Joestar breached the reinforced door to Noa Amemiya's room using Soul Pierce. Noa was found unharmed, though the action alerted nearby guards to their presence.

After Kenji Aoi challenges Jovian Joestar, Yuzuki Hoshino acts as a stand-in fighter and defeats Kenji with help from Mikoto Kurogane and Rikona Mibu. Rikona asks Jostin and Jovian to help rescue abducted debtors, leading Haruto Saionji to organize a mission at a bunker in Steam Lantern Alley. The group infiltrates the facility, where Jovian and Jostin defeat various opponents, including Banda and Tatsuya, to rescue Shun and other captives.

Jovian Joestar mocks Kenji Aoi, who responds by demanding to fight a "wind-user" and claiming to recognize Jovian from school. Haruto Saionji alerts the crew via headset that Kenji's partner has a hidden knuckle spike, prompting Mikoto Kurogane to warn Jovian. In the annex, Jostin Joestar uses "Eagle Vision" to locate prisoners in the humming room and instructs Rikona Mibu to evacuate Shun and the debtors. Nobu Takamine confirms the topside evacuation is complete as Banda rings the bell to start Round 2.

Jovian and Mikoto argue over their team name while Jostin laments the loss of his weapons. Using Eagle Vision, Jostin locates a gold mark behind a guarded door near the betting desk and informs Haruto, who identifies Yuji as the one managing the payouts. Banda announces the start of Tag Night, ordering "Jovian and Friend of Course" to face "Vise & Paper Cut" in the first bout.

Riko Amane leads Jostin Joestar to the weapons room to practice "curve-and-catch" drills with a padded kusarigama. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar activates Zero Form: Sovereign's Will on the training floor, creating a crushing aura that cracks the floor and strains Kaito Serizawa. Tetsu warns Jovian about damaging the facility, emphasizing the importance of control over raw power.

Jovian Joestar attempts to hide his fighting skills by acting like a delinquent, but Kenji Aoi recognizes his stance and challenges him to a fight at the riverbank after school. Haruto Saionji warns Jovian that accepting would link him to the Kobuncho explosion in front of witnesses, while Ayame Fujinami suggests the fight is a strategic opportunity to gain a support mage. A disciplinary teacher intervenes to clear the crowd as Kenji exits the campus, reiterating the challenge.

Jovian and Marlon trade insults, with Marlon noting Jovian's lack of flinching during a feint. Jostin confirms his identity to Iori Vale after receiving a message from Ayame, who is filming from a distance. The other pairs—Vera and Reiko, and Toma and Mikoto—exchange professional warnings and competitive boasts regarding their fighting styles. Daigo Renjiro ends the dialogue and signals for all four auditions to begin.

Conversation with Sato "Sickle": Jostin Joestar asked Sato "Sickle" if he still had two heavies with him. Sato confirmed their presence but warned Jostin that they were not the primary threat to worry about.

Sato deploys Harvest Line and challenges Jovian Joestar, who launches a barrage of strikes. Heavy 5 uses Iron Posture to shield Sato, though Jovian still lands several hits. Jostin Joestar drops from a rooftop, wounding Heavy 5 and Heavy 6 with his kusarigama. Heavy 6 ambushes Kaito Arashima, clipping his shoulder and causing Kaito's ricochet bolt to miss Sato. Mikoto Kurogane uses a Riot Pulse to disrupt Sato's footing, while Yuzuki Hoshino uses Soothing Aura to heal Mikoto and Kaito.

The buzzer signals the start of the battle test. Jovian Joestar manifests Breaker's Soul as the stocky boy strikes him, staggering Jovian back. Simultaneously, the tall girl hits Jostin Joestar in the ribs, and the lean student disrupts Haruto Saionji's gold marks with a projectile. Mikoto uses a shockwave to break the stocky boy's guard, though he maintains his position to block the center of the arena.

Jovian Joestar attempts a "Breaker's Soul" strike, but Genta Oda corrects his wide windup and telegraphing by demonstrating a compact half-step and hip turn. After Sayaka Mizuhara instructs him to keep his rear heel planted for stability, Jovian successfully executes the refined strike. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar requests a spar, leading Riko Amane to teach him a hip-driven jab. Jostin initially struggles with his timing and weight distribution but eventually delivers a crisper punch under Riko's guidance.

Jostin Joestar urged Kaito Serizawa to use a Stand, which Kaito denied having. Kaito launched an Iron Palm Strike at Jovian Joestar, but Jovian used "Soul Eclipse" to catch the blow and throw Kaito onto the mat. Tetsu awarded the first round to Jovian, and Haruto Saionji provided water while checking Jovian's condition. Ayame Fujinami broadcast the counter to her viewers, and Masaru Hachiya logged the technique as Jovian prepared for round two.

Conversation with Kaito Arashima: Jostin Joestar asked Kaito Arashima about his background and the nature of Josuke Higashikata's Stand. Kaito explained that he was once a mercenary who was reformed by Josuke and described Crazy Diamond as a repair-type Stand capable of restoring objects and healing.

Jostin Joestar orders the full crew to mobilize for a strike on Club Kagerō. Jovian Joestar forcibly secures the handler in the sedan and demands the driver head to the club, while Rikona Mibu extracts information about the venue's cameras and exits from the two women. Kaito Arashima coordinates with Haruto Saionji to deploy reinforcements and Nobu Takamine and Rin to investigate the club's ownership. The group arrives at Club Kagerō, noting the presence of bouncers and security cameras.

Jovian Joestar uses Desperation Impact to break Iwao's grip and strike Kiri, creating an opening for Mikoto Kurogane to hit Kiri with a Riot Pulse. Both Iwao and Kiri remain standing, though wounded, causing the crowd to shift their betting odds. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar attempts to knock out Tatsuya from behind, but Tatsuya dodges the blow and calls for guards. Shun retreats in fear as Tatsuya prepares to blow his whistle to alert security.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Kaito Arashima joined the crew as a ranged support specialist after being vouched for by Josuke Higashikata. He made a loud entrance by kicking open the security door of the Club Lumière office.

Riko Amane directs Jostin Joestar through lateral shift exercises, correcting his stance and footwork after he suggests they drill each other. During their spar, Jovian Joestar attempts a sweep he learned from a tutorial, but Genta Oda easily evades the move and pushes Jovian off balance. Sayaka Mizuhara instructs Jovian to focus on Genta's weight distribution before attempting another attack.

Jovian Joestar used a "Desperation Impact" flurry and heel kick to defeat Marlon Velez. Jostin Joestar used "Peach Launcher" to wound Iori Vale's thigh, but Iori countered with a low sweep and wrist strike that knocked him back. Mikoto Kurogane activated "Riot Engine" to break Toma Genda's "Gravity Lock" with a series of explosive strikes, leaving both combatants winded. Reiko Amagawa ignored Vera Sable's "Severline" traps and used "Dragon's Coil" to smash Vera's guard.

The auditions begin with four simultaneous bouts. Iori Vale uses Predictive Frame to strike Jostin Joestar, mocking his repetitive patterns, while Ayame Fujinami films and encourages Jostin. Reiko Amagawa ignores Vera Sable's Severline to land a Dragon's Coil strike, and Mikoto Kurogane uses a Riot Pulse to break Toma Genda's Gravity Lock. Jovian Joestar lands a heavy punch on Marlon Velez, who absorbs the impact to deliver a powerful counter-hook to Jovian's ribs. Daigo Renjiro analyzes the initial exchanges and declares the start of a second round.

Riko Amane informs Jostin Joestar that Jovian's rematch is a test of control to avoid further gym damage. Ayame Fujinami begins live-streaming the event, while Kaito Serizawa agrees to participate provided his corner remains off-camera. Tetsu establishes that the match will be scored by touch rather than damage, warning the fighters against breaking the floor. Jovian Joestar enters the ring and deploys Sovereign's Will, creating a crushing pressure that Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara note is carefully controlled. The match begins with Kaito launching a low jab, which Jovian slips as the two exchange blows.

Jovian Joestar rejects Jostin Joestar's strike plan to prioritize a rematch with Kaito Serizawa at Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Jovian and Haruto Saionji coordinate a recon operation at the Kurosaki lot involving Nobu Takamine, Rin, Kaito Arashima, Hana Kisaragi, Ayame Fujinami, and Mirei Tachibana. After sparring with Reiko Amagawa and declining Jostin's private payment attempt, Jovian arrives at the gym for his match.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Ayame Fujinami discovered Councilor Ohmori's authorization stamp on forged licenses. This revelation suggests the corruption extends to the ward's business licensing committee.

Daigo Renjiro organizes a series of one-on-one "auditions" to test the Joestar crew. He assigns Marlon Velez to Jovian, Vera Sable to Reiko, Toma Genda to Mikoto, and Iori Vale to Jostin. Jostin discovers his Eagle Vision is on cooldown and sends a farewell message to Riko. The fighters take their positions and await Daigo's signal to begin.

Kaito Serizawa corrected Jovian Joestar's footwork, enabling Jovian to successfully execute the "Twin Soul" technique. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar attempted to lift his limiter during Stillpoint reps, causing him to lunge violently toward a heavy bag. Kaito and Genta Oda intercepted and pinned Jostin to the mat to prevent injury. Riko Amane ordered that Jostin must use a spotter for all future attempts at the technique.

Jostin Joestar thanks the group for the training and asks Tetsu for a private area to practice with weapons. Tetsu directs him to a converted storage room, warning Jostin to avoid damaging the walls. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar successfully integrates the technical lessons into a "Breaker's Soul" strike, impressing Genta Oda with the delivery's efficiency. Sayaka Mizuhara notes a slight wobble in Jovian's follow-through and instructs him to keep his heel planted for a final attempt.

Haruto, Rin, and Nobu brief Jovian on a cash delivery at a Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing lot, while Reiko, Mikoto, and Ayame repel two attackers at the shop. Jovian and Jostin establish a two-branch organizational structure and prioritize recruiting an infiltrator and a forge hand. Jostin assigns Ayame to lead the Lantern Network, while Mirei and Maki offer scouting and facility support for the mission.

Jovian Joestar cheers Yuzuki Hoshino from the overlook, while Jostin Joestar asks Rikona Mibu why she assisted the fight; Rikona cites her hatred of seeing others beaten for entertainment. Kenji Aoi launches a final violet beam that wounds Yuzuki, but she counters with a spiraling green storm and dives to defeat him. As the crowd celebrates and Yuji manages payouts, Ayame Fujinami records the victory and Haruto Saionji warns the group to prepare for a quick departure.

Jostin Joestar sprints toward the park entrance to buy Chiikawa merchandise, nearly knocking over Ayame Fujinami. Ayame agrees to film Jostin eating takoyaki for her channel if he visits the first stall. Jovian Joestar, Yuzuki Hoshino, and Haruto Saionji explore the park, where Yuzuki offers to buy everyone taiyaki. Haruto discusses his restrictive upbringing with Hana Kisaragi, who provides Jovian with takoyaki and settles in to observe the surroundings.

Jostin Joestar registers his ability, 「I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH」, which absorbs and redirects kinetic energy through touch. Jovian Joestar registers Breaker's Soul, a physical-class humanoid Stand that fights alongside him. Hoshino approves both forms, issues black wristbands and signup slips, and informs Jovian that his entity requires a supervised control assessment.

Jostin Joestar asks Hana Kisaragi why Jovian is fighting Kaito Serizawa; Hana explains that Serizawa requested a rematch and Jovian agreed. Rin mandates that Jostin retrieve her coffee from the Vault before Hana will build the cord spools. Meanwhile, Jovian arrives at the gym for his rematch, and Kaito Serizawa invites him to warm up on the heavy bags before their 8:00 PM match.

Jovian Joestar accuses Rin of being a spy after recognizing her as a former clerk from the House. Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to confirm Rin is not a threat, while Haruto Saionji and Reiko Amagawa note her familiarity and composure. Rin explains she applied for the position because she lost her job when the House collapsed and expresses her hatred for her former employers. Nobu Takamine stipulates that a probation clause would apply if she is hired, and Ayame Fujinami supports the hire for its narrative appeal.

Haruto Saionji texts Jostin Joestar instructions for the day, designating Jostin as the extraction lead for the upcoming rematch at Tetsu Gym. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar spars with Reiko Amagawa in the alley behind Club Lumiere to warm up his reflexes. Reiko enforces light contact and grapples, ultimately advising Jovian to fix his footing on right-hand strikes before the match.

Ayame Fujinami tasked Jostin Joestar with protecting the Amemiya shop and tracking a courier to trace Marumo Financial Services funds. Haruto, Nobu, Kaito, and Jostin monitored the courier, Kenjiro Sato, as he delivered cash to a vehicle identified by Rin as a Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing lease. Simultaneously, Yoshida and Kato attempted to seize inventory from the Amemiya shop while being blocked by Reiko and Mikoto and filmed by Ayame.

Conversation with Rin: Jovian Joestar commented that Rin's personality had changed following a makeover, but Rin denied this, claiming the new look only enhanced her sarcasm. Rin further clarified that her loyalty to the Joestar Gang was based on the steady pay and the lack of physical abuse compared to previous employment.

Jovian Joestar retreats to nap and requests that Rin forge a school excuse letter so he can focus on his upcoming rematch. Haruto Saionji finalizes the recon operation, with Kaito Arashima pairing with Maki Hayashida for rooftop scouting and Nobu Takamine pairing with Hana Kisaragi for drone surveillance. After Jostin Joestar returns to the academy dorms, Haruto reports the next morning that a grey sedan visited the lot briefly near dawn.

Jovian Joestar and Rikona Mibu investigate Noa Amemiya's disappearance with Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine. Jovian and Jostin Joestar track a man in a grey jacket to a club, where they incapacitate guards and intercept a suited man's getaway van. The team infiltrates Club Kagerō, where Jovian rescues Noa from a reinforced room after Jostin and Jovian interrogate a records manager regarding a 4.6 million yen debt.

After Jovian Joestar secures a trial cash placement for Haruto Saionji from a senior account manager, the crew coordinates two simultaneous operations. Jostin, Kaito, and Haruto handle the cash pickup at Shutter Alley in Kobuncho, while Mikoto, Reiko, Ayame, and Yuzuki protect Noa's shop. Nobu and Hana provide operational support through mapping and financial verification before the teams deploy to their respective locations.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Haruto Saionji detailed the structure of Daigo Renjiro's organization, identifying the four pillars of its power. Reiko Amagawa and Jovian Joestar agreed to target the 'Legitimacy' pillar first to strip Daigo of his public and legal protections.

After collectors attempt to post a notice on a shop, Haruto Saionji and his crew trace the collectors' vehicle to Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing. To locate Marumo's cash runs before a sundown deadline, Haruto and Jovian Joestar infiltrate the leasing branch posing as wealthy clients using forged documents from Nobu Takamine. While Hana Kisaragi and Mikoto Kurogane provide exterior backup, the receptionist begins an audit that prompts Nobu to tell the duo to end the interaction.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji organize a lean search-and-rescue team consisting of Jovian, Jostin, Rikona, and Kaito. After Jostin promises Noa's parents he will find her, he uses Eagle Vision to tail a man in a grey jacket to a shuttered club. Nobu Takamine confirms Noa's phone last pinged at that same location. The team converges at the club, where Jostin reports two watchers and movement inside the building.

Daigo Kurosawa questions Jovian Joestar on whether Lumière serves the whole neighborhood or only his own people, warning that the club's stance toward the local "order" will determine its future. Jostin Joestar avoids Sayaka Mizuhara's request for paperwork to lead Rika Saotome onto the dance floor. Meanwhile, Maki Hayashida confirms the venue's legitimacy to Sayaka, who subsequently agrees to support the toast, and Hana Kisaragi hangs the Iron Palm banner. Mikoto Kurogane continues to monitor the tense conversation at the bar via earpiece.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar arrive at Club Lumière, where Reiko directs the assembled crew to prepare their gear in the back office. Aurelia Voss presents ownership transfer documents, and Jovian officially registers the property as "Club Lumière" before signing the paperwork. Once the legal transfer is complete, Reiko summons the brothers for the crew briefing.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar enter Club Lumiere, which is currently closed for repairs. They are greeted by five hostesses who are cleaning and prepping the venue. Jostin singles out the Sporty Hostess, while the Tattooed Hostess questions the brothers' claim of ownership.

Aurelia Voss confirms she is the Joestars' official Speedwagon Foundation contact and coordinated the crew's branding and gear, noting the new crew is waiting at a nearby safehouse. Kaede Shishido expresses skepticism regarding the Foundation's rapid decision-making. Maki Hayashida, Natsumi Arai, and Chiho Moriyama urge the brothers to visit Gara in Shutter Alley before midnight to address their declared war on the boss.

After Jovian and Jostin Joestar support Mikoto Kurogane's proposal to fight debt collectors, Haruto Saionji assigns the crew roles to track the lenders and prepare gear. The group confronts two collectors from Marumo Financial Services at Noa Amemiya's shop in Tower Five, where Ayame Fujinami films the encounter. The collectors demand 7.8 million yen by the following sundown, threatening to seize inventory, while Collector 2 calls for backup.

Jostin Joestar calls Sonobe to ensure he stays safe and ready to testify tomorrow, noting that Kaito will monitor him. Ayame Fujinami confirms Sonobe will protect the original documents and directs Jostin and Jovian to help her cross-check dates and signatures. Haruto Saionji organizes the files and identifies three missing original entries needed to solidify the case. Reiko Amagawa offers to provide food and assist with double-checking the payout schedule.

Jostin Joestar steals the payout satchel from Yuji and scatters the cash into the crowd, causing a chaotic scramble that allows a dazed Seiran student to escape. Rikona Mibu expresses anger at being treated like a project, though she allows Jostin to lead her away. Haruto Saionji assists a stumbling Yuzuki Hoshino and Jovian Joestar toward the exit as Kenji Aoi vows revenge. The group converges on the campus-footbridge, with Mikoto Kurogane and Nobu Takamine securing the rear.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin and Jovian successfully captured the Kurokawa minder and secured the stolen cash bag and intelligence. The operation was witnessed by the Kurokawa muscle and the captured courier.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for a probation period in the Command division, where she implements a financial plan and event protocols approved by Jovian Joestar and Nobu Takamine. The team successfully manages a trial event at Club Lumière with the help of Jostin, Hana Kisaragi, and Yuzuki Hoshino. Later, Rikona Mibu informs Jovian and Jostin that debt collectors are targeting the Amemiya family shop, leading Jostin to invite Rikona to join their crew.

Jostin Joestar bids Rikona Mibu and Shun farewell as they reach their destination. After Rikona ensures Shun enters his home, Jovian Joestar wakes and discovers that Haruto Saionji stole a duffel bag of money during the fight to fund a safehouse. Following teasing from Mikoto Kurogane and Ayame Fujinami, Nobu Takamine completes the debtor drop-offs and asks the crew where to regroup.

Jostin and Jovian wake up and prepare for their day. On Saturday night, the brothers meet Nobu, Haruto, Kaito, Reiko, and Rikona at Steam Lantern Alley to plan a rescue mission at The House. Nobu notes that red tokens are required for entry, leading Kaito to take overwatch on a roof and Reiko to secure the alley exit. Rikona asks the group to bring her neighbor's son, Saturday, home safely.

Jovian Joestar knocks out the barrel-chested fighter with a roundhouse kick, prompting Old Man Koga to grant him access to the captain's office on the condition that he enters alone. At the licensing office, Sonobe identifies the captain's courier as Genda Shuji, who visits on Mondays and Wednesdays. Ayame Fujinami and Yuzuki Hoshino urge Jostin Joestar to choose between ambushing Sonobe's location or pursuing the courier lead before they leave the building.

Jovian Joestar pulls Jostin Joestar aside to question if Satoshi Tsuge knows they are a gang; Jostin denies telling him and claims the role is simply managing legal establishments. During the interview, Tsuge provides specific financial figures from his history and correctly identifies a balancing error in a ledger provided by Nobu Takamine. Reiko Amagawa notes that Tsuge appears genuine and nervous, while Hana Kisaragi monitors the street. Tsuge then asks for clarification on the nature of the businesses, noting that their accounts look unusual.

Jostin Joestar scales a water tower bracket to secure a vantage point while Jovian Joestar requests that Mikoto join the group at Shutter Alley. Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian's bruises before the group is admitted into a hidden workshop by a man named Gara. After reviewing their evidence, Gara reveals that Daigo Renjiro is the boss behind the protection racket and is systematically seizing control of Kobuncho.

Jostin questions the two men and the tattooed hostess, prompting the lean man to warn him to stay out of their business. The Sporty Hostess and Petite Hostess urgently signal the brothers to remain quiet. A woman named Reiko arrives and intercepts the men, claiming the tattooed hostess's debt as her own problem to ensure the payment deadline is honored. The lean man acknowledges the situation but warns Reiko that the boss does not grant extensions.

Jovian Joestar, Hana Kisaragi, Jostin Joestar, and Kaito Arashima escort Noa Amemiya to Club Lumière after Jostin attacks one of Daigo Renjiro's men. Haruto Saionji instructs the group to target Daigo's subordinates, while Reiko Amagawa guards Noa's family shop and Maki Hayashida provides Noa with a room. After Rin reveals Noa's debt has increased to 7.8 million yen, Haruto calls for a final group decision on whether to pay the debt or fight the collectors.

Jovian Joestar and Rin review the club's budget and projected attendance, noting a need to renegotiate with a Lantern street vendor. Jostin Joestar provides a drink to Rikona Mibu before initiating a discussion about debt collectors targeting the Amemiya shop. Maki Hayashida, Airi, and Sena reveal that Noa Amemiya is missing and unresponsive after leaving for an errand.

Jovian Joestar notifies Haruto and Reiko via earpiece that the collector was hijacked by a puppeteer and that the team is returning to Gara. Kaito Arashima scouts the rooftops and clears the route while Mikoto Kurogane guards the rear. As the group exits the market into Kobuncho, they encounter a residential fire where firefighters are unable to reach a trapped woman on the second floor.

Jovian Joestar confronts the Minder, questioning him about the missing bag and his potential ties to Kurokawa. The Minder attempts to pursue a fleeing teenager, but the Retired Hero intervenes by ordering him to keep his weapon visible. Mikoto and Reiko provide tactical support, while Haruto Saionji confirms the alley mouth is secure as the remaining teenagers scatter.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar spend a quiet Saturday morning in the Sakura Lane common lounge. Jovian expresses boredom with the city's stillness, while Jostin advises him to enjoy the peace and avoid picking fights.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar facilitate the escape of Noa Amemiya and others from Club Kagerō, which Jostin collapses using "Peach Aftershock" after attacking a man in a dark suit. While Yuzuki Hoshino treats Noa’s injuries and Kaito Arashima leads the group toward a getaway vehicle to evade police, Haruto Saionji informs them that Noa's family's 4.6 million yen debt remains active. Jovian Joestar tells Haruto they will target the debt collectors, and the group plans to pursue leads from Rikona Mibu and a courier at Club Lumière.

Jovian Joestar enters the underground fighting pit alone to find the Enforcement captain, while Reiko Amagawa and Mikoto Kurogane follow the masked vigilante to investigate the stolen equipment. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar, Ayame Fujinami, and Yuzuki Hoshino travel to meet a licensing officer but encounter three men attempting to rob a support technician. A squirrel perched on a lamppost provides theatrical commentary for the confrontation, prompting the trio to decide whether to intervene.

Jovian Joestar commands Kaito Arashima to intercept the enemy and Yuzuki Hoshino to evacuate the shops. Kaito halts Sato with a cable-bow shot, while Yuzuki successfully warns the tofu shopkeepers to hide. Jostin Joestar attacks the heavies with throwing knives, wounding two, as three additional enforcers arrive to flank the group. Sato orders Heavy 1 to track Kaito and Heavy 2 to cut off Yuzuki's escape route.

Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jostin Joestar, who then offers Ayame Fujinami a high-paying contract to lead the gang's media division. Haruto Saionji and Reiko Amagawa pitch a plan to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's legitimacy through targeted exposure, though Ayame demands guarantees regarding creative control and source protection. Meanwhile, Reiko directs Jovian Joestar toward Daigo's Enforcement captain via an illegal underground fight circuit, which Jovian eagerly accepts.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar interrogate a records manager to locate Noa Amemiya, who is being held until a 4.6 million yen debt is paid. While Nobu Takamine and Kaito Arashima manage security feeds and evacuations, Jostin assaults the manager to extract information. Jovian eventually breaks into a reinforced room and finds Noa, while the group prepares for the arrival of police and enemy reinforcements.

Conversation with Rikona Mibu: Jostin Joestar noted that Rikona Mibu seemed on edge. Rikona admitted there was a problem near her block that she could not fix alone.

Rikona Mibu leads Jovian and Jostin Joestar to the center of the roof to speak privately. Rikona reports that debt collectors, including one she recognizes from her past, have been loitering around the Amemiya family shop. She reveals that Noa, the hostess at the Joestars' club, is the daughter of the Amemiyas. Jostin promises to keep an eye on the situation to protect their associate.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin Joestar successfully snatched the forged authorization from the Legitimacy captain's jacket. The party engaged the captain in a street brawl as police sirens approached, while bystanders and a mysterious observer filmed the encounter.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Jostin Joestar defeated Iori Vale after disarming himself to prove his sincerity, leading her to agree to try changing her life. Daigo Renjiro then activated a remote control mechanism, seizing control of the defeated elites' bodies.

Maki Hayashida, Ayame Fujinami, Haruto Saionji, and Reiko Amagawa plan to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's legitimacy branch by targeting the Enforcement captain, Intelligence hub, and Finance office. The group collects falsified records from Sonobe and money from a warehouse before Jovian Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, and Jostin Joestar fight enforcers and steal documents from the captain. Haruto Saionji and his team publicly expose the captain through a forged document, resulting in the captain's arrest and an order for the team to avoid Kobuncho for one week.

Jostin Joestar and Rin discuss their respective roles in sales and logistics. Jovian Joestar successfully sells three bottles of champagne to a booth of regulars, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to gain confidence and secure another sale. Nobu Takamine audits the champagne transactions while Ayame Fujinami streams the event to her followers. By eleven, Rin reports that attendance and revenue have exceeded projections by twenty percent.

Jovian Joestar approves Rin's financial plan on a trial basis, starting with event nights tonight, though Yuzuki Hoshino requests a written proposal before agreeing to the bathhouse bundles. Ayame Fujinami promotes the event via a teaser stream, while Nobu Takamine and Haruto Saionji establish strict auditing and funding protocols for the operating float. At nine o'clock, Hana Kisaragi manages the door as guests enter Club Lumière to begin the trial run.

Jostin Joestar uses "Peach Healing" to stabilize Jovian's injuries. Haruto Saionji disarms the defeated guards and separates them to prevent regrouping. The wiry man reveals that the recent payment was a test by Kurokawa and identifies Ohba at the nearby old bathhouse as the person in charge of the protection route. Haruto demands the guards leave the children alone and declares that the group will head to the bathhouse.

Yuzuki Hoshino used her healing abilities to treat Noa Amemiya's injuries while Jovian Joestar coordinated an escape route via comms with Nobu Takamine. Jostin Joestar used his "Peach Aftershock" ability to collapse Club Kagerō into the earth, an event that prompted Rikona Mibu to evacuate the building and Mikoto Kurogane and Reiko Amagawa to clear the crowd. The man in the dark suit remained behind, stating that the organization's debts still exist despite the destruction. Kaito Arashima rallied the group to head toward the canal walkway to evade approaching police.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorLocationChange
Description: Jostin Joestar used Peach Aftershock to collapse the front facade of Club Kagerō, burying the building's records. This act of destruction was witnessed by the evacuees, security staff, and the man in the dark suit on Neon Lantern Street.

After learning from two women that Noa was taken to Club Kagerō, Jostin Joestar and his crew mobilize to rescue her. Jovian Joestar captures a handler to force entry into the club, while Kaito Arashima, Rikona Mibu, Haruto Saionji, Nobu Takamine, and Rin provide tactical support and intelligence. Using his abilities, Jostin bypasses security and reaches a man in the monitor room on the second floor.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Jostin Joestar released a massive wave of raw pressure that knocked out multiple people across the Kobuncho district. The event was witnessed by the entire party and numerous civilians and enemies in the surrounding area.

In the fighting pit, Jovian Joestar uses Breaker's Soul to slam the Barrel-Chested Fighter against the cage wall and follows up with a brutal combination. Old Man Koga demands Jovian finish the fight to earn his place. At the Licensing Services, Sonobe gives Ayame Fujinami a notebook of copied records, revealing the folder by the kettle is bait and that he has further duplicates hidden. Jostin Joestar tells Sonobe to leave the bait in place, while Yuzuki Hoshino learns that the captain arrives every Thursday with two guards.

Jovian Joestar, Jostin, Rikona, and Kaito form a rescue team to find Noa. After tailing a man in a grey jacket to a club, Jovian and Jostin incapacitate guards and interrogate witnesses who reveal a man in a dark suit was monitoring the area. Jostin stops the suited man's getaway van with a kusarigama, forcing the handler to exit the vehicle.

After Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane, the group defeats Banda, allowing Haruto Saionji to seize a ledger proving Banda stole from Daigo. The Joestar Gang allocates these funds for repairs and a safehouse, later celebrating their victory with a meal and a livestream. Following several failed interviews, the group hires Rin, a former House clerk, under a probation clause.

Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to verify that Gara is telling the truth about his motives and the mission. Gara urges the group to hurry as "Sickle" Sato's crew is already moving toward the first target. Kaito Arashima spots Sato and his heavies approaching the tofu shop and requests orders, while Yuzuki Hoshino heads to warn the shopkeepers. Jovian Joestar leads the team to the canal, where they establish a tactical position as Sato arrives at the first shop.

Jovian Joestar recruits Rikona Mibu to help investigate Noa Amemiya's disappearance, and they later meet with Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine at Club Lumière. Rikona describes three debt collectors seen near the Amemiya shop while Nobu tracks Noa's phone using a thread from Airi Kurosawa. Jostin Joestar visits the Amemiya shop, learns about an anonymous cash envelope, and observes an unidentified man in a grey jacket leaving the area.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully retreated to Club Lumière after exposing the Legitimacy captain's corruption. The evidence was broadcast on the noon news, confirming the captain's arrest and the public nature of the scandal.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar questioned if they had arrived at the correct bathhouse. Haruto Saionji confirmed the location and explained that while Ohba operated out of the establishment, the priority was for the group to be patched up by Yuzuki.

Jostin Joestar notices a small green spirit beside Yuzuki Hoshino, whom Haruto Saionji identifies as an untrained Stand. Yuzuki completes the healing of Jovian Joestar's ribs, causing Jovian to fall into a deep sleep. Haruto informs Jostin that they plan to confront Ohba tomorrow to force him to give up the Kurokawa protection route. The group wakes the following morning, and Yuzuki provides breakfast for the recovered Jovian and Jostin.

Jovian Joestar pins Banda's wrist to prevent him from using a syringe, allowing Mikoto Kurogane to knock Banda unconscious with a Riot Pulse. Haruto Saionji seizes Yuji's duffel bag and orders the runner to flee. After Kenji Aoi departs and Kaito Arashima clears the rooftop, the crew retreats to the van as sirens approach. Nobu Takamine drives the group, including a rescued Shun, away from the docks.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar prepare to leave for Shutter Alley to find Gara. Jovian requests that Aurelia Voss and Maki Hayashida handle the club's paperwork and various facility upgrades; Aurelia agrees to the repairs and car service but refuses to clear Kaede's debts, citing it as a negotiation matter. Maki instructs the brothers to use her name when speaking with Gara, while the other women offer warnings and well-wishes for their departure.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar promise to protect the club and keep the Kurokawa syndicate's power in check. Reiko, the lean man, and the hostesses warn the brothers that their actions were a declaration of war and that the boss will respond with overwhelming force. The staff highlights the financial burden of repairs and the danger their presence poses to the non-combatant employees. The Curvy Hostess suggests they contact a man named Gara in Shutter Alley to fix the club and navigate the ward's back routes.

Ayame and Nobu inform Jovian that Rikona Mibu requested a meeting on the roof at lunch. After a surprise quiz from Yamada, Jovian and Jostin Joestar meet Rikona, who reports that debt collectors are loitering near the Amemiya family shop. Rikona reveals that Noa is the Amemiyas' daughter and that the shop previously provided free food to her brother; Jostin promises to monitor the situation and invites Rikona to join their crew.

Jostin Joestar rescues the older woman from the second floor and leaps from the window, landing in Yuzuki Hoshino's designated medical zone. Yuzuki uses her abilities to treat the woman's smoke inhalation and injuries. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar attempts to help the firefighters by spraying a toy water blaster into the building, drawing a dry comment from Kaito Arashima. Following the rescue, Jostin suggests it is time to visit Gara.

Jovian Joestar gathers customer feedback at Lumière, where Rin logs complaints and Maki Hayashida removes Jostin Joestar from the bar. Following a successful night, Haruto Saionji denies Jovian's request to skip school at Chikara Academy, and the group attends homeroom under Nobu Takamine's supervision. Jovian approves Rin's budget requests for discounted cover charges and sound caps before the team returns to school on Monday.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorRevelation
Description: Jostin Joestar revealed the name of the raw power he unleashed as 'Blackstar Dominion' while receiving medical treatment. The event was overheard by Maki Hayashida and observed by the remaining crew members at Club Lumière.

Jostin Joestar disrupts Ayame Fujinami's promotional stream with a loud, cheerful appearance to welcome guests to Club Lumière. Jovian Joestar mingles with regulars to gauge their reactions to the new management and agrees to reserve the best booths in exchange for their word-of-mouth support. At the bar, Nobu Takamine audits the first hour's cash, while Hana Kisaragi collects cover charges at the door and Yuzuki Hoshino provides guest service. Rin reports to Jovian that the first hour's attendance is slightly below projection, though higher drink spending is keeping gross revenue on track.

Jovian Joestar tastes his own tea and discovers it is awful, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to admit she disliked it. Jostin Joestar messages Aurelia Voss to settle Rikona Mibu's debt and then privately confesses to Rikona that he was raised in a lethal branch of the Joestar family. Rikona maintains her demand for a receipt before deciding to help and departs. Reiko Amagawa confronts Jostin about his burdens, while Haruto Saionji leads Mikoto, Nobu, and Ayame into the back office for a gear check.

Jostin Joestar celebrates the team's first full-scale operation. Haruto Saionji instructs the crew to lie low for a week to heal and avoid Kobuncho. The crew members remove their uniforms and begin maintaining their gear, while Hana Kisaragi provides Jostin with a cold pack for his shoulder.

Jovian Joestar instructs the group to disperse and meet at the riverbank at 4:00 PM to avoid Seiran spies. Jostin Joestar questions Rikona Mibu about her debts, prompting her to reveal she wants to move away with her brother, though she refuses his financial help and remains noncommittal about attending the fight. Hana Kisaragi warns that a student may tip off Aoi about the stand-in, while Ayame Fujinami coordinates Yuzuki Hoshino's disguise. Haruto Saionji assigns tactical roles to Mikoto, Nobu, Ayame, and Hana before the group splits up at the noon bell.

Jostin Joestar introduces the group to Rikona Mibu, who reveals she is a second-year Support track student specializing in barriers, debuffs, and mending. Rikona questions the crew's motives for intervening, but Haruto Saionji clarifies they have no ulterior motives. Meanwhile, Ayame Fujinami reports that bets are already being placed on the rumored fight at the riverbank scheduled for 4:00 PM.

On the second day at Chikara Academy, Jovian Joestar wakes up as Jostin Joestar emerges from his room, noting he overslept and texting Ayame. Rikona Mibu approaches them in the hallway, presenting a receipt proving her debt is paid. She asks Jostin for help recovering her neighbor's sixteen-year-old son, who was abducted by Kurokawa's Enforcement captain to fight in an underground circuit called "The House" this Saturday.

Jovian Joestar declares a majority vote to make Yuzuki Hoshino the mystery fighter. Yuzuki agrees on the condition that she remains anonymous, no one bets on her, and she is pulled out immediately if she begins to lose, which Haruto Saionji accepts. After a passing student potentially overhears them, Ayame Fujinami and Nobu Takamine coordinate a disguise and a tactical plan for Mikoto Kurogane to assist Yuzuki. Hana Kisaragi reluctantly agrees provided the crew avoids betting and lies low afterward, while Rikona Mibu remains undecided on attending.

Jovian Joestar strikes Jostin Joestar on the back and convinces him to visit Club Lumière instead of an izakaya. The two men enter the club, where they are greeted by a woman in a sequined jacket. The hostess informs them that lunch sets are available until two and asks if they are there to eat or browse.

Jovian Joestar urged Rikona Mibu to join their investigation, prompting Jostin Joestar to pat her head. After Rikona reacted with annoyance, she agreed to help with the case out of obligation to the Amemiyas. Rikona specified she is not joining the crew and will meet them at Club Lumière after school.

Jovian Joestar questioned Rikona Mibu regarding her personal investment in the situation. Rikona revealed she is helping because the Amemiya shop fed her brother on credit without asking for payment. Jostin Joestar invited Rikona to join their crew, though she deflected the offer.

Jostin Joestar promotes Club Lumière through guest interactions and a bar dance, while Jovian Joestar manages sales and instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to prioritize expensive bottles. Nobu Takamine, Hana Kisaragi, and Rin handle financial auditing, door charges, and attendance reports. By eleven, the team exceeds revenue and attendance projections, and Haruto Saionji confirms his trust in Yuzuki's performance.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully evacuated the arena with the rescued prisoners and secured a ledger revealing Banda's embezzlement from Daigo. This operation was streamed by Ayame, causing the defeat of The House to trend socially.

Jovian Joestar encourages Yuzuki Hoshino to demonstrate her battle warrior fusion. After Rikona Mibu identifies a seam in Aoi's barriers, Yuzuki leads the group to a secluded yard and performs a powerful cast that cracks concrete, though she struggles to control the energy. Mikoto Kurogane gives a conditional yes vote based on the power, while Hana Kisaragi remains opposed due to potential exposure. Ayame Fujinami supports the stand-in for content purposes, and Haruto Saionji calls for a final tally, asking for Yuzuki's personal consent.

The crew tries on their new cobalt blue and white streetwear provided by Aurelia. Hana, Nobu, and Mikoto praise the quality and functional design of the clothing. Haruto notes that the color change effectively masks their identities while they are on break, and Ayame takes a private group photo to commemorate the new uniforms.

Jostin Joestar follows Nobu Takamine into the lab wing, attempting to bond over their intelligence despite Nobu noting they share no classes. In the main hall, Jovian Joestar expresses a desire to find Renji to see if he is following the rules. Yuzuki Hoshino warns Jovian that Principal Anya will shut everything down if another incident occurs, while Mikoto Kurogane reminds Jovian of the 5 PM meeting.

Banda pits Jovian and Mikoto against Iwao and Kiri, while Jostin and Kaito rescue Shun and other debtors from Tatsuya in a concrete annex. Jovian defeats Goro and Kenji Aoi in the ring and later fights Banda, while Haruto and Kaito trap Yuji to recover stolen cash and ledgers. Simultaneously, Jostin and Daiki ambush an overseer in the humming room to free six casters before Jostin retreats to Yuzuki Hoshino for treatment.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for a one-month probation in the Command division, where Nobu Takamine and Jovian Joestar task her with managing finances and coordinating a safehouse build. Rin presents a financial plan to Jovian Joestar involving event nights, sponsorships for Ayame Fujinami, and new suppliers, which is approved on a trial basis. Following a makeover by Ayame, the group implements auditing protocols and Hana Kisaragi manages the door for the trial event at Club Lumière.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: The party successfully concluded the trial operational night at Club Lumière, exceeding revenue projections by twenty-two percent. Rin identified necessary adjustments for pricing and volume to optimize future events.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: longRest
Description: The party spent the night recovering at the bathhouse under the care of Yuzuki Hoshino. Haruto Saionji revealed to Jostin Joestar that Yuzuki possesses an unmanifested Stand.

Jovian elbows Jostin in the ribs and claims the venue is better than a dive bar.
