Five hostesses emerge from the back curtain: a tattooed woman, a curvy woman, a petite girl, a statuesque woman, and a sporty woman. The sporty hostess notes the early hour while the tattooed hostess dismisses the brothers as kids. The curvy hostess invites them to sit and asks who ordered the spicy curry.

Jostin Joestar performs a choreographed dance on the bar to entertain the crowd, which Rin notes has increased the average tab by fifteen percent. Ayame Fujinami streams the performance before ending her broadcast, while Hana Kisaragi and Nobu Takamine express concerns over potential property damage and financial losses. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar encourages Yuzuki Hoshino, and Haruto Saionji tells Jovian that he trusts Yuzuki's performance and wants to keep her on the crew.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar reject Satoshi Tsuge and Ginji Ozu after interviews involving financial tests and salary demands. Haruto Saionji then introduces Rin, a former House clerk whom Jovian suspects of spying. After Jostin confirms she is not a threat, Nobu Takamine and Ayame Fujinami agree to hire Rin under a probation clause.

MAJOR EVENT
Type: majorMilestone
Description: Yuzuki Hoshino officially joined the group after accepting a Joestar gang kimono from Hana Kisaragi. The core crew and support staff of Club Lumière welcomed her as their new crewmate.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar join a group including Haruto, Ayame, and Rikona to plan a rescue mission at "The House," with Haruto organizing roles for distraction, infiltration, and support. Before the mission, the brothers visit Tetsu Iron Palm Gym where Riko Amane trains Jostin in kusarigama drills and Tetsu forces Jovian to practice power control after he damages the facility. Later, at Steam Lantern Alley, the group executes a plan involving Nobu's drone and red tokens to enter a bunker arena where a humming sound dampens Mikoto's powers.

Jostin Joestar posts a treasurer job listing that Nobu Takamine edits, while Haruto Saionji and Hana Kisaragi manage budget and repair allocations. The Joestar Gang celebrates their victory over Daigo's captains with a meal prepared by Yuzuki Hoshino, featuring a livestream by Ayame Fujinami and toasts from the crew. The following morning, the group interviews a job applicant named Satoshi Tsuge regarding his professional history and probation terms.
The final confrontation of this circuit's lifecycle is planned to take place at the abandoned Harumi Wharf warehouse, where the most successful 'assets' are liquidated.

Jostin Joestar proposes fortifying both the club and the bathhouse via an underground tunnel. Hana Kisaragi completes Jovian Joestar's power knuckles and offers to survey the foundations for the project. Nobu and Reiko suggest utilizing existing service and drainage tunnels to save time and avoid detection, a plan Yuzuki Hoshino reluctantly accepts provided her grandmother's tiles remain intact.

Jovian Joestar and Yuzuki Hoshino travel to the ruins of the old bathhouse district for combat training. After Jovian clears the area of witnesses, Yuzuki identifies a stray dog named Bin and suggests training in the windowless corner of the old women's bath. Meanwhile, at the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Riko Amane explains to Jostin Joestar that her footwork skills were taught by her late mother, a courier. Riko acknowledges Jostin's improvement and offers him one honest answer to any question.

summaries.text: Jovian and Jostin Joestar spend a quiet Saturday morning in the Sakura Lane common lounge. Jovian expresses boredom with the city's stillness, while Jostin advises him to enjoy the peace and avoid picking fights.
Jostin Joestar steps onto the balcony to smoke. Inside, Jovian Joestar receives a notification from the academy. Jovian informs Jostin that all initiates must register for Pulse by tonight.

Jovian and Jostin agree to register for Pulse immediately to avoid long lines at the campus gate. Jovian expresses a desire for the brothers to be well-known at the academy, while Jostin focuses on the logistical requirements. Jostin gathers his belongings and prompts Jovian to follow him out of the building.

Jovian and Jostin travel from Sakura Lane to Chikara Academy to register for Pulse. Upon arrival, Jovian bypasses the main ID line to approach a side table managed by a staff member named Hoshino. Hoshino provides them with Ability Declaration forms and asks them to name and describe their powers for registration.

Jostin Joestar registers his ability, 「I FELL IN LOVE WITH PRINCESS PEACH」, which absorbs and redirects kinetic energy through touch. Jovian Joestar registers Breaker's Soul, a physical-class humanoid Stand that fights alongside him. Hoshino approves both forms, issues black wristbands and signup slips, and informs Jovian that his entity requires a supervised control assessment.

Jostin Joestar informs Hoshino that his ability is a physical-class manifest Stand, leading Hoshino to update the registration and mandate a supervised assessment for Jostin. After leaving, the Joestar brothers encounter Renji Kuroba, a second-year student, in the plaza. Renji mocks the brothers for being newcomers, prompting a verbal confrontation between Renji and Jovian.

Jovian Joestar dismisses Renji Kuroba, who warns the brothers to stay away until their assessments are complete. Jostin and Jovian leave the academy grounds and visit a convenience store for coffee. Outside, Jostin witnesses a student shove a boy distributing flyers for the Tetsu "Iron Palm" Gym. Jostin notices a gym business card among the scattered flyers on the pavement.

Jostin Joestar hauls the scrawny kid up to ask about the Tetsu gym, and the kid explains the facility's offerings and its inclusive rule. Jovian Joestar mocks Renji Kuroba for bullying and tells him to walk away. Renji threatens the brothers, warning them that he will make their first day memorable if they do not leave.

Jovian Joestar challenges Renji Kuroba to fight. Jostin Joestar warns Renji to walk away and accepts the invitation to visit the Tetsu gym. Renji uses his "Gravity Crush" ability to slam Jovian into the pavement, cracking the stone. Jovian recovers and resumes his fighting stance despite his injuries.

Jovian Joestar uses Breaker's Soul to slam Renji Kuroba's face into the pavement and kicks him across the plaza. Renji shouts to the crowd that the freshmen are jumping a second-year, prompting Jostin Joestar to attack with IFILWPP. Renji counters with a localized Gravity Crush, knocking Jostin backward and repelling both brothers. Renji then warns them to walk away or be slammed into the pavement.

Jovian Joestar attacks Renji Kuroba with a low kick and shoulder tackle, wounding him. Renji calls for reinforcements via his wristband and uses an invisible force to fling Jostin Joestar into a bicycle rack during a stealth attack. Renji's gang arrives to surround the brothers, warning them not to flee. Meanwhile, the Scrawny Kid alerts Tetsu-san at the Iron Palm Gym to Renji's actions, prompting the old man to investigate.

Jovian Joestar summons Breaker's Soul to defend against a gang assault, while Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to launch pavement debris at the attackers. Several gang members restrain the brothers to ensure the fight is filmed, with Renji Kuroba ordering them to make it look like the brothers started the fight. Principal Anya arrives to observe the brawl, followed by Tetsu-san and his regulars, who intervene to protect the brothers. Tetsu-san challenges Renji's gang to fight the gym crew instead.

Jovian Joestar frees himself from his captors, while Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to knock back a gang member and demands that no one interfere. Following a phone call, Renji Kuroba orders his gang to stand down and retreat, though he threatens the brothers before leaving. Principal Anya informs the departing students that the academy will review footage of the brawl. Tetsu-san escorts the gang off the street and invites the Joestar brothers to visit his gym.

Conversation with Anya: Jostin Joestar asked Anya if there was an issue with his registration. Anya confirmed the registration was fine but informed him that she had witnessed a brawl he and his brother started on academy grounds.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar follow Tetsu-san and his associates to the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Principal Anya informs the brothers that their assessments are still scheduled and a footage review of the brawl will occur tonight. Upon arrival at the gym, the brothers meet Kaito, Riko, Sayaka, Genta, and Masaru, who assess their fighting style and condition. Tetsu-san orders everyone to sit and drink tea before evaluating the brothers' abilities.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar warned Riko Amane not to get used to his attitude. Riko responded with a grin, claiming her attitude required no training unlike her discipline. She then questioned Jostin about whether he always used his golden fist Stand to punch first before speaking.

Jovian Joestar observes Kaito Serizawa and Riko Amane practicing their respective striking and footwork drills. Jostin Joestar offers Riko a cigarette, and she explains the gym's training schedule and strict discipline. Tetsu-san describes the territorial layout of Kurokawa Ward, detailing the Shirogane crew, Daigo syndicate, and Honebi Collective. Kaito and Riko warn the brothers that their brawl with Renji Kuroba's crew has already drawn neighborhood attention and dangerous notoriety.

Jovian Joestar challenges Genta Oda to a spar to learn new techniques. Genta accepts on the condition that no powers or cheap shots are used, while Sayaka Mizuhara oversees the match to enforce gym rules. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar offers to train at the gym if Riko Amane goes out with him; Riko rejects the romantic offer but agrees to be his drill partner, immediately ordering him to begin lateral shift exercises.

Riko Amane directs Jostin Joestar through lateral shift exercises, correcting his stance and footwork after he suggests they drill each other. During their spar, Jovian Joestar attempts a sweep he learned from a tutorial, but Genta Oda easily evades the move and pushes Jovian off balance. Sayaka Mizuhara instructs Jovian to focus on Genta's weight distribution before attempting another attack.

Jostin Joestar makes a sexual joke, prompting Riko Amane to order him to restart his drills. During the exercises, Jostin performs hundreds of push-ups with mechanical precision, leading Riko to question him about his "assassin's footwork." Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar attempts a chopping kick against Genta Oda, who absorbs the blow and instructs Jovian to analyze his weight distribution. Sayaka Mizuhara intervenes to warn Jovian that his front-foot loading is telegraphing his movements.

Jovian Joestar attempts a "Breaker's Soul" strike, but Genta Oda corrects his wide windup and telegraphing by demonstrating a compact half-step and hip turn. After Sayaka Mizuhara instructs him to keep his rear heel planted for stability, Jovian successfully executes the refined strike. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar requests a spar, leading Riko Amane to teach him a hip-driven jab. Jostin initially struggles with his timing and weight distribution but eventually delivers a crisper punch under Riko's guidance.

Jostin Joestar thanks the group for the training and asks Tetsu for a private area to practice with weapons. Tetsu directs him to a converted storage room, warning Jostin to avoid damaging the walls. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar successfully integrates the technical lessons into a "Breaker's Soul" strike, impressing Genta Oda with the delivery's efficiency. Sayaka Mizuhara notes a slight wobble in Jovian's follow-through and instructs him to keep his heel planted for a final attempt.

Jovian Joestar successfully executes a "Breaker's Soul" strike with a stable heel and straight spine, earning approval from Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara. Jostin Joestar enters the storage room to practice with his kusarigama and the Stand IFILWPP. Integrating Riko's footwork, Jostin revives the "Peach Python" technique to redirect the weapon's momentum and topple a training dummy.

Jostin Joestar practices his kusarigama and Stand IFILWPP in the storage room, eventually recovering the "Peach Python" pattern despite some technical errors. On the main floor, Jovian Joestar attempts a "Breaker Limit" combo, but Genta Oda corrects his rushed hip rotation. Sayaka Mizuhara ends the session and directs both brothers to Tetsu, who praises their discipline and grants them a second visit. Tetsu instructs Jovian to build on his foundation and Jostin to utilize Riko's redirecting footwork, then orders them to return Monday for controlled sparring.

Jostin Joestar thanks Riko Amane for the drills, though she bluntly tells him not to make it weird. Jovian Joestar thanks Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara for their corrections, receiving final training advice from Genta and Sayaka. After Jovian rejects Jostin's invitation to an izakaya, Jovian departs the gym alone and arrives in the Kobuncho district.

Jovian Joestar strikes Jostin Joestar on the back and convinces him to visit Club Lumière instead of an izakaya. The two men enter the club, where they are greeted by a woman in a sequined jacket. The hostess informs them that lunch sets are available until two and asks if they are there to eat or browse.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar take a booth and order two curry rice sets. Jovian requests the hostess call the women out, jokingly claiming Jostin prefers them "old and fat," while Jostin counters by requesting "spicy" women with tattoos and piercings. The hostess summons the staff, promising Jostin the spicy options before leaving to fetch the food.

Jovian elbows Jostin in the ribs and claims the venue is better than a dive bar. Five hostesses emerge from the back curtain: a tattooed woman, a curvy woman, a petite girl, a statuesque woman, and a sporty woman. The sporty hostess notes the early hour while the tattooed hostess dismisses the brothers as kids. The curvy hostess invites them to sit and asks who ordered the spicy curry.

Jovian mocks the petite hostess's age, but she deadpans that she is twenty-two and has worked there for four years. Jostin chooses the tattooed hostess, who tells him to decide if he is there for the food or her ink. The sporty hostess joins them, asking Jostin to choose between her and the tattooed woman.

Jovian requests a drink from the petite hostess, who demonstrates her skill by pouring a perfect glass. Jostin asks both the sporty and tattooed hostesses to show him a good time. The sporty hostess claims she is the better choice, while the tattooed hostess offers a strong drink on the condition that Jostin keeps his hands on the table.

Conversation with Sporty Hostess: Jostin Joestar ordered a spicy drink from the Sporty Hostess. The hostess praised his taste and offered him a complimentary lighter beverage from the back if the spicy drink proved too strong.

Jovian praises the petite hostess's skill before eating a curry rice set. Jostin proposes that both the sporty and tattooed hostesses drink with him, prompting the sporty hostess to laugh at his ambition and the tattooed hostess to challenge him. The curvy hostess delivers more food and drinks while questioning where the brothers spent their morning. After topping off Jovian's glass and teasing him, the petite hostess returns to the bar, and the tattooed hostess exits the building.

Jovian smokes a cigarette while Jostin tells the Curvy Hostess they beat up Renji's gang earlier that morning. Two men from the Kurokawa crew enter the club and confront the tattooed hostess near the service corridor regarding a delayed payment. The Sporty and Curvy Hostesses warn the brothers not to get involved, while the tattooed hostess claims she will have the money by next week.

Jostin questions the two men and the tattooed hostess, prompting the lean man to warn him to stay out of their business. The Sporty Hostess and Petite Hostess urgently signal the brothers to remain quiet. A woman named Reiko arrives and intercepts the men, claiming the tattooed hostess's debt as her own problem to ensure the payment deadline is honored. The lean man acknowledges the situation but warns Reiko that the boss does not grant extensions.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar leave Sakura Lane for Chikara Academy to register for Pulse. Upon arrival, Jovian approaches a staff member named Hoshino at a side table. Hoshino provides the brothers with Ability Declaration forms to name and describe their powers.

Jostin reveals a star-shaped birthmark on his shoulder, prompting the lean man to warn him that the Joestar name holds no power in Kurokawa's territory. Jovian distracts the men with loud comments while analyzing their combat readiness. The broad man blocks Reiko, warning her that obstructing the door will only increase the tattooed hostess's debt. Despite the tattooed hostess's pleas to stop, Reiko refuses to move, while the Sporty Hostess whispers for Jostin to stay out of the conflict.

Jostin smokes in the booth and watches the corridor in silence. Jovian mocks the lean man and broad man for their numbers and compliments Reiko's tattoos. The lean man orders Jovian to sit down while the broad man squares up to face the group. Reiko refuses to move, insisting the tattooed hostess will pay next week and challenging the men to go through her.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar register their respective abilities with Hoshino, who mandates supervised assessments for both. After a verbal confrontation with Renji Kuroba in the plaza, the brothers visit a convenience store where Jostin gathers information from a boy about the Tetsu "Iron Palm" Gym. Renji threatens the brothers again before they depart.

Jovian confronts the lean man and declares the club under Joestar protection, throwing a glass that cuts the broad man's cheek. Jostin supports this claim and strikes the broad man in the chest with a kinetic-charged cigarette, staggering him. Reiko threatens the men to protect the tattooed hostess, but the lean man warns that her interference will increase the hostess's debt. The broad man blocks Reiko's path and tells her to walk away, while the tattooed hostess begs her sister not to fight.

Jovian strikes the lean man in the ribs, causing him to stagger. Jostin attempts a high-velocity charge but overshoots the target, colliding with the bar counter. Reiko activates her indigo dragon tattoo to protect the tattooed hostess, but the broad man attempts to pin her while the lean man lands a blind-side palm strike to her ribs. The sporty hostess shields the petite hostess behind the bar, and the curvy hostess urges the Joestar brothers to stop intervening for Reiko's sake.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar fight Renji Kuroba in a plaza, where Renji uses "Gravity Crush" and reinforcements to overpower the brothers. Renji's gang restrains the brothers to film the fight for Principal Anya, but Tetsu-san and his crew from the Iron Palm Gym intervene. Tetsu-san then challenges Renji's gang to fight his crew instead.

Jovian attempts a chain of punches but is staggered by the lean man and slammed into a booth by the broad man. Jostin launches debris at the lean man using "Peach Launcher," leaving him bleeding and wounded. Reiko exploits the opening to strike the lean man into a wall, while the Tattooed Hostess desperately begs her to stop. The Curvy Hostess orders the brothers to stay back, and the Sporty Hostess keeps the Petite Hostess under cover.

Jostin uses "Peach Launcher — Twin Volley" to heavily wound the lean man with debris. Jovian activates "Breaker Limit Flush," unleashing a relentless flurry of strikes that drives the broad man backward. The lean man orders the broad man to hold and warns Reiko that the boss will not forgive her defiance, offering a final chance to settle the debt next week. The Tattooed Hostess and Curvy Hostess both plead for the fighting to stop to prevent the boss from sending more reinforcements.

Jovian Joestar launches a final assault, breaking the broad man's guard and forcing him to his knee. Exhausted, Jostin Joestar collapses behind the bar, though he mentally imprints the pattern of his twin volley attack. The lean man presents a debt ledger for the Tattooed Hostess, who agrees to pay by next week to ensure Reiko's safety. Reiko stands down and warns the lean man she will destroy the boss's operations if the Tattooed Hostess is harassed. The Curvy Hostess takes the ledger, vouching for the payment and ordering the lean man to clean his face.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar free themselves from Renji Kuroba's gang, who retreat after Renji's orders. Principal Anya notifies the brothers that the academy will review footage of the brawl before they visit Tetsu-san at the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. There, the brothers meet Kaito, Riko, Sayaka, Genta, and Masaru, who provide information on the Kurokawa Ward territories. Jovian spars with Genta under Sayaka's supervision, while Jostin agrees to perform exercises with Riko as his drill partner.

Jovian Joestar suggests creating a plan to deal with the Kurokawa syndicate, while an exhausted Jostin Joestar proposes using the club as a base of operations. The Sporty Hostess mocks the request given the wreckage, and Reiko checks her sister for injuries before demanding that future debt payments go through the club to prevent further harassment of the staff. The lean man agrees to relay Reiko's terms to his boss.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar promise to protect the club and keep the Kurokawa syndicate's power in check. Reiko, the lean man, and the hostesses warn the brothers that their actions were a declaration of war and that the boss will respond with overwhelming force. The staff highlights the financial burden of repairs and the danger their presence poses to the non-combatant employees. The Curvy Hostess suggests they contact a man named Gara in Shutter Alley to fix the club and navigate the ward's back routes.

Jostin Joestar ejects the two men from the club and asks the hostesses about the Speedwagon Foundation, requesting that they keep his lineage a secret for safety. Jovian Joestar contacts the Foundation to request cash and logistical support following their declaration of war against the Kurokawa syndicate. The Curvy Hostess provides directions to Gara in Shutter Alley, advising them to use Maki's name. The brothers then depart the club and return to their school campus at Chikara Station.

Jovian Joestar rips the Battle Test poster from the main hall bulletin board, ignoring protests from a second-year student, and heads to the training arena to scout potential teammates. In the support workshop, a student offers Jostin Joestar maintenance for his kusarigama. At the arena, a second-year female student informs Jovian about the strengths and weaknesses of students Daigo, Sera, and Nobu. Reiko calls Jovian to confirm that the Speedwagon Foundation has arrived at the club to begin work.

Riko Amane directs Jostin Joestar through lateral shift exercises and a hip-driven jab, after which Tetsu directs Jostin to a storage room for weapons practice. Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara instruct Jovian Joestar on weight distribution and footwork, enabling Jovian to successfully execute a refined "Breaker's Soul" strike.

Jostin Joestar requests weapon maintenance and a second kusarigama from the support-workshop student, prompting Nobu to offer his technical expertise. In the arena gallery, Jovian Joestar tells a second-year student he needs "rebellious" teammates rather than textbook students. Sera offers to introduce Jovian to a dirty fighter and an insubordinate student, while Daigo rejects recruitment and challenges Jovian to a spar.

Jovian Joestar declines Daigo's challenge to spar and dismisses Sera's offer of introductions as he exits the gallery. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar offers a part-time job to whoever can repair his kusarigama and craft a second one, a knife belt, and a hidden blade by the end of the day. Nobu requests technical specifications for the weapon, while the support-workshop student offers to handle the knife rig.

Jostin Joestar summons his Stand, IFILWPP, and demonstrates its kinetic abilities by using a kusarigama and launching bolts to show Nobu and Hana the specific technical requirements for his equipment. Impressed by the power, Nobu agrees to modify the chain to prevent wrist strain, and Hana agrees to craft reinforced throwing knives. Jostin hires both students and tells them to meet him at Club Lumière after school. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar changes his mind and asks Sera to introduce him to Mikoto and Haruto immediately.

Jovian Joestar earns approval from Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara for his "Breaker's Soul" strike, while Jostin Joestar uses Riko Amane's footwork to revive the "Peach Python" technique. Tetsu praises the brothers' discipline and schedules them for sparring on Monday. After leaving the gym, Jovian convinces Jostin to visit Club Lumière in the Kobuncho district, where a hostess greets them.

Sera brings Jovian Joestar to the combat gym and introduces him to Mikoto, a second-year strike class student who fights dirty. Mikoto acknowledges Jovian and asks if he is from the family with the star birthmark. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar arrives at the spectator gallery above the arena to watch the proceedings.

Jovian Joestar confirms his family lineage to Mikoto, who questions his motives for building a crew at the academy. Ignoring her, Jovian demands to find Haruto, and Sera leads him and Mikoto to the battle-test arena. Upon arrival, the announcer mistakes Jovian, Mikoto, and Haruto for a registered battle test team and orders them to the center mark. Jostin Joestar watches the scene from the spectator gallery.

Jovian Joestar claims leadership of the group, assigning Mikoto to "dirty work" and telling Haruto Saionji to stay out of the way. Mikoto reluctantly agrees, while Haruto agrees to cooperate temporarily. The announcer orders the trio to the center mark and explains the battle test rules for their match against a coordinated team of four second-year students. From the gallery, Jostin Joestar and Sera watch the confrontation, with Jostin expressing confidence in his brother's victory.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar order curry rice and request specific types of hostesses from the staff. Five hostesses arrive, and Jostin chooses between the tattooed and sporty women while Jovian requests a drink from the petite hostess. Jostin asks both the sporty and tattooed hostesses to entertain him, resulting in competing offers.

Jovian Joestar requests to add Jostin Joestar as a fourth team member to balance the fight against the four second-year students. Despite noting it is not standard procedure, the announcer permits the substitution. Jostin jumps from the gallery to the arena floor, signs the supplemental roster, and prepares for battle.

The buzzer signals the start of the battle test. Jovian Joestar manifests Breaker's Soul as the stocky boy strikes him, staggering Jovian back. Simultaneously, the tall girl hits Jostin Joestar in the ribs, and the lean student disrupts Haruto Saionji's gold marks with a projectile. Mikoto uses a shockwave to break the stocky boy's guard, though he maintains his position to block the center of the arena.

Jovian Joestar charges through a barrier, injuring the barrier-type student, but is stopped by the stocky boy's Knuckle Break. Mikoto detonates a shockwave to disrupt the stocky boy's guard, urging Jovian to move. After being hit by the tall girl, Jostin Joestar is protected by Haruto Saionji's gold mark; Jostin then manifests IFILWPP to catch a projectile and launch a "Peach Gearshift" strike barrage against the lean student. The lean student survives the assault with a shoulder rush as the announcer warns the Joestars they are drifting toward the boundary.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar dine at a club where they interact with several hostesses and discuss their fight with Renji's gang. Two men from the Kurokawa crew arrive to collect a debt from the tattooed hostess, leading to a confrontation intercepted by a woman named Reiko. The men warn the group that the Joestar name carries no influence in their territory before the broad man blocks Reiko from the exit.

Jovian Joestar uses Breaker Limit Flush to shatter the barrier-type student's shield and incapacitate her. Mikoto detonates a shockwave to disrupt the stocky boy's guard, allowing Jovian's flurry to knock him unconscious; however, the stocky boy lands a final blow that shoves Jovian toward the boundary before being carried out by medics. Simultaneously, the tall girl strikes Jostin Joestar's ribs while the lean student uses metal balls to break Jostin's focus and trip him. With thirty seconds remaining in the round, only two second-year students remain standing.

Jovian Joestar attempts to coordinate an attack with Haruto Saionji, but the barrier-type student recovers and deploys a reinforced pane that absorbs Jovian's blow. Simultaneously, Jostin Joestar utilizes "Peach Assassination" to knock out the tall girl and the lean student, the latter of whom was opened up by a shockwave from Mikoto. The announcer declares a round-one sweep for the Joestar unit.

Jovian Joestar invites his opponents to join the "Joestar gang" at Club Lumiere, prompting dry criticism from Mikoto and Sera regarding his public recruitment. Haruto Saionji denies hearing the invitation, while Jostin Joestar expresses a desire for a beer. The announcer orders the Joestar unit to a post-test debrief and medical checks, demanding an explanation for the "Joestar gang" comment.

Jovian and Jostin protect Reiko and a tattooed hostess from a lean man and a broad man in a club. After a series of fights involving kinetic attacks and tattoo abilities, Jostin uses "Peach Launcher" to wound the lean man, allowing Reiko to strike him into a wall. Throughout the conflict, the curvy and sporty hostesses attempt to manage the situation and protect a petite hostess.

Jostin Joestar denies being a Joestar before he and Jovian Joestar sprint out of the arena to avoid the debrief. Haruto Saionji lies to the announcer, claiming the "gang" comment was a joke to cover for them. After traveling by train to Kobuncho's Neon Lantern Street, the winded brothers arrive at the closed Club Lumiere.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar enter Club Lumiere, which is currently closed for repairs. They are greeted by five hostesses who are cleaning and prepping the venue. Jostin singles out the Sporty Hostess, while the Tattooed Hostess questions the brothers' claim of ownership.

Jostin requests introductions, and the hostesses identify themselves as Maki, Natsumi, Chiho, Tomoe, and Kaede. Jovian reveals that a Speedwagon representative will arrive tonight to finalize the club's paperwork. Reiko calls Jovian to complain that the Foundation sent a "makeover team" who forced a new, branded visual identity and gear upon their crew. Jovian informs the hostesses that the group now has official merchandise.

Jostin requests food after the fight, and Reiko warns Jovian that they must establish ground rules for his gang before the boss intervenes. Natsumi offers to help clean the construction debris, though Kaede insists the brothers clean up their own mess. Jovian requests a gourmet meal from Maki, who agrees to provide kitchen curry first while the gourmet food prepares.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar defeat a lean man and a broad man, leading the lean man to agree to Reiko's terms regarding future debt payments for the Tattooed Hostess. The brothers propose using the damaged club as a base to fight the Kurokawa syndicate, despite warnings from Reiko and the hostesses that this declares war on the boss. To repair the wreckage, the Curvy Hostess suggests the brothers contact Gara in Shutter Alley.

Jovian and Jostin promise promotions and a celebratory "spread" to the staff to put the Joestar name on the map. Natsumi mocks the ambition while cleaning the debris, and Chiho asks Jostin to move a broken chair leg. Kaede and Tomoe warn the brothers to consider the visibility and attention their loudness will attract before the night begins. Maki agrees to the feast, ordering them to sit while she prepares the curry.

Jostin and Jovian help the staff clean the establishment before eating curry prepared by Maki. During the meal, the staff request timely payments, a security door, safer commutes, and a resolution to Kaede's debts. Aurelia Voss of the Speedwagon Foundation then arrives to finalize the Joestars' agreement and fund the repairs.

Aurelia Voss confirms she is the Joestars' official Speedwagon Foundation contact and coordinated the crew's branding and gear, noting the new crew is waiting at a nearby safehouse. Kaede Shishido expresses skepticism regarding the Foundation's rapid decision-making. Maki Hayashida, Natsumi Arai, and Chiho Moriyama urge the brothers to visit Gara in Shutter Alley before midnight to address their declared war on the boss.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar prepare to leave for Shutter Alley to find Gara. Jovian requests that Aurelia Voss and Maki Hayashida handle the club's paperwork and various facility upgrades; Aurelia agrees to the repairs and car service but refuses to clear Kaede's debts, citing it as a negotiation matter. Maki instructs the brothers to use her name when speaking with Gara, while the other women offer warnings and well-wishes for their departure.

Jostin Joestar ejects two men from a club and asks the hostesses about the Speedwagon Foundation, while Jovian Joestar requests support from the Foundation for their war against the Kurokawa syndicate. After receiving directions to Gara in Shutter Alley, the brothers return to Chikara Station, where Jovian scouts potential teammates at the training arena and rejects a spar with Daigo. Simultaneously, Jostin recruits Nobu and a support-workshop student to maintain his kusarigama and craft additional weapons.

Jostin Joestar embraces Natsumi Arai, who shoves him away and demands a proper introduction. Jovian Joestar instructs Aurelia Voss to procure a shuttle bus for the staff and follow Speedwagon recommendations for the door, which Aurelia confirms. The brothers then depart Club Lumiere and enter Shutter Alley, where they are met with suspicion and scrutiny by the locals.

Jovian Joestar warns Jostin to avoid violence while they search for Gara. A man leaning against a doorway approaches and identifies the brothers by their Foundation-issue jackets. He informs them that Gara is located on the third floor of a building at the end of the alley, but asks who recommended them.

Jovian Joestar avoids answering the man's question, but the man concludes they were sent by Maki and warns them to let Gara speak first and avoid mentioning the club. The brothers reach the building and ascend to the third floor, where Gara opens the door before they can knock. Gara acknowledges they are likely Maki's or Foundation's associates and demands a significant favor in exchange for information and routes.

Gara demands that Jostin and Jovian Joestar recover protection money stolen by a teenage crew and identify the person organizing them. In exchange for this favor, Gara promises to provide routes and back door access to the club. Gara provides a map and a coded receipt identifying a noodle shop near the canal as the operation's hub. Jovian accepts the terms and agrees to bring Gara the money and the name.

Jostin Joestar demonstrates his Stand, IFILWPP, to Nobu and Hana, who agree to modify his equipment and meet him at Club Lumière. Meanwhile, Sera introduces Jovian Joestar to Mikoto and Haruto Saionji at the combat gym and battle-test arena. The announcer mistakenly registers the trio as a team and orders them to fight four second-year students while Jostin watches from the gallery.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar leave Gara's office and return to Chikara Academy. Principal Anya reprimands the brothers for escalating a public brawl and presents them with a conditional disciplinary agreement to avoid expulsion. To work off their punishment, she tasks them with stopping a string of shakedowns by minors near Kobuncho, which aligns with the job Gara previously assigned them.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar sign Principal Anya's disciplinary agreement after she rejects Jovian's attempt to negotiate the arrangement as a business deal for his gang. Reiko contacts Jovian to report that their crew and gear are ready at Club Lumière, noting that they must act before Kurokawa intervenes. The brothers travel to the club to meet their assembled team.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar arrive at Club Lumière, where Reiko directs the assembled crew to prepare their gear in the back office. Aurelia Voss presents ownership transfer documents, and Jovian officially registers the property as "Club Lumière" before signing the paperwork. Once the legal transfer is complete, Reiko summons the brothers for the crew briefing.

The announcer allows Jovian Joestar to add Jostin Joestar to the team to face four second-year students. During the battle, Jovian and Mikoto incapacitate the barrier-type student and the stocky boy. With thirty seconds remaining, the tall girl and the lean student remain standing after striking Jostin Joestar.

Jovian Joestar approves the new security door's quality, while Aurelia Voss notes it meets Foundation standards. Reiko assembles the crew in the back office and establishes ground rules regarding civilian safety, teamwork, and the academy's reputation. Despite skepticism from Mikoto and Haruto Saionji, the crew adopts red-and-black uniforms with Joestar patches.

Jovian Joestar confronts Haruto Saionji for not wearing the crew colors, prompting Haruto to put on the red-and-black jacket. Jostin Joestar introduces himself and defines the crew's mission as protecting the weak and operating as a family. The crew members express their commitment to the new identity, and Reiko asks Jovian to explain the crew's organizational structure.

Jovian Joestar establishes the crew's hierarchy, appointing Reiko as head lieutenant, Haruto as tactician, and Mikoto as enforcer captain. Hana Kisaragi and Nobu define their roles as support engineer and field technician, respectively. Mikoto and Haruto accept their positions, though Mikoto asserts her right to criticize failing plans. Reiko confirms the structure and asks Jovian for their first move, noting a deadline to recover money from a noodle shop for Gara.

Jostin Joestar appoints Nobu to lead the intelligence division and Hana to lead engineering. Jovian Joestar orders Reiko to track Kurokawa's movements and Haruto to develop a counter-strategy, while Mikoto prepares for tomorrow's shakedown. Nobu and Hana present Jostin with a custom-built kusarigama designed to his specifications.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar defeat Haruto Saionji and their teammates, leading the announcer to declare a round-one sweep. After Jovian invites the opponents to join the "Joestar gang" at Club Lumiere, the Joestar brothers flee the arena to avoid a post-test debrief. They travel to Neon Lantern Street in Kobuncho, where they enter the closed Club Lumiere and encounter five hostesses.

Jovian Joestar jokingly complains to Nobu and Hana about not having a custom weapon. Hana reveals she is designing a weapon for him and asks for his preferences. Nobu provides Jostin Joestar with the remainder of his order, consisting of throwing knives and a hidden blade, which Jostin tests while summoning IFILWPP.

Jostin Joestar praises the team and requests a second kusarigama by tomorrow. Nobu agrees to the request and plans to finalize Jostin's gloves and monitor Kurokawa communications, while Hana presents schematics for high-impact knuckle gloves. The group decides to celebrate their upcoming operation with drinks, though Mikoto and Haruto express concerns regarding sobriety and responsibility.

The crew gathers in the Main Lounge to celebrate their ownership of Club Lumière. Jovian serves champagne while Reiko, Hana, and Nobu toast to the group and confirm that gear and intelligence will be ready for tomorrow's shakedown. Mikoto and Haruto remain cautious and sober to ensure the team stays functional, despite Jostin's intent to get drunk.

Jostin and Jovian meet hostesses Maki, Natsumi, Chiho, Tomoe, and Kaede, who help them clean their establishment before eating curry prepared by Maki. Reiko informs Jovian that the Foundation provided new branded gear, and the staff requests payments, security upgrades, and debt resolution for Kaede. Aurelia Voss of the Speedwagon Foundation then arrives to fund repairs and finalize the Joestars' agreement.

Jostin Joestar departs the celebration, teasingly leaving Jovian Joestar to handle the cleanup. Mikoto, Hana, and Nobu exit the club, with Hana and Nobu confirming that gear and intelligence will be ready by morning. The following day, the crew receives updates confirming the completion of equipment and Reiko's warning that the Noodle Shop crew moves at midday.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar return to the club suffering from severe hangovers. Reiko and Chiho Moriyama mock their condition and remind them that the Noodle Shop crew moves at midday. Reiko confirms that Hana has delivered the gloves and a second kusarigama for their use.

Jovian falls asleep on the office desk. Jostin uses a "Peach Limit Break" to instantly cure his hangover. Reiko briefs Jostin on the plan to intercept the Noodle Shop crew's money transfer at midday, detailing the positions of Mikoto, Haruto, and Nobu. Chiho warns the Joestars that the crew might recognize them from a previous fight and offers to keep a getaway route open.

Aurelia Voss confirms her role as the Speedwagon Foundation contact for Jostin and Jovian Joestar, who then agree to visit Gara in Shutter Alley before midnight. Jovian instructs Aurelia and Maki Hayashida to manage the club's paperwork and upgrades, though Aurelia refuses to clear Kaede Shishido's debts. Upon arriving at Shutter Alley, a local man identifies the brothers by their jackets and directs them to Gara's location on a third floor.

Conversation with Chiho Moriyama: Chiho Moriyama expressed her anxiety over the young members of the noodle shop crew and their criminal activities. Jostin Joestar teased her by claiming that Jovian had feelings for her, which caused Chiho to blush and deny the possibility. She insisted on remaining inconspicuous in her role and asked to change the subject.

Conversation with Reiko: Jostin Joestar asked Reiko if she was ready to move. Reiko confirmed her readiness and proposed a plan to keep the shadows busy while the others handled the intercept once the targets left the shop.

Jovian wakes up and asks Haruto for an explanation of the mission. Haruto and Reiko reiterate the intercept plan: the Joestars must seize the Noodle Shop crew's cash and carrier between the canal-side shops and Shutter Alley at midday. Jostin expresses confidence in the plan, and the group prepares to head to the lounge to address the assembled crew.

Jovian Joestar takes anti-hangover pills and instructs the group to use disguises for the intercept, drafting Mikoto Saionji into the team for coordination. Reiko mandates that the operation avoid civilians and unnecessary cruelty, while Mikoto expresses moral discomfort with targeting teenagers. Nobu Tanaka distributes earpieces for field communication, and Jostin Joestar outlines his plan to use his speed to seize the money. The group then assembles in the Main Lounge to finalize preparations.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar agree to recover stolen money and identify a teenage crew's leader for Gara in exchange for information regarding a club. After returning to Chikara Academy, Principal Anya requires the brothers to stop these same shakedowns in Kobuncho to avoid expulsion. The brothers sign the agreement and then travel to Club Lumière to meet a team organized by Reiko.

Jostin Joestar signals the start of the operation, and the crew splits up through Kobuncho's backstreets to intercept the targets. While looping toward the canal, Jovian, Jostin, and Mikoto encounter a Retired Hero who offers a finder's fee to solve a series of waterfront thefts, though Mikoto declines due to their current timeline. Nobu, Reiko, and Haruto report via earpiece that the targets are moving faster than expected and are now accompanied by a paranoid minder on a scooter.

Conversation with Mikoto: Mikoto briefed Jostin Joestar on their objective to retrieve a cash bag and capture the organizer of a group of children for Gara. She warned him that while most of the group consisted of scared children, the "scooter minder" was a formidable fighter and the primary threat. They confirmed the target group consisted of five individuals in total.

Jovian coordinates the team via earpiece, ordering Mikoto to distract the target teenagers while he targets the adult minder. Mikoto blocks the teenagers' path with fake questions about a ramen shop, providing cover for Jostin to stealthily steal the cash bag from the carrier. The Retired Hero watches the theft occur unnoticed until the carrier shrieks and the minder begins searching the crowd. Mikoto retreats to the brothers as the teenagers scatter and the minder threatens the nearby civilians.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar arrive at Club Lumière, where Jovian signs ownership transfer documents provided by Aurelia Voss. Reiko organizes the crew, who adopt red-and-black uniforms and accept organizational roles: Reiko as head lieutenant, Haruto as tactician, Mikoto as enforcer captain, Hana Kisaragi as support engineer, and Nobu as field technician. Reiko then asks Jovian for their first move regarding recovering money from a noodle shop for Gara.

Jovian Joestar confronts the Minder, questioning him about the missing bag and his potential ties to Kurokawa. The Minder attempts to pursue a fleeing teenager, but the Retired Hero intervenes by ordering him to keep his weapon visible. Mikoto and Reiko provide tactical support, while Haruto Saionji confirms the alley mouth is secure as the remaining teenagers scatter.

Jostin Joestar identifies a fleeing small boy as non-hostile and pursues him onto Neon Lantern Street, where the boy clutches two envelopes. Jovian Joestar confronts the Minder, who attempts to reach for a weapon while demanding the boy's location. The Carrier Girl claims responsibility for the lost bag to protect the children, while the Retired Hero and Mikoto attempt to de-escalate the situation. Nobu and Haruto Saionji confirm via comms that the Minder is a Kurokawa courier.

Jostin Joestar appoints Nobu to lead intelligence and Hana to lead engineering, while Jovian Joestar assigns Reiko to track Kurokawa and Haruto to develop a strategy. Nobu and Hana provide Jostin with a custom kusarigama, throwing knives, and a hidden blade, and they agree to produce a second kusarigama and knuckle gloves by tomorrow. The group gathers in the Main Lounge of Club Lumière to drink and confirm that gear and intelligence are ready for the upcoming shakedown.

Jovian Joestar confronts the Minder about a koi sticker, prompting the man to shove the Carrier Girl aside and flee into an alley. Mikoto and Jovian pursue him, eventually cornering the Minder between themselves and two unidentified allies. Simultaneously, Jostin Joestar uses his stand, Peach Python, to snag the small boy and hoist him onto a rooftop. During the capture, the boy drops a note with pickup times and a drop address, which Reiko warns Jostin to protect from two nearby Kurokawa musclemen.

Conversation with Mikoto: Jostin Joestar questioned Mikoto regarding the number of envelopes a boy had been carrying and the current location of their contents. Mikoto explained that there were two envelopes, noting that one had spilled a note with pickup times and a drop address, while the other remained with the boy.

Conversation with Reiko: Jostin Joestar asked Reiko for a situation report regarding whether they had been spotted. Reiko informed him that the men had seen the boy but not them, and she warned Jostin to keep the child and a specific note out of the men's reach.

Jostin Joestar pins the small boy to a rooftop at knifepoint, seizes the envelope, and forces the boy to shout that he is safe. Below, Reiko refuses to surrender the boy or the note to two Kurokawa musclemen. Meanwhile, Mikoto strikes the Minder Backup with a shockwave to open a path, urging Jovian Joestar to intercept the fleeing Minder.

After a celebration, Hana and Nobu prepare gear and intelligence for an intercept of the Noodle Shop crew's midday money transfer. Reiko and Chiho Moriyama brief Jostin and Jovian Joestar on the plan to seize the cash and carrier between the canal-side shops and Shutter Alley. The group coordinates positions with Mikoto, Haruto, and Nobu before heading to the lounge to address the assembled crew.

Jostin Joestar ties the boy to a vent pole, requests backup from the club for the child's extraction, and vanishes into the crowd to retrieve the dropped note. Reiko blocks a Kurokawa muscleman's attempt to flank her while the other offers a deal for the boy and the note. In the alley, Jovian Joestar slams the Minder into the pavement, while Mikoto repels the Minder Backup with a shockwave. Using Eagle Vision, Jostin locates the dropped note on Neon Lantern Street.

Conversation with Reiko: Reiko informed Jostin Joestar that she was holding the alley mouth against two Kurokawa thugs to protect the rooftop. Jostin confirmed the boy was secure and stated he was retrieving a note. Reiko agreed to hold the line but urged Jostin to move quickly.

Jovian Joestar pins the Minder to the pavement while Mikoto repels the Minder Backup with a shockwave and zip-ties the Minder's wrists. Jostin Joestar retrieves the dropped note and rescues the boy from the vent pole, retreating from the rooftop. Reiko fends off two Kurokawa musclemen, with one warning her that her actions have created a "Kurokawa problem." The group secures the prisoner and returns to Club Lumière's back office to meet Maki Hayashida.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar register their abilities with Hoshino at Chikara Academy and later fight Renji Kuroba in a plaza. Tetsu-san and the Iron Palm Gym crew intervene during the brawl, leading the brothers to later visit the gym to gather information on Kurokawa Ward territories from Kaito, Riko, Sayaka, Genta, and Masaru. Jovian spars with Genta under Sayaka's supervision, and Jostin agrees to train with Riko.

Jovian Joestar orders a debrief and instructs Reiko to secure the Minder and the rescued boy in a separate KTV room. Jostin Joestar uses his Stand and Eagle Vision to enter a heightened state of sensory awareness. Nobu identifies a counting spot at an old dry-goods store and proposes staking out the 4:30 pickup to identify the organizer. Haruto warns the crew that their public actions may expose them to Principal Anya and Kurokawa, while Hana and Mikoto argue for a plan that returns the stolen money and protects the child carriers.

Jovian Joestar appoints Haruto Saionji to lead the next mission, instructing the other members to remain behind. Jostin Joestar tasks Nobu with erasing surveillance footage and falsifying school records to hide their absence. Haruto coordinates the crew, assigning Mikoto to secure the cash, Nobu to verify the note, and Hana to protect the witnesses and draft a report for Gara. Haruto proposes a discreet, nonlethal operation for himself, Jostin, and Jovian to investigate the drop address and identify Kurokawa's organizer.

Jovian Joestar, Jostin, Mikoto, Nobu, Reiko, and Haruto coordinate an operation in Kobuncho to retrieve a cash bag from a group of teenagers and their minder. Mikoto distracts the teenagers while Jostin steals the bag, leading Jovian to confront the minder regarding ties to Kurokawa. After a brief encounter with a Retired Hero, the team secures the area as the teenagers scatter.

Jovian, Jostin, and Haruto travel to Kobuncho in Haruto's SUV to investigate a drop address at an old dry-goods store. Mikoto, Nobu, and Hana remain at the club to secure the cash and monitor feeds. Upon arrival, a man in a black bomber jacket with a koi insignia confronts them, accusing the group of being couriers and blocking the lane.

Jovian confronts the Lean Watcher over an insult to his backpack while Jostin stealthily scales a building to secure a vantage point. Haruto informs the store's occupants that he knows their cash pickup schedule and demands the identity of the 4:30 signer in exchange for leaving their operation alone. A heavyset woman dismisses Haruto's "deal" but acknowledges the wiry counter man as the one who counts the money. Haruto demands to speak with the man, who subsequently opens the steel door.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar questioned Haruto Saionji about his fighting style and special abilities. Haruto described himself as a tactical fighter and explained that his "Crown Script" ability allows him to redirect or accelerate objects and people that cross a golden line he traces in the air. He warned that attempting to manipulate objects that are too large or fast can cause the line to shatter and result in physical injury to his arm.

Jovian shouts at the wiry man, who challenges Jovian to enter the store. Haruto attempts to negotiate the return of a stolen cash bag in exchange for the 4:30 signer's name, but the heavyset woman accuses the group of being reconnaissance for a rival crew. The Lean Watcher and other associates box the group in, demanding the bag and the identity of their backers. The woman offers a final deal: the signer's name in exchange for the bag, their jackets, and a promise to never return.

Jostin Joestar pursues a boy onto Neon Lantern Street, where Jovian Joestar and Mikoto corner a Kurokawa courier known as the Minder. Jostin uses his stand, Peach Python, to move the boy to a rooftop, seizing an envelope and recovering a dropped note while Reiko blocks Kurokawa musclemen from accessing the child. Jovian slams the Minder into the pavement as Mikoto repels the Minder's backup with shockwaves.

Jovian Joestar attacks the Lean Watcher with a powered punch, while Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to restrain the Watcher and reposition himself. The heavyset woman shoves Haruto back, leaving him vulnerable to a flank attack by the wiry man in the gray windbreaker. Simultaneously, the pipe-carrier strikes Jovian, and additional associates move to seal the lane's exits.

Jovian Joestar charges through the lane, slamming the heavyset woman into a wall. Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to deflect a blade attack and immobilize the wiry man. From the rooftop, Jostin Joestar launches a volley of knives, but the Lean Watcher warns the group, and the wiry man uses crates for cover.

In the ensuing melee, a worker throws a box at Jovian, leaving him open to strikes from the pipe-carrier and the Lean Watcher. The heavyset woman attacks Haruto’s chest to break his focus while the shelf-guard and the man in the leather jacket seal the exits. Haruto orders Jovian to handle the woman and Jostin to pin the workers.

Jostin Joestar leaps into the lane, using his chain to wound the shelf-guard, pipe-carrier, Lean Watcher, leather-jacketed man, and wiry man. Jovian Joestar delivers an explosive punch to the heavyset woman, hurling her into a stack of crates. Haruto Saionji deploys a massive command seal that heals the Joestar brothers and freezes all enemies in place. Haruto warns that the immobilization is temporary and urges the brothers to attack.

Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to redirect the wiry man's attack and urges the Joestars to attack. Jovian Joestar launches a "Desperation Impact" barrage of punches, while Jostin Joestar uses his kusarigama to strike multiple guards through a veil of steam. The Lean Watcher and pipe-carrier manage to wound Jovian, and the shelf-guard strikes Jostin, but the Joestars leave the enemy group defeated and wounded. The wiry man concedes the fight and tells the group to state their business.

After Reiko fends off Kurokawa thugs, Jovian, Jostin, and Mikoto rescue a boy and capture a Minder before returning to Club Lumière to meet Maki Hayashida. Jovian appoints Haruto to lead a mission where Nobu, Hana, and Mikoto secure assets while Jostin, Jovian, and Haruto investigate a drop address in Kobuncho. Upon arrival at the dry-goods store, a man in a koi-insignia jacket confronts the three men.

Jostin Joestar uses "Peach Healing" to stabilize Jovian's injuries. Haruto Saionji disarms the defeated guards and separates them to prevent regrouping. The wiry man reveals that the recent payment was a test by Kurokawa and identifies Ohba at the nearby old bathhouse as the person in charge of the protection route. Haruto demands the guards leave the children alone and declares that the group will head to the bathhouse.

Haruto Saionji leads Jostin and Jovian Joestar to an old bathhouse to seek medical aid. The proprietor, Yuzuki Hoshino, uses golden healing light to close Jostin's cuts and ease Jovian's rib injuries. When Yuzuki questions the cause of their severe wounds, Haruto vaguely replies that the situation is complicated and may worsen.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar questioned if they had arrived at the correct bathhouse. Haruto Saionji confirmed the location and explained that while Ohba operated out of the establishment, the priority was for the group to be patched up by Yuzuki.

Jostin Joestar notices a small green spirit beside Yuzuki Hoshino, whom Haruto Saionji identifies as an untrained Stand. Yuzuki completes the healing of Jovian Joestar's ribs, causing Jovian to fall into a deep sleep. Haruto informs Jostin that they plan to confront Ohba tomorrow to force him to give up the Kurokawa protection route. The group wakes the following morning, and Yuzuki provides breakfast for the recovered Jovian and Jostin.

Riko Amane, Tetsu, Genta Oda, and Sayaka Mizuhara train Jostin and Jovian Joestar in various combat techniques at a gym. After training, the brothers visit Club Lumière in the Kobuncho district, where they dine and interact with several hostesses. Two men from the Kurokawa crew arrive to collect a debt from a hostess, leading to a confrontation intercepted by Reiko.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar asked Haruto Saionji if he was a stand user, prompting Haruto to confirm that his stand is called Crown Script. After being asked for a demonstration, Haruto created a small, humming gold line in the air and invited Jostin to touch it.

Jovian Joestar returns to sleep after breakfast. Jostin Joestar coordinates with Nobu over the phone to cover their school absences and confirm the completion of new gear. Jostin asks Haruto Saionji for the plan to confront Ohba, and Haruto specifies that they will conduct reconnaissance after breakfast. Haruto invites Yuzuki Hoshino to join the crew as a healer, offering her protection and training; Yuzuki expresses fear regarding her safety and the bathhouse and asks for time to think.

Jovian Joestar searches the bathhouse and discovers a suspicious door with a new lock. Jostin Joestar calls Hana Kisaragi to commission a themed kimono. Haruto Saionji outlines a plan to ambush Ohba in the back corridor during his morning routine. The group is interrupted by Kurokawa enforcers who demand payment from outside the shutters, causing a panicking Yuzuki Hoshino to barricade the front door.

Jovian, Jostin, and Haruto confront the Lean Watcher and associates at a store to identify a specific cash signer. A fight ensues involving Jovian's powered punches, Jostin's knife volleys from a rooftop, and Haruto's "Crown Script" ability to redirect objects. The group battles a heavyset woman and several workers who attempt to seal the exits and overpower them.

Conversation with Yuzuki Hoshino: Jostin Joestar asked Yuzuki Hoshino who owned the bathhouse. Yuzuki, who appeared frightened by a knocking sound on the shutters, whispered that she owned the establishment after inheriting it from her grandmother.

Jovian Joestar prepares to confront the Kurokawa enforcers, while Haruto Saionji sets gold script tripwires at the entrance to protect Yuzuki Hoshino. Mikoto arrives and distracts the enforcers, prompting them to demand the group face them in the street to avoid a trap. Haruto abandons his stealth plan and warns the enforcers to leave, but Jostin Joestar leads the group out into the alley to engage the four men.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar asked Haruto Saionji how to avoid a fight with four enforcers. Jostin suggested offering to meet the enforcers on their own turf to lure them away. Haruto agreed to the plan, noting that the enforcers would take the bait if they felt they had the advantage.

Jostin Joestar offers to surrender himself to the Kurokawa boss to spare his companions, but Enforcer 1 rejects the deal and punches Jostin. Enforcer 2 hurls a crate into the brothers, prompting Jovian Joestar to launch a rapid series of strikes that hit all four enforcers. The enforcers regroup with weapons to box the group in, while a green spirit flares defensively around Yuzuki Hoshino.

Jostin Joestar stabbed Enforcer 1 in the throat but was countered with a pipe blow that left him incapacitated. Enforcer 2 attempted to throw a bottle at Yuzuki Hoshino, which her Verdant Sylph shattered as she stepped forward to protect her guests. Haruto Saionji used Crown Script to shield Yuzuki's doorway, while Mikoto attacked Enforcer 2 from behind and Jovian Joestar slammed Enforcer 4 into the pavement. Enforcer 3 struck Jovian in the ribs, claiming the exits were sealed.

Jovian Joestar launched a "Desperation Impact" barrage, striking all four enforcers. Enforcer 1 struck the incapacitated Jostin with a pipe, while Enforcer 2 scratched Mikoto with a bottle and Enforcer 3 hit Jovian in the ribs. Yuzuki Hoshino used her spirit to heal the allies and launch wind blades that disarmed the enforcers, aided by Haruto Saionji's redirection to prevent lethal injury. After Mikoto knocked Enforcer 2 into Enforcer 3, the disarmed and beaten enforcers retreated against the sealed exits.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar defeat a group of guards, including the Lean Watcher and a wiry man, with assistance from Haruto Saionji. After Haruto disarms the guards, the wiry man identifies Ohba at a nearby old bathhouse as the person in charge of the protection route. Haruto leads the brothers to the bathhouse, where Yuzuki Hoshino heals their injuries.

Jovian Joestar tells Mikoto to let the retreating enforcers flee. Jostin Joestar promises Yuzuki Hoshino to protect her bathhouse before activating the forbidden "Hoshino Requiem" technique to pursue and kill the fleeing enemies. Haruto Saionji uses Crown Script to freeze Jostin in place, allowing the enforcers to escape. Mikoto questions the decision, but Haruto refuses to let them become killers, leaving Yuzuki pleading for an end to the violence.

Jostin Joestar attributes his bloodlust to family instincts before falling unconscious. Jovian Joestar slaps his brother and reprimands him for acting like a weapon. Haruto Saionji comforts a panicked Yuzuki Hoshino and admits that stopping Jostin exhausted his abilities, leaving him unfit for the frontline. Mikoto confirms Jostin is unconscious and directs the group to move him into the bathhouse to avoid public attention.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar defeat a lean man and a broad man to protect Reiko and a tattooed hostess, leading the lean man to agree to Reiko's debt terms. The brothers decide to use the damaged club as a base against the Kurokawa syndicate and seek help from Gara in Shutter Alley. While Jostin recruits Nobu and Hana to maintain his equipment, Jovian meets Mikoto and Haruto Saionji and fights four students at a combat arena.

Mikoto and Haruto carry an unconscious Jostin into the bathhouse, where he eventually wakes the next morning. Jovian coordinates with Aurelia Voss to send a Speedwagon Foundation repair team to the damaged bathhouse and directs the group to Club Lumière for a briefing. During the transit, Haruto explains the nature of Stands to a confused Yuzuki. Once at the club, Haruto informs the crew that Yuzuki's instinctive healing abilities make her a high-value target for Ohba and Kurokawa, prompting a discussion on how to defend her and the club.

Jovian and Jostin officially welcome Yuzuki into the crew, prompting Hana to dress her in a custom red-and-black Joestar gang kimono. Haruto and Mikoto acknowledge Yuzuki's effectiveness as a healer and combatant during the previous conflict. Yuzuki accepts the uniform and the role, receiving a collective welcome from the crew.

Conversation with Yuzuki Hoshino: Jostin Joestar complimented Yuzuki Hoshino on her crest. Yuzuki admitted she felt strange wearing it but expressed her determination to live up to it to protect those who had been kind to her.

Jovian requests his promised power knuckles, which Hana provides for fitting. Jostin returns from a break and collects a modified second kusarigama from Nobu for balance testing. Reiko warns that Ohba is aware of Yuzuki and the club, urging the crew to choose between securing Shutter Alley or fortifying the club.

After arriving at a bathhouse, Jostin Joestar and Haruto Saionji have Yuzuki Hoshino heal Jovian Joestar. Haruto demonstrates his Stand, Crown Script, and plans an ambush of Ohba to seize the Kurokawa protection route while inviting Yuzuki to join them as a healer. When Kurokawa enforcers arrive at the bathhouse, Jostin leads the group into the alley to engage them.

Jostin Joestar proposes fortifying both the club and the bathhouse via an underground tunnel. Hana Kisaragi completes Jovian Joestar's power knuckles and offers to survey the foundations for the project. Nobu and Reiko suggest utilizing existing service and drainage tunnels to save time and avoid detection, a plan Yuzuki Hoshino reluctantly accepts provided her grandmother's tiles remain intact.

Jostin Joestar asks for the day's priorities and current time. Reiko demands a decision on whether to pursue the lead on Gara in Shutter Alley or fortify the club first, while Nobu seeks approval to survey existing service tunnels. During the discussion, Aurelia Voss calls Jovian Joestar to propose adding Kaito Arashima, a contractor specializing in a collapsible cable-bow for ranged support, to the crew.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar discuss Kaito Arashima's recruitment with Aurelia Voss, agreeing to accept him because he was vouched for by Josuke Higashikata. Jostin establishes a five-division organizational structure, assigning the crew into Vanguard, Forge, Phantom, Command, and Lifeline roles. The crew accepts these assignments, and the group now awaits a decision on whether to survey the tunnels or pursue Gara in Shutter Alley.

Jostin Joestar officially organizes the crew into five divisions: Vanguard (Jovian, Mikoto), Forge (Nobu, Hana), Phantom (Jostin, Kaito), Command (Haruto, Reiko), and Lifeline (Yuzuki). Jovian confirms with Aurelia Voss that a security door installation and staff shuttle are scheduled for tomorrow. Nobu and Reiko press the leaders for a decision between surveying the canal-side service tunnels or pursuing Gara in Shutter Alley.

Jovian Joestar decides the crew will pursue both objectives, assigning Nobu and Hana to survey the tunnels while he, Jostin, and Kaito head to Shutter Alley to find Gara. Kaito accepts the invitation to join the hunt. Yuzuki Hoshino requests to accompany the Shutter Alley group, offering her medical skills and knowledge of Kobuncho's back streets to avoid being a burden.

Jostin Joestar and Haruto Saionji plan to lure four enforcers away, but a fight ensues at Yuzuki Hoshino's bathhouse involving Jovian Joestar and Mikoto. Despite injuries to the allies, Yuzuki uses her spirit to heal the group and disarm the enemies, forcing the enforcers to retreat. Haruto uses Crown Script to stop Jostin from using the "Hoshino Requiem" technique to kill the fleeing enforcers.

Jostin and Jovian accept Yuzuki Hoshino into their group, and she leads them through Kobuncho's back streets to Shutter Alley. Upon arrival, Kaito Arashima takes a rooftop overwatch position with his cable-bow to monitor the area. Yuzuki identifies a safe extraction point by the beer crates, while Reiko, Nobu, and Hana provide a status update via earpiece regarding the service-tunnel survey.

Jostin Joestar scales a water tower bracket to secure a vantage point while Jovian Joestar requests that Mikoto join the group at Shutter Alley. Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian's bruises before the group is admitted into a hidden workshop by a man named Gara. After reviewing their evidence, Gara reveals that Daigo Renjiro is the boss behind the protection racket and is systematically seizing control of Kobuncho.

Jovian Joestar demands to know if Daigo Renjiro is a subordinate of the Kurokawa syndicate. Gara clarifies that Renjiro is actually the superior, having usurped control and using Kurokawa as a puppet. Gara explains that Renjiro is using secret tunnels to seize the district and suggests these tunnels are linked to the disappearance of local hostesses. Gara presents a photograph of Renjiro, warning the group that they are now fighting the man who controls the entire area.

Jostin Joestar questions Gara's motives, to which Gara replies that he wants the ward to be safer for shopkeepers. Gara then assigns the group their first job: stopping "Sickle" Sato's collection crew from attacking three specific businesses along the canal today. Kaito Arashima offers to scout the route, and Yuzuki Hoshino requests to warn the shopkeepers beforehand. While Jovian Joestar demands Daigo Renjiro's current location, Gara urges patience, stating that defeating Sato's crew is the first step to understanding Daigo.

After Jostin Joestar falls unconscious, Jovian, Haruto, and Mikoto move him to a bathhouse. Haruto explains Stands to Yuzuki Hoshino and later informs the crew that Yuzuki's healing abilities make her a target for Ohba and Kurokawa. After Yuzuki joins the crew and receives a custom kimono, Jovian and Jostin collect new equipment while Reiko urges the group to either secure Shutter Alley or fortify the club.

Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to verify that Gara is telling the truth about his motives and the mission. Gara urges the group to hurry as "Sickle" Sato's crew is already moving toward the first target. Kaito Arashima spots Sato and his heavies approaching the tofu shop and requests orders, while Yuzuki Hoshino heads to warn the shopkeepers. Jovian Joestar leads the team to the canal, where they establish a tactical position as Sato arrives at the first shop.

Jovian Joestar commands Kaito Arashima to intercept the enemy and Yuzuki Hoshino to evacuate the shops. Kaito halts Sato with a cable-bow shot, while Yuzuki successfully warns the tofu shopkeepers to hide. Jostin Joestar attacks the heavies with throwing knives, wounding two, as three additional enforcers arrive to flank the group. Sato orders Heavy 1 to track Kaito and Heavy 2 to cut off Yuzuki's escape route.

Jostin Joestar uses a kusarigama to incapacitate Heavy 1 and Heavy 2, the latter falling to a combined strike from Jostin and Kaito Arashima. Sato "Sickle" redirects a knife to block Yuzuki Hoshino's retreat and yanks Kaito's cable-bow line to disrupt his aim. Heavy 1 interrupts Jovian Joestar's energy buildup with a shoulder slam, while Jostin wounds Heavy 3 and Heavy 4. Mikoto Kurogane arrives and detonates a shockwave under Heavy 4 after taking a baton strike to the shoulder. Sato claims the advantage as Heavy 3 cuts off Jostin's escape route.

Jostin Joestar proposes fortifying the club and bathhouse via underground tunnels, a plan Nobu and Reiko suggest executing through existing service tunnels with Yuzuki Hoshino's approval. Jovian and Jostin Joestar agree to recruit Kaito Arashima after Aurelia Voss vouches for him via Josuke Higashikata. Jostin organizes the crew into five divisions and awaits a decision on whether to survey the tunnels or pursue Gara in Shutter Alley.

Conversation with Mikoto Kurogane: Jostin Joestar asked Mikoto Kurogane if she possessed a stand. Mikoto denied having one and instead explained that her power, Riot Pulse, allows her to convert movement and impact into close-range shockwaves.

Jovian Joestar incapacitates Heavy 3 with a Breaker Limit strike and later knocks Heavy 1 into a truck using a Road Hog charge. Yuzuki Hoshino uses Soothing Aura to heal the wounded on both sides, while Jostin Joestar downs Heavy 4 with a high-velocity knife throw. Mikoto Kurogane takes a hit to the ribs from Heavy 4 but retaliates with a shockwave to finish him. Kaito Arashima summons his Stand, Horizon Breaker, and aims an energy bolt at Sato, who now stands alone.

Conversation with Sato "Sickle": Jostin Joestar asked Sato "Sickle" if he still had two heavies with him. Sato confirmed their presence but warned Jostin that they were not the primary threat to worry about.

Sato deploys Harvest Line and challenges Jovian Joestar, who launches a barrage of strikes. Heavy 5 uses Iron Posture to shield Sato, though Jovian still lands several hits. Jostin Joestar drops from a rooftop, wounding Heavy 5 and Heavy 6 with his kusarigama. Heavy 6 ambushes Kaito Arashima, clipping his shoulder and causing Kaito's ricochet bolt to miss Sato. Mikoto Kurogane uses a Riot Pulse to disrupt Sato's footing, while Yuzuki Hoshino uses Soothing Aura to heal Mikoto and Kaito.

Jovian Joestar splits his crew, sending Nobu and Hana to survey tunnels while he, Jostin, Kaito, and Yuzuki Hoshino travel to Shutter Alley. There, the group meets Gara, who reveals that Daigo Renjiro has usurped the Kurokawa syndicate and is using secret tunnels to seize Kobuncho. Gara provides a photograph of Renjiro and links his activities to the disappearance of local hostesses.

Jovian Joestar attempted a synchronized strike with Mikoto Kurogane, but Sato "Sickle" evaded by using a delivery cart as a pivot, causing Mikoto to hit the cart and sustain shrapnel scratches. Jostin Joestar overwhelmed Heavy 5 and Heavy 6 with kusarigama strikes, though Heavy 6 retaliated by striking Jostin's shoulder with a pry bar. Sato redirected Kaito Arashima's bolt and Jostin's momentum to strike Jostin in the ribs, while Yuzuki Hoshino used Soothing Aura to heal the Joestar Gang. Kaito shot and wounded the cable-cutter, and Mikoto detonated a Riot Pulse to destroy Sato's delivery cart anchor, staggering him.

Jovian Joestar swept Sato "Sickle" off his feet and landed a heavy uppercut to his ribs, forcing the leader into a defensive struggle. Jostin Joestar used an enhanced Peach Assassination barrage to severely wound Heavy 5 and Heavy 6, though both remained standing. Heavy 6 struck Kaito Arashima from behind, and the cable-cutter severed Kaito's tether, but Kaito retaliated by shooting the cutter in the chest. Mikoto Kurogane destroyed Sato's delivery cart with a Riot Pulse, though Sato evaded and countered with a strike to her arm. Yuzuki Hoshino used Soothing Aura to heal Mikoto and Kaito as Sato acknowledged the Joestar Gang's strength.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar defeat Haruto Saionji and three teammates in a battle, after which the brothers flee to Club Lumiere in Kobuncho. There, they help hostesses Maki, Natsumi, Chiho, Tomoe, and Kaede clean the establishment and meet Aurelia Voss, who funds repairs through the Speedwagon Foundation. Jovian assigns paperwork to Aurelia and Maki before the brothers travel to Shutter Alley to find Gara.

Jovian Joestar used Desperation Impact to incapacitate Heavy 5 and Heavy 6, whom Jostin Joestar then executed with a Peach Assassination volley and hidden blade. Yuzuki Hoshino healed Mikoto and Kaito, while Kaito overcame an attack by the cable-cutter to shoot Sato, breaking his Harvest Line web. Mikoto used a shockwave to off-balance Sato, but the leader countered by swinging around a cart to strike Jovian in the ribs.

Jostin Joestar launched a glass volley at Sato, but Sato countered by redirecting debris to wound Jostin and the others. The cable-cutter injured Kaito with an awning cable, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to heal Kaito and Mikoto. After Sato dodged Jostin's blade and absorbed Jovian's charge, Mikoto detonated a Riot Pulse at Sato's knee, allowing Kaito to shoot him with a ricochet bolt. Following Sato's death, the cable-cutter surrendered.

Jovian Joestar requests a group heal as Jostin Joestar prepares to loot Sato's body for information. Sato's corpse suddenly reanimates as a mindless puppet, prompting Mikoto Kurogane and Kaito Arashima to engage it with a Riot Pulse and a ricochet bolt to cover the group's retreat. Jostin steals a route sheet and keyring from the body before the crew escapes into the Riverside Food Market. Kaito warns the group that an unknown enemy now knows their identities.

Gara assigns Jostin, Jovian, Kaito, and Yuzuki the task of protecting three canal businesses from "Sickle" Sato's collection crew to eventually locate Daigo Renjiro. Kaito and Yuzuki scout and warn the shopkeepers while Jovian leads the team to intercept the attackers. After a series of exchanges involving knives, a cable-bow, and a shockwave from Mikoto Kurogane, the group incapacitates several heavies, though Sato maintains a tactical advantage.

Conversation with Kaito Arashima: Jostin Joestar questioned Kaito Arashima about the mechanics of his stand, Horizon Breaker. Kaito explained that he uses anchors on surfaces to create paths that allow his shots to bend around corners and hit targets blindly. He concluded by revealing that he had already set three anchors in the market rafters to ambush anyone entering.

Conversation with Mikoto Kurogane: Jostin Joestar asked Mikoto Kurogane if they possessed a stand. Mikoto replied that they did not, explaining instead that their power, Riot Pulse, allows them to convert movement and impact into close-range shockwaves.

Yuzuki Hoshino uses Golden Mend to heal Jovian and Jostin Joestar. Jostin praises the team's success, but Mikoto Kurogane warns him not to jinx the situation while she guards the market entrance. Kaito Arashima takes the point toward Gara, urging Jostin to deliver Sato's route sheet quickly.

Jovian Joestar notifies Haruto and Reiko via earpiece that the collector was hijacked by a puppeteer and that the team is returning to Gara. Kaito Arashima scouts the rooftops and clears the route while Mikoto Kurogane guards the rear. As the group exits the market into Kobuncho, they encounter a residential fire where firefighters are unable to reach a trapped woman on the second floor.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar agree to recover stolen money for Gara and stop shakedowns in Kobuncho for Principal Anya. After Jovian assumes ownership of Club Lumière from Aurelia Voss, he and Jostin organize a crew consisting of Reiko, Haruto, Mikoto, Hana Kisaragi, and Nobu. The group prepares specialized gear and a tactical plan to intercept a money transfer from the Noodle Shop crew.

Jovian Joestar urges the group to prioritize delivering intel to Gara, but Jostin Joestar ignores him and enters the burning building to rescue civilians. A panicked resident informs Jostin that her mother is trapped on the second floor.
