Jovian Joestar feigns a stumble to lure Kiri into a star-shaped shockwave, knocking him unconscious. Mikoto Kurogane is ambushed by the real Kiri via a copy trick, but she quickly counters with a Riot Pulse to knock him out. Below, Jostin Joestar uses "Peach Killroom" to silence the area and knock Tatsuya into shelving, though Tatsuya manages to blow his whistle and alert a descending guard. Kaito Arashima prepares to intercept the guard from the roof, while Nobu Takamine and Rikona Mibu monitor the exterior and dead communications.

Jostin Joestar invites magic users to the gym, where the crew meets Kenji Aoi, a Seiran Tech fighter searching for the perpetrator of a car explosion. After Kenji challenges Jovian Joestar to a fight at the riverbank, the group recruits Rikona Mibu and decides to have Yuzuki Hoshino act as a disguised stand-in fighter. At the riverbank, Kenji deploys barriers and challenges Yuzuki to combat.

Jostin Joestar attempts to contact Haruto Saionji for help, but the signal fails; Haruto instead distracts cage officials by accusing them of tampering. In the annex, Tatsuya attacks Jostin, but Jostin redirects the momentum to throw Tatsuya into a doorframe. Kaito Arashima pins a descending guard to a ladder with a tether bolt, while Shun attempts to unlock the annex door. In the cage, Jovian Joestar strikes Iwao with a powerful aerial attack, but Mikoto Kurogane intervenes to break Iwao's subsequent attempt to grab Jovian. Meanwhile, Nobu Takamine monitors the service hatch via drone, and Rikona Mibu moves toward the service door.

In the cage, Jovian Joestar uses a new technique, "Soul Pierce," to bypass Iwao's guard and knock him down, winning the first round. Banda declares a ten-minute break with no medics, while Haruto Saionji secretly places a gold line under Iwao's feet. In the annex, Jostin Joestar incapacitates Tatsuya with a "Peach Flash Step" and locks the arena-side door, while Kaito Arashima pins a guard's arm to a ladder with a tether bolt. Simultaneously, Rikona Mibu and Shun signal for entry at the service door as Nobu Takamine prepares the getaway vehicle.

Jostin, Jovian, Nobu, Haruto, Kaito, Reiko, and Rikona meet at Steam Lantern Alley to plan a rescue mission at The House. Nobu uses a drone to distract a guard so Haruto can steal required red tokens, while Jovian and Mikoto register as fighters and Jostin enters as a spectator. After Rikona enters the building to gain the target's trust, the group arrives at a bunker arena where a humming sound dampens Mikoto's powers.

Conversation with Nobu Takamine: Nobu Takamine informed Jostin Joestar that Tatsuya was down and the team was positioned at the annex under The House. Nobu confirmed that the arena door was deadbolted and instructed Jostin to escort Shun through the service door to where Rikona and a running van were waiting.

Jovian Joestar boasts about his abilities to Mikoto Kurogane while Haruto Saionji identifies Kenji Aoi as the next opponent. Banda announces the start of Round 2 preparations as house staff assist a bleeding Iwao. In the annex, Jostin Joestar uses Tatsuya's keys to free debtors and directs them toward Nobu Takamine's idling van. Shun refuses to leave until his friend Daiki and other prisoners are rescued from the "humming room," prompting Rikona Mibu to coordinate their evacuation.

Jovian Joestar mocks Kenji Aoi, who responds by demanding to fight a "wind-user" and claiming to recognize Jovian from school. Haruto Saionji alerts the crew via headset that Kenji's partner has a hidden knuckle spike, prompting Mikoto Kurogane to warn Jovian. In the annex, Jostin Joestar uses "Eagle Vision" to locate prisoners in the humming room and instructs Rikona Mibu to evacuate Shun and the debtors. Nobu Takamine confirms the topside evacuation is complete as Banda rings the bell to start Round 2.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar, along with their allies, defeat several enemies including Sato and Daigo Renjiro's enforcers to establish Club Lumière in Kobuncho. Jostin disrupts Daigo's finances and recruits students while Jovian and Yuzuki Hoshino coordinate alliances to seize Kurokawa's territory. After Jostin kills Iori Vale and the group repels Kurokawa's forces, Haruto Saionji, Reiko, and Jovian plan an attack on Daigo Renjiro's Legitimacy captain.

Jovian Joestar eats takoyaki and taunts Kenji Aoi as Round 2 begins. Banda encourages the crowd to bet against the newcomers, while Haruto Saionji loudly accuses the officials of rigging the ring to distract them from the service corridor. Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch from the roof as Kenji's rune attack is neutralized by the arena's hum. Goro stabs Jovian in the ribs with a hidden knuckle spike, and Mikoto Kurogane strikes Kenji with a Riot Pulse. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar uses Shadow Step to infiltrate the humming room, where he discovers six chained prisoners powering a machine; one prisoner, Daiki, silently warns him not to cut the power too quickly.

Jovian Joestar taunts Goro into attacking, then uses his Stand, Breaker's Soul, to counter the strike and slam Goro into the fence, exposing Goro's hidden knuckle spike to the crowd. Kenji Aoi expresses disgust at the cheating, but Mikoto Kurogane interrupts him with a Riot Pulse strike. A runner informs Banda that the Handler is down in the annex, prompting the overseer to investigate. Meanwhile, Daiki uses Energy Shunt to weaken his shackles, and Jostin Joestar sets several weak Peach Aftershock charges to ambush the overseer. Haruto Saionji continues to distract the officials, while Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch of the service corridor.

Banda starts Tag Night by pitting Jovian and Mikoto against Iwao and Kiri. While Jovian and Mikoto fight the duo in the ring, Jostin uses Shadow Step to enter a concrete annex where he finds imprisoned debtors and a handler named Tatsuya preparing a teen named Shun. Jostin attempts to knock out Tatsuya, but Tatsuya dodges and calls for guards.

Conversation with Daiki: Jostin Joestar questioned why they were waiting to attack. Daiki explained that he was slowly bleeding off an electrical current to avoid a lethal feedback loop. He warned Jostin not to strike until he gave the signal, as an early attack would cause a surge to kill everyone.

Jovian Joestar uses his Stand's Third Form to knock Goro unconscious, leading Kenji Aoi to forfeit the win in disgust over Goro's cheating. Mikoto Kurogane warns the group of incoming guards as Banda orders subordinates to the arena and the annex. Jostin Joestar ambushes the overseer with Peach Aftershocks, though the overseer remains standing after the attack. Daiki frees one wrist and scrambles for the overseer's dropped keys, urging the others to hold hands.

Jostin Joestar secures the keys for Daiki and attempts to restrain the overseer, but the overseer throws him into a pipe to break the grip. Daiki uses the keys to unlock the casters' shackles and leads them toward a service door. Jovian Joestar praises Kenji Aoi for forfeiting before using Road Hog to launch himself from the cage toward Haruto Saionji. Haruto uses Crown Script to freeze a descending guard, while Banda injects himself with a syringe and orders the crowd to evacuate under threat of violence.

Jovian Joestar defeats Kiri and Iwao in the cage, while Mikoto Kurogane assists him. In the annex, Jostin Joestar incapacitates Tatsuya and pins guards with Kaito Arashima's help to free debtors and escort Shun toward Nobu Takamine and Rikona Mibu's getaway van. Haruto Saionji distracts officials and prepares the next opponent, Kenji Aoi, as Shun and Rikona coordinate a rescue for prisoners in the humming room.

Jostin Joestar pins the overseer to the wall to allow Daiki to lead six freed casters toward the service door. The overseer headbutts Jostin and slams him into a wall, but Jostin recovers and informs Nobu Takamine via comms that the basement is breaking open. In the arena, Jovian Joestar uses Phantom Step to confront Banda, who strikes Jovian in the jaw and claims leadership. Meanwhile, Haruto Saionji spots Yuji stealing cash and ledgers; Mikoto Kurogane blocks Yuji's path while Kaito Arashima targets Yuji's legs with a tether.

Jovian Joestar taunts Banda and attacks with Phantom Strike, but Banda shrugs off the hits and crushes Jovian in a clinch. At the betting desk, Mikoto Kurogane and Haruto Saionji reject Yuji's bribe and trap him in the corridor while Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch. Jostin Joestar uses Shadow Step to escape the basement after Daiki clears the prisoners, leaving a Peach Aftershock charge that detonates under the overseer. Jostin reaches the extraction van, where Yuzuki Hoshino begins treating his injuries as Nobu Takamine confirms the prisoners are secure.

Jovian Joestar uses Heaven's Impact to blast Banda away and retreats to the stairwell, calling for Mikoto Kurogane to take over. Mikoto strikes the charging Banda with a Riot Pulse shockwave, knocking him into the cage mesh, though Banda remains standing. Topside, an exhausted Jostin Joestar collapses while trying to return to the fight, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to treat his wounds and urge him to stop. Meanwhile, Haruto Saionji keeps Yuji trapped with a gold line and requests that someone retrieve the runner's bag.

Jostin Joestar retreats to the van, but Nobu Takamine refuses to leave until Mikoto and Haruto are safe. In the basement, Yuzuki Hoshino uses the last of her healing energy to mend Jovian Joestar's injuries. Banda pins Mikoto to the ground, prompting Kenji Aoi to intervene by striking Banda with a violet energy bolt. Topside, Haruto Saionji maintains his restraint on Yuji and coordinates with Kaito Arashima to provide cover for Jovian's final assault.

Jovian Joestar defeats Goro and Kenji Aoi in the ring after Mikoto Kurogane and Haruto Saionji provide tactical support. Simultaneously, Jostin Joestar infiltrates the humming room to rescue prisoners, where he and Daiki coordinate an ambush on the overseer. While Kaito Arashima maintains overwatch, Daiki attempts to retrieve keys following Jostin's attack on the overseer.

Rikona Mibu treats Jostin Joestar's injuries in the van while Shun thanks Jostin for the rescue. In the arena, Yuzuki Hoshino provides a final burst of healing to Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane, allowing Jovian to tackle Banda away from Mikoto. Kenji Aoi strikes Banda with energy bolts, and Banda eventually collapses as his enhancer syringe fails, though he desperately searches for a replacement. Topside, Haruto Saionji and Kaito Arashima keep Yuji restrained while Yuji attempts to push a duffel bag away. Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi coordinate the getaway van's departure as Ayame Fujinami records Banda's defeat.

Jovian Joestar pins Banda's wrist to prevent him from using a syringe, allowing Mikoto Kurogane to knock Banda unconscious with a Riot Pulse. Haruto Saionji seizes Yuji's duffel bag and orders the runner to flee. After Kenji Aoi departs and Kaito Arashima clears the rooftop, the crew retreats to the van as sirens approach. Nobu Takamine drives the group, including a rescued Shun, away from the docks.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar celebrate their victory despite their injuries, leading to a sarcastic exchange with Mikoto Kurogane about who defeated Banda. Rikona Mibu uses Mending Pulse to treat the brothers' ribs and internal injuries. Haruto Saionji discovers a second ledger in the stolen duffel bag, noting that Banda was skimming money from Daigo. Ayame Fujinami reports that her stream of the fight is trending, while Nobu Takamine asks the group for a decision on where to drop off Shun and the other rescued debtors.

Jovian Joestar feigns sleep to avoid decision-making, prompting Haruto Saionji to order that debtors be dropped home via staggered, untraceable routes. Haruto suggests using the stolen funds to establish a permanent safehouse, a plan Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi begin coordinating via secure routing. Yuzuki Hoshino provides food and water to the debtors, while Rikona Mibu insists on personally escorting Shun home to ensure his safety. Shun remains distressed at the mention of his home but begins to eat as Nobu starts the drop-off sequence.

Kenji Aoi attacks Yuzuki Hoshino, but Yuzuki defeats him with help from Mikoto Kurogane and Rikona Mibu. After Jostin Joestar pays Rikona's debt and the group retreats to Club Lumière, Rikona asks Jostin and Jovian Joestar to help rescue a boy abducted by the Kurokawa Enforcement captain. Haruto Saionji organizes a rescue plan for a bathhouse basement following Nobu Takamine's scouting of Steam Lantern Alley.

Jostin Joestar bids Rikona Mibu and Shun farewell as they reach their destination. After Rikona ensures Shun enters his home, Jovian Joestar wakes and discovers that Haruto Saionji stole a duffel bag of money during the fight to fund a safehouse. Following teasing from Mikoto Kurogane and Ayame Fujinami, Nobu Takamine completes the debtor drop-offs and asks the crew where to regroup.

Jovian Joestar demands custody of the stolen money to prevent others from siphoning it. Haruto Saionji proposes allocating most of the funds to a safehouse and a smaller portion for a celebration, provided every yen is logged. While Jostin Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane argue for an expensive party and yakiniku, Hana Kisaragi insists on prioritizing gear repairs and operating costs. Ayame Fujinami suggests filming a victory party for her stream, and Yuzuki Hoshino offers to cook for the crew at Club Lumière. After Nobu Takamine drives the group back to the club, Haruto asks the crew to vote on how to split the budget and who should hold the cash.

Jovian Joestar demands the appointment of a finance officer to manage the crew's funds. Jostin Joestar agrees with the need for a business-minded recruit, while Haruto Saionji proposes a 70/30 split between the safehouse and tonight's celebration. Nobu Takamine insists on strict receipt logging, Hana Kisaragi demands priority funding for gear repairs, and Mikoto Kurogane threatens mutiny if they do not eat yakiniku. Ayame Fujinami begins preparing her stream for the party, and Yuzuki Hoshino starts cooking in the kitchen as the crew enters Club Lumière to decide who will manage the money.

Jostin Joestar secures keys for Daiki to free six casters from the basement, eventually detonating a charge under the overseer before retreating to Yuzuki Hoshino for medical treatment. In the arena, Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane engage in a physical confrontation with Banda. Simultaneously, Haruto Saionji and Kaito Arashima trap Yuji to prevent him from escaping with stolen cash and ledgers.

Jostin Joestar posts a job listing for a treasurer on the crew's app, which Nobu Takamine edits to include receipt requirements and a probation clause. Haruto Saionji allocates the party budget, while Hana Kisaragi demands a line item for equipment repairs. Mikoto Kurogane purchases meat from a local butcher, and Ayame Fujinami begins livestreaming the celebration. The crew gathers for a meal prepared by Yuzuki Hoshino to celebrate their victory.

Jostin Joestar invites Rikona Mibu to the celebration via text, though she declines to stay home. Ayame Fujinami teases Jostin on her livestream while Mikoto Kurogane and Jovian Joestar playfully fight over the meat. Yuzuki Hoshino insists on inspecting Jostin's bandaged ribs before he eats. Reiko Amagawa warns the group that Daigo will be monitoring them, while the rest of the crew discusses budgets, repairs, and the night's victory.

Jovian Joestar leads the group in a celebratory toast to the Joestar Gang's second victory over Daigo's captains. Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami play to Ayame's livestream, while Kaito, Hana, Haruto, Nobu, Mikoto, and Reiko each offer a toast reflecting their personal priorities. Yuzuki Hoshino encourages Jostin to eat more protein for his rib recovery as the crew celebrates together.

Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane, enabling Jovian to pin Banda while Kenji Aoi attacks him with energy bolts. Mikoto knocks Banda unconscious, and Haruto Saionji seizes Yuji's duffel bag before the group retreats to a van driven by Nobu Takamine. Rikona Mibu treats the Joestar brothers' injuries, and Haruto finds a ledger in the bag proving Banda stole money from Daigo.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar lead the crew in a final celebratory toast before Ayame Fujinami ends her livestream with a tease of a future announcement. The following morning, Yuzuki Hoshino provides recovery drinks and food to the hungover group. Hana Kisaragi admits an applicant named Satoshi Tsuge for an interview. Nobu Takamine informs Tsuge of strict probation and ledger terms, and Haruto Saionji begins the interview by demanding concrete figures from Tsuge's professional history.

Jovian Joestar pulls Jostin Joestar aside to question if Satoshi Tsuge knows they are a gang; Jostin denies telling him and claims the role is simply managing legal establishments. During the interview, Tsuge provides specific financial figures from his history and correctly identifies a balancing error in a ledger provided by Nobu Takamine. Reiko Amagawa notes that Tsuge appears genuine and nervous, while Hana Kisaragi monitors the street. Tsuge then asks for clarification on the nature of the businesses, noting that their accounts look unusual.

Jovian Joestar rejects Satoshi Tsuge's application, and Jostin Joestar adds that Tsuge is not a "culture fit." After Tsuge departs, Haruto Saionji calls in the next candidate, Ginji Ozu. Ozu, a former bank employee, presents his resume and demands a meaningful cut of operations and signing authority in exchange for his financial expertise.

Jovian Joestar rejects Ginji Ozu for being too old and expresses disbelief to Haruto Saionji that Ozu was even considered. Ozu departs after noting the gang's loss. Haruto introduces the final candidate, a scruffy fixer named Rin, who presents a disorganized folder of notes. Rin immediately pitches strategies to fill dead hours, bundle business passes, and fix supplier leaks, claiming she knows every fixer in the ward.

Haruto Saionji uses stolen funds to plan a safehouse while Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi coordinate debtor drop-offs. After Rikona Mibu escorts Shun home, the crew returns to Club Lumière to debate how to divide the money between gear repairs, a celebration, and the safehouse. The group, including Jovian Joestar, Jostin Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, Ayame Fujinami, and Yuzuki Hoshino, votes on a budget split and the appointment of a finance officer.

Jovian Joestar accuses Rin of being a spy after recognizing her as a former clerk from the House. Jostin Joestar uses his Stand to confirm Rin is not a threat, while Haruto Saionji and Reiko Amagawa note her familiarity and composure. Rin explains she applied for the position because she lost her job when the House collapsed and expresses her hatred for her former employers. Nobu Takamine stipulates that a probation clause would apply if she is hired, and Ayame Fujinami supports the hire for its narrative appeal.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for the Command division to manage finances and logistics under a one-month probation. Rin explains she recognized the group from "Tag Night" and Ayame's social media posts. Ayame then forcibly takes Rin for a makeover, while Nobu Takamine enforces strict audit and receipt requirements for the new hire.

Jostin Joestar orders Rin to immediately begin managing the club and bathhouse finances and to coordinate a safehouse build with the Forge Division. Nobu Takamine and Hana Kisaragi outline the technical requirements for the safehouse, which Haruto Saionji approves and funds. After Ayame Fujinami gives Rin a professional makeover, Rin returns to the group to deliver her full pitch to Jovian Joestar.

Rin presents a financial pitch to Jovian Joestar involving club event nights, bathhouse and izakaya bundles, stream sponsorships for Ayame, and a new produce supplier to stop skimming. Haruto Saionji questions the event night projections, while Nobu Takamine demands a full audit and paperwork for all expenditures. Ayame Fujinami expresses excitement over the sponsorship cuts, and Yuzuki Hoshino requests final approval over any changes to her bathhouse.

Jostin Joestar posts a treasurer job listing that Nobu Takamine edits, while Haruto Saionji and Hana Kisaragi manage budget and repair allocations. The Joestar Gang celebrates their victory over Daigo's captains with a meal prepared by Yuzuki Hoshino, featuring a livestream by Ayame Fujinami and toasts from the crew. The following morning, the group interviews a job applicant named Satoshi Tsuge regarding his professional history and probation terms.

Jovian Joestar approves Rin's financial plan on a trial basis, starting with event nights tonight, though Yuzuki Hoshino requests a written proposal before agreeing to the bathhouse bundles. Ayame Fujinami promotes the event via a teaser stream, while Nobu Takamine and Haruto Saionji establish strict auditing and funding protocols for the operating float. At nine o'clock, Hana Kisaragi manages the door as guests enter Club Lumière to begin the trial run.

Jostin Joestar disrupts Ayame Fujinami's promotional stream with a loud, cheerful appearance to welcome guests to Club Lumière. Jovian Joestar mingles with regulars to gauge their reactions to the new management and agrees to reserve the best booths in exchange for their word-of-mouth support. At the bar, Nobu Takamine audits the first hour's cash, while Hana Kisaragi collects cover charges at the door and Yuzuki Hoshino provides guest service. Rin reports to Jovian that the first hour's attendance is slightly below projection, though higher drink spending is keeping gross revenue on track.

Jostin and Jovian Joestar join a group including Haruto, Ayame, and Rikona to plan a rescue mission at "The House," with Haruto organizing roles for distraction, infiltration, and support. Before the mission, the brothers visit Tetsu Iron Palm Gym where Riko Amane trains Jostin in kusarigama drills and Tetsu forces Jovian to practice power control after he damages the facility. Later, at Steam Lantern Alley, the group executes a plan involving Nobu's drone and red tokens to enter a bunker arena where a humming sound dampens Mikoto's powers.

Conversation with curious students: Jostin Joestar asked a group of students about the size of the crowd. Nanami, one of the students, mistakenly claimed it was Thursday, but Jostin corrected her that it was Sunday. Nanami admitted she had lost track of the week due to finals and noted that the "mystery takeover" was successfully attracting people.

Conversation with Lumière regulars: Jostin Joestar offered to buy a round of drinks for the Lumière regulars. A silver-haired man declined the gesture, advising Jostin to save his money for the business's float instead.

Jostin Joestar invites Rikona Mibu to the club via text, but she declines to stay home with her brother. Jovian Joestar dismisses Rin's concerns about attendance projections and instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to prioritize selling expensive bottles over tea. Yuzuki attempts a nervous sales pitch to regulars who mock her delivery, though one guest eventually asks to see the bottle list. Nobu Takamine logs the champagne pricing, while Hana Kisaragi notes Yuzuki's lack of sales skills.

Jostin Joestar and Rin discuss their respective roles in sales and logistics. Jovian Joestar successfully sells three bottles of champagne to a booth of regulars, prompting Yuzuki Hoshino to gain confidence and secure another sale. Nobu Takamine audits the champagne transactions while Ayame Fujinami streams the event to her followers. By eleven, Rin reports that attendance and revenue have exceeded projections by twenty percent.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar reject Satoshi Tsuge and Ginji Ozu after interviews involving financial tests and salary demands. Haruto Saionji then introduces Rin, a former House clerk whom Jovian suspects of spying. After Jostin confirms she is not a threat, Nobu Takamine and Ayame Fujinami agree to hire Rin under a probation clause.

Jostin Joestar performs a choreographed dance on the bar to entertain the crowd, which Rin notes has increased the average tab by fifteen percent. Ayame Fujinami streams the performance before ending her broadcast, while Hana Kisaragi and Nobu Takamine express concerns over potential property damage and financial losses. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar encourages Yuzuki Hoshino, and Haruto Saionji tells Jovian that he trusts Yuzuki's performance and wants to keep her on the crew.

Jovian Joestar gathers feedback from Lumière regulars, who praise the service but criticize the high cover charge and excessive volume. Rin logs these complaints before ordering the hostesses to the floor for their showcase slot. After the hostesses introduce themselves to the crowd, Maki Hayashida orders Jostin Joestar off the bar to prevent property damage, prompting him to comply.

Jovian Joestar encourages the crowd to enjoy the night before stepping back to let the staff work. Yuzuki Hoshino celebrates selling six bottles, receiving praise from Reiko Amagawa and Kaito Arashima. After the guests depart and Hana Kisaragi locks the venue, Nobu Takamine and Maki Hayashida finalize the till. Rin reports that the night exceeded projections by twenty-two percent and proposes adjustments to the cover charge and volume. Haruto Saionji approves the results but orders the students, including Jostin Joestar, to go home and sleep.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for a one-month probation in the Command division, where Nobu Takamine and Jovian Joestar task her with managing finances and coordinating a safehouse build. Rin presents a financial plan to Jovian Joestar involving event nights, sponsorships for Ayame Fujinami, and new suppliers, which is approved on a trial basis. Following a makeover by Ayame, the group implements auditing protocols and Hana Kisaragi manages the door for the trial event at Club Lumière.

Jovian Joestar attempts to skip school to celebrate the night's success, but Haruto Saionji denies the request and promises to document the win in a formal report instead. Jostin Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane begrudgingly agree to attend homeroom, while Nobu Takamine warns the group to keep their phones silent in class. Hana Kisaragi orders the students to walk home together for safety, and Ayame Fujinami threatens to film Jovian's potential detention. Meanwhile, Rin asks Jovian to approve a discounted student cover and a late-night sound cap for future events.

Jovian approves Rin's budget requests, and the group departs for the dorms, though Yuzuki and Reiko split off. During their walk, Hana provides a first-aid kit to paramedics treating an injured student. By Monday morning, the crew returns to Chikara Academy, where Haruto reminds Jovian of his meeting with Rin and Nobu enforces phone silence before the homeroom bell rings.

Banda pits Jovian and Mikoto against Iwao and Kiri, while Jostin and Kaito rescue Shun and other debtors from Tatsuya in a concrete annex. Jovian defeats Goro and Kenji Aoi in the ring and later fights Banda, while Haruto and Kaito trap Yuji to recover stolen cash and ledgers. Simultaneously, Jostin and Daiki ambush an overseer in the humming room to free six casters before Jostin retreats to Yuzuki Hoshino for treatment.

Jovian notices Rikona's absence, but Mikoto reminds him that she is in a different classroom. Ayame and Nobu inform Jovian that Rikona requested a low-key meeting on the roof at lunch regarding her block. Haruto announces that the funding session with Rin is moved to after school as the substitute teacher begins roll call.

The substitute teacher, Yamada, administers a surprise twenty-minute quiz. Ayame offers to cover for Jovian and Jostin's lunch meeting by filming a fake media errand in exchange for future content. After class, Mikoto warns the brothers that Rikona's classroom was empty during the break and to return before fifth period. Jovian and Jostin arrive on the roof, where Rikona Mibu is waiting to speak with them.

Conversation with Rikona Mibu: Jostin Joestar noted that Rikona Mibu seemed on edge. Rikona admitted there was a problem near her block that she could not fix alone.

Rikona Mibu leads Jovian and Jostin Joestar to the center of the roof to speak privately. Rikona reports that debt collectors, including one she recognizes from her past, have been loitering around the Amemiya family shop. She reveals that Noa, the hostess at the Joestars' club, is the daughter of the Amemiyas. Jostin promises to keep an eye on the situation to protect their associate.

Jostin Joestar promotes Club Lumière through guest interactions and a bar dance, while Jovian Joestar manages sales and instructs Yuzuki Hoshino to prioritize expensive bottles. Nobu Takamine, Hana Kisaragi, and Rin handle financial auditing, door charges, and attendance reports. By eleven, the team exceeds revenue and attendance projections, and Haruto Saionji confirms his trust in Yuzuki's performance.

Jovian Joestar questioned Rikona Mibu regarding her personal investment in the situation. Rikona revealed she is helping because the Amemiya shop fed her brother on credit without asking for payment. Jostin Joestar invited Rikona to join their crew, though she deflected the offer.

Jovian Joestar urged Rikona Mibu to join their investigation, prompting Jostin Joestar to pat her head. After Rikona reacted with annoyance, she agreed to help with the case out of obligation to the Amemiyas. Rikona specified she is not joining the crew and will meet them at Club Lumière after school.

Jostin Joestar rested at the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym to recover from strain before heading to Kobuncho. At Club Lumière, Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine reviewed the club's budget, cover charges, and vendor quotes. Rikona Mibu arrived at the club and sat apart from the group as previously agreed.

Jovian Joestar and Rin review the club's budget and projected attendance, noting a need to renegotiate with a Lantern street vendor. Jostin Joestar provides a drink to Rikona Mibu before initiating a discussion about debt collectors targeting the Amemiya shop. Maki Hayashida, Airi, and Sena reveal that Noa Amemiya is missing and unresponsive after leaving for an errand.

Jovian Joestar declares his involvement in Noa Amemiya's disappearance, prompting Rikona Mibu to describe three debt collectors who had been loitering near the shop. Nobu Takamine begins tracking Noa's last phone ping using a message thread provided by Airi Kurosawa. Jostin Joestar conducts solo recon at the Amemiya shop, where the parents reveal Noa has been missing since the morning and discovered an anonymous envelope of cash. An unidentified man in a grey jacket departs the area upon noticing Jostin's club jacket.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji organize a lean search-and-rescue team consisting of Jovian, Jostin, Rikona, and Kaito. After Jostin promises Noa's parents he will find her, he uses Eagle Vision to tail a man in a grey jacket to a shuttered club. Nobu Takamine confirms Noa's phone last pinged at that same location. The team converges at the club, where Jostin reports two watchers and movement inside the building.

Jovian Joestar gathers customer feedback at Lumière, where Rin logs complaints and Maki Hayashida removes Jostin Joestar from the bar. Following a successful night, Haruto Saionji denies Jovian's request to skip school at Chikara Academy, and the group attends homeroom under Nobu Takamine's supervision. Jovian approves Rin's budget requests for discounted cover charges and sound caps before the team returns to school on Monday.

Kaito Arashima takes a rooftop sniping position while Rikona Mibu guards the rear with a kinetic barrier. Jostin Joestar kicks open the staff door and enters the club, followed by Jovian Joestar, whose Stand's pressure incapacitates two guards. Jovian demands information on Noa's location, though the effort causes a physical strain on his arm. A man in a grey jacket denies knowledge of Noa, while footsteps are heard retreating toward a back stairwell on the second floor.

Jovian Joestar directs Jostin Joestar to pursue the retreating footsteps. Jostin intercepts the man in the grey jacket on the stairs, incapacitating him with a strike to the knees. Rikona Mibu interrogates the man and a terrified vending-machine guy, both of whom claim a nameless man in a dark suit paid them to monitor the area. 

On the second floor, Jostin discovers the suited handler escorting two women who are not Noa through a rear exit. Kaito Arashima tags the handler's getaway van with a tether shot, tracking its movement north. Rikona concludes that the suited man has already moved Noa to another location.

Jovian Joestar breaks a sedan window and orders Kaito Arashima to hotwire the vehicle to pursue the targets. While Kaito and Rikona Mibu drive north following a tether line, Jostin Joestar runs on foot, outpacing the car. Jostin intercepts the getaway van at a red light, popping its rear tires with his kusarigama and forcing it to a halt. The suited handler bails from the vehicle and warns the group to stay back.

Ayame and Nobu inform Jovian that Rikona Mibu requested a meeting on the roof at lunch. After a surprise quiz from Yamada, Jovian and Jostin Joestar meet Rikona, who reports that debt collectors are loitering near the Amemiya family shop. Rikona reveals that Noa is the Amemiyas' daughter and that the shop previously provided free food to her brother; Jostin promises to monitor the situation and invites Rikona to join their crew.

Jostin Joestar consoles two young women at the van, learning from them that Noa was taken to the main house, Club Kagerō, to settle a family debt. Jovian Joestar intercepts the suited handler, using his Stand to demand Noa's location; the handler confirms the destination but claims he is only a courier and fears for his life if he reveals more. Kaito Arashima reports no enemy reinforcements are nearby, while Rikona Mibu maintains a barrier over the car and monitors the women.

Conversation with Kaito Arashima: Jostin Joestar asked Kaito Arashima about his background and the nature of Josuke Higashikata's Stand. Kaito explained that he was once a mercenary who was reformed by Josuke and described Crazy Diamond as a repair-type Stand capable of restoring objects and healing.

Jostin Joestar orders the full crew to mobilize for a strike on Club Kagerō. Jovian Joestar forcibly secures the handler in the sedan and demands the driver head to the club, while Rikona Mibu extracts information about the venue's cameras and exits from the two women. Kaito Arashima coordinates with Haruto Saionji to deploy reinforcements and Nobu Takamine and Rin to investigate the club's ownership. The group arrives at Club Kagerō, noting the presence of bouncers and security cameras.

Jovian Joestar recruits Rikona Mibu to help investigate Noa Amemiya's disappearance, and they later meet with Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine at Club Lumière. Rikona describes three debt collectors seen near the Amemiya shop while Nobu tracks Noa's phone using a thread from Airi Kurosawa. Jostin Joestar visits the Amemiya shop, learns about an anonymous cash envelope, and observes an unidentified man in a grey jacket leaving the area.

Conversation with Kaito Arashima: Jostin Joestar remarked that Kaito Arashima seemed knowledgeable about "jojos." Kaito acknowledged this and asked if Jostin was seeking a recommendation or had a grievance with one of them.

Jovian Joestar uses the suited handler as a human shield to force entry into Club Kagerō. Kaito Arashima uses his Stand, Horizon Breaker, to trip and pin two bouncers, securing the entrance. Using Eagle Vision, Jostin Joestar identifies guards at every exit and locates a target in a camera-monitored room on the second floor. Rikona Mibu warns the group to move quickly to avoid civilian casualties.

After Yuzuki Hoshino heals Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane, the group defeats Banda, allowing Haruto Saionji to seize a ledger proving Banda stole from Daigo. The Joestar Gang allocates these funds for repairs and a safehouse, later celebrating their victory with a meal and a livestream. Following several failed interviews, the group hires Rin, a former House clerk, under a probation clause.

Jovian Joestar forces the suited handler to act as a friend while escorting him upstairs. Kaito Arashima pins the bouncers and monitors the stair guards, while Rikona Mibu secures the street side with a barrier. Using Shadow Step, Jostin Joestar bypasses security and cameras to reach a man in a dark suit in the monitor room, who acknowledges Jostin's stealth and invites him to ask his question.

Jovian Joestar demands Noa's room number and key, threatening the man in the dark suit. The man, identifying himself as the manager of records, claims Noa Amemiya is upstairs and will be released once her family's debt is paid. He shows the Joestars recorded footage of their breach and warns that any further violence will automatically alert the police and Hero Agency. Despite Jovian manifesting Breaker's Soul, the manager remains calm and offers to discuss terms.

Jovian Joestar claims the security feeds are looping, which Nobu Takamine confirms via comms while splicing the footage. Jostin Joestar uses Blackstar Dominion to slam the man in the dark suit into a desk, demanding to know his identity and employer. The man explains he manages records and debts for anonymous clients and reveals that the police will arrive in ten minutes. Kaito Arashima warns the group over comms that the debt must be settled at the front desk quickly.

Jovian Joestar, Jostin, Rikona, and Kaito form a rescue team to find Noa. After tailing a man in a grey jacket to a club, Jovian and Jostin incapacitate guards and interrogate witnesses who reveal a man in a dark suit was monitoring the area. Jostin stops the suited man's getaway van with a kusarigama, forcing the handler to exit the vehicle.

Jovian Joestar drops the suited handler and demands to know the location of his backups. Jostin Joestar strikes the man in the dark suit, who insists that Noa will not be freed until 4.6 million yen is paid. Nobu Takamine broadcasts a fake earthquake warning over the intercoms to evacuate the club, while Kaito Arashima reports that backup is arriving in two minutes and a guard has radioed for help. Jovian locates a room with a fresh paper tag as the man in the dark suit remains silent.

Jostin Joestar instructs arriving backup to evacuate civilians and slams the man in the dark suit's head into a desk, demanding Noa's release. The man warns Jostin that destroying the building's records will provoke dangerous people. Rikona Mibu blocks the stairs with a kinetic barrier, while Kaito Arashima secures the front entrance as civilians exit. Jovian Joestar uses his Stand to break into a reinforced room, discovering an unharmed Noa Amemiya. Jostin alerts the group that enemies are approaching from the far wing as Kaito reports police arrival in six minutes.

Jovian Joestar used his Stand to break into the room and hurl himself and Noa Amemiya through a window onto Neon Lantern Street, though the rough landing injured Noa. Noa informed Jovian that her family's contract with the organization remains active. Kaito Arashima reported via comms that police are four minutes away. Jostin Joestar threw the man in the dark suit out the window, landing beside him to prepare an unknown action while stair guards alerted remaining security to the breach.

After learning from two women that Noa was taken to Club Kagerō, Jostin Joestar and his crew mobilize to rescue her. Jovian Joestar captures a handler to force entry into the club, while Kaito Arashima, Rikona Mibu, Haruto Saionji, Nobu Takamine, and Rin provide tactical support and intelligence. Using his abilities, Jostin bypasses security and reaches a man in the monitor room on the second floor.

Yuzuki Hoshino used her healing abilities to treat Noa Amemiya's injuries while Jovian Joestar coordinated an escape route via comms with Nobu Takamine. Jostin Joestar used his "Peach Aftershock" ability to collapse Club Kagerō into the earth, an event that prompted Rikona Mibu to evacuate the building and Mikoto Kurogane and Reiko Amagawa to clear the crowd. The man in the dark suit remained behind, stating that the organization's debts still exist despite the destruction. Kaito Arashima rallied the group to head toward the canal walkway to evade approaching police.

Jostin Joestar kicked the man in the dark suit in the mouth and insulted him before Kaito Arashima forced Jostin to retreat toward the canal walkway. As Yuzuki Hoshino supported a limping Noa Amemiya, Noa questioned if her family's debts vanished with the destroyed records. Haruto Saionji informed the group via comms that the contract still exists and asked if they intend to pay the 4.6 million yen or face the collectors.

Jostin Joestar and Rin discuss the loan's profitability via comms, but Jovian Joestar tells Haruto Saionji they intend to target the debt collectors instead of paying. Noa Amemiya asks for confirmation of this plan, while Haruto notes they will pursue leads from a courier and Rikona Mibu's memory back at Club Lumière. Reiko Amagawa reports that the man Jostin attacked matches a watcher from a previous job, and Kaito Arashima alerts the group to an idling vehicle at the end of the walkway as police approach.

Jovian Joestar guides Noa Amemiya into a getaway car driven by Hana Kisaragi, followed by Jostin Joestar and Kaito Arashima as police arrive. Jostin identifies the attacked man as one of Daigo's men, leading Haruto Saionji to instruct the group to systematically target Daigo Renjiro's subordinates. Reiko Amagawa promises to protect Noa's family shop, and Hana drives the group toward Club Lumière.

Maki Hayashida, Ayame Fujinami, Haruto Saionji, and Reiko Amagawa plan to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's legitimacy branch by targeting the Enforcement captain, Intelligence hub, and Finance office. The group collects falsified records from Sonobe and money from a warehouse before Jovian Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, and Jostin Joestar fight enforcers and steal documents from the captain. Haruto Saionji and his team publicly expose the captain through a forged document, resulting in the captain's arrest and an order for the team to avoid Kobuncho for one week.

Hana Kisaragi drives the group to Club Lumière, where Jostin Joestar boasts to Ayame Fujinami about causing an earthquake. Haruto Saionji briefs the crew on the remaining pillars of Daigo's network, citing Nobu Takamine's discovery of a grey-suited man linked to Daigo's finance network. Reiko Amagawa departs to guard the Amemiya shop, while Maki Hayashida provides Noa Amemiya with a secure room for the night. Haruto orders the group to rest until they can map out an attack on the Finance pillar tomorrow.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami if she had witnessed him beat up the captain. Ayame confirmed that she had filmed the encounter, including Jostin's destruction of a building, and intended to post the footage for her followers.

Jostin Joestar recounts assaulting a tail and destroying his archives. Rin confirms the 4.6 million yen debt is real and promises a full financial breakdown by morning, at which point Haruto Saionji and the group will decide whether to pay the debt or fight the collectors. Noa Amemiya asks for permission to call her parents and questions the crew's actual plan regarding her family's contract.

Jostin Joestar slapped the debt paperwork off the table, and Jovian Joestar informed Noa Amemiya that the crew intends to destroy the debt collectors rather than pay the 4.6 million yen. Haruto Saionji permitted Noa to make a brief, anonymous call to her parents before Yuzuki Hoshino escorted her to rest. The next morning, Rin revealed the debt had ballooned to 7.8 million yen due to interest, and Nobu Takamine linked the collectors' vehicle to the same finance network. Mikoto Kurogane argued against paying the debt, leading Haruto to call for a final group decision.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar interrogate a records manager to locate Noa Amemiya, who is being held until a 4.6 million yen debt is paid. While Nobu Takamine and Kaito Arashima manage security feeds and evacuations, Jostin assaults the manager to extract information. Jovian eventually breaks into a reinforced room and finds Noa, while the group prepares for the arrival of police and enemy reinforcements.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar enthusiastically support Mikoto Kurogane's proposal to fight the debt collectors instead of paying the 7.8 million yen. Haruto Saionji formalizes the group's decision to fight and assigns roles: Rin and Nobu will trace the lender and leasing shells, Kaito will provide overwatch, Hana will prep gear, and Ayame will film the encounter. The planning is interrupted when Haruto receives a message from Reiko stating that the collectors are currently serving Noa Amemiya's contract at her shop.

Hana Kisaragi refuses Jostin Joestar's request for new gear due to a lack of funds, providing him with repurposed charge discs instead. Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane prepare to attack the debt collectors at the Amemiya shop, though Haruto Saionji warns them to be cautious as Reiko Amagawa reports the collectors are currently unarmed. The crew arrives at Tower Five, where they locate the two collectors serving notice at the shop.

Jostin Joestar and Kaito Arashima take stealthy vantage points above the shop. Jovian Joestar, Mikoto Kurogane, and Reiko Amagawa confront the debt collectors, blocking the shop entrance and warning them against entering. Ayame Fujinami films the encounter while Haruto Saionji orders the crew not to strike first. The senior collector reads a notice demanding 7.8 million yen for Marumo Financial Services and threatens to send more men if the debt remains unpaid.

Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar facilitate the escape of Noa Amemiya and others from Club Kagerō, which Jostin collapses using "Peach Aftershock" after attacking a man in a dark suit. While Yuzuki Hoshino treats Noa’s injuries and Kaito Arashima leads the group toward a getaway vehicle to evade police, Haruto Saionji informs them that Noa's family's 4.6 million yen debt remains active. Jovian Joestar tells Haruto they will target the debt collectors, and the group plans to pursue leads from Rikona Mibu and a courier at Club Lumière.

Collector 1 sets a deadline of sundown tomorrow for the debt payment, threatening to seize the shop's inventory as collateral. Collector 2 calls for backup due to the crew's presence. Reiko Amagawa notes the call is being recorded, and Haruto Saionji orders the crew to hold their positions until the call is finished.

Jovian Joestar mocks Collector 2, who claims backup is arriving. Three men in suits arrive in a grey sedan and line up beside Collector 1, who reaffirms the sundown deadline before attempting to post the notice. Reiko Amagawa and Mikoto Kurogane block their path, while Ayame Fujinami films the arrival and Kaito Arashima and Nobu Takamine trace the vehicle's registration to Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing. Haruto Saionji orders the crew to hold their positions.

Yoshida posts the notice on the shop shutter before the collectors depart, with Kato alerting his office that the encounter was filmed. While returning to Club Lumière, Hana and the crew encounter twelve smugglers unloading glowing crates in a narrow passage, but Haruto orders a peaceful retreat to avoid a fight. At the club, Rin presents a map of Marumo's courier routes and cash runs. Haruto proposes either tailing the cash or infiltrating as clients to find the money's destination, noting that the deadline means Marumo will seize the shop's inventory by tomorrow evening.

Jovian Joestar, Hana Kisaragi, Jostin Joestar, and Kaito Arashima escort Noa Amemiya to Club Lumière after Jostin attacks one of Daigo Renjiro's men. Haruto Saionji instructs the group to target Daigo's subordinates, while Reiko Amagawa guards Noa's family shop and Maki Hayashida provides Noa with a room. After Rin reveals Noa's debt has increased to 7.8 million yen, Haruto calls for a final group decision on whether to pay the debt or fight the collectors.

Jovian Joestar proposes infiltrating Marumo's operation by posing as wealthy clients, leveraging the historical ties between the Saionji and Joestar families. Haruto Saionji agrees, provided the cover is airtight to avoid detection. Rin identifies Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing's flagship branch as the target, while Nobu Takamine offers to forge the necessary business documentation and Ayame Fujinami prepares a hidden camera for Jovian's jacket. Mikoto Kurogane and Hana Kisaragi agree to provide exterior backup and transportation once the paperwork is ready.

Haruto Saionji and Jovian Joestar enter the Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing flagship branch, posing as wealthy clients from Saionji Holdings and Joestar. Haruto presents forged documents provided by Nobu Takamine, who warns the duo via comms that the cover will fail if the receptionist performs a detailed audit. While Hana Kisaragi and Mikoto Kurogane provide exterior backup with a sleeping Jostin Joestar, the receptionist begins to verify the account manager, prompting Nobu to urgently tell the pair to conclude the interaction.

Jovian Joestar interrupts the receptionist's verification process by demanding to see a manager, prompting her to summon a senior account manager. The manager offers Haruto Saionji a trial placement involving a modest sum to be collected by a courier tomorrow night at a designated address. Kaito Arashima notes via comms that this courier window coincides with Marumo's planned visit to Noa's shop.

Haruto Saionji hires Rin for a probation period in the Command division, where she implements a financial plan and event protocols approved by Jovian Joestar and Nobu Takamine. The team successfully manages a trial event at Club Lumière with the help of Jostin, Hana Kisaragi, and Yuzuki Hoshino. Later, Rikona Mibu informs Jovian and Jostin that debt collectors are targeting the Amemiya family shop, leading Jostin to invite Rikona to join their crew.

Nobu Takamine updates a groggy Jostin Joestar on the shell firm's trial placement, which requires a cash collection tomorrow night. After Haruto Saionji accepts the manager's contact card and exits the building, the crew regathers to discuss the conflict between the courier window and Marumo's planned visit to Noa's shop. Kaito Arashima suggests tailing the courier, but Hana Kisaragi warns that doing so could jeopardize the trial. Haruto notes the crew cannot be at full strength in both locations, while Reiko Amagawa offers to hold the shop alone until sundown.

Jovian Joestar assigns Jostin, Kaito, and Haruto to the cash run, while Rin, Hana, and Nobu serve as the ops team. Haruto confirms the pickup for tomorrow after sundown at Shutter Alley in Kobuncho, noting the courier will only wait a few minutes. Mikoto, Reiko, Ayame, and Yuzuki prepare to protect Noa's shop, with Reiko agreeing to hold the location until the cash run team finishes.

Jostin spends the night practicing "Peach Flash Step" in the storage room, though the technique strains his legs. Hana verifies the cash total while Nobu maps Shutter Alley's sightlines and exit routes via drone. The next afternoon, the cash run team enters Shutter Alley as the shop team takes positions at the Amemiya storefront. Mikoto coordinates the shop's defense, placing Reiko at the entrance, Ayame at a window, and Yuzuki inside with Noa.

After Jovian and Jostin Joestar support Mikoto Kurogane's proposal to fight debt collectors, Haruto Saionji assigns the crew roles to track the lenders and prepare gear. The group confronts two collectors from Marumo Financial Services at Noa Amemiya's shop in Tower Five, where Ayame Fujinami films the encounter. The collectors demand 7.8 million yen by the following sundown, threatening to seize inventory, while Collector 2 calls for backup.

Jovian proposes stalling the courier to find his boss, but Haruto refuses to risk the trial placement. Haruto hands the cash to the courier, Kenjiro Sato, who departs without further interaction. Kaito and Jostin begin tailing Sato while Nobu maintains drone surveillance. Simultaneously, Yoshida and Kato arrive at the Amemiya shop to collect debt or seize inventory, where they are confronted by Mikoto and Reiko.

Kenjiro Sato delivers the cash packet to an obscured grey sedan at the waterfront, as confirmed by Kaito via comms. Meanwhile, Haruto informs Jostin that they must eliminate the Finance and Intelligence captains before targeting Daigo, clarifying that the trial funds came from his own stake. At the Amemiya shop, Yoshida asserts his legal right to seize inventory despite Ayame's filming, ignoring Kato's nervous suggestion to retreat.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Ayame Fujinami briefed Jostin Joestar on a two-part operation to protect the Amemiya family's inventory and tail a courier carrying trial cash. She explained that the mission aimed to trace money from Marumo Financial Services back to a finance captain linked to Kurokawa to resolve Noa's debt. The two shared a playful exchange regarding their relationship status before Jostin departed for his assignment.

Jovian asks Haruto about his family's wealth, but Haruto refuses to discuss figures. Haruto directs the group to track the courier via Nobu's drone rather than on foot, leading Kaito to break off his trail and wait for further orders. Nobu tracks the sedan into a gated lot and sends the license plate to Rin for identification. At the Amemiya shop, Yoshida orders Kato to photograph inventory for seizure, prompting Reiko and Mikoto to physically block him while Ayame films the encounter.

After collectors attempt to post a notice on a shop, Haruto Saionji and his crew trace the collectors' vehicle to Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing. To locate Marumo's cash runs before a sundown deadline, Haruto and Jovian Joestar infiltrate the leasing branch posing as wealthy clients using forged documents from Nobu Takamine. While Hana Kisaragi and Mikoto Kurogane provide exterior backup, the receptionist begins an audit that prompts Nobu to tell the duo to end the interaction.

Rin identifies the courier's vehicle as belonging to Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing and a nameless leased lot. Haruto orders Jostin and Kaito to return to the club for debriefing while Nobu logs the building layout via drone. At the shop, Reiko threatens to make the dispute public unless Yoshida removes the seizure tags, but Yoshida ignores her and orders Kato to continue photographing inventory. Ayame records the encounter for evidence. The cash team returns to Club Lumière, where Rin and Hana prepare to begin the debriefing.

At Club Lumière, Haruto, Rin, and Nobu brief Jovian on the cash delivery, identifying a gated lot linked to Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing as the destination. Meanwhile, at the shop, two heavies attempt to drag Reiko away, but she pins one while Mikoto uses a Riot Pulse to knock the other back. Yoshida and Kato flee the scene, leaving their seizure tags behind. Ayame records the altercation as evidence, and Reiko declares the shop clear.

Jovian Joestar establishes a two-branch structure consisting of "Spearhead" under himself and "Hearth" under Jostin, leaving seven seats open for recruitment. Haruto, Rin, Hana, and Nobu discuss the logistical and financial requirements for these roles, emphasizing the need for vetting, skill tests, and counter-intel screening. Kaito and Mirei suggest specific needs for an Infiltrator and a Community Liaison. Reiko approves the reorganization via comms and asks which seats will be prioritized first.

After Jovian Joestar secures a trial cash placement for Haruto Saionji from a senior account manager, the crew coordinates two simultaneous operations. Jostin, Kaito, and Haruto handle the cash pickup at Shutter Alley in Kobuncho, while Mikoto, Reiko, Ayame, and Yuzuki protect Noa's shop. Nobu and Hana provide operational support through mapping and financial verification before the teams deploy to their respective locations.

Jovian Joestar prioritizes filling the Infiltrator and Forge hand roles first. Jostin Joestar declares that recruitment is handled by himself and Jovian, and confirms that members will not receive salaries. Reiko Amagawa clarifies that she manages discipline and training, while noting that Maki Hayashida—not Mirei Tachibana—runs Lumiere House. Mirei agrees to scout for the Liaison role, and the group shifts focus to finding an Infiltrator for the Kurosaki job.

Jovian Joestar tasks Jostin Joestar with finding an infiltrator to exploit a blind spot in the Kurosaki shell company. Jostin assigns Ayame Fujinami to lead the "Lantern Network" for intelligence gathering, a role Ayame accepts provided she sets the editorial rules. Mirei Tachibana offers the support of her hostesses on the condition that the women remain safe, and Maki Hayashida offers Lumiere House for briefings. After Mikoto Kurogane requests a data feed for the Vanguard, Reiko Amagawa prompts the brothers to decide between targeting the Kurosaki lot or the captains.

Jovian Joestar and Rikona Mibu investigate Noa Amemiya's disappearance with Haruto Saionji, Rin, and Nobu Takamine. Jovian and Jostin Joestar track a man in a grey jacket to a club, where they incapacitate guards and intercept a suited man's getaway van. The team infiltrates Club Kagerō, where Jovian rescues Noa from a reinforced room after Jostin and Jovian interrogate a records manager regarding a 4.6 million yen debt.

Jovian Joestar rejects Jostin Joestar's plan for an immediate strike, prioritizing a rematch with Kaito Serizawa tomorrow night. Jovian and Haruto Saionji establish a recon-only plan for the Kurosaki lot: Nobu Takamine will deploy a drone, Rin will trace the lease, Kaito Arashima will scout overwatch positions, and Hana Kisaragi will prepare basic equipment. Ayame Fujinami and Mirei Tachibana agree to use the Lantern Network to gather intelligence on grey sedans and the leasing company. Rin confirms the lot is funded by Marumo Financial, linking it to the finance captain.

Conversation with Rin: Jovian Joestar commented that Rin's personality had changed following a makeover, but Rin denied this, claiming the new look only enhanced her sarcasm. Rin further clarified that her loyalty to the Joestar Gang was based on the steady pay and the lack of physical abuse compared to previous employment.

Jovian Joestar retreats to nap and requests that Rin forge a school excuse letter so he can focus on his upcoming rematch. Haruto Saionji finalizes the recon operation, with Kaito Arashima pairing with Maki Hayashida for rooftop scouting and Nobu Takamine pairing with Hana Kisaragi for drone surveillance. After Jostin Joestar returns to the academy dorms, Haruto reports the next morning that a grey sedan visited the lot briefly near dawn.

Ayame Fujinami tasked Jostin Joestar with protecting the Amemiya shop and tracking a courier to trace Marumo Financial Services funds. Haruto, Nobu, Kaito, and Jostin monitored the courier, Kenjiro Sato, as he delivered cash to a vehicle identified by Rin as a Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing lease. Simultaneously, Yoshida and Kato attempted to seize inventory from the Amemiya shop while being blocked by Reiko and Mikoto and filmed by Ayame.

Haruto Saionji texts Jostin Joestar instructions for the day, designating Jostin as the extraction lead for the upcoming rematch at Tetsu Gym. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar spars with Reiko Amagawa in the alley behind Club Lumiere to warm up his reflexes. Reiko enforces light contact and grapples, ultimately advising Jovian to fix his footing on right-hand strikes before the match.

Jostin Joestar attempts to pay Hana Kisaragi privately to craft "Peach Snares" for tonight's extraction mission, but Hana and Rin refuse based on crew policy and audit requirements. Hana agrees to review the schematics only if Jostin retrieves coffee for her from Rin's hidden stash in the Vault. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar travels across Kobuncho and arrives at the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym to face Kaito Serizawa for a rematch.

Jostin Joestar asks Hana Kisaragi why Jovian is fighting Kaito Serizawa; Hana explains that Serizawa requested a rematch and Jovian agreed. Rin mandates that Jostin retrieve her coffee from the Vault before Hana will build the cord spools. Meanwhile, Jovian arrives at the gym for his rematch, and Kaito Serizawa invites him to warm up on the heavy bags before their 8:00 PM match.

Jostin Joestar retrieves Rin's coffee from the Vault and delivers it to Hana Kisaragi, who promises the cord spools will be finished by evening. After teasing Ayame Fujinami and Rin, Jostin travels to the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar and Kaito Serizawa warm up on the heavy bags, with Kaito providing form corrections. Jostin arrives at the gym in the late afternoon to offer Jovian moral support before the match.

Haruto, Rin, and Nobu brief Jovian on a cash delivery at a Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing lot, while Reiko, Mikoto, and Ayame repel two attackers at the shop. Jovian and Jostin establish a two-branch organizational structure and prioritize recruiting an infiltrator and a forge hand. Jostin assigns Ayame to lead the Lantern Network, while Mirei and Maki offer scouting and facility support for the mission.

Jostin Joestar shouts for Riko Amane, who emerges and orders him to perform twenty minutes of Stillpoint reps. Kaito Serizawa interrupts to have Jovian Joestar demonstrate his "Twin Soul" technique on the heavy bags. Despite technical advice from Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara, Jovian's synchronized attack fails due to poor timing and a drifting heel, resulting in a recoil that knocks him back. Kaito identifies the synchronization error and instructs Jovian to fix his lead and footwork for a second attempt.

Kaito Serizawa corrected Jovian Joestar's footwork, enabling Jovian to successfully execute the "Twin Soul" technique. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar attempted to lift his limiter during Stillpoint reps, causing him to lunge violently toward a heavy bag. Kaito and Genta Oda intercepted and pinned Jostin to the mat to prevent injury. Riko Amane ordered that Jostin must use a spotter for all future attempts at the technique.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar apologized for briefly losing control. Riko Amane held onto his shoulder and cautioned him against acting alone.

Riko Amane comforts Jostin Joestar after his failed attempt, informing him that she will spot him in the future but not tonight. Jovian Joestar meditates for an hour to refine his timing and synchronize his movements. Haruto Saionji arrives to deliver equipment from Hana, including an extraction kit for Jostin, and announces he will be cornering Jovian. Ayame Fujinami proposes live-streaming a sanctioned rematch, which Kaito Serizawa agrees to provided his corner is not filmed.

Jovian Joestar rejects Jostin Joestar's strike plan to prioritize a rematch with Kaito Serizawa at Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. Jovian and Haruto Saionji coordinate a recon operation at the Kurosaki lot involving Nobu Takamine, Rin, Kaito Arashima, Hana Kisaragi, Ayame Fujinami, and Mirei Tachibana. After sparring with Reiko Amagawa and declining Jostin's private payment attempt, Jovian arrives at the gym for his match.

Riko Amane informs Jostin Joestar that Jovian's rematch is a test of control to avoid further gym damage. Ayame Fujinami begins live-streaming the event, while Kaito Serizawa agrees to participate provided his corner remains off-camera. Tetsu establishes that the match will be scored by touch rather than damage, warning the fighters against breaking the floor. Jovian Joestar enters the ring and deploys Sovereign's Will, creating a crushing pressure that Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara note is carefully controlled. The match begins with Kaito launching a low jab, which Jovian slips as the two exchange blows.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar told Riko Amane not to blink. Riko responded with a grin and remained focused on the match, noting that the first real exchange was the most important part to watch.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami to ensure she was capturing his best side while filming. Ayame adjusted her camera and teased him about a previous stumble, promising to edit the footage to make him appear heroic.

Jostin Joestar urges Kaito Serizawa to release an aura, which Kaito dismisses. Jovian Joestar fakes a frontal rush and uses Phantom Strike to score several touches on Kaito's ribs and shoulder, containing the resulting shockwave within the mat's edge. Tetsu confirms the touches were scored, while Ayame Fujinami live-streams the fight. Haruto Saionji instructs Ayame to blur the gym's location to maintain its neutrality. Masaru Hachiya and Sayaka Mizuhara note Jovian's successful control, and Kaito resets his stance for the next exchange.

Jostin Joestar urged Kaito Serizawa to use a Stand, which Kaito denied having. Kaito launched an Iron Palm Strike at Jovian Joestar, but Jovian used "Soul Eclipse" to catch the blow and throw Kaito onto the mat. Tetsu awarded the first round to Jovian, and Haruto Saionji provided water while checking Jovian's condition. Ayame Fujinami broadcast the counter to her viewers, and Masaru Hachiya logged the technique as Jovian prepared for round two.

After Kenji Aoi challenges Jovian Joestar, Yuzuki Hoshino acts as a stand-in fighter and defeats Kenji with help from Mikoto Kurogane and Rikona Mibu. Rikona asks Jostin and Jovian to help rescue abducted debtors, leading Haruto Saionji to organize a mission at a bunker in Steam Lantern Alley. The group infiltrates the facility, where Jovian and Jostin defeat various opponents, including Banda and Tatsuya, to rescue Shun and other captives.

Jostin Joestar challenged Jovian Joestar to fight without using his Stand. After Tetsu signaled the start of round two, Kaito Serizawa landed a measured strike, which Jovian ignored to drink and pour water over his head. Jovian then used Breaker's Soul's "Heaven's Impact" to slam Kaito into the mat, leaving him winded but conscious. Tetsu and Masaru Hachiya praised Jovian's precision for avoiding collateral damage, while Haruto Saionji noted that Jovian is nearing his physical limit for the night.

Kaito Serizawa attacked with palm-heel strikes, scoring a shallow hit on Jovian Joestar's cheek. Jovian responded with "Fifth Form: Falling Star Palm," blasting Kaito across the mat and causing deep "Soul Burn" cracks on his own arm. Tetsu ended the bout and declared Jovian the winner after Kaito conceded. As Ayame Fujinami streamed the victory, Riko Amane spotted two unknown men in suits entering the gym and demanding to see the broadcaster.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar checked on Ayame Fujinami as she remained focused on two mysterious men in suits. After Jostin offered his support, Ayame agreed to go on a date with him if he could keep her safe and the stream running.

Jostin Joestar uses Eagle Vision to detect three hostile men, including one outside the gym. Riko Amane and Ayame Fujinami prepare for a confrontation while Ayame continues streaming the event. Tetsu, Haruto Saionji, and Kaito Serizawa block the entrance to protect Ayame after Suited Man 1 demands she come with them to satisfy an unnamed client. Suited Man 1 threatens that Ayame will leave the gym regardless of whether she chooses to do so.

Hana Kisaragi tells Jostin Joestar that Jovian Joestar is fighting Kaito Serizawa after retrieving Rin's coffee from the Vault. At the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym, Kaito helps Jovian correct his footwork to successfully execute the "Twin Soul" technique. Riko Amane orders Jostin to perform Stillpoint reps, but Kaito and Genta Oda must pin him to the mat after he lunges violently during a limiter lift attempt.

Jovian Joestar, exhausted, asks Jostin to handle the situation alone. Jostin uses Blackstar Dominion to knock down two suited men, then hauls them into the street and pins them to the pavement. While Haruto Saionji evacuates the gym's students and Ayame Fujinami streams the event, Jostin demands to know who sent the men. Suited Man 1 refuses to give a name, citing a client, while a third man watches silently from a nearby car.

Jovian Joestar, supported by Genta and Sayaka, retreats to the rear corridor. Haruto Saionji leads Ayame Fujinami and Riko Amane out the back door, ending Ayame's livestream. Out front, Jostin Joestar uses Blackstar Dominion to pin three men to the pavement and brutally beats Suited Man 2, who manages to land one hit on Jostin's hip. The third man, Kazuya Oka, surrenders and states that his client's terms will wait to ensure a girl's identity remains hidden.

Riko Amane cautions Jostin Joestar after his failed attempt while Jovian Joestar meditates and receives equipment from Haruto Saionji. Ayame Fujinami live-streams a sanctioned match between Jovian and Kaito Serizawa, which Tetsu scores by touch. Jovian uses Phantom Strike and Soul Eclipse to score points and throw Kaito, winning the first round.

Conversation with suited man 2: Jostin Joestar asked a wounded man in a suit if he had finished bleeding on the pavement. The man responded by spitting blood and claiming that he would be paid regardless of the situation.

Jostin Joestar masks his face and kills Suited Man 2 by stomping his head into the pavement. Jostin then brutally beats Kazuya Oka for threatening his gym and girlfriend, leaving Oka severely injured and barely conscious. Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara attempt to shield Jovian Joestar from the violence, though Jovian watches and mocks the attackers. Matsumoto attempts to surrender, but his phone begins to ring.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar asked Riko Amane if she was alright. Riko replied that she was fine but questioned the well-being of others after Jostin had violently attacked them.

Jovian Joestar mocks the defeated attackers while Sayaka Mizuhara warns that further killing will endanger the gym. Ignoring her, Jostin Joestar kills Kazuya Oka with a neck jab and slams Matsumoto's head into the pavement, injuring his own calf in the process. Jostin seizes Matsumoto's ringing phone and answers it, only for an anonymous caller to state that the "bill" has increased before hanging up.

Jovian Joestar urges his group to flee the scene, prompting Haruto Saionji to prepare the getaway car. Jostin Joestar brutally beats Matsumoto until he is barely conscious, at which point Matsumoto tells Jostin that the caller's number is in the phone's log. While Riko Amane and Ayame Fujinami secure the perimeter and footage, Jostin vows to track the caller upon returning to the club. Tetsu orders the group to leave, stating he will handle the aftermath while reminding them of the cost to his gym.

Conversation with Riko Amane: Jostin Joestar asked Riko Amane how she was doing. Riko responded with a flat look, criticizing his priorities given that two bodies were on the pavement and sirens were approaching.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar asked Ayame Fujinami if she was alright while she packed up her streaming equipment. Ayame responded with a smile and noted that she was doing better than the security guards outside. She then questioned Jostin's well-being after noticing blood on his knuckles.

Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji cancel tonight's mission so the group can recover. After Genta Oda and Sayaka Mizuhara agree to maintain silence about the incident, Riko Amane reports the injuries to an unknown party via burner phone. Back at Club Lumière, Yuzuki Hoshino treats Jostin Joestar's injuries while Nobu Takamine and Haruto Saionji begin tracing the caller's prepaid phone. Nobu believes he can pinpoint the caller's district by morning due to a routing error in the final hop.

Jovian Joestar defeated Kaito Serizawa in a fight, winning the bout after using "Falling Star Palm" to blast Kaito across the mat. Following the match, three suited men arrived at the gym and demanded that Ayame Fujinami accompany them to satisfy a client. Jostin Joestar used Blackstar Dominion to defeat the men and pinned them to the street, where he questioned them about their employer.

Nobu Takamine attempted to trace a call from a dead man's phone while Jostin Joestar dialed the most recent contact. An unidentified caller claimed the Amemiya account increased by the cost of three men before hanging up, leaving Nobu unable to pinpoint a location until morning. Haruto Saionji ordered the group to wait for the results. Jovian Joestar slept in a booth at Club Lumière after receiving tea from Maki Hayashida, waking the next morning to find Nobu and Haruto already working.

Jostin Joestar wakes in the back office and texts Riko Amane, who informs him that the gym is quiet but mentions Jostin claimed Ayame Fujinami was his girlfriend. Ayame confronts Jostin about this claim, demanding he tell her directly. Meanwhile, Nobu Takamine traces the unidentified caller to a few blocks near Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji reports that the Amemiya shop received a larger notice overnight and halts all movement until the crew decides on a plan.

Nobu Takamine narrows the unidentified caller's location to two blocks on Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji reads a final notice demanding 5.9 million yen by Monday, leading Jovian Joestar to conclude the Finance Captain is responsible. Meanwhile, Jostin Joestar apologizes to Ayame Fujinami for lying about their relationship and asks her on a date, which she accepts.

Jovian and Jostin Joestar help Noa Amemiya escape Club Kagerō, after which Haruto Saionji informs the group that Noa's family debt has increased to 7.8 million yen. Following a decision to fight the collectors, the group confronts Marumo Financial Services agents at Noa's shop in Tower Five. Haruto and Jovian then infiltrate Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing using Nobu Takamine's forged documents to locate the lenders' cash runs.

Jostin Joestar denies a romantic relationship with Riko to Ayame Fujinami and reaffirms their date for after the current crisis. The group assembles in the Main Lounge, where Jovian Joestar calls for a strategic plan to pressure the loan office on Neon Lantern Street. Haruto Saionji proposes three options: an undercover audit using his family name, a direct heist of the records room, or a reconnaissance mission using Ayame's camera and Nobu's drone. Rin warns the crew that the office serves as a central hub for counting and moving the collectors' cash.

Conversation with Ayame Fujinami: Jostin Joestar remarked that he should have gone for a kiss. Ayame Fujinami responded playfully, suggesting she could create a "blooper reel" of the near-miss moment.

Jovian Joestar delegates the mission strategy to Jostin Joestar, who expresses frustration over the escalating debt and failing leads. Rin warns Jostin that aggressive tactics only hinder their progress. Haruto Saionji proposes a multi-stage plan: Nobu's drone will map the office on Friday, Ayame will gather intelligence via hostesses, and Haruto and Rin will use the Saionji name to enter the office on Saturday to secure proof.

Haruto Saionji corrects the timeline and outlines a four-day roadmap on a whiteboard: drone scouting Friday, intelligence gathering Saturday, action Sunday, and debt eradication Monday. Rin clarifies that the debt is a fabricated number used to seize real assets and people from the Amemiya family. Haruto assigns Jovian Joestar the role of reserve, instructing him to rest and remain available to intervene if the weekend operations fail.

Jostin Joestar pins three men to the pavement, killing Suited Man 2 and Kazuya Oka while severely injuring Matsumoto. After answering a call from an anonymous person on Matsumoto's phone, Jostin beats him until Matsumoto reveals the caller's number is in the log. Tetsu orders the group, including Jovian Joestar, Haruto Saionji, Riko Amane, and Ayame Fujinami, to flee the gym.

Haruto Saionji dismisses the group for the day, scheduling the next rendezvous for Saturday morning at Club Lumière. Jovian Joestar accompanies Yuzuki Hoshino to her shadowing shift with Dr. Kiyose at the academy, while Ayame Fujinami deflects classmate inquiries about her fight footage. Later that evening, Nobu Takamine notifies the crew via text that drone footage confirms the loan office is the counting hub, noting its staffing and layout.

Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami shared a brief kiss and a promise of safety before Ayame returned to her dorm. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar feigned an injury to get Yuzuki Hoshino's attention, leading to a kiss that left Yuzuki flustered. On Saturday morning, the crew gathered at Club Lumière where Haruto Saionji and Rin confirmed the loan office as the counting hub. Haruto outlined the mission plan: he and Rin will enter through the front door using the Saionji name, while Jostin leads the field team outside.

Jovian Joestar opts out of the mission to remain at the lounge. Haruto Saionji coordinates the team, placing Jostin in the field and Hana at the rear door as backup. Haruto and Rin enter the loan office as auditors, where the manager questions Rin's verification of a specific courier run. Rin refuses to provide the figure until the branch's ledger is confirmed.

The Loan Office Manager leads Haruto and Rin to the records room, where Rin secretly photographs Noa Amemiya's file and notes a courier's cash collection schedule. After the manager briefly leaves and returns to approve the audit, Haruto and Rin exit the office. Jovian Joestar leaves Club Lumière to follow the team and observes from an alley as a staff member from the loan office begins tailing Haruto and Rin.

After a violent incident, Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji cancel a mission so the group can recover at Club Lumière. While Yuzuki Hoshino treats Jostin Joestar's injuries, Nobu Takamine traces a call from an unidentified person who mentioned the Amemiya account to Neon Lantern Street. Haruto reports a 5.9 million yen demand on the Amemiya shop, leading Jovian to identify the Finance Captain as the responsible party, while Jostin apologizes to Ayame Fujinami for lying about their relationship and secures a date with her.

While Jostin Joestar monitors the area from a nearby storefront, a sedan cuts off Haruto Saionji and Rin on Neon Lantern Street. Three collectors emerge to seize Rin's phone and Haruto's folders, prompting both Haruto and Rin to demand they release the items. Nobu Takamine alerts the team via comms, and Jostin and Jovian Joestar move to intercept the collectors.

Conversation with Haruto Saionji: Jostin Joestar offered to intervene in a tense situation. Haruto Saionji declined, choosing to let their opponents believe they were cornered to better read their movements.

Collectors seize Rin's phone and Haruto's folders, shoving Rin to the pavement and striking Haruto in the mouth. The collectors and an extra man flee in a sedan heading east on Neon Lantern Street. Nobu Takamine deploys a drone to track the vehicle, while Haruto notes the license plate for a report. Jostin and Jovian Joestar observe the pursuit from their positions, with Jovian deferring to Jostin as the lead.
